    • Water treatment
    • Thermal systems
    • Industrial product development

Technical Skills

  • Engineering calculations and data analysis
  • Water chemistry and treatment fundamentals
  • Technical report writing
  • Product testing and validation
  • Project management
  • Customer-facing engineering support

Preferred Experience

  • Evaporative cooling systems
  • Data center cooling applications
  • Heat transfer and thermodynamics
  • ASHRAE participation
  • WateReuse participation
  • Product certification programs
  • CFD, modeling tools, or performance simulation software

  • 401K retirement savings plan with employer matching
  • Professional development opportunities, including tuition reimbursement, and conference attendance
  • Company-sponsored social events and team-building activities
  • State-of-the-art equipment and tools to support your work

Equal Opportunity Employer: We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. All offers are contingent on a pre-employment drug test and background check, as applicable for the position.

jobs.title: Account Executive — Aerospace & Mission Systems
jobs.excerpt: Account Executive — Aerospace & Mission SystemsRole OverviewDefense Unicorns is seeking an Account Executive to lead business development and revenue growth across the aerospace market, including rotary-wing aircraft, fixed-wing aircraft, and space launch systems.
jobs.description:
Account Executive — Aerospace & Mission Systems

Role Overview

Defense Unicorns is seeking an Account Executive to lead business development and revenue growth across the aerospace market, including rotary-wing aircraft, fixed-wing aircraft, and space launch systems.

This role will work with aircraft manufacturers, aerospace and defense primes, subsystem providers, mission-system integrators, launch providers, Federal Systems Integrators, and government program offices responsible for developing, modernizing, and sustaining complex aerospace platforms.

The Account Executive will identify opportunities where Defense Unicorns can help customers modernize how software is built, integrated, secured, deployed, and sustained across aerospace and mission systems.

A core focus of this role will be understanding environments where traditional platform development requires highly isolated or platform-specific engineering efforts—including SAP/SAR environments, classified systems, specialized integration laboratories, and programs where software delivery is tightly coupled to an individual platform.

The Account Executive will work closely with Solutions Architects and technical teams to help customers identify opportunities to introduce modern cloud-native software practices, DevSecOps, digital engineering, modeling and simulation, and onboard compute architectures that enable mission owners to deploy new capabilities more rapidly.

The ideal candidate understands both the aerospace acquisition ecosystem and the technical evolution occurring across modern mission systems: from vertically integrated platform software toward modular, software-defined architectures that allow mission applications and capabilities to be developed, tested, delivered, and updated independently of the underlying platform.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own pipeline creation, account strategy, opportunity development, and revenue across the aerospace market, including rotary-wing, fixed-wing, and space launch programs.
  • Develop strategic relationships with aerospace primes, aircraft manufacturers, launch providers, mission-system integrators, subsystem vendors, Federal Systems Integrators, and government program offices.
  • Identify aerospace programs where modern software architectures can reduce platform-specific engineering, accelerate mission capability delivery, and improve software sustainment.
  • Work with customers to understand how software is currently developed, integrated, tested, accredited, deployed, and maintained across their platforms.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce duplicated or isolated engineering efforts across aircraft, spacecraft, test environments, integration laboratories, and mission systems.
  • Understand the unique constraints associated with SAP/SAR, classified, air-gapped, disconnected, and highly controlled engineering environments.
  • Work closely with Solutions Architects to map Defense Unicorns capabilities into aerospace platform architectures, mission computers, onboard compute environments, ground systems, integration facilities, and software factories.
  • Develop account and opportunity strategies that connect technical modernization efforts to program priorities, funding, acquisition pathways, and mission outcomes.
  • Engage early in platform modernization and next-generation aircraft or spacecraft programs where software architecture decisions are still being formed.
  • Develop opportunities around modular mission-system architectures that allow mission capabilities to evolve independently of the underlying vehicle.
  • Build relationships across engineering leadership, program management, digital engineering teams, software organizations, acquisition stakeholders, and executive leadership.
  • Partner with Defense Unicorns Product, Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Marketing, Contracts, and leadership teams to advance strategic aerospace opportunities.
  • Maintain disciplined opportunity management, including stakeholder mapping, technical fit, decision criteria, funding pathways, competitive positioning, next actions, and forecast.
  • Represent Defense Unicorns at aerospace industry events, customer engagements, technical demonstrations, program reviews, and partner discussions.
  • Capture recurring market requirements and customer challenges to help influence Defense Unicorns product strategy and aerospace go-to-market approach.

Mission Systems & Onboard Compute

A major focus of this role will be helping customers understand how modern onboard compute architectures can change the way mission capabilities are delivered to aircraft and other aerospace platforms.

The Account Executive should understand concepts such as Open Mission Systems and other modular mission-computing approaches that separate mission applications from tightly coupled platform software.

These architectures can enable mission owners to deploy new applications, algorithms, data-processing capabilities, autonomy, sensor integrations, or mission workflows onto existing platforms without requiring a complete redesign of the underlying aircraft or mission system.

The Account Executive will work with technical teams to identify where Defense Unicorns can support:

  • Packaging and deploying mission applications onto onboard compute modules.
  • Establishing repeatable and secure software deployment patterns across heterogeneous aerospace platforms.
  • Managing software across ground, test, integration, and operational environments.
  • Enabling mission owners to rapidly introduce new capabilities while maintaining appropriate platform and security boundaries.
  • Reducing the engineering burden associated with porting software independently to every aircraft or mission system.
  • Creating a consistent software delivery layer across multiple platforms, compute architectures, and security environments.

Digital Engineering, Model & Simulation

The Account Executive should understand the growing role of digital engineering across aerospace programs.

This includes familiarity with how modeling and simulation, digital twins, hardware-in-the-loop environments, software-in-the-loop environments, integration laboratories, and digital engineering ecosystems contribute to the development and sustainment of aerospace platforms.

The role will identify opportunities where software infrastructure can help connect these environments and create more consistent workflows from development through integration and operational deployment.

The Account Executive should be able to engage customers around questions such as:

  • How can software move consistently from a developer environment into model and simulation, integration labs, flight test, and operational systems?
  • How can programs reduce differences between engineering, testing, and operational environments?
  • How can digital twins and simulated environments support faster development and validation of mission software?
  • How can software artifacts be securely promoted between security boundaries and isolated environments?
  • How can programs create repeatable DevSecOps pipelines while operating across disconnected or highly controlled networks?
  • How can capabilities validated in a digital engineering environment be more easily transitioned onto operational platforms?

DevSecOps & Software Delivery

The Account Executive should be familiar with modern DevSecOps practices and how they apply within aerospace programs.

This includes understanding the challenges of delivering software into environments where traditional enterprise cloud patterns may not apply, including classified networks, disconnected systems, onboard compute, integration laboratories, embedded environments, and aircraft or spacecraft operating at the tactical edge.

The role does not require the Account Executive to be the technical architect, but they must have enough technical fluency to recognize where software delivery, containerization, orchestration, artifact management, security, and automation can materially change the economics and speed of a program.

Working in SAP/SAR & Isolated Environments

Many aerospace programs require development and integration efforts to operate inside highly restricted or isolated environments.

The Account Executive should understand the business and engineering implications of Special Access Programs, Special Access Required environments, classified networks, air-gapped systems, and other restricted development environments.

They should recognize the operational impact when each program or platform requires its own isolated software factory, integration workflow, tooling stack, or engineering team.

A key part of the role will be identifying opportunities to create reusable patterns, software components, deployment approaches, and architectures that allow customers to maintain required isolation while reducing unnecessary duplication across programs.

Partnership With Solutions Architecture

The Account Executive will operate in close partnership with a Solutions Architect.

The Account Executive owns the business and account strategy, including:

  • Identifying strategic programs and customers.
  • Developing executive and program-level relationships.
  • Understanding acquisition and funding pathways.
  • Building the opportunity and competitive strategy.
  • Navigating partner and prime relationships.
  • Driving commercial negotiations and closing business.

The Solutions Architect owns the technical architecture, including:

  • Understanding platform and mission-system architectures.
  • Mapping software and data flows.
  • Evaluating onboard compute environments.
  • Designing deployment approaches.
  • Working through disconnected and classified architectures.
  • Developing demonstrations, prototypes, and reference architectures.

Together, the AE and SA should be capable of engaging with a customer at the platform architecture level and helping them develop both the technical and programmatic path toward a more modular, software-defined aerospace system.

What Success Looks Like

A successful Account Executive in this role will establish Defense Unicorns as a strategic partner to organizations building and modernizing aerospace platforms.

They will understand that the opportunity is not simply to sell software into an aircraft program.

The opportunity is to help customers fundamentally change how mission software is developed and delivered across fleets of aircraft, spacecraft, test environments, and mission systems.

They will be able to identify situations where each platform currently requires unique engineering and help customers envision architectures where common software infrastructure, modular compute, digital engineering, and DevSecOps allow capabilities to move across platforms more rapidly.

Over time, the Account Executive should help customers transition from thinking about software as a tightly integrated component of an individual aircraft to thinking about software as a continuously evolving mission capability that can be securely deployed across a portfolio of platforms.

Desired Experience

  • Demonstrated success selling complex technology, mission systems, software, or engineering capabilities into aerospace and defense markets.
  • Experience working with rotary-wing aircraft, fixed-wing aircraft, space systems, launch systems, mission systems, or adjacent aerospace programs.
  • Strong understanding of the aerospace and defense ecosystem, including OEMs, primes, government program offices, mission-system integrators, subsystem providers, and Federal Systems Integrators.
  • Familiarity with SAP/SAR programs, classified environments, air-gapped networks, and highly controlled engineering environments.
  • Familiarity with Open Mission Systems, modular open systems architectures, mission computers, onboard compute, or similar mission-system concepts.
  • Familiarity with digital engineering, digital twins, modeling and simulation, software-in-the-loop, hardware-in-the-loop, and systems integration laboratories.
  • Understanding of DevSecOps, software factories, containerization, cloud-native technologies, software supply chains, and modern application deployment.
  • Ability to understand complex system architectures and engage credibly with aerospace engineers, systems architects, software leaders, and program managers.
  • Experience developing opportunities early in a program lifecycle before a formal procurement exists.
  • Ability to navigate complex, multi-year opportunities involving government customers, prime contractors, technology partners, and multiple acquisition stakeholders.
  • Strong executive communication, relationship management, negotiation, and account-planning skills.
  • Ability to build new markets and develop strategic opportunities rather than exclusively managing established accounts.

Ideal Background

This role may be a strong fit for someone who has worked as a Strategic Account Executive, Aerospace Account Executive, Federal Account Executive, Capture Executive, Mission Systems Business Development Executive, or aerospace technology sales leader.

The strongest candidates will combine deep familiarity with the aerospace market with enough technical understanding to recognize how software architecture is changing the design and sustainment of modern aircraft and space systems.

They should be comfortable engaging a chief engineer about platform architecture, a program manager about acquisition and schedule, a software leader about DevSecOps, and an executive about how modular software architectures can change the economics and speed of delivering mission capability.

Base Salary

$145,000 – $185,000 base salary.

This role is eligible to participate in Defense Unicorn's commission plan and it is common for employees in this role to receive total on-target earnings of $290k to $370k.

Who We Are

Defense Unicorns delivers mission value by streamlining software delivery so our customers can focus on the most important challenges. We share a vision of freedom and security for the advancement of progress and innovation. Our commitment to this vision, and to our mission-driven customers, means a commitment to speed, user experience and optionality, without compromising security. Our team is composed of innovators, software engineers, and veterans with decades of experience delivering technology programs across the federal market.

What We Do

We create and deliver secure solutions for continuous software integration and delivery. Defense Unicorns consolidates the best practices for security pipelines, testing, and deployment automation in order to meet the high security requirements valued by mission owners. Our solutions are agnostic by design and we believe that growing a robust ecosystem of secure, cloud-native software solutions can help enterprise customers inside and outside the federal market buy and integrate software more easily.

Who We Serve

Defense Unicorns’ customers are mission-focused leaders across public and private enterprises. We proudly support defense and civil agencies across the U.S. government and we work closely with the creators of leading-edge software solutions to deliver value to the mission-owner by improving the security and consumability of commercial software products.

What We Work On

  • Kubernetes
  • Cloud Environments (AWS/GCP and Azure)
  • Infrastructure-as-code (like Terraform/Pulumi)
  • Continuous Delivery and automation tooling
  • GitOps
  • Containers
  • CNCF projects and open source products and packages
  • Helm/Kustomize-Value Stream Mapping
  • Building and improving security delivery
  • Building Kubernetes and cloud native applications

Benefits Our Unicorns Enjoy

Health:

  • Medical/Dental/Vision
  • Premiums are 100% Company Paid
  • Health Savings Account
  • Life Insurance
  • Disability Insurance

Financial:

  • 401k Retirement Plan
  • Company Stock Options
  • Home Office Budget

Leave:

  • We offer all full-time Unicorns Flexible Time Off (FTO) plus all Federal Holidays, one week for Thanksgiving, and two weeks for Christmas and New Year’s
  • Paid Parental Leave

Learning:

• Job Type: Full-time, long-term contractor

About Us

HireHawk connects skilled professionals with remote opportunities at U.S. and Canadian companies. This opportunity is with a founder-led personal-brand content business focused on helping clients share their expertise through natural, credible social content. The goal is to make each client more engaging while keeping them recognizably themselves.

About the Role

You’ll own post-production, working directly with the founder, who handles client conversations, filming, and guidance on the core messaging. There is no creative team: you’ll turn approximately 20-minute conversational recordings into polished short-form videos, primarily for Instagram and Facebook, using your own judgment to create a clear, natural narrative.

This is a full-time contractor role, Monday to Friday on Central Time (CT), for an editor who proactively moves work forward and becomes increasingly independent as they learn the founder’s preferences.

Responsibilities

  • Turn conversational footage into focused short-form stories with strong hooks, clear structure, and pacing that gives viewers a reason to keep watching.
  • Use the founder’s messaging guidance to identify the strongest moments and build a complete narrative without needing detailed, step-by-step editing instructions.
  • Preserve each client’s voice, personality, and intended meaning while removing repetition, tangents, and distractions.
  • Add accurate captions, thoughtful framing, B-roll, punch-ins, and supporting visuals when they improve clarity or engagement, not simply to add effects.
  • Deliver clean audio and polished, platform-ready videos, checking subtitles, visual details, and overall flow before handoff.
  • Keep recurring content and revisions organized across 4-6 clients, maintaining approximately 3-4 completed videos per day in total within the expected turnaround.
  • Adapt your editing style to each client rather than applying the same formula to every speaker or brand.
  • Take initiative on next steps, flag unclear messaging or delivery risks early, and apply feedback so future edits require less direction.

Requirements

Must-Have:

  • A portfolio that includes Instagram Reels and relevant talking-head, interview, podcast, founder, executive, thought-leadership, or personal-brand content.
  • Relevant professional video editing experience. We’re targeting 3-5 years, ideally including 2+ years in social content, but candidates with 1-2 years and an exceptional portfolio are encouraged to apply. Editing ability and editorial judgment matter more than years alone or a degree.
  • Proficiency in CapCut, with strong fundamentals in captions, pacing, framing, B-roll, punch-ins, basic audio cleanup, and finishing.
  • Strong short-form storytelling instincts: you understand why people stop scrolling, what belongs in the edit, and how to strengthen a message without making the speaker sound manufactured.
  • Strong English comprehension and communication, including the ability to understand conversational nuance and preserve the speaker’s meaning.
  • Demonstrated initiative and independent judgment, with the organization to manage recurring edits, revisions, and delivery deadlines without waiting for detailed instructions.
  • Comfort working directly with a founder without a creative team, responding constructively to feedback, and working Monday to Friday on Central Time.

Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience working directly with a founder or in a startup, strongly preferred.
  • Experience using Descript, strongly preferred.
  • A background editing for personal brands, consultants, coaches, marketing or content agencies, podcast creators, or professional-service and local business owners.
  • Experience adapting videos for TikTok, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, or other social channels.
  • Familiarity with Premiere Pro or comparable professional editing software. There is no specific preference for Premiere Pro; CapCut remains required.

Benefits

  • Access to a $200K+ perk marketplace with discounts on 150+ global services.
  • Option to withdraw up to 50% of approved earnings before payday.

About the Opportunity

LMG Staffing Solutions is conducting a confidential search on behalf of a fast-growing, fully remote marketing agency that helps funded B2B SaaS and technology companies win visibility in traditional and AI-powered search. The company has nearly doubled revenue over the past year and is building its first-ever sales development function to keep pace with a growing stream of inbound demand. This is a newly created role reporting directly to the Founder, sitting outside the delivery-focused teams (content, strategy, and link building).

Position Summary

The Sales Development Representative (SDR) will be the first point of contact for a steady stream of inbound, outbound (ABM), and reactivation leads, and will play a key role in building the company’s outbound systems from the ground up. This is not a generic dialer role — the ideal candidate has real experience selling into B2B SaaS or funded tech startups, can hold a credible first conversation with senior marketing and growth buyers, and is motivated to grow into a more senior sales role as the function scales. The role starts part-time (~20 hours/week), with a 90-day review for a move to full-time based on performance and lead volume.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

Lead Response & Qualification

  • Respond same-day, ideally within the hour, to every inbound, outbound (ABM), and reactivation handoff — across email, LinkedIn, and phone/text
  • Qualify every lead against ICP criteria, protecting the founder’s calendar from below-budget or bad-fit prospects
  • Book qualified discovery calls — turning a reply into a booked next step is the core measure of the role

Multi-Channel Outbound & Prospecting

  • Run second-channel follow-up (call, text, LinkedIn) wherever email goes quiet on handoffs from inbound and ABM
  • Self-source prospecting against the company’s ICP during downtime between handoffs — LinkedIn outreach and targeted email to build pipeline beyond inbound and ABM
  • Support the development and execution of high-value, niche outbound campaigns (e.g., targeted email and direct mail to a curated list of key accounts) in partnership with the founder

CRM & Sales Systems

  • Keep the CRM clean and current — every touch, stage move, and next action logged as you go
  • Help select, configure, and maintain outreach tooling as the company builds out its sales stack; the team is open to your recommendations on platforms

Coaching & Growth

  • Shadow the founder’s calls and playbook early on, then operate independently as you prove it out
  • Build toward a more senior sales role as the function and lead volume scale

Qualifications

  • B2B SaaS or sales-development experience, ideally selling to funded tech startups — prioritized over specific SEO or digital-marketing expertise
  • Able to hold a credible first conversation with marketing, growth, or founder-level buyers
  • Exposure to the SEO/AEO or digital-marketing space is a plus, but not required
  • Organized and responsive across multiple channels — phone, LinkedIn, email, and CRM
  • Coachable and fast-learning, comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy in a lean, remote-first environment
  • Based in the United States; Eastern or Central time zone preferred to support overlap with a globally distributed team and West Coast clients (soft preference)

Preferred Skills

  • Multi-Channel Outbound Prospecting
  • Lead Qualification (ICP-Based)
  • B2B SaaS / Tech Startup Sales Experience
  • CRM Management & Pipeline Hygiene
  • Sales Outreach Tool Selection & Setup (e.g., Apollo or similar)
  • Relationship Building & Written Communication
  • Cold Email & Direct Mail Campaign Development

What Success Looks Like

  • Response speed (non-negotiable): same-day, within-the-hour response on every handoff, no exceptions
  • Booked calls: 15–20 qualified discovery calls booked per month, roughly one per day, across handoff response and self-sourced outreach
  • The founder stops being the bottleneck on responding to his own pipeline

Benefits

Uncapped commission — 5% on every deal you personally book that closes, and with 2–6 week sales cycles, commission can quickly exceed the base pay

Fast path to full-time — 90-day review with an updated, higher base if it's working well for both sides

Fully remote, flexible part-time schedule (~20 hrs/week)

Direct mentorship from the founder — shadow live sales calls and the playbook early on

Ground-floor ownership — help build the company's first-ever outbound sales systems and tooling from scratch

High-growth environment — the company nearly doubled revenue this year with a goal to triple, meaning real room to grow into a more senior sales role

jobs.description:
Are you a person of compassion? An advocate for justice? Someone who stands up for the rights of the vulnerable and speaks out for the marginalized, the exploited and the forgotten? Do you believe in our calling as Christians to welcome the least of these and love our neighbor?
If you answered ‘yes’, to any of the above, World Relief, and millions of people around the world need you.
At this pivotal moment in time, we are rapidly expanding and growing our team to meet the increasing needs of our world. We are looking for people who want to use their gifts and talents to make a real and tangible difference in our world and the lives of the suffering.
If you’re looking for a purpose-driven career in which you can grow your talents, while also standing up for the rights of the vulnerable, we want you to join us today.

ORGANIZATION SUMMARY

World Relief is a global Christian humanitarian organization whose mission is to boldly engage the world’s greatest crises in partnership with the church. The organization was founded in the aftermath of World War II to respond to the urgent humanitarian needs of war-torn Europe. Since then, for 80 years, across 100 countries, World Relief has partnered with local churches and communities to build a world where families thrive and communities flourish.
Today, organizational programming focuses on humanitarian and disaster response, community strengthening and resilience, and refugee & immigrant services and advocacy.

POSITION SUMMARY:

World Relief seeks an individual experienced in Mental Health and Psychosocial Support (MHPSS) group programming for especially vulnerable refugees who is passionate about expanding best practices across the network. The individual must also have experience in implementing PC Gaps locally and conducting internal audits to ensure proper PC documentation. The PC Program Officer for Groups and Gaps Services will serve as a subject matter expert, monitoring offices for compliance within the PC program and supporting training efforts to equip field staff to deliver effective, compassionate, self-sufficiency-oriented services to refugees. A successful candidate will be able to work collaboratively with the field and within the MHPSS technical assistance team. They must be detail and excellence oriented. They will combine technical expertise in MHPSS group facilitation and gaps program implementation with strong communication and organizational skills to ensure high-quality programming across World Relief’s U.S. network.

ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Organize and facilitate the Groups Community of Practice and technical assistance training for PC Gaps enrollment and service tracking.

  • Build familiarity and rapport with local staff to strengthen collaboration.
  • Provide onboarding support for new managers and PC-funded staff.
  • Conduct annual PC Site Profile reviews for all PC-funded staff.
  • Host quarterly check-ins with managers to promote accountability, self-audit completion, and awareness of home office guidance.
  • Maintain home office administrative records for assigned portfolio offices.
  • Conduct PC monitoring visits to field offices and follow-up desk audits.
  • Collaborate with fellow Program Officers to meet network-wide programmatic needs.
  • Overall PC Grant and MHPSS Service Line Responsibilities
  • Collaborate with Education Service Line staff to ensure English language learning and adult education principles are integrated into MHPSS group programming.
  • Participate in additional Communities of Practice and cross-departmental meetings within the refugee resettlement community to stay informed of holistic support approaches.

  • Committed to the mission, vision, and values of World Relief

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience with the Preferred Communities (PC) program at the field level

jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

The Pre Service Center (PSC) Verification Specialist role belongs to the Revenue Cycle Patient Access team and is responsible for coordinating all financial clearance activities by navigating all pre-registration (to include acquiring or validating patient demographic, insurance, and other required elements along with insurance verification activities), obtaining referral authorization, or precertification number(s), pre-service cash collections. The role ensures timely access to care while maximizing BMC hospital reimbursement. This role requires adherence to quality assurance guidelines as well as established productivity standards to support the work unit’s performance expectations. This position reports to the Pre Service Center Supervisor and requires interaction and collaboration with important stakeholders in the financial clearance process including but not limited to insurance company representatives, patients, physicians, Boston Medical Center (BMC) practice staff, case management and Patient Financial Counseling. This is a Remote Position.

Position: Pre Service Center Verification Specialist

Department: Ambulatory

Schedule: Full Time

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES / DUTIES:

  • Monitors accounts routed to registration, referral and prior authorization work queues and clears work queues by obtaining all necessary patient and/or payer-specific financial clearance elements in accordance with established management guidelines.
  • Maintains knowledge of and complies with insurance companies’ requirements for obtaining prior authorizations/referrals and completes other activities to facilitate all aspects of financial clearance.
  • Acts as subject matter experts in navigating both the BMC and payer policies to get the appropriate approvals (authorizations, pre-certs, referrals, for example) for the scheduled care to proceed. The PSC Verification Specialist is an important part of the larger patient care team and helps clinicians understand what payer requirements are necessary for the widest possible patient access to services.
  • Supports BMC staff at all levels for hands-on help understanding and navigating financial clearance issues.
  • Uses appropriate strategies to underscore the most efficient process to obtaining insurance verification, authorizations and referrals, including online databases, electronic correspondence, faxes, and phone calls.
  • Obtains and clearly documents all referral/prior authorizations for scheduled services prior to admission within the Epic environment.
  • Works collaboratively with primary care practices, specialty practices, referring physicians, primary care physicians, insurance carriers, patients and any other parties to ensure that required managed care referrals and prior authorizations for specified specialty visits and other services are obtained and appropriately recorded in the relevant practice management systems for patient appointments/visits prior to scheduled patient visits or retro-actively if not in place at the time of the appointment/visit. Ensure that approval numbers are appropriately linked to the relevant patient appointment/visit.
  • When it is determined that a valid referral does not exist, utilize computer-based tools or contact the appropriate party to obtain/generate referral/authorization and related information. Record the referral/authorization in the practice management system.
  • Contact internal and external primary care physicians to obtain referral/authorization numbers.
  • Perform follow-up activities indicated by relevant management reports and WQ’s.
  • Collaborates with patients, providers, and departments to obtain all necessary information and payer permissions prior to patients scheduled services.
  • Communicates with patients, providers, and other departments such as Utilization Review to resolve any issues or problems with obtaining required referral/prior authorizations.
  • Work collaboratively with the practices to resolve registration, insurance verification, referral or authorization issue to the extent that these unresolved issues impact the ability to obtain a referral/authorization.
  • Escalates accounts that have been denied or will not be financially cleared as outlined by department policy
  • Interview patients, families or referring physicians via telephone in advance of the patient’s appointment/visit whenever possible, to obtain all necessary information, including but not limited to, financial and demographic information required for reimbursement and compliance for services rendered.
  • Accept registration updates from various intake points, including but not limited to those received via paper forms, internet registration forms, telephones located in practices and direct calls from patients.
  • Ensure that all updated demographic and insurance information is accurately recorded in the appropriate registration systems for primary, secondary and tertiary insurances.
  • Review all registration and insurance information in systems and reconcile with information available from insurance carriers. For any insurance updates, utilize any available resources to validate the updated insurance information, insurance plan eligibility, primary care physician, subscriber information, employer information and appointment/visit information. Contact patients as necessary if clarifications or other follow-up is required, and at all times maintain sensitivity and a clear customer friendly approach.
  • For any patient who is new to Boston Medical Center, create a new registration record, accurately obtaining all required data elements, including generating a medical record number and complete a full registration for the patient.
  • For self-pay patients or patients with unresolved insurance, and for financial counseling, refer patients Patient Financial Counseling.
  • Process current copayments, coinsurance, and/or deductibles for scheduled visits and outstanding patient balances for prior patient accounts during the pre-registration process.
  • Maintains confidentiality of patient’s financial and medical records; adheres to the State and Federal laws regulating collection in healthcare; adheres to enterprise and other regulatory confidentiality policies; and advises management of any potential compliance issues immediately.
  • Participates in educational offerings sponsored by BMC or other development opportunities as assigned/available and complies with all applicable organizational workflows, as well as established policies and procedures.
  • Demonstrates knowledge & skills necessary to provide level of customer experience as aligned with BMC management expectations.
  • Demonstrates the ability to recognize situations that require escalation to the Supervisor.
  • Establishes relationships and effectively collaborates with revenue cycle staff to support continuous improvement aligned with BMC management expectations as outlined.
  • Takes opportunity to know and learn other roles and processes and works together to assist with process improvement initiatives as directed.
  • Consistently meets productivity and quality expectations to align performance with assigned roles and responsibilities.
  • Handle telephone calls in a timely fashion, following applicable scripting and customer service standards. Appropriately manage all calls by either working with the customer or referring the call to the appropriate party.
  • Regularly undergo Managed Care Quality Audits to achieve the required standard.

(The above statements in this job description are intended to depict the general nature and level of work assigned to the employee(s) in this job. The above is not intended to represent an exhaustive list of accountable duties and responsibilities required).

JOB REQUIREMENTS

EDUCATION:

High School Diploma or GED required, associate's degree or higher preferred.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS REQUIRED:

EXPERIENCE:

1-3 years Hospital registration and/or Insurance experience desirable. At least one year of experience must be in a customer service role.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS:

  • General knowledge of healthcare terminology and CPT-ICD10 codes.
  • Complete understanding of insurance is preferred.
  • Demonstrated customer service skills, including the ability to use appropriate judgment, independent thinking and creativity when resolving customer issues.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills, including the ability to establish and maintain effective relationships with patients, physicians, management, staff, and other customers.
  • Able to communicate effectively in writing.
  • Requires excellent verbal communication skills, and the ability to work in a complex environment with varying points of view.
  • Must be comfortable with ambiguity, exhibit good decision making and judgment capabilities, attention to detail.
  • Knowledge of and experience within Epic is preferred.
  • Demonstrates technical proficiency within assigned Epic work queues and applicable ancillary systems, including but not limited to: ADT/Prelude/Grand Centrale.
  • Must be able to maintain strict confidentiality of all personal/health sensitive information.
  • Ability to effectively handle challenging situations and to balance multiple priorities.
  • Basic computer proficiency inclusive of ability to access, enter and interpret computerized data/information including proficiency in Microsoft Suite applications, specifically Excel, Word, Outlook and Zoom.
  • Displays a thorough knowledge of various sections within the work unit in order to provide assistance and back-up coverage as directed.
  • Displays a deep understanding of Revenue Cycle processes and applies knowledge to meet and maintain productivity standards as outlined by Management.

This range offers an estimate based on the minimum job qualifications. However, our approach to determining base pay is comprehensive, and a broad range of factors is considered when making an offer. This includes education, experience, and licensure/certifications directly related to position requirements. Product

Through close partnership with clients and cross-functional collaboration with Go-to-Market, Technology, Data Management, and Operations teams, the team translates market insights and customer needs into innovative, scalable products. Built upon IQVIA's industry-leading healthcare data assets and privacy-by-design foundation, these solutions deliver differentiated value to clients, drive business growth, and advance IQVIA Digital's leadership in the healthcare marketing ecosystem.

About the Role

As the Sr. Product Manager,Measurement Studies, Platforms & Data Services,IQVIA Digital, you will lead a critical portion of IQVIA Digital's measurement portfolio, overseeing products and services that enable our measurement value proposition through advanced measurement studies, platform reporting solutions, and Data-as-a-Service offerings.

This role spans both Healthcare Professional (HCP) and Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) measurement capabilities across a diverse client base that includes pharmaceutical manufacturers, healthcare marketers, agencies, publishers, and media partners. You will be responsible for maximizing the value, adoption, scalability, and commercial success of our measurement solutions while continuously identifying opportunities to enhance and evolve the portfolio.

The ideal candidate combines strategic product leadership with deep knowledge of digital media, healthcare marketing, measurement methodologies, and data-driven decision making. You will play a key role in shaping the future of healthcare media measurement by developing innovative solutions, advancing industry standards, and delivering actionable insights that help clients optimize marketing performance.

Working closely with cross-functional teams—including Platform, Science & Innovation, Data Management, Commercial, Marketing, and Client Services—you will define product strategy, prioritize investments, guide execution, and ensure market readiness for both new and existing solutions.

  • Drive consistency across product teams to ensure common measurement standards, integrated experiences, and scalable platform capabilities.

  • Manage and mentor two Product Owners, ensuring alignment on priorities, delivery expectations, stakeholder communication, and execution excellence.

  • Develop strong relationships with key healthcare clients and industry partners to gain insights into market needs and emerging opportunities.

  • Translate client challenges and business objectives into innovative product solutions that drive measurable outcomes and long-term value.

  • Collaborate with Product Strategy and Marketing teams on positioning, messaging, launch planning, and go-to-market readiness.

  • Monitor industry trends, competitive offerings, healthcare advertising technologies, regulatory developments, and emerging measurement methodologies to inform product direction.

  • Ensure privacy, security, compliance, and regulatory considerations are incorporated into product design, data usage, and platform capabilities.

  • Support strategic planning and investment decisions that drive portfolio growth, innovation, and operational scale.

What You'll Bring

jobs.excerpt: About the roleHelpware's AI Platform team builds a portfolio of AI-native products for customer support and business operations, all running on a shared multi-tenant platform.
jobs.description:
About the role

Helpware's AI Platform team builds a portfolio of AI-native products for customer support and business operations, all running on a shared multi-tenant platform. The team also implements these products for individual clients with custom configurations, integrations, and SLAs.

We're looking for two Senior QA Engineers to own quality end-to-end — from pre-release testing of the products themselves to validating each customer's live implementation. The two hires will share this work across the portfolio, with each expected to flex between product testing and customer-facing implementation QA as priorities shift.

What you'll do

  • Own test strategy for one or more products in the AI portfolio, from requirements review through release sign-off.
  • Design, build, and maintain automated test suites covering API, UI, integration, and regression testing, integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Test multi-tenant platform behavior, including RBAC, tenant isolation, data access, and integrations with CRM, ticketing, telephony, and other third-party systems.
  • Validate AI-agent behavior against functional requirements, including conversation flows, workflow automation, scoring and coaching logic, and structured-data extraction.
  • Lead QA for customer implementations by validating client-specific configurations, connectors, knowledge bases, scoring rubrics, and workflow rules against requirements before go-live.
  • Design and execute UAT plans together with client stakeholders and internal delivery and Customer Success teams.
  • Perform exploratory and scenario-based testing against real customer workflows and monitor early-production behavior after launch.
  • Distinguish between configuration issues, implementation defects, and product-level bugs, and ensure the right teams address them.
  • Triage, document, and track defects; work closely with engineers to identify root causes and verify fixes.
  • Maintain test plans, implementation checklists, and QA playbooks that can scale across a growing product portfolio and client base.
  • Turn recurring implementation issues into automated regression coverage and continuously improve overall QA processes.
  • Report on release readiness, product quality, and implementation risks to Product, Engineering, Delivery, and client-facing teams.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of experience in software QA, including both product-level testing and customer-facing implementation or UAT activities.
  • Strong hands-on experience with test automation, using tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar.
  • Solid experience with API testing using Postman, REST-assured, or comparable tools.
  • Strong manual and exploratory testing skills, with the ability to create meaningful test scenarios from business and client requirements.
  • Experience testing multi-tenant and role-based access systems, including data isolation and configuration-driven deployments.
  • Ability to read and understand API and database schemas and work with engineers on root-cause analysis.
  • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated tests into development and release processes.
  • Comfortable working directly with external stakeholders during UAT and implementation validation.
  • Strong understanding of software testing principles, defect lifecycle, regression strategy, and release readiness.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt communication for both technical and client-facing audiences.

Nice to have

  • Experience testing AI/LLM-powered products, including accuracy evaluation, hallucination checks, prompt regression, RAG quality, or AI output validation.
  • Experience in customer support, contact center, or BPO technology, including call QA, workforce management, agent-assist, or support automation platforms.
  • Familiarity with AWS-based environments and cloud-based application testing.
  • Experience with observability, logging, tracing, or monitoring tools used for production troubleshooting.
  • Exposure to testing in compliance-sensitive environments, such as SOC 2, HIPAA, or PCI-DSS.
  • Experience testing integrations with platforms such as Zendesk, Freshdesk, Intercom, telephony systems, or other customer-support technologies.

Job Title: Sr. Analyst, Financial

A little bit about our team:

Warner Music Group's Global Business Services (GBS) is home to the finance operations, legal, and administrative functions that provide critical support and best-in-class services to our global Finance labels and affiliates. Each regional center embodies the collaboration and creative spirit that stems from the company’s deep history in cultivating entrepreneurial thinking and artist-focused innovation, enabling our employees to develop a wide range of skills through cross-function collaboration and development opportunities. Based out of Nashville, our US Participations team is fully remote and committed to supporting all U.S. record labels, and artist & label services divisions.

We’re excited to hear from impactful finance and audit professionals who are ready to apply their elite analytical skills to a specialized, high-stakes environment. We are looking for "detective-minded" analysts with a passion for music, who thrive on uncovering the "why" behind the numbers and who possess the commercial acumen to translate complex legal logic into precise financial outputs.

Why this could be your next big break:

You are a highly autonomous finance professional who takes immense pride in ownership and accountability. You don't just process data; you interrogate it. You thrive in environments where you are expected to be a subject matter expert, serving as a trusted point of contact for both partners across the company, and your peers.

This role is perfect for someone coming from a rigorous Audit, Royalty, or Financial Reporting background who is ready to move into a fast-paced, dynamic industry. You’ll be given the space to work independently, but you’ll do so through a lens of deep collaboration—mentoring analysts and acting as a link between financial accounting, royalty operations and our business. If you enjoy the challenge of high-volume data, complex financial calculations, and the satisfaction of delivering accurate insights under tight deadlines, this is your next step.

Here you’ll get to:

  • Lead the preparation, analysis and review of complex participation profit-share and distribution financial statements. You will ensure every output aligns with both unique contractual obligations and rigorous accounting standards.

  • Prepare fiscal month-end close tasks, including true-ups, reconciliations, and expense accruals. You will act as the link between statement reporting and general ledger accuracy, ensuring financial integrity for the labels you support.

  • Act as the team’s primary “Variance Detective” and quality gatekeeper. You will interrogate the “how” and “why” behind data fluctuations to provide clear narratives for management while reviewing peer statements to ensure the highest standards of precision, audit-readiness, and internal control compliance.

  • Translate complex artist and label legal agreements into functional financial models. You will identify and comprehend intricate deal terms and apply them to large-scale data sets to ensure reporting accuracy and rigor.

  • Compile, transform and analyze vast sets of transactional data to support statement reporting, budgets, and cash forecasts. You will provide critical financial data for deal models and audit responses, ensuring the Participations group remains a valued partner to the wider organization.

  • Proactively investigate artist inquiries, data issues or audit claims with a focus on mitigating financial risk. You are expected to anticipate future roadblocks and suggest resolutions to management before they impact deadlines or relationships.

  • Take an active role in team development by guiding analysts, providing ongoing review feedback, and facilitating training sessions for new hires to demonstrate standard processes in Participations accounting.

  • Build and maintain strong working relationships across the company—from label finance and legal teams to senior executives—acting as a trusted partner with a high degree of professional IQ and responsiveness.

  • Contribute to the evolution of the department by identifying inefficiencies and implementing solutions supported by modern tools. You will champion automation initiatives and process improvements that drive team-wide excellence and scalable growth.

About you:

  • BA/BS degree required (Accounting or Finance preferred) with 3-5 years of professional experience in a sophisticated financial capacity.

  • Advanced proficiency with MS Excel is crucial. You should be very comfortable with complex calculations and working with large, disparate data sets.

  • You have a solid grasp of financial accounting principles and how they apply to P&L statements, reconciliations, fiscal close processes and internal controls.

  • You have strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a proven track record of taking full ownership of your work. You are self-driven, highly organized, and able to implement with accuracy and deliver under pressure.

  • You can distill complex financial information into clear, actionable insights for interested parties and possess the leadership traits necessary to mentor peers.

We’d love it if you also had:

  • Experience in Music, Media, or Entertainment (specifically in Participations, Royalties or Audit).

  • Proficiency with SAP S4 Hana, SAP Analysis for Office, BI and SharePoint.

  • A natural technical curiosity, and digital innovation having leveraged Generative AI tools to automate manual workflows and drive efficiency in finance operations.

  • Proven success working in a fully remote, Shared Services environment.

As the home to 10K Projects, 300 Elektra, Asylum, Atlantic, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. jobs.excerpt: “For every person joining us for any position, there is a path and an opportunity to reach an executive role and become a company partner.
jobs.description:
“For every person joining us for any position, there is a path and an opportunity to reach an executive role and become a company partner.”
Antons Sapriko, Company Founder

How to become a PR & Media Hacker at scandiweb?

We are a very inclusive company with colleagues from over 30 countries across all continents. We welcome people from all walks of life who can complete a practical test by showing how they think, create stories, and turn an ordinary business topic into something people want to discuss.
This is not a traditional PR position where your main responsibility is to prepare press releases, upload them to distribution platforms, and send the same pitch to a long media list. We are looking for someone who knows how to direct people's attention.
Your job will be to find the tension, consequence, opponent, proof, or human angle that turns it into a story worth sharing.
Sometimes the story already exists and needs to be discovered. Sometimes you will help create the real event, benchmark, public challenge, experiment, debate, collaboration, or campaign that gives the media a reason to cover it.
We welcome previous experience in PR, journalism, communications, creative agencies, content, startups, or growth marketing. However, the strongest evidence of your ability will be how you approach the practical tasks.
We value your ability to deliver results, your curiosity, your persistence, and your openness to learn from feedback. Continuous learning and acting on feedback are among our core organizational values.

What are the responsibilities of a PR & Media Hacker?

As a PR & Media Hacker at scandiweb, your main responsibility will be to create public attention around scandiweb, internal ventures, company developments, and selected client projects.
You will work closely with company founders and business leaders to identify stories that deserve public attention. You will not wait for someone to hand you a finished announcement. You will proactively search for opportunities, develop the angle, shape the campaign, collect the proof, and bring the story to the right audience.
Your responsibilities will include:
  • Finding PR opportunities inside scandiweb (e.g., projects, client work, internal discussions, product development, research, technical achievements, market changes, etc)
  • Turning complex or seemingly ordinary topics into stories worth sharing with a strong headline, tension, consequence, and reason for people to care;
  • Developing creative PR campaigns and stunts and making people speak about it;
  • Creating real newsworthy moments when a strong story does not yet exist, rather than just waiting for them to appear;
  • Building several media angles around the same core event for different audiences;
  • Researching journalists, editors, newsletter writers, podcasters, creators, analysts, and industry communities that are relevant to each story;
  • Preparing personalized pitches and reaching out directly through email, social media, calls, introductions, events, and other appropriate channels;
  • Building long-term relationships with media professionals by understanding what they cover and bringing them useful, timely, and credible stories;
  • Coordinating interviews, expert comments, supporting data, visuals, demonstrations, customer evidence, and spokesperson preparation;
  • Working with content, design, video, data, and development teams to create the materials needed to prove and distribute a story;
  • Monitoring public conversations, competitor activity, industry news, and cultural trends to identify moments when scandiweb can contribute a relevant point of view;
  • Responding quickly when an unexpected media opportunity appears and coordinating the required internal contributors;
  • Using AI and research tools to monitor media, find patterns, identify relevant contacts, develop angles, and improve outreach without turning communication into automated spam;
  • Measuring campaign results, documenting what worked, and improving future campaigns based on actual media response and business impact.
The number of press releases produced will not measure success in this role.
It will be measured by the quality and relevance of earned media coverage, the conversations your campaigns create, the relationships you build, the attention generated among the right audiences, and the business opportunities supported by your work.

What do we expect from you?

We are looking for a curious, persistent, and highly proactive person who naturally looks for the story behind what is happening.
You may come from PR, journalism, media, content, communications, creative strategy, startup marketing, or another relevant background. A traditional PR career can come in handy. Still, you should be able to demonstrate that you have previously attracted attention, earned coverage, built an audience, or created public interest around an idea.
The following qualities will help you succeed in the role:
  • Strong news judgment and the ability to understand why one story gets covered while another is ignored;
  • The ability to find a compelling angle in technical, commercial, or otherwise ordinary information;
  • Excellent headline, pitch, and short-form writing skills;
  • Confident written and spoken English, as you will be working with international media and clients;
  • The ability to understand technical and business topics and explain them in simple language;
  • A proactive attitude and willingness to contact people directly rather than waiting for inbound interest;
  • Persistence when pitches are ignored, rejected, or require several attempts before receiving a response;
  • Comfort working with incomplete information and developing a campaign while the underlying project is still evolving;
  • The ability to manage several stories, stakeholders, and deadlines at the same time;
  • Confidence when communicating with founders, executives, technical experts, clients, journalists, and creators;
  • The ability to work independently, make decisions, and take responsibility for campaign outcomes;
  • Curiosity about media, business, technology, eCommerce, culture, and the reasons people share information;
  • A practical understanding of social media, online communities, podcasts, newsletters, creator channels, and other forms of media beyond traditional publications.
Existing relationships with journalists, editors, creators, or industry media will be considered an advantage. However, we value your ability to identify and build the right relationships more than the size of an existing contact list.
Experience in eCommerce or technology will also be considered an advantage, but it is not mandatory. We will help you understand our industry, projects, services, and technical context.

What do we offer?

  • Monthly salary of 3500-4200 EUR NET, depending on experience and execution level.
  • Opportunity to gain stock options within the company
  • Support for hardware upgrades;
  • Core health insurance coverage and sports bonuses;
  • A diverse multinational team of experts to learn from;
  • Legendary online and onsite events to celebrate our success together.

jobs.description:
Real opportunities. Real impact. Your career, redefined.

(NOTE: A human reviews every application at Oceans, so please apply for only one position and only once a year—if you're a better fit for another role, we’ll route your application accordingly and if we’re not quite ready for you, we’ll reach back out later.)

At Oceans, we help the best and brightest of Sri Lanka to take advantage of opportunities that otherwise wouldn’t be available to them, while supporting entrepreneurs around the world. Our community (we call them Divers) don’t do surface work—they go deep to solve complex challenges and make a real impact. As the Chief Marketing Officer, you will own the marketing and growth strategy for an early-stage direct-to-consumer subscription business, helping build the brand, acquisition engine, and go-to-market model from the ground up. You'll work closely with the founders and leadership team to shape market positioning, drive subscriber growth, build creator and community-led acquisition, strengthen retention and customer lifetime value, and establish the marketing foundation required to scale across markets.

This is a leadership role with a distinctly hands-on mandate. Rather than setting strategy and delegating execution to a large team, you'll be expected to determine where and how the business should grow, then roll up your sleeves to build the campaigns, partnerships, systems, processes, and measurement frameworks that bring that strategy to life. As the function matures, you'll evolve from individual execution into building and leading the broader marketing organization.

Here's how you'll make an impact:

Accountability

Marketing Strategy & Leadership

  • Own the overall marketing strategy and growth agenda in partnership with the founders and leadership team.
  • Translate company goals into clear marketing priorities, channel strategies, investment decisions, and measurable outcomes.
  • Establish the marketing vision, operating rhythm, and strategic roadmap for the business.
  • Balance long-term brand building with near-term subscriber acquisition and commercial performance.
  • Identify the capabilities, resources, and investments required to support the company's growth trajectory.
  • Serve as the senior marketing voice in company-wide strategic and commercial decisions.

Brand Strategy & Positioning

  • Own and evolve the brand positioning, voice, messaging, and consumer narrative.
  • Build a differentiated premium brand within a trust-sensitive consumer category.
  • Translate the company's mission and value proposition into compelling consumer-facing messaging.
  • Establish messaging frameworks that can scale across channels and geographic markets.
  • Maintain consistency across paid, organic, creator, lifecycle, community, and customer touchpoints.
  • Ensure brand development strengthens both customer trust and commercial performance.

Subscriber Acquisition & Growth

  • Own the customer acquisition strategy across paid, organic, creator-led, affiliate, and community channels.
  • Determine channel priorities and allocate marketing investment based on performance, growth potential, and customer economics.
  • Own subscriber acquisition performance and continuously improve customer acquisition economics.
  • Identify, test, and validate new growth opportunities and channels.
  • Develop a repeatable acquisition model that can support expansion into additional markets.
  • Connect acquisition performance to downstream retention, customer quality, and lifetime value.

Creator, Influencer & Community Growth

  • Build the creator and influencer growth strategy from the ground up.
  • Identify and evaluate creators who align with the brand and target customer.
  • Develop creator partnerships, affiliate relationships, campaigns, and measurement frameworks.
  • Personally manage key creator relationships and outreach during the early stages of the function.
  • Establish repeatable systems for sourcing, briefing, tracking, and evaluating creator performance.
  • Develop creator and community activity into a meaningful acquisition and retention channel rather than treating it solely as brand awareness.

Paid Acquisition

  • Own the strategic direction and investment approach across relevant paid acquisition channels.
  • Evaluate channel allocation, acquisition economics, and growth opportunities.
  • Oversee campaign setup, creative requirements, QA, testing, and optimization.
  • Monitor CAC, ROAS, subscriber conversion, and downstream customer quality.
  • Use performance data to determine where to increase, reduce, or redirect marketing investment.
  • Work with internal or external specialists where appropriate while retaining executive accountability for results.

Lifecycle, Retention & Customer Value

  • Own the customer lifecycle strategy across onboarding, engagement, retention, churn prevention, and win-back.
  • Develop email and SMS programs using platforms such as Klaviyo.
  • Build subscriber onboarding and nurture journeys that strengthen customer relationships.
  • Develop retention, churn reduction, referral, and loyalty initiatives.
  • Use behavioral and lifecycle segmentation to improve customer engagement.
  • Increase repeat purchase, retention, and subscriber lifetime value.
  • Establish a structured test-and-learn approach to customer lifecycle performance.

Conversion & Customer Journey

  • Own the customer journey from initial acquisition through subscription and ongoing engagement.
  • Identify friction across landing pages, offers, checkout, and subscription flows.
  • Develop and prioritize conversion improvements based on customer and performance data.
  • Work across the Shopify and subscription technology stack to improve the purchase experience.
  • Ensure acquisition investment translates into high-quality customers and sustainable subscription growth.
  • Build a culture of continuous experimentation across the customer funnel.

Marketing Analytics & Commercial Performance

  • Establish the measurement framework for the marketing function and broader growth engine.
  • Track CAC, LTV, subscriber conversion, retention, churn, ROAS, and channel performance.
  • Evaluate the effectiveness of paid, organic, creator, lifecycle, and community programs.
  • Translate marketing performance into clear commercial recommendations and investment decisions.
  • Identify trends, opportunities, and risks across the customer funnel.
  • Provide leadership with clear visibility into marketing performance, efficiency, and growth potential.

Marketing Operations & Execution

  • Build the operating infrastructure required for a high-performing marketing function.
  • Establish campaign calendars, workflows, processes, timelines, QA standards, and reporting rhythms.
  • Coordinate content and campaign production across internal and external resources.
  • Maintain oversight of the Shopify, subscription, CRM, and broader marketing technology ecosystem.
  • Ensure campaigns and initiatives launch accurately, efficiently, and on schedule.
  • Build scalable processes that reduce reliance on founder-driven or ad hoc execution.
  • Remain directly involved in campaign development, optimization, reporting, and execution while the function is lean.

Multi-Market GTM & Function Building

  • Develop a repeatable marketing and go-to-market playbook for geographic expansion.
  • Determine which acquisition, community, brand, and lifecycle approaches can be replicated across markets.
  • Adapt positioning, messaging, and channel strategies where market or regulatory differences require it.
  • Establish the systems, processes, and capabilities needed to scale the marketing function.
  • Identify future marketing leadership and specialist hiring needs.
  • Build and lead a high-performing marketing team as the business grows.
  • Evolve the marketing organization from a lean, hands-on function into a scalable growth engine.

Colleagues

You'll work closely with the company's founders and leadership team, acting as the senior marketing owner across brand, growth, acquisition, retention, and go-to-market strategy. You'll also coordinate with creators, influencers, marketing specialists, external partners, and other resources supporting growth. As the function develops, you'll be responsible for building the team and creating an environment where marketing can scale effectively.

At Oceans Talent, you'll also receive guidance and support from your Operations Manager, who will help you succeed in the role and ensure that you're continuously growing and developing in your career.

Skills and Qualifications

As a Chief Marketing Officer, your vertical focus will be on marketing strategy, brand leadership, DTC growth, and commercial performance, while your horizontal focus will include acquisition, lifecycle marketing, analytics, creator growth, conversion optimization, marketing operations, GTM, and AI-enabled execution.

  • Experience: 8+ years of experience across growth marketing, brand marketing, marketing leadership, or related disciplines, with significant ownership of acquisition, retention, and commercial outcomes.
  • Executive Marketing Leadership: Demonstrated ability to own marketing strategy, make independent investment decisions, and connect marketing activity to broader business objectives.
  • DTC & Subscription Growth: Strong experience building and scaling direct-to-consumer or subscription growth programs.

  • Lifecycle Marketing: Hands-on experience developing email, SMS, retention, churn reduction, referral, loyalty, and LTV programs.
  • Creator & Influencer Growth: Proven experience building or scaling creator, influencer, affiliate, or community-led acquisition programs.
  • Brand Strategy: Strong judgment in positioning, messaging, voice, and premium consumer brand development.
  • Marketing Analytics: Strong understanding of CAC, LTV, retention, churn, ROAS, conversion, and channel performance, with the ability to turn data into commercial decisions.
  • Go-to-Market: Experience developing repeatable GTM strategies and scaling marketing across multiple markets or customer segments.
  • Marketing Operations: Ability to build the systems, processes, workflows, and infrastructure required to scale a marketing function from a relatively blank slate.
  • Hands-On Execution: Comfortable personally building, managing, analyzing, and optimizing marketing programs while the function remains lean.
  • Team Building: Ability to identify future capabilities, hire effectively, and develop a high-performing marketing team as the business scales.
  • Startup & Build-from-Zero Experience: Comfortable operating with ambiguity, limited infrastructure, and minimal hand-holding.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal English, with the ability to communicate clearly across strategic, creative, analytical, operational, and executive contexts.
  • AI Fluency: Strong proficiency with AI tools and willingness to incorporate tools such as Claude into research, analysis, campaign development, content workflows, and marketing operations.

During the interview process, you'll have the opportunity to showcase your skills in the following areas:

  • Marketing Strategy & Executive Leadership: Your ability to develop and own a marketing strategy, set priorities, lead a marketing function, and connect marketing activity to broader business goals.
  • DTC Growth & Customer Acquisition: Your ability to build and optimize acquisition strategies across paid, organic, and other growth channels while balancing customer acquisition costs, conversion, and sustainable growth.
  • Brand Strategy & Positioning: Your ability to shape a distinctive brand, translate positioning into effective marketing, and ensure consistency across channels, audiences, and customer touchpoints.
  • Creator, Influencer & Community Growth: Your ability to develop creator and influencer partnerships, build engaged communities, and turn these relationships into meaningful and measurable growth.
  • Lifecycle, Retention & Customer Value: Your ability to develop lifecycle strategies that improve engagement, retention, conversion, and customer lifetime value across the customer journey.
  • Marketing Analytics, Commercial Decision-Making & Execution: Your ability to use marketing and commercial data to make decisions, identify opportunities, prioritize resources, and remain hands-on in executing and improving marketing initiatives.

Diversity of experience is core to Oceans. You are expected to work inclusively with individuals from a variety of backgrounds, ensuring that both personal and collective dignity are supported.

Role Specifications

This is a remote role, where you will be expected to work a split shift with some overlap with our client’s time zone. You will, however, be expected to be present for in-person training programs during your first 3.5 weeks with us. During the offer process, we’ll share more information about our benefits and compensation philosophy, considering both market trends and individual factors.

About Oceans

At Oceans Talent, we connect the world’s top talent with visionary companies building what’s next. Here, you’re not just stepping into another role — you’re joining a team that values individuality, ambition, and growth without limits. Unique, like you.

We’re always excited to share more about our journey, where we’re headed, and how you can grow with us throughout the interview process.
