jobs.description:
About Fetch

At Fetch, we’re dedicated to helping pets live their healthiest and happiest lives. Our comprehensive insurance coverage is designed with modern pet parents in mind, and we’re proud to support the veterinary, shelter, and breeder communities. We believe in ensuring pets receive the best care possible and are committed to making that vision a reality every day.

Fetch is a high-growth Warburg Pincus portfolio company with an expanding team of over 350 pet-loving employees working together to shape the future of pet health and wellness.

About the Industry

The pet insurance industry is more important than ever, offering peace of mind and financial protection for pet owners. The sector is expanding quickly, fueled by growing awareness of the need for accessible, high-quality veterinary care. With advances in veterinary medicine, pets now have access to the most effective treatments available, making pet insurance an essential component of modern pet care.

About the Role

Overview

We are looking for an Actuarial Data Scientist to help Fetch continue to have best-in-class pricing and profitability while also supporting growth of the business. You will leverage predictive analytics to improve the sophistication of our existing pricing models and build tools to monitor the performance of our rating plans over time.

In this highly visible role, you will be a member of a small, close-knit actuarial team and will need to be adaptable, wearing multiple hats in support of various actuarial pricing and financial forecasting initiatives. Time will be roughly evenly split between pricing, conversion, and retention modeling work and traditional actuarial pricing work. You will help evaluate product proposals from a pricing and enterprise risk management perspective, support rate filings and responses to regulatory objections, and contribute to special pricing projects such as increased limit factor analyses, policyholder coverage utilization studies, and pricing brand new coverages. You will frequently engage in creative problem-solving and present your findings to senior leadership, actively shaping the organization’s future.

Location

Remote (U.S.)

Primary Responsibilities

  • Price Elasticity & Lifetime Value: Develop price elasticity curves to forecast the impact of rating changes on policyholder retention and conversion, and assess their impact on customer lifetime value
  • Conversion and Retention Forecast: Forecast policyholder retention and conversion for the portfolio based on pricing, operational changes, and business initiatives
  • Risk Segmentation: Improve the risk segmentation sophistication of our rating plans by developing GLM-based rating factors (in R or Python) and applying advanced predictive modeling techniques
  • Performance Monitoring: Build and maintain tools to monitor the performance of our existing rating plans and rate level over time, including loss ratio, conversion rate, churn, and lifetime value
  • Data Analysis & Modeling: Write advanced SQL procedures to pull from large, line item level veterinary bill databases
  • Product & Coverage Analysis: Estimate the impact of coverage and product changes on pricing
  • Evaluate New Product Proposals: Analyze product design proposals to determine pricing viability, impact on enterprise risk, competitive positioning, and customer value
  • Market Analysis: Stay highly informed on competitor filings to understand how our products and pricing stand relative to the market
  • Rate Filings & Indications: Support rate filing and rate indication work, including the development of filings and responses to regulatory objections
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Operate seamlessly with product, underwriting, marketing, BI, and IT teams, and communicate complex actuarial concepts to a non-actuarial audience
  • Innovate: Propose creative ways to price innovative coverage concepts and ideas

Qualifications

  • ACAS designation required (or ASA working in health insurance)
  • At least 5 years of experience working in an actuarial or data science P&C and/or Health insurance role
  • At least 2 years of experience in an actuarial ratemaking and/or pricing modeling role
  • Advanced knowledge of SQL is required
  • Strong knowledge of R and/or Python is required
  • Intermediate knowledge of Excel is required
  • Advanced knowledge of generalized linear models (GLMs) is required
  • Intermediate knowledge of elastic net GLMs, k-means clustering, and geospatial statistics is desirable
  • The ability to review and evaluate data for quality, completeness, and reasonability is required
  • Experience performing competitor filing research in SERFF is a plus
  • Comfortable or willingness to learn how to work with AI assisted coding tools, such as, Claude, GitHub Copilot, or Gemini
  • Excellent verbal, interpersonal and written communication skills; an excellent team player able to apply innovative ideas and critical thinking
  • Able to anticipate needs, innovate and flourish in a high-volume, fast paced environment

Compensation

  • Along with base salary, your position may qualify for additional bonuses
  • This position is eligible for the Company’s bonus plan(s)

  • When in office, enjoy complimentary lunch daily, and pets are always welcome

HRIS Administration and Data Integrity

Onboarding and Offboarding

Recruitment Administration
  • Administer Pinpoint ATS, including job postings, candidate pipeline management, interview scheduling, and coordination with hiring managers and external recruiters

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Why Kenya

Kenya is where our next chapter begins. Following our acquisition of Sumac Microfinance Bank, we're preparing to go live — which means the people we hire here help build a business from its first day, not inherit one. How we execute in Kenya will shape how we approach every market we enter after it, making this one of the most consequential engineering mandates in the business right now. This is the natural extension of our mission: to drive financial inclusion, and help millions of business owners and individuals across the African continent achieve financial happiness and success.

So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Supply Chain to join us in Kenya.

About The Role

POS Hardware and Device Platforms owns the software behind the physical side of Moniepoint's business: the systems that track, move, maintain and account for millions of POS terminals in the field. That covers inventory and warehouse management, logistics and distribution, repair and maintenance workflows, and the operational tooling the business runs on day to day. It is a backend and distributed systems challenge at real scale - making operational data about millions of physical devices visible, trustworthy and consistent across every market we operate in. It is not a hardware engineering role.

The Head of Engineering, POS Supply Chain, oversees that software estate and is vital as Moniepoint expands internationally and scales device operations globally. The position involves leading the technical strategy for the domain and managing a large engineering organisation in a remote, distributed environment. As Head of Engineering, Supply Chain, your responsibilities will include:

  • Owning the technical strategy and architecture for inventory and logistics tools and repair management software.
  • Leading an engineering organisation of approximately 25 engineers, including managers, QA, SRE and Data Engineering.
  • Driving platformisation of inventory and supply chain systems so operational data is visible, trustworthy and consistent across millions of terminals.
  • Bridging the gap between operational practice and software systems by building operationally disciplined solutions.
  • Defining architecture standards, engineering processes and quality metrics across squads to ensure reliability and data integrity.
  • Collaborating with business and operational stakeholders to translate operational requirements into engineering solutions.
  • Hiring, mentoring and developing engineering managers and senior engineers to support team growth up to 30+ members.

Who You Are

  • 10–15 years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 5 years leading engineering teams through growth phases.
  • 5+ years of hands-on, production-level experience writing and shipping Java code as a practising engineer. This means years spent writing Java yourself, not years spent overseeing teams who write it.
  • At least 5 years of experience managing managers - leading an engineering organisation through other engineering leaders, rather than running a single team.
  • Deep hands-on experience in supply chain, inventory, warehouse or logistics software at scale.
  • Fintech or regulated-industry experience, with an understanding of the operational stakes of device management in a payments environment.
  • Strong backend engineering skills for data-intensive, distributed, operational systems.
  • Proven system design ability at large scale, managing hundreds of thousands of devices or more.
  • Experience managing and developing large engineering teams of 20 or more members.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, translating complex technical concepts for non-technical leaders.
  • A product-minded approach to solving operational problems with engineering solutions.

Cultural Alignment

As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.

  • Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
  • Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
  • Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
  • Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
  • Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
  • No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
  • Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
  • Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.

What Success Looks Like In The Role

  • Scalable inventory and logistics systems delivered, supporting millions of devices across multiple countries.
  • A high-performing, motivated engineering team aligned with company growth.
  • Operational data visibility and trust established across multiple global markets.
  • Robust architecture standards enabling reliability and data integrity.
  • Effective collaboration with business and operational teams to meet rapid expansion needs.

What we can offer you

  • Lead engineering for one of Africa's largest POS networks and directly influence our global expansion.
  • Work in a fast-paced, innovative environment at the intersection of fintech and hardware operations.
  • Be part of a mission-driven company impacting millions of businesses and individuals across Africa and beyond.

What to expect in the hiring process

  • A preliminary phone call with the recruiter.
  • 60 minute High level System Design round with one of our Engineering Managers.
  • 60 minute Panel Interview with 2 of our Head of Engineering leaders, 30 minutes focused on a technical deep dive into your CV and into a project/system you built in the past. 30 minutes will be focused on testing for leadership attributes.
  • 60 minute Stakeholder Management Round with one of our Product Heads/VPs, focused on your stakeholder management, collaboration skills with product/business.
  • 60 minute Technical round and Culture fit interview with our Co-founder & Group CTO (the hiring manager).

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

They're looking to bring on a dedicated assistant with genuine healthcare experience to support the clinical and administrative side of the practice.
Why does this role exist?
The practice has learned firsthand that generalist administrative support isn't enough for a healthcare setting — the current assistant in this seat lacks a medical background, which has created a steep learning curve around healthcare terminology, insurance processes, and how to appropriately support patients who may be in distress. This role exists to bring in someone who already understands the healthcare world and can hit the ground running on intake, insurance claims, and documentation — freeing the practice owner from the administrative load of prior authorizations and claims follow-up so she can focus on patient care. Patient Intake

The IT Director, IT Service Management (ITSM) and Quality Assurance will lead Eurofins’ global ITSM function, driving the strategy, governance, quality, and continuous improvement of IT services across the organization.

This role is responsible for establishing and evolving the global ITSM operating model, ensuring reliable, efficient, and user-focused service delivery while advancing process maturity and operational excellence.

The successful candidate will oversee the enterprise ITSM platform, lead global teams, and collaborate closely with IT, business, infrastructure, security, and regional stakeholders to enhance service performance, quality, and business value.

We are looking for a dynamic leader who can combine strategic vision with execution excellence, foster cross-functional collaboration, and help shape the future of IT service delivery at Eurofins.

In this position you will:

  • Define and lead the global ITSM strategy, governance model, and continual improvement roadmap.
  • Own full ITIL-aligned practice governance across Service Portfolio Management, Incident, Problem, Change Enablement, Request Fulfilment, Service Catalogue, Knowledge, CMDB/Configuration, IT Asset, Service Level, and Continual Improvement. Increase ITIL process maturity across global IT.
  • Enhance the quality and performance of IT services globally.
  • Lead BMC Helix platform governance, including roadmap, configuration standards, access controls, integrations, workflow automation, reporting, data quality, upgrades, and enhancement prioritization.
  • Establish service quality metrics, dashboards, KPIs, and executive reporting for ITSM performance and platform health.
  • Increase CMDB accuracy and service mapping maturity.
  • Manage ITSM and BMC Helix budgets, vendors, contracts, performance expectations, escalations, and cost-benefit prioritization.
  • Build strong partnerships across IT, business, security, infrastructure, applications, regional organizations, and external vendors, ensuring that ITSM services and BMC Helix capabilities are aligned with enterprise priorities and business needs.
  • Ensure ITSM processes and BMC Helix configurations support compliance, auditability, role-based access, data integrity, and operational risk management.
  • Improve automation, reduce cycle time and operating cost of IT through endorsed investments in AI, chatbots, virtual agents, and improved customer-accessible knowledge management.
  • Minimum Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field is required.
  • 10+ years of experience of IT leadership experience, including significant ITSM, IT Operations, Service Delivery, or platform governance experience.
  • 5+ years of people leadership experience, including global or distributed teams
  • Strong ITIL/ITSM expertise and demonstrated experience owning or improving enterprise ITSM practices.
  • Experience with enterprise ITSM platforms; BMC Helix experience is strongly preferred.
  • Proven experience with service quality metrics, SLAs/OLAs, reporting, CMDB/configuration management, service catalogue, automation, and continual improvement.
  • Experience managing budgets, vendors, contracts, and senior stakeholder relationships.

We support your development! Do you feel you don’t match 100% of the requirements? Don’t hesitate to apply anyway! Eurofins companies are committed to supporting your career development.

We embrace diversity!  As an Equal Opportunity Employer, the Eurofins network of companies believes in strength and innovation through diversity. Company description: Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to ca. 63,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 60 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6.95 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

WHO WE ARE: 

We are a global collective of innovators applying the New every day to improve the way the world works and lives. Join Accenture and help transform leading organizations and communities around the world. The sheer scale of our capabilities and client engagements and the way we collaborate, operate and deliver value provides an unparalleled opportunity to grow and advance. Choose Accenture and make delivering innovative work part of your extraordinary career.  

Mid-market is a Growth Driver for Accenture

The Accenture Mid-market business is a core growth driver within Accenture, focused on helping Mid-market companies reinvent, scale, and compete with the agility required in today’s market. Mid-market organizations share the same bold ambitions as large enterprises, they are undergoing a significant transformation, driven by the need to modernize operations, accelerate growth, and respond to evolving industry demands. Accenture brings the full strength of our global capabilities—deep industry expertise, ecosystem partnerships, and proven innovation—to make enterprise grade solutions accessible, scalable, and simplified for midmarket needs. 

Powered by curated offerings, preconfigured solutions, accelerators, and AI enabled delivery models, Accenture Mid-market brings together teams across our global network to help clients drive real ROI, innovate faster, and transform with confidence. The Mid-market portfolio spans repeatable, industrialized solutions across technology, operations, security, cloud, and industry-specific needs to meet clients where they are on their reinvention journey. 

We are looking to expand our Mid-market team with the best talent, who have experience in the mid-market, across the business suite, and across functions, that will enable us to continue to drive transformations at scale. 

THE WORK: 

The Mid-Market Oracle Sales Executive is responsible for driving sales growth in the Accenture Edge Business by developing and closing new business opportunities with customers seeking Oracle Cloud ERP, NetSuite, and/or OCI solutions. They will focus on originating and closing opportunities across the full Oracle portfolio. This role combines deep industry knowledge, a passion for Oracle Fusion Cloud (ERP, HCM, SCM, EPM), NetSuite, and/or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and a consultative sales approach to help clients leverage Accenture's pre-defined Mid-Market offerings. The Sales Executive will interface directly with CFO, CIO, CTO, CHRO, and VP-level Operations and Finance leaders. They will be accountable for progressing opportunities from origination through close, coordinating closely with solution architects, delivery leads, and Oracle alliance teams.

 Key Responsibilities 

  • Engage directly with Mid Market Direct Prospects from the C-Suite to other Leaders

  • Coordinate closely lead generation providers, solutioning team and Technical Architects 

  • Engage with Oracle AEs, NetSuite channel reps, and OCI specialists, at the tactical and strategic level across the Sales, Solution Architect, and Partner Teams 

  • Meeting monthly, quarterly and yearly sales targets for the segment 

Travel may be required for this role.  The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements. 

 

Job Qualifications

  • Minimum 7 years of experience selling Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP/HCM/SCM, NetSuite, or OCI or comparable cloud ERP/infrastructure solutions

  • Proven track record of sourcing and closing business, preferably $500K+ ARR

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience (12 years) or an Associate’s Degree with 6 years of work experience

jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is seeking a high-impact, strategic seller to lead the go-to-market execution for our newest frontiers in Connected Equipment. As an Enterprise Specialist (Overlay), you will partner with our Account Executives (AEs) to build deep partnerships with our largest, most complex accounts. You aren't just selling a tool; you are pioneering GTM, ensuring our customers realize continuous value from new products as a part of the overall platform.

This specialist reports into the VP of Sales, EMEA and will be aligned by segment and product. AEs on the team are charged with accelerating the growth of one or more new product(s) and will be incentivized on quarterly product sales targets mapped to mainline sellers in the segment. Product Specialist sellers drive growth through strategic, high-value deal executing and enabling the segment overall to be successful.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the United Kingdom.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’re meeting with a VP of Operations in waste management; the next, you’re diving into the logistics of a global food distributor. You seek to understand the "unit of value" for every customer.
  • You build genuine, high-stakes relationships: Our customers operate in "boots-on-the-ground" industries. They value earned trust and partners who understand their operational realities.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team Player: In an overlay role, your success is tied to the success of the broader account team. You lead through influence, not just authority.

In this role, you will:

  • Architect deals that align Samsara’s new products value with customer use cases to provide maximum value and return on investment
  • Co-generate new product pipeline with ADRs/AEs across high propensity to buy accounts
  • Drive strategy and pilot/trial success
  • Provide commercial insights and pricing benchmarks often for unique set of competitors in the market
  • Partner with GTM and Product to feed back insights and help shape roadmap
  • Build frameworks, assets and insights that scale across the sales org
  • Travel 20%+ to meet customers where they physically operate and to advance solutions and deals
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years in complex, full-cycle Enterprise sales.
  • Proven Track Record: Consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts with £500k+/€500k+ ARR transactions.
  • Deal Complexity: Demonstrated success navigating 6- and 7-figure deals involving multiple stakeholders (Legal, Procurement, InfoSec, and C-Suite).
  • Entrepreneurial Agility: Experience selling new products where the playbook is still being written.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience working in a specialist/overlay co-selling with a mainline AE team.
  • Second language experience in French or German at business-level proficiency.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

About the job

About Juno

Juno leverages collective bargaining power to secure better student loan rates for higher education students. With 290,000+ members and over $2B in negotiated loan volume, we've proven that group buying works. We are the most popular way to pay for the world's top graduate programs, and we're expanding what a Juno membership is worth.

The Problem

Federal lending reforms have created a significant market shift. In July 2026, new caps on federal graduate loans, including the elimination of Grad PLUS for new students, came into effect, leaving millions of students with significant funding gaps. Students need transparent, competitive private options.

Our members trust us with one of the largest financial decisions of their lives. That trust is worth far more than a single loan.

Your Mission

Juno has 290,000 members who came to us for one product. We're building a portfolio of financial products and benefits that follows them from school into their careers.

You'll own that expansion. Each new product is yours from the first market question through to the first cohort of members using it. You'll pick the partners, build the case, and run the launch.

This is the widest surface area at Juno and the shortest path from a decision to a launch.

What You'll Do

  • Launch new products and member benefits end to end. Size the opportunity, select the partner, build the plan, ship it, and own the result.
  • Own the analysis behind the decision. Unit economics, market sizing, and build versus buy versus partner diligence that leadership acts on.
  • Carry our largest partnerships. Own major distribution and integration relationships day to day so they compound rather than stall.

What We Offer

Compensation: $115,000 to $140,000, plus variable compensation tied to performance.

Benefits: Comprehensive health, dental, vision, and retirement matching.

What We're Looking For

  • Background: 2 to 4 years in management consulting, investment banking, or a high-growth startup, or you've built something of your own.
  • Ownership end to end. You've taken something from a blank page to live in market.
  • Commercial judgment. You decide what to launch from real member research, then read early signals to make the call to scale it or wind it down.
  • Comfort with ambiguity. You're handed a goal rather than a plan, and you come back with a recommendation and the steps to get there.
  • Technical leverage. When the tool you need doesn't exist, you build it. AI tooling and APIs are how you already work.

The X-Factor

  • You're resourceful: constraints are where your best ideas have come from.
  • You're persuasive: you can get a partner, a lender, or a room of executives to say yes.

Interview process

Intro chat with the hiring manager, a case study exercise, cross-functional conversations with senior leadership, and references.

Why Join Juno?

Real Impact: Help hundreds of thousands of students get access to lower rates

Market Timing: Federal aid changes create massive tailwind for growth

Proven Model: $2B+ negotiated, 290K+ members, product-market fit achieved

Position Summary

The Director, Program Management is accountable for the strategic leadership, enterprise alignment, and end-to-end execution of one of the company’s most complex and high-profile programs. The program spans multiple interdependent workstreams and requires coordination and leadership across Product, Engineering, Operations, Commercial, Finance, Legal, Compliance, and other enterprise functions.

This role is a member of the Program Management Office (PMO) and reports through the PMO, with a dotted-line reporting relationship to the Senior Vice President accountable for the program. Working in close partnership with the SVP and Program Principal, the Director serves as a senior leader for both the external stakeholder relationship and internal program, translating contractual commitments, stakeholder priorities, and business objectives into enterprise strategy, priorities, and measurable outcomes.

The Director is expected to operate with significant autonomy, sound executive judgment, and a high degree of discretion. This individual must be equally effective influencing executive decisions, navigating sensitive stakeholder matters, and engaging directly in critical program work when necessary to accelerate progress, resolve complex issues, or protect program and business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Program Leadership

  • Partner with the SVP and Program Principal to establish the strategic direction, priorities, governance, and success measures for the program.
  • Serve as a senior, trusted partner to external and internal leadership, building credibility through transparency, responsiveness, sound judgment, and consistent execution.
  • Represent the broader enterprise in external stakeholder engagements, balancing contractual commitments and stakeholder priorities with the company’s operational, financial, technical, and strategic objectives.
  • Anticipate emerging program, stakeholder, and business challenges and lead proactive strategies to address them before they materially impact outcomes.
  • Provide the SVP and executive leadership with clear assessments, recommendations, and options on critical program decisions, risks, and opportunities.

Enterprise Program Leadership

  • Provide overall leadership and accountability for a complex portfolio of interconnected workstreams spanning multiple business and functional organizations.
  • Establish an integrated enterprise operating model that creates clear ownership, decision rights, escalation paths, dependencies, and accountability across workstream leaders.
  • Set direction and drive alignment across senior functional leaders where competing priorities, resource constraints, or organizational dependencies require enterprise-level resolution.
  • Ensure program decisions optimize overall enterprise and stakeholder outcomes rather than individual functional or workstream objectives.
  • Establish and maintain disciplined program governance, including executive steering, program reviews, decision forums, and escalation mechanisms.

Program Performance & Financial Management

  • Maintain executive oversight of program scope, schedule, budget, quality, resources, risks, dependencies, and contractual commitments.
  • Establish performance expectations and ensure workstream leaders are accountable for measurable deliverables, milestones, financial targets, and contractual commitments.
  • Own program-level risk and issue management, directing recovery strategies and corrective actions when delivery, financial, contractual, or stakeholder outcomes are at risk.
  • Provide oversight of program budget, forecasts, expenditures, resource requirements, and financial exposure in partnership with Finance and functional leadership.
  • Evaluate and communicate the enterprise impact of material scope changes, schedule adjustments, resource decisions, and external commitments.
  • Maintain sufficient depth in program details to independently assess program health, challenge assumptions, and intervene directly when required to drive resolution.

Government Contracts, Compliance & Risk

  • Ensure program execution aligns with government contract requirements, statements of work, service-level commitments, policies, regulations, and stakeholder-specific obligations.
  • Partner with Legal, Commercial, Finance, Security, and Compliance leadership to identify and mitigate contractual, regulatory, financial, and reputational exposure.
  • Ensure appropriate controls, documentation, approvals, and evidence are maintained to support contractual compliance and audit readiness.
  • Provide leadership for significant contract changes, escalations, remediation efforts, audits, and corrective action plans.

Executive Communication & Stakeholder Leadership

  • Lead executive-level program reviews, steering committees, escalations, and strategic planning discussions with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Communicate complex, sensitive, and high-impact matters with exceptional clarity, precision, discretion, and judgment at every level of the organization and with external stakeholders.
  • Synthesize complex program information into concise executive communications that clearly articulate program health, business implications, risks, recommendations, and decisions required.
  • Navigate sensitive contractual, organizational, operational, and stakeholder matters with a high degree of professionalism and confidentiality.
  • Influence senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders without reliance on direct authority, building alignment and accountability around enterprise priorities.
  • Maintain credibility and composure in high-pressure environments, including executive escalations, service disruptions, contractual disputes, and other critical program matters.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, program management, public administration, technology, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 12+ years of progressive program, project, or business leadership experience, including responsibility for large-scale, highly complex, cross-functional programs.
  • Demonstrated experience leading strategic, high-visibility programs with significant enterprise, financial, operational, contractual, and reputational impact.
  • Proven ability to operate effectively with senior executives and serve as a trusted advisor to both internal and external leadership.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to synthesize complex information, communicate with precision, and tailor messaging for executive, external stakeholder, technical, and operational audiences.
  • Exceptional judgment and discretion, with demonstrated experience managing confidential, politically sensitive, contractual, or high-risk matters appropriately at all organizational levels.
  • Strong executive presence and demonstrated ability to communicate difficult messages, influence decisions, resolve conflict, and establish alignment with credibility and composure.
  • Significant experience managing programs governed by government contracts, public-sector requirements, or highly regulated contractual environments.
  • Advanced expertise in scope, schedule, budget, financial management, resource planning, risk, dependency, governance, and change control.
  • Strong understanding of contractual requirements, statements of work, service-level commitments, acceptance criteria, compliance obligations, and audit requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead effectively within a highly matrixed organization and drive accountability across teams and leaders outside of direct reporting authority.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to evaluate program decisions through operational, contractual, financial, stakeholder, and enterprise perspectives.
  • Exceptional organizational discipline, attention to detail, judgment, and follow-through.
  • Ability to move fluidly between strategic leadership and detailed execution, engaging directly in critical work when required to achieve the desired outcome.

Preferred Qualifications

  • PMP, PgMP, or comparable program management certification.
  • Experience supporting state, local, municipal, transportation, public safety, tolling, mobility, or other government entities.
  • Experience leading technology-enabled programs involving software, infrastructure, operational services, integrations, data, or regulatory compliance.
  • Experience leading significant escalations, service recovery, contract change, remediation, or transformation initiatives.
  • Experience operating in a PMO, enterprise transformation, or portfolio management environment.

Verra Mobility Values
An ideal candidate for this role naturally works in alignment with the Verra Mobility Core Values:

  • Own It.We focus on high performance and drive toward breakthrough outcomes. Our employees ensure accountability, optimize and align work, focus on the customer, and cultivate innovation.
  • Do What’s Right.We champion integrity and good character. Our team members model ethical behavior, demonstrate good judgment and are courageous.
  • Choose Courage Over Comfort. We lean into the conversations, decisions and actions that move the business forward, even when they feel uncomfortable. We challenge assumptions, address issues early and prioritize progress over ease.
  • Win Together. We believe in growing and inspiring people together. We seek people who collaborate, value differences, think and act globally, foster an engaging work environment, and recognize and develop others.

In no event will we retain such data more than two (2) years following the closure of the recruitment process relating to the role for which you applied or in the event other related job opportunities arise within the company. Job Description:

Title:  AI Engineer(P3)

Location: Remote – USA, Canada,Europeor Australia

Reports to:Sr. Director, AI & Innovation

The Role:  

You build the full-stack components that power Innovation Crew pilots and prototypes. Under the technical direction of the Principal AI Engineer, in close collaboration with the AI Experience Engineer, you write the backend services, API integrations, data connectors, and frontend implementations that turn AI architectures into working systems. This role has a high ceiling and a fast runway: you will be working alongside engineers at the frontier of AI application development, with hands-on exposure to frontier model APIs, agentic frameworks, Power Agents library development, and JD Power's core data infrastructure. You arrive with strong engineering fundamentals and a genuine appetite for AI systems. You gain deep, production-proven agentic engineering experience. In your first 30 days, you will have your first feature shipped inside a PoC sprint and the codebase oriented. By day 60, you will have your first Power Agents contribution reviewed and merged. By day 90, you will have full implementation ownership of at least one PoCcomponent.

How we BuildAgents:

The Innovation Crew builds alongside its own AI agent workforce. As AI Engineer, you will contribute to building andmaintainingthose agents: writing the tool integrations, evaluation harnesses, and API connectors that give agents access to JD Power's data and systems. You learn to build for observability from day one - every agent pattern you ship is instrumented, testable, and inspectable. The bar here is not "it worked in the demo" but "it behaves predictably, and we can prove it." When a pattern proves reliable, you contribute it to the Power Agents library, where 400+ engineers & knowledge workers can build on it.

The Impact You Will Have in This Role: 

Innovation Crew pilots only get built because the engineering work that underlies them gets done cleanly and quickly. You are the execution engine that turns architectural direction into working code. You build backend services that connect to Snowflake, API integrations that wire agent outputs to JD Power's core platforms, frontend components the AI Experience Engineer builds on. The pilots you help build will be handed off as operational systems tomaintainingteams within Product Engineering, Engineering, OEM Solutions, Infrastructure, and Internal Platforms. You will contribute directly to the Power Agents library, meaning code you write will be used by engineers & knowledge workers across JD Power.

WhatYou’llBe Doing in This Role:

  • Build full-stack features and components for Innovation Crew pilots under the technical direction of the Principal AI Engineer: backend services, REST APIs, data pipeline connectors, and frontend implementations; writing clean, well-documented code oriented toward handoff to maintaining teams within Product Engineering, Engineering, OEM Solutions, Infrastructure, or Internal Platforms.

  • Integrate Innovation Crew builds with JD Power's core data infrastructure: Snowflake, internal APIs, cloud platforms, and the API Gateway following published gateway standards and working with Internal Platforms to confirm data access, schema conventions, and connection patterns before building.

  • Contribute to Power Agents library development: implement new agent patterns under the direction of the Principal AI Engineer, write tests, instrument traces, and document behavior so every module you contribute is auditable, testable, and reusable by the engineering organization.

  • Contribute to the team's AI agent workforce: build tool integrations, evaluation harnesses, and observability instrumentation that give development agents access to JD Power's systems; implement the baseline evals that let the team verify agent behavior is reliable before relying on it.

  • Consume and configure frontier model APIs, agentic frameworks (LangGraph,CrewAI, or equivalent), and MCP server integrations as directed; develop hands-onproficiencywith the team's AI engineering stack in a production-adjacent environment with real delivery pressure.

  • Collaborate closely with the AI Experience Engineer to bring interface designs to life: implement frontend components, connect UI layers to backend services, and contribute to the sharedcomponentlibrary.

  • Support intake technical scoping by mapping integration dependencies, spiking on technical unknowns, and estimating effort;participatein Emerging Technology evaluations by building PoC implementations and contributing benchmark findings to Technology Radar drafts.

Qualifications of this Role:

  • Full-stack engineering fundamentals across backend (REST APIs, cloud-native service patterns) and frontend: solid enough to build a working API, connect it to a data source, and surface it through a functional UI - you do not need a dedicated teammate to do either half.

  • Genuine, demonstrable curiosity about AI systems: you have built something with an LLM API, understand what RAG and tool-calling mean in practice, follow frontier model developments, and actively use AI coding tools as part of how you work.

  • Clean, well-documented code and a fast-learning orientation: this role pairs closely with principal-level engineers who move quickly; you absorb direction, ask sharp questions, and contribute meaningfully without waiting for complete specifications.

Also Valued

  • Python and/or TypeScript; experience withLangChain,LangGraph, or equivalent agent frameworks; familiarity with Snowflake,BigQuery, or equivalent cloud data platform.

  • RAG patterns, vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone,Weaviate), and basic eval harness design, even if you have only done this in a side project, knowing the concepts matters.

  • Observability basics: you know the difference between a trace and a log, have seenLangfuseorLangSmithin use, and understand why instrumentation is part of building, not a post-build step.

  • JD Power internal platform or API familiarity; existing knowledge of our data schemas or product ecosystem reduces ramp time significantly.

The Hiring Manager says: 

“I am looking for someone with strong engineering fundamentals and a genuine hunger to apply them to AI systems. You do not need a five-yeartrack record, you need to have built something real with an LLM, have clean code instincts, and be ready to learn fast alongside engineers who are working at the frontier. If you can demo something youactually shipped (an agent, a RAG pipeline, a tool-calling integration, anything where you can walk through what broke and how you fixed it) that tells me everything I need to know.”

  • Ensure BI solutions comply with data governance policies, security standards, and regulatory requirements.

  • Contribute to and follow standards for naming, workspace structure, environments, and deployment flows in Fabric.

  • Contribute to shared libraries of reusable calculations, templates, and visual standards.

  • Provide structured handovers, user support, and occasional training or knowledge-sharing sessions.

  • Collaborate with data engineering, architecture, governance, and security teams to align on standards and patterns.

  • Power BI datasets, reports, and apps

  • Solid understanding of data warehousing and dimensional modelling concepts.

  • Experience implementing BI security models (e.g. RLS).

  • Familiarity with Git-based source control and CI/CD practices for BI and analytics assets.

  • Experience working with enterprise source systems (e.g. ERP, CRM, finance systems).

Our purpose, to improve customers’ lives by making healthcare work better, is far from ordinary. And so are our employees. Working at Premera means you have the opportunity to drive real change by transforming healthcare.

In this role, your accuracy, sound judgment, and commitment to quality will help ensure members and providers receive timely, reliable outcomes. You’ll also strengthen valuable skills in research, benefit interpretation, claims adjudication, and peer support—creating a strong foundation for continued growth within the organization.

The Claims Processor II is responsible for the accurate and timely review, research, and resolution of moderately complex claims in accordance with contracts and policies. This may include subrogation, Medicare, and coordination of benefits for dental, medical and hospital claims. Incumbent is responsible for interpreting procedures and policies to ensure accurate claims resolution. Incumbent may also be responsible for processing simple and routine claims.

What you will do:

  • Review, process, and resolve moderately complex claims in accordance with contracts and policies.
  • Research claims through the utilization of reference materials and on-line tools.
  • Responsible for accurately coding claims through the system.
  • Translate data into information acceptable to the claims processing system including follow up on pended claims.
  • Maintain all appropriate claims files and perform follow-up on pended claims.
  • Prepare claims for return to Provider or Subscriber when additional information is needed.
  • Demonstrate adjudication proficiency to meet or exceed accuracy goals.
  • Consistently meet cycle time/productivity goals that are aligned with corporate objectives.
  • Maintain confidentiality of all documents/files.
  • Contact other carriers or provider offices as necessary.
  • May provide `buddy training' and feedback to new associates.
  • May complete adjustments, reversals, and/or refunds.
  • Apply commitment to quality by doing things right the first time in order to avoid defects from reaching customers or requiring internal re-work.

What you will bring:

  • High School diploma or GED (Required).
  • Six (6) months of claims processing experience or customer service experience (Required).
  • Experience with Out-of-area program.
  • Technical experience of contract benefits, claims processing steps, and correction procedures.

Thousands of advisors and branch professionals rely on strong supervision, sound judgment, and thoughtful guidance to serve clients with confidence. We are looking for a Senior Advisor, Supervisory Solutions to join our team.

This role is for a professional who enjoys solving complex problems, navigating regulatory requirements, and partnering with advisors and branch leadership to manage risk while supporting business growth.

You will review activity that requires supervisory oversight, identify emerging concerns, provide guidance on firm and regulatory requirements, and serve as a trusted resource to advisors, branch managers, and business partners.

The work requires strong judgment. The regulations evolve. The questions are rarely identical.

The impact is real.

You Might Be a Great Fit If You

  • Remain calm and objective when addressing complex supervisory matters
    • Balance risk management with practical business solutions
    • Ask thoughtful questions and follow the facts
    • Communicate difficult messages with professionalism and credibility
    • Build trusted relationships across multiple business partners
    • Enjoy interpreting regulations and translating them into actionable guidance
    • Can identify patterns, trends, and emerging risks before they become larger issues
    • Take ownership and work independently while collaborating effectively with others
    • View every supervisory review as an opportunity to protect clients, advisors, and the firm

What You'll Do

Strong supervision is more than reviewing transactions and policies.

If you are energized by meaningful work, thoughtful collaboration, and making sound decisions in a complex environment, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.excerpt: The RoleWe're looking for an Ad Operations Manager to own trafficking, tagging, and campaign QA across every paid channel our B2B team runs: Programmatic, Direct I/O, Paid Social, and Paid Search.
jobs.description:
The Role

We're looking for an Ad Operations Manager to own trafficking, tagging, and campaign QA across every paid channel our B2B team runs: Programmatic, Direct I/O, Paid Social, and Paid Search. The role is primarily dedicated to one of Wpromote's largest B2B accounts, a leading financial software company with multiple product lines and business units, with additional support across our other B2B clients as needed. Programmatic and direct buys will generate most of the day-to-day trafficking volume, but you'll be the single point of accountability for tracking and campaign setup across all channels, so the team has one consistent standard rather than channel-by-channel workarounds. You'll work alongside our channel teams, Client Service, and Analytics as the person who makes sure every campaign is set up correctly, tracked accurately, and launched on time.

This is a hands-on technical role. You'll traffic creatives, build and QA tags, troubleshoot tracking issues, and keep the measurement plumbing clean so the media and analytics teams can trust the data. B2B campaigns often involve long conversion paths, multiple tracking systems, and lead data that has to flow cleanly from ad click to CRM, so you'll need to be comfortable working across ad servers, tag managers, platform pixels, and marketing automation tools.

At Wpromote, we believe that great work is only possible with great people. Our goal is to build a better, more inclusive work environment and support our people at every stage of their careers by prioritizing a strong work-life balance through our policies and benefits listed below. As a Best Place to Work according to both Ad Age and Glassdoor and Adweek’s Fastest Growing Digital Agency, we are moving fast to expand our teams and bring new experts into the fold to keep pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in marketing.
We offer:
-Remote-first culture
-Unlimited PTO
-Extended Holiday break (Winter)
-Flexible schedules
-Work from anywhere options*
-100% paid parental leave
-401(k) matching
-Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Pet Insurance
-Sponsored life insurance
-Short Term Disability insurance and additional voluntary insurance
-Annual Class Pass credits and more!
The anticipated annual salary for this role will range from $70,000 - $80,000, based on consideration of a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years and depth of experience, education and certifications, competitive benchmarks, scope of responsibility, market dynamics, geographic location, and respective state’s salary threshold for exempt employees. The total compensation package for this role will include benefits (listed above).
*This position may be performed remotely in most states within the US, with some exclusions
**While this role offers the flexibility to work remotely, we have office hubs in Los Angeles, Chicago, and New York, where you can join in on learning and development opportunities, fun events, take advantage of a space to work, and collaborate in person!
***This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship
Important Notice: Beware of Job Scams
Wpromote recruiting communications will only be sent through our official channels via email addresses. If you see a posting elsewhere that is not reflected on Wpromote.com/careers, it may be a fraudulent posting. We do not require payment or fees during the hiring process nor do we request sensitive information, such as Social Security numbers or payment details. Please safeguard yourself against possible scams and contact us if you encounter any suspicious activity.

You Will Be

  • Trafficking all programmatic and direct I/O creatives in Campaign Manager 360, including standard, HTML5, and third-party served creatives, and ensuring every setting is right before launch
  • Building, implementing, and QAing impression trackers, click trackers, and daisy-chained tags across CM360, DSPs, and publisher partners, including passing macros and custom variables through the chain so downstream systems get the data they need
  • Implementing and QAing site-side tracking across Google Tag Manager, GA4, and platform pixels (LinkedIn Insight Tag, Meta, and others), using data layer variables for triggers and troubleshooting when tracking breaks
  • Owning conversion tracking hygiene across channels, including UTM governance, conversion event setup, and coordinating offline conversion imports and CRM or marketing automation integrations with client teams
  • Fielding tagging and tracking requests from Media and Analytics teams, and making sure data lands where it needs to for reporting
  • Serving as the main point of contact for technical issues related to ad serving, verification vendors, and third-party tracking
  • Working with the Programmatic Activation team on missing assets, campaign pacing, and launch readiness
  • Supporting Paid Social and Paid Search teams on conversion tracking, pixel and tag setup, UTM consistency, and campaign QA so all channels report against the same measurement standard
  • Coordinating with Client Service to make sure client assets are delivered to all necessary parties on time
  • Managing intake, tracking, and documentation of trafficking and tagging requests so nothing falls through the cracks
  • Contributing to campaign performance reporting and flagging delivery, tracking, or data quality issues early
  • Documenting and improving ad ops processes and QA checklists as the team and client scope grow

You Must Have

  • 2-5 years of ad operations experience, ideally at an agency or ad tech company
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in Campaign Manager 360: placements, creatives, tracking ads, Floodlight configuration, and the settings that quietly break campaigns when they're wrong
  • Fluency with impression trackers, click trackers, and HTML5 creatives, including how they embed and how to daisy-chain tags across ad server, DSP, and publisher
  • Experience with DSP tag setup, including using platform macros and custom variables to pass additional data through tags
  • Experience with tag management and web analytics, including Google Tag Manager and GA4, and using data layer variables to build triggers
  • Hands-on pixel implementation experience across the major platforms (LinkedIn, Meta, Google Ads, and others)
  • Familiarity with verification and viewability vendors such as IAS or DoubleVerify
  • Working knowledge of HTML, JavaScript, and browser debugging tools
  • Working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets, including pivot tables and formulas
  • Strong understanding of media planning and buying processes and basic campaign KPIs (CTR, viewability, conversion rate, CPL)
  • Exceptional attention to detail and a proven ability to troubleshoot and solve problems
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues to non-technical teammates and clients
  • Strong prioritization skills and the ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-moving environment

Nice to Have

  • Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo) and how paid media data flows into them
  • Experience supporting B2B or SaaS advertisers
  • Experience on large, complex accounts with multiple stakeholders and business units
  • Familiarity with server-side tagging, consent management, or privacy-related tracking changes

jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

As the Marketing Communications Manager, Contrast Media, you will lead integrated marketing communications strategy for GE HealthCare's Contrast Media portfolio, driving awareness, adoption, and commercial growth through compelling content, omnichannel campaigns, and customer engagement programs. Partner cross-functionally with product marketing, sales, digital marketing, medical affairs, regulatory, and legal to deliver customer-focused communications while managing the regulatory approval process for all promotional materials. Ideal for a highly collaborative, detail-oriented marketing professional with strong project management skills and healthcare/pharmaceutical industry experience.

Job Description

Job Description Summary

The Marketing Communications Manager, Contrast Media Portfolio, is responsible for developing and executing integrated marketing communications strategies that drive awareness, adoption, customer engagement, and commercial growth across the Contrast Media portfolio.

This role partners closely with Product Marketing (i.e. Brand Managers), Clinical Marketing, Sales, Digital Marketing, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Legal, and external agencies to deliver compelling, customer-focused communications that support business objectives throughout the customer journey. The Marketing Communications Manager serves as the strategic lead for content development, campaign execution, omnichannel communications, sales enablement, event promotion, and marketing operations while ensuring all materials meet regulatory and compliance requirements.

The ideal candidate is highly collaborative with strong project management skills, a passion for storytelling, and experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives in a regulated healthcare environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Marketing communications & strategy: Develop and lead integrated marketing communications strategies that align business objectives, drive portfolio growth, and strengthen customer engagement across the Contrast Media portfolio.
  • Content strategy & creation: Create compelling, customer-focused content and messaging that effectively communicates portfolio value across audiences, channels, and stages of the buyer journey.
  • Campaign management: Plan, execute, and optimize omnichannel marketing campaigns that increase awareness, generate demand, and support commercial objectives. Coordinate with Director of Marketing Communications and Brand to manage the content calendar and tactic flowchart documents.
  • Brand standards & content review: Ensure all marketing communications and materials align with GE HealthCare brand guidelines, applying strong attention to detail to write, edit, review, and proof content for accuracy, consistency, and quality.
  • Sales enablement & commercial support: Develop strategic marketing tools, resources, and communications that enhance sales effectiveness and support customer decision-making.
  • Events, webinars & customer engagement: Lead the promotion and execution of customer engagement programs, including events, webinars, and educational initiatives that strengthen customer relationships and market presence.
  • APR ownership and management: Ensure all marketing communications comply with regulatory, legal, and medical company requirements through effective management of approval processes and promotional review workflows. This role will also manage updating and maintaining the claims matrix document.
  • Cross functional leadership: Partner across Marketing, Commercial, Clinical, Digital, Regulatory, Medical Affairs, Legal, and external teams to align priorities, drive execution, and deliver impactful business outcomes.
  • Measurement & optimization: Leverage performance data and customer insights to evaluate effectiveness, guide decision-making, and continuously improve marketing outcomes.
  • Agency & vendor management: Manage agency and vendor relationships to ensure high-quality, cost-effective delivery of marketing communications programs and initiatives.
  • Budget management: Ensure projects stay on scope and do not go over the estimated total expenditure.
  • Budget and purchases: Support the team in managing the marketing budget, processing invoices and purchase orders, and submitting compliance approvals (i.e. AST system).

Key Capabilities:

  • Strong project management skills with the ability to plan, execute, budget and oversee multiple marketing projects and events.
  • Ability to create comprehensive and holistic communication strategy in support of marketing strategy and in line with programs and tactics to drive growth.
  • Strong writing and editorial skills to write, create and review copy to ensure high-quality level of work, including making APR edits and confirming edits have been made correctly to avoid multiple rounds of approvals and FDA 2253 submissions.
  • Experience in coordinating with regulatory, legal and compliance teams to navigate the review and approval process for marketing content.
  • Experience planning and managing marketing events, including trade shows, conferences and digital events (i.e. webinars, speaker programs, etc.)
  • Ability to coordinate logistics, vendor relations and on-site support to ensure seamless event execution.
  • Meticulous attention to detail and the customer experience.
  • Familiarity with marketing software and tools, such as CRM, sales enablement and marketing automation platforms.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.

Our client runs a boutique social media organic content agency that manages the full short-form video production process — scripting, filming, and posting — for approximately 20 clients across industries like real estate, mortgage lending, law, and medical aesthetics. They specialize in evergreen, organic content (not trend-chasing) and work roughly a month ahead on their content calendar, giving them a structured, deadline-driven production rhythm.
Why does this role exist?
The founders currently handle every stage of the scripting process themselves — from researching what's working on TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube to writing and formatting full scripts for each client — and it has become the biggest bottleneck to growing the business. This role exists to take that research-to-script pipeline off their plate entirely, so they can focus on client growth and strategy instead of production. The right person will operate as a true scripting partner: someone who can independently spot what's performing, generate strong ideas, and execute polished, on-template scripts across multiple client accounts without needing to be walked through each one.

The Impact you’ll make

Content Research
  • Scrape and identify top-performing content on TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube within specific client niches (e.g., real estate, loan officers, law, medical aesthetics)
  • Track patterns in what's driving engagement across those niches
  • Use findings to inform idea generation and script direction

Idea Generation
  • Generate content ideas tailored to each client's brand and audience
  • Base ideas on proven, high-performing content rather than trend-chasing
  • Bring proactive suggestions to the team without waiting to be prompted

Script Writing Formatting
  • Write full short-form scripts (30–60 seconds) using the client's existing templates, including visual hooks, picture formatting, and inspiration links
  • Apply the established color-coding and formatting system consistently across every script
  • Deliver completed scripts at least 48 hours ahead of each film day

AI-Assisted Workflow Tools
  • Use Claude and other existing frameworks to support and speed up the scripting process
  • Work fluidly across G Suite, MS 365, and native social platforms as part of daily production

Client Process Support
  • Support client communications and keep clients updated throughout the content process
  • Help build out the scripting SOP as the role and process matures
  • Take on general administrative tasks and other delegated responsibilities as needed

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Required:
  • Strong, demonstrable understanding of what performs well on TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube across multiple content niches
  • Proven experience writing structured short-form video scripts (30–60 seconds) that include visual hooks and formatting systems
  • Hands-on experience using Claude or similar AI tools for content research and script generation
  • Ability to research and reverse-engineer top-performing content into original scripts
Your superpowers are...
  • Technical:
    • Sharp eye for short-form content trends and what drives watch-through and engagement
    • Structured, template-driven script writing (hooks, pacing, formatting)
    • Comfortable working across G Suite, MS 365, and AI tools like Claude in a daily production workflow
    • Strong research skills — able to scan platforms and extract actionable patterns quickly
  • Soft Skills:
    • Meticulous attention to detail, especially around formatting and color-coding systems
    • Self-starter who generates ideas proactively rather than waiting for direction
    • Reliable under deadline pressure, especially the 48-hour delivery window
    • Clear, responsive communicator over WhatsApp, Slack, or iMessage
    • Comfortable adapting to evolving SOPs and frameworks as the process is built out

  • You're proactive by nature, comfortable bringing ideas to the table rather than waiting to be told what to do, and you thrive in a fast-moving, deadline-driven environment where consistency matters as much as creativity.
  • You're also excited by the idea of using AI tools like Claude as part of your everyday workflow, not intimidated by it.

What this opportunity involves

We're building competitive-programming problems and their automatic graders (test cases + checkers) used to train advanced AI coding models. You'll create problems, write both correct and deliberately-wrong solutions, and design the tough test cases that catch subtly-broken code. Your work is what makes the training signal trustworthy.

To apply, share: your competitive-programming handle(s) + current/peak rating, any problem-setting experience, and IOI/ICPC/olympiad history.

What you'll do

  • Write original algorithmic problems — clear statement, sound constraints, an intended solution;
  • Write correct solutions in C++ and Python;
  • Write realistic wrong solutions (common mistakes) to test against;
  • Build and harden test cases: generators, edge cases, stress and "hacking" tests;
  • Write checkers/interactors (testlib) for problems with more than one valid answer;
  • Confirm the quality bar: correct solutions pass, wrong ones fail, within time limits.

What we look for

  • Strong competitive programming background, shown by a public profile — a Codeforces rating (see levels below), OR an IOI / ICPC / national-olympiad record;
  • Fluent contest C++ (STL, complexity); comfortable writing Python;

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. jobs.description:
This is an internal role at Weekday. Not a role by a client.

  • Role type: Full time
  • Location: Remote
  • Working days: Monday–Saturday
  • Working with: Founders and the customer success team

Weekday is an AI-native recruiting platform. We are backed by Y Combinator and Venture Highway (now General Catalyst). We have built the largest white-collar talent database in India and have built tools to run outbound recruiting campaigns to them.

About the role

Every week, founders and talent leads book time with us because hiring in India is broken for them. You take that meeting and you take it all the way to a signed subscription.

The pipeline is handed to you. The conversation is not. Thirty minutes with a founder is enough to either earn a customer or lose one, and the difference is almost always how well you understood their hiring problem before you started talking about ours. You'll learn the product deeply enough to search live on a call, quote real candidate supply for their roles, and answer the hard question — "why can't my recruiter just do this?" — without flinching.

This is a closing seat, not a coordinating one. You'll be judged on revenue you brought in this month, and you'll know exactly where you stand at all times. Some months that's a great feeling. Some months it isn't.

If you need a defined territory, a fixed script, and quarterly reviews to know how you're doing, this will feel uncomfortable.

What you'll actually do

On any given day you might be:

  • Taking booked demos with startup founders, HR leads and talent partners, and diagnosing their hiring problem before pitching anything
  • Showing exactly how our database and outbound campaigns fill the roles sitting open on their careers page
  • Writing follow-ups people actually reply to, and building the case internally for the person championing us
  • Working pricing, paperwork and procurement to done — not to "waiting on them"
  • Reviving deals that went cold, and killing the ones that were never real
  • Bringing objections and lost-deal patterns back to the founders and product team
  • Sitting in on early customer success conversations so what you sell is what gets delivered

You'll be measured on whether deals closed — well, and on time. Not on activity.

What we're looking for

  • 2+ years selling B2B SaaS or services, with a number you owned and hit
  • You're curious on calls — you ask the second and third question instead of jumping to the demo
  • You can explain a product simply to a founder who has ten minutes and no patience
  • You chase things down. Nothing sits in your pipeline untouched for a week
  • You're straight with people — no overselling, because customer success has to live with what you promise
  • You want to understand recruiting deeply, not just sell software
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and a Monday–Saturday pace

What you get

  • Warm, qualified demos from day one — you spend your time selling, not prospecting from zero
  • A product built on the largest white-collar talent database in India, with 1000+ companies as proof
  • Direct exposure to the founders and how decisions actually get made
  • A real look at how a profitable, venture-backed startup is built and run
  • Uncapped upside if you can close
