Empowering people to be creative.

That’s why Knak exists.

We are a world-class enterprise email and landing page creation platform with a focus on making successful and happy customers by providing them with an incredibly powerful, yet easy to use creation platform.

Our industry leading SaaS solution is built by Marketers, for Marketers. We know that it’s the small things that make the biggest impact and that emails and landing pages are where the rubber hits the road when it comes to Marketing Automation. We change the way Marketers work by making them more efficient, while improving conversion rate of their campaigns and helping them stay on brand.

Oh, and we have a bit of fun while doing it, too!

The Role: Senior Software Developer, AI Agents

We’re looking for an experienced software developer to build and scale the AI agents behind Knak’s platform. In this role you'll develop the agent harness itself: the orchestration, tool calling, context management, and guardrails that let agents analyze data, generate complex marketing assets, and deliver real value to our customers. You'll also ensure we know they work, by building the evaluation suites that measure agent quality and catch regressions before they reach customers.

This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to be deep in agent internals every day. You'll also contribute to architecture decisions, mentor teammates, and collaborate across engineering and product to shape the future of marketing automation.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Build the agent harness: Design and implement the core agent runtime in Python: orchestration loops, tool definitions and execution, memory and context management, structured outputs, and failure handling.
  • Own agent evaluations: Build and maintain eval datasets, automated evaluators, and LLM-as-judge pipelines (LangSmith) so every prompt, model, or harness change is measured, not guessed at.
  • Iterate on agent quality: Diagnose agent failures from traces, tune prompts and tool designs, and run model comparisons and benchmarks to drive measurable improvements.
  • Create AI microservices: Build Python and Node.js services for agent hosting and LLM interaction.
  • Build reliable APIs: Develop and maintain the Laravel (PHP) APIs that integrate agents into the Knak platform, ensuring testability, observability, and performance.
  • Deploy to the cloud: Use AWS services (Lambda, Bedrock, CDN delivery) to build secure, scalable infrastructure for agents.
  • Optimize databases: Tune MySQL queries and indexing to improve speed and reduce latency.
  • Elevate code quality: Lead and participate in code reviews, maintaining high standards across the team.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work with product, design, QA, and DevOps to align solutions with business needs.
  • Mentor engineers: Share knowledge on agent development and evaluation practices, and set a high bar for technical excellence.

What You Should Bring

  • 6+ years of backend software development experience
  • Hands-on experience building LLM-powered agents in production, including tool calling, orchestration, context management, and prompt engineering
  • Experience designing and running evaluations for LLM systems, including dataset curation, automated evaluators, LLM-as-judge, and regression tracking
  • Strong proficiency in Python, Node.js, and MySQL
  • Expertise in RESTful APIs, TDD, CI/CD (GitHub Actions)
  • Experience with SaaS architecture, microservices, and AWS
  • Knowledge of observability, performance tuning, and scalability
  • Familiarity with Docker/Kubernetes
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a collaborative mindset

Nice to Have

  • Interest in, or experience with, full-stack web development spanning frontend (e.g. Vue), backend (e.g. PHP Laravel), and agent engineering, with a willingness to work across all three as the product needs
  • Experience in AI-powered product development
  • Background with LLMs, LangGraph, or AI agent frameworks
  • Prior experience in a fast-growing SaaS company

What We Offer

At Knak we have four foundational pillars. Culture, customers, product and growth. Culture is our number one pillar because we know that is at the core of building a strong company that can build amazing products and delight our customers. We do this with a laser focus on hiring the right people who are smart, positive and who want more than the typical nine-to-five offers.

We offer an extremely rewarding, second to none work environment as acknowledged by Ottawa’s Best Places to Work 2025! We show our investment in our people through our competitive salaries, equity in the company, great benefits, paid vacation, Life leave days (because life happens), team lunches and off-sites, and most importantly our commitment to YOUR career growth.

If this sounds like something you’re looking for, then we’d love to hear from you!

If you don’t see yourself fully reflected in every job requirement listed on the posting above, we still encourage you to reach out and apply. Research has shown that women and underrepresented groups often only apply when they feel 100% qualified. jobs.excerpt: Imagine a world where everyone’s full potential is recognized and nurtured.
jobs.description:
Imagine a world where everyone’s full potential is recognized and nurtured.

That’s what we’re building at Acuity Insights.

We believe higher education admissions should look beyond grades and consider the whole person—their experiences, strengths, and unique qualities.

Join a community of Raters helping admissions teams see applicants beyond grades.

Video Interviews is a fully configurable, asynchronous interview tool designed for higher education admissions teams. It gives programs a scalable way to hear directly from applicants and assess the attributes that matter most to them, without the scheduling, coordination, or workload of live interviews.

Together with our other products, such as Casper, it helps admissions teams see applicants more fully, beyond grades and test scores, and make confident, defensible decisions about their future professionals.

As a Video Interviews Rater, you’ll play a critical role in this process. By reviewing and scoring applicant responses, you’ll help our Canadian-based partners make more well-rounded and informed admissions decisions.

This role is designed to fit into your life:

  • Work on your own schedule from anywhere in Canada.
  • Earn extra income while doing socially meaningful work.
  • Join a community of Raters committed to strengthening admissions with reliable, evidence-based assessments.

What You’ll Do as a Video Interviews Rater

  • Become a certified Rater. Complete virtual, scientifically backed, onboarding training to learn how to rate responses of applicants to academic programs.
  • Complete ongoing training and mandatory annual recertification. Participate in ongoing refresher training and complete our required paid annual Rater recertification, ensuring your quality of work remains high.
  • Rate and score Video Interviews responses : Review applicant video responses and assign scores following scoring guidelines.
  • Share feedback. Provide feedback to help improve and optimize the Video Interviews tool, platforms, and content.

Foundations for Success as a Video Interviews Rater

  • Consistent Engagement & Professionalism—You demonstrate high commitment by consistently participating in rating sessions and upholding a professional demeanour, recognizing the significance of your contribution.
  • Ongoing Skill Development—You regularly engage in the required training and feedback activities to stay informed on best practices and ensure that your evaluations are current and reliable.
  • Effective Communication & Responsiveness—You exhibit clear and effective communication, responding promptly to surveys and feedback, and reflecting a proactive and collaborative mindset.
  • Empathy & Understanding—You approach every response with empathy and fairness, recognizing the impact your evaluations can have on an applicant’s academic journey.
  • Bias Awareness & Integrity—You maintain strong self-awareness, actively reflecting on and addressing potential biases to provide objective and equitable evaluations.

Payments

We issue payments for work you’ve completed via Plooto once a month.

While there’s no guaranteed minimum work, you can access a quarterly testing schedule, which allows you to choose when to work and estimate potential earnings. Pay may include activities outside of rating, like job training and participating in research studies.

To Qualify as a Video Interviews Rater, you must:

  • Be a Canadian citizen.
  • Currently residing in Canada.
  • Have your own desktop/laptop computer to work on.
  • Have no plans to apply to and become a student in a program using an Acuity Insights product (e.g., Video Interviews and Casper) in the next 2-3 years.
  • Communicate effectively and proactively in writing, enabling you to raise issues and clearly articulate score choices.
  • Demonstrate you have the following soft skills:
    • Communication
    • Self-awareness
    • Professionalism
    • Empathy

We welcome applicants from all walks of life across Canada, which means you’ll also be part of a diverse group of Raters!

Steps to Become a Video Interviews Rater

  1. Submit Your Application. Complete the online application form. It includes multiple questions to determine if you meet the basic qualifying criteria to become a Video Interviews Rater.
  2. Take a Mini-Casper and Reading Comprehension Test. If the basic criteria are met, you’ll receive an invitation to take a shortened version of the Casper test. Your responses will be reviewed and rated to determine if you share the four aspects listed in the previous section. You’ll also be required to take a reading comprehension test aimed at evaluating your ability to read and understand written information. This step may take up to 25 minutes to complete.
  3. Complete Paid Online Rater Training. You will receive an invitation to complete our scientifically backed Rater training, which you must complete within 5 business days. Regardless of the outcome, you will be compensated for your time.
  4. Become a Certified Rater. You’ve successfully completed the necessary steps to become a Video Interviews Rater. You’re now certified and can start rating Video Interviews test responses!

How We’ll Train You

Our Video Interviews Rater training program will equip you with the skills and knowledge needed to make fair, unbiased judgments.

Throughout the program, you will complete knowledge checks, activities, and exercises that assess and deepen your understanding of the rating process. These interactive elements reinforce learning by enabling you to apply knowledge in realistic scenarios, building confidence and accuracy in your evaluations.

Before certification, you must complete a calibration assessment and demonstrate consistent alignment with benchmark ratings to ensure your readiness for live assessments.

Why Video Interviews Matter

Video Interviews is a flexible, asynchronous interview tool for higher education admissions. Part of Acuity’s broader admissions offering, it pairs seamlessly with Casper to support a more comprehensive and holistic review process.

With Video Interviews, programs can hear directly from applicants in their own words, without the scheduling challenges of traditional interviews. Applicants complete interviews at their convenience, while admissions teams review responses when it works best for them, saving both time and resources.

Programs can choose from Acuity’s research-backed questions and rubrics or create their own, ensuring the focus stays on the attributes that matter most. For added support, trained Acuity Raters are available to score responses, helping programs gain meaningful insights without overwhelming internal capacity or adding administrative lift.

Video Interviews consistently delivers what programs need most: reliable, research-based insights into applicants, with the flexibility to fit seamlessly into existing admissions processes.

Thanks for considering contributing to Acuity Insights as a Video Interviews Rater!

About the Job:

At LaunchDarkly, our Product-Led Growth (PLG) motion is evolving rapidly. We are looking for an experienced, highly analytical, and strategic Senior Growth Marketing Analyst to help us decode the digital body language of our prospects and users.

In this role, you will leverage wide-ranging experience across GTM disciplines to help build, optimize, and scale our PLG engines. Reporting to the Principal Growth Marketer or Director of Growth Marketing, you will resolve complex data and operational issues requiring an in-depth evaluation of variable factors mapping user and account signals across channels, establishing the "next best action" for high-value leads, and optimizing conversion pathways. You will act with a high degree of independence to determine methods and procedures on new assignments, collaborating across Marketing, Product, RevOps, and Data engineering teams to drive function-impacting results.

Responsibilities:

  • Data & Signal Strategy
    • Audit, track, and categorize 1st-party, 3rd-party (e.g., 6sense, GitHub), and product/marketing signals across target contacts and enterprise accounts.
    • Evaluate variable factors and intangible data nuances to distinguish technical practitioner actions (e.g., SDK deployment) from broader enterprise intent (e.g., security evaluations).
    • Partner cross-functionally with Data Engineering and RevOps to clean, enrich, and continuously source high-intent signal data.
    • Feed signal combinations, recency, and frequency into predictive models to refine lead routing and account prioritization.
  • Activation Strategy
    • Use signal combinations to define the right "next best action" for accounts and individual users based on their segment, ICP fit, and stage (e.g., prospect vs. existing customer).
    • Map and trigger appropriate activation responses ranging from personalized marketing content to white-glove outreach from Product Advocates or automated handoffs to SDRs and Enterprise AEs.
  • Operational Motion & Cross-Functional Integration
    • Act as the primary business lead to cross-functionally implement, refine, and maintain activation workflows across Marketing, Product, Sales Ops, and Data teams.
    • Apply an understanding of the interrelationships between different disciplines to navigate complex cross-team dependencies and drive strategic alignment.
    • Help define and iterate on sales-facing tools (such as a "single pane of glass" interface) that surface product affinity, app usage, intent signals, and account fit to enable sales execution.
    • Maintain structured feedback loops with Product Advocates, SDRs, and sales reps to assess lead quality and continuously refine signal logic.
  • Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) & Experimentation
    • Analyze and optimize conversion rates across the end-to-end flow—from initial signal capture to activation, handoff, and pipeline generation.
    • Independently design and run growth experiments (in-product onboarding adjustments, messaging, routing logic) to maximize engagement and move accounts through the buyer journey.
  • System Administration & Technical Tooling
    • Manage technical configuration, tracking setups, and ongoing maintenance for core data and analytics platforms (e.g., GA360/GA4, customer data platforms, product analytics).
    • Maintain rigorous data flow standards and proper tag/tracking setups across web properties, marketing tools, and product analytics environments.

Qualifications:

  • Experience: Minimum of 8–10 years of related experience in growth marketing, marketing analytics, revenue operations, or PLG strategy within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Cross-Disciplinary Expertise: Deep understanding of B2B SaaS growth tactics, PLG motions, marketing technology stacks, and revenue analytics, with a proven ability to bridge Marketing, Sales Ops, Data, and Product management.
  • Independent Problem Solving: Proven track record of independently determining methods and procedures on complex, ambiguous assignments requiring evaluation of variable factors.
  • Technical: Hands-on proficiency with web analytics (GA360/GA4), product analytics (e.g., Amplitude, Mixpanel), CDPs, SQL, and CRM/automation platforms.

Pay:

Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level 4:

  • Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $136,500 - $187,660**
  • Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $122,800 - $168,850**
  • Zone 3: All other US locations - $116,000 - $159,500**

LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.

*Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas.
**Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary.

About LaunchDarkly:

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations.

The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

  • Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages
  • Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts
  • Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize
  • Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types
  • Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability

jobs.title: Sales Specialist - Florida
jobs.excerpt: Nofence has built the world’s firstprecision livestock management platform for livestock.
jobs.description:
Nofence has built the world’s firstprecision livestock management platform for livestock. The technology consists of a solar-powered collar that communicates with an app over the cellular network. Through the app, livestock producers can set up a new grazing area in seconds, and the long days of installing and moving fences are officially over! Livestock can graze longer and in more areas, and the owner will always have visibility of their location. This means better profitability and more free time for producers as well as improved animal welfare.

With a strong foundation of 10,000+ customers globally, we are expanding in the US. To support this growth, we’re looking for a Sales Specialist to join our dynamic team.

We’re building a remote-friendly team across the country and currently hiring across the US.

This position will be located in the state of Florida.

Join us on the journey to revolutionize agriculture and create a better everyday life for livestock producers and their animals!

About the role

Your mission will be to sell Nofence, a precision livestock management platform to US producers.

You will reach out to and follow up with potential and existing customers, coming from inbound inquiries and face to face producer outreach. However, we’re looking for someone adaptable, proactive, and ready to take on new challenges as our company evolves. If future needs require cold calling, you should be comfortable stepping into that role.

Above all, we prioritize building strong customer relationships. This means understanding our customers' needs and guiding them to make the most of our product. While we provide full product training, previous experience working with livestock producers is a great advantage.

The right candidate is self-motivated, energetic, and hardworking, preferably with a background from agriculture. As a part of our team you will have the opportunity to grow together with the company, as the opportunities for development are endless both for our product and our employees!

Title: Sales Specialist

Status: Full-time, exempt (not subject to overtime), 40 hours per week

Supervisor: National Sales Director- US

Location: US-Remote -Florida

The main responsibilities for this role will be:

  • Close sales through phone, email and face to face

  • Respond to inbound sales via phone and email, ticketing system, and other tools

  • Document and update customer records and support cases in our CRM system.

  • Work alongside our customer support team

  • Travel expected to relevant events and to potential and current customers

In the current phase of growing our team we will need someone who is adaptable and willing to contribute to non-sales and non-support related tasks like;

  • Contributing to projects across the organization

  • Contributing to developing the Sales team and shaping our structure

  • Contributing to developing the Support team and shaping our structure

About you

We are looking for someone who has:

  • A degree or equivalent in a field relevant to the position. Practical experience and engagement can compensate for a lack of formal qualifications

  • Proven experience as a sales consultant or similar role in a tech company or industry

  • A background which makes you able to answer questions related to agriculture, pasture management, or animal husbandry

  • Keen interest in our market and ability to gain competence in our technology

  • Excellent English oral and writing skills

  • Strong communication skills

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Independent and self-driven

  • Ambitious and result-oriented

  • Genuinely interested in livestock production

  • A team player with a heart for the greater good

About Nofence

Managing livestock has always been a challenge. Humanity has tried everything from herding with dogs to walling the animals in with barbed wire, electric, and wooden fences, but these are costly and time-consuming solutions and often in conflict with the local wildlife. It has also left vast areas of potential pasture overgrown and underutilized.

Until now.

Enter virtual fences. What started as a small group of farmers and engineers with a big idea has become Nofence – the world’s first virtual fencing solution for livestock. Curious about how it works?Find out more here.

What can we offer?

Our way of working is continuously evolving, and you will have the opportunity to make an impact on how we do things. We are passionate about product development, animal welfare, producer welfare, and sustainable agriculture. As our colleague, you will be part of an exciting company with enormous ambitions for growth in the US. We genuinely believe our grazing technology can be the biggest technological change in agriculture since the tractor!

The right candidate will receive a competitive benefits package, including 100% employer-paid health insurance, 25 days of paid time off (PTO) plus all federal holidays, an additional 5 days of company-wide leave during quieter periods, 401(k) retirement contributions (4%, Nofence contributes 4% of your salary automatically, with absolutely no matching contribution required from you). 8 weeks of paid parental leave, and a vehicle stipend: all within a supportive, rewarding environment designed to help you thrive.

Salary & Compensation:

The base salary for this role is $60,000 – $90,000 per year, with an annual performance bonus of up to 20% of base salary.

We are open to considering candidates at a more senior level. Should a more experienced candidate be selected, this position may be filled at the Senior Sales Specialist level, with a corresponding base salary of $90,000 – $130,000 per year and the same 20% bonus opportunity.

When determining salary ranges for our roles, we look at external market data and the salaries of Nofencers holding the same or similar roles. Our pay bands reflect the broad range of skills and experience levels great candidates bring to us. When making individual pay decisions, we take into account the candidate's depth of relevant experience, their skills relative to the role, and their location.

About the Application

Are you ready to change pasture? Just like the soil needs a balanced diversity of nutrients to thrive, a company needs a diversity of hearts and minds. We are an equal-opportunity employer.

Please submit your application directly through this portal. In line with applicable data protection regulations and ourdata protection practices, we are unable to accept or process applications received by email. Applying through the portal also ensures your personal data is handled securely. We review applications on a rolling basis and look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.description:
Senior Network Architect | HM- Ashish Pawar

Your Day at Altera Digital Health

The Senior Network Architect is a highly skilled subject matter expert responsible for designing, architecting, and leading complex and strategic network initiatives.

This role involves setting network technology standards, driving innovation, and providing technical leadership in network infrastructure design and implementation.

The Senior Network Architect plays a pivotal role in shaping network strategies and ensuring alignment with overall business objectives.

Location: Pune, India – Remote
Experience: 15–18+ Years
Certification:CCIE – Mandatory

What You'll Be Doing

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and architecture of advanced network solutions, including LAN, WAN, Data Center, Cloud, and Hybrid Cloud environments.
  • Develop highly scalable, secure, resilient, and high-performing network architectures to meet current and future business requirements.
  • Define and establish network technology standards, best practices, architecture principles, and technology roadmaps.
  • Evaluate new networking technologies and recommend their adoption based on business and technical requirements.
  • Contribute to strategic network initiatives that align with the company's long-term technology and business goals.
  • Introduce innovative solutions and approaches to enhance network performance, security, availability, scalability, and operational efficiency.
  • Lead and manage network projects from inception through completion.
  • Ensure project objectives are achieved, resources are allocated effectively, and project milestones are delivered successfully.
  • Collaborate closely with senior leadership, cross-functional teams, and business stakeholders to ensure network solutions align with overall business strategies.
  • Serve as a senior-level subject matter expert and provide technical guidance, mentorship, and knowledge sharing to network engineering and operations teams.
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with network vendors, service providers, cloud providers, and technology partners.
  • Evaluate vendor offerings and technical solutions and provide recommendations aligned with organizational requirements.
  • Lead efforts to optimize network performance by analyzing traffic patterns, implementing appropriate QoS strategies, improving network resiliency, and enhancing availability.
  • Stay current with emerging networking technologies, industry trends, and technology developments and assess their applicability to the organization.
  • Develop and maintain high-level network documentation, including architecture diagrams, HLD/LLD documents, configuration templates, standards, and technical guidelines.
  • Perform network capacity planning to accommodate anticipated business growth and evolving technology requirements.
  • Provide architectural guidance and technical leadership for network transformation, modernization, migration, and optimization initiatives.
  • Lead architecture reviews and ensure network designs comply with established enterprise standards, security requirements, and best practices.
  • Act as a senior technical escalation point for complex network architecture, performance, and connectivity issues.

Knowledge and Attributes

  • Extensive understanding of advanced networking concepts, protocols, architectures, and services.
  • Extensive proficiency in designing, configuring, and managing complex network environments, including routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, SD-WAN, and cloud networking technologies.
  • Extensive knowledge of advanced network protocols and technologies such as BGP, OSPF, MPLS, VXLAN/EVPN, SD-WAN, QoS, IPv4/IPv6, and advanced security protocols.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise LAN, WAN, Data Center, Internet, and Hybrid Cloud architectures.
  • Extensive experience with Microsoft Azure and/or AWS cloud networking.
  • Strong understanding of network security architecture, firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPN, network segmentation, and secure connectivity.
  • Extensive hands-on experience with network monitoring, analysis, troubleshooting, and performance management tools.
  • Excellent documentation, communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Extensive proficiency in network administration, configuration, and architecture tools.
  • Proven experience leading and managing large-scale network architecture, transformation, and migration projects.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex network issues.
  • Strong ability to translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and resilient network architectures.
  • Strong ability to align network strategies and technology roadmaps with business objectives.
  • Ability to work effectively with global teams, senior leadership, vendors, service providers, and cross-functional stakeholders.

Academic Qualifications and Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Active CCIE certification is mandatory.
  • Preferred CCIE specializations include:
    • CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure
    • CCIE Service Provider
    • CCIE Security
  • Relevant cloud certifications such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud are preferred.
  • Additional networking or security certifications are an advantage.

Required Experience

  • Minimum 15–18+ years of experience in the Network and Security domain.
  • Extensive experience in network engineering, architecture, and progressively responsible technical leadership roles.
  • Extensive experience working in large-scale enterprise networking environments.
  • Extensive experience designing and architecting complex LAN and WAN environments.
  • Extensive experience with network security and enterprise security architectures.
  • Extensive experience with Data Center networking and connectivity.
  • Extensive experience with cloud networking, including Azure and/or AWS.
  • Extensive experience with SD-WAN and software-defined networking (SDN) concepts.
  • Proven experience with network transformation, modernization, migration, and optimization initiatives.
  • Proven experience working with network vendors, ISPs, cloud providers, and technology partners.
  • Demonstrated experience providing technical leadership and architectural direction to engineering and operations teams.

Mandatory Requirements

  • 15–18+ years of relevant Network and Security experience.
  • Active CCIE certification – Mandatory.
  • Strong enterprise network architecture and design experience.
  • Expert-level Cisco networking experience.
  • Strong expertise in BGP, OSPF, MPLS, SD-WAN, LAN/WAN, and Data Center networking.
  • Strong experience with network security technologies.
  • Strong experience with cloud and hybrid network architectures.
  • Proven experience leading complex network projects and strategic initiatives.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Location

Pune, India – Remote

The successful candidate will work as part of a global network architecture and engineering organization and will be expected to collaborate effectively with teams and stakeholders across different time zones.

About Us

Sophos is a cybersecurity leader defending 600,000 organizations globally with an AI-driven platform and expert-led services. Sophos meets organizations wherever they are in their security maturity and grows with them to defeat cyberattacks. Its solutions combine machine learning, automation, and real-time threat intelligence with frontline human expertise from Sophos X-Ops to deliver advanced, 24/7 threat monitoring, detection, and response.
Sophos offers industry-leading managed detection and response (MDR) alongside a comprehensive portfolio of cybersecurity technologies — including endpoint, network, email, and cloud security, extended detection and response (XDR), identity threat detection and response (ITDR), and next-gen SIEM. Together with expert advisory services, these capabilities help organizations proactively reduce risk and respond faster, with the visibility and scalability needed to stay ahead of evolving threats.
Sophos goes to market with a global partner ecosystem, including Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs), resellers and distributors, marketplace integrations, and cyber risk partners, giving organizations the flexibility to choose trusted relationships when securing their business. Sophos is headquartered in Oxford, U.K. More information is available at .

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced Manager, Software Engineering (SRE) to lead a team focused on improving the reliability, scalability, and operational maturity of Sophos cloud services and engineering delivery systems. In this role, you will lead a team distributed across the U.S. and Canada. The team is responsible for production reliability, operational readiness, incident response, escalation management, observability, automation, release reliability, and continuous improvement across cloud-based platforms.

This role requires a leader with a strong background spanning site reliability engineering, platform engineering, DevOps practices, release engineering, infrastructure management, and cloud operations. You should have enough technical depth to guide discussions around AWS, Kubernetes/EKS, CI/CD, Linux, infrastructure as code, observability, cost optimization, security practices, compliance needs, and automation, while primarily focusing on team leadership, execution, stakeholder alignment, prioritization, and improving how engineering teams deliver and operate services at scale.

What You Will Do

    Leadership and Team Management

    • Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers focused on site reliability, platform operations, release engineering, and automation. Set clear priorities, expectations, and delivery goals aligned to business and engineering needs.
    • Support hiring, onboarding, performance management, and career development for team members.
    • Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

      • SRE Strategy and Operational Maturity

      • Partner with senior leadership to define and execute the roadmap for SRE and operational improvements.
      • Drive improvements in reliability, availability, scalability, deployment confidence, and production readiness.
      • Drive operational efficiency and cost optimization practices across cloud platforms, balancing reliability, performance, and responsible cloud spend.
      • Help establish best practices for incident response, escalation management, observability, runbooks, post-incident reviews, and toil reduction.
      • Promote the use of reliability metrics, operational health indicators, and continuous improvement practices.

        • Platform, Release, and Automation Enablement

        • Partner with engineering, architecture, security, release, and operations teams to improve shared tooling and delivery workflows.
        • Support improvements across CI/CD pipelines, release automation, deployment reliability, and environment stability. Guide team efforts involving cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes/EKS, Linux systems, Terraform/IaC, Ansible, and automation tooling.
        • Encourage responsible use of approved AI tools to improve troubleshooting, documentation, automation, and engineering productivity.

          • Incident Management and Reliability

          • Ensure effective incident and escalation management practices are in place for timely response, communication, resolution, and follow-up.
          • Assess operational situations quickly, prioritize response activities, and balance customer impact, business risk, reliability, security, and delivery needs.
          • Drive root cause analysis and long-term corrective actions to reduce repeat incidents.
          • Improve observability, alerting, monitoring, and operational visibility across services and platforms.
          • Support capacity planning and operational readiness for scalable, high-availability systems.

            • Security, Compliance, and Governance

            • Partner with security, AppSec, compliance, and engineering teams to ensure operational practices support secure and reliable service delivery.
            • Help manage CI/CD security gates, vulnerability remediation workflows, audit readiness, and compliance-related operational controls.
            • Support vendor management for SRE, platform, observability, security, and cloud tooling, including renewals, evaluations, usage reviews, and service escalations.
            • Ensure team documentation, runbooks, operational evidence, and process controls are maintained to support audits and internal reviews.

              • Planning and Delivery

              • Lead sprint planning, backlog management, prioritization, and delivery tracking for SRE and platform initiatives.
              • Balance competing priorities across reliability work, operational escalations, security needs, technical debt, roadmap delivery, and team capacity.
              • Participate in quarterly planning, roadmap development, and cross-team dependency management.
              • Work with engineering, product, architecture, and security stakeholders to align reliability and operational priorities with business needs.
              • Use Agile/Scrum practices to improve execution, transparency, predictability, and continuous improvement across the team.

                • Collaboration and Communication

                • Work closely with engineering teams to understand service needs and ensure SRE priorities align with product and platform goals.
                • Lead technical and operational discussions with engineering leaders, product stakeholders, and executive audiences, including Directors, VPs, and C-level staff.
                • Present reliability updates, operational risks, roadmap progress, incident trends, and investment needs in a clear, concise, and audience-appropriate way.
                • Facilitate meetings, drive decisions, manage follow-ups, and ensure cross-functional conversations result in clear ownership and action.
                • Communicate status, risks, operational trends, and improvement opportunities to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What You Will Bring

    • Extensive experience in site reliability engineering, DevOps practices, platform engineering, infrastructure management, operational efficiency, cloud infrastructure, or production operations.
    • Proven experience leading and managing engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement.
    • Strong understanding of reliability engineering, operational excellence, incident management, escalation management, observability, production support, and scalable system operations.
    • Strong working knowledge of cloud technologies, especially AWS; Azure experience is a plus.
    • Familiarity with operating and supporting containerized platform environments, including Kubernetes/EKS, Docker, Helm, and Linux-based systems.
    • Familiarity with infrastructure as code, configuration management, and automation practices using tools such as Terraform and Ansible.
    • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, release automation, deployment practices, and developer tooling such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Artifactory, or similar tools.
    • Proficiency with scripting and automation concepts using languages such as Python, Bash, or Groovy.
    • Experience with monitoring, logging, and observability tools such as ELK stack, Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, or similar platforms.
    • Working knowledge of security, application security, vulnerability management, compliance controls, audit readiness, and vendor management in a cloud or SaaS environment.
    • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum practices, sprint planning, backlog management, quarterly planning, roadmap development, and cross-team dependency management.
    • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to assess situations quickly, prioritize work, manage escalations, and balance competing technical and business priorities.
    • Strong presentation and facilitation skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and confidently with technical teams, senior leaders, executives, vendors, and cross-functional stakeholders.
    • Ability to guide technical discussions, evaluate trade-offs, balance reliability, security, compliance, delivery speed, and operational efficiency, and help teams make sound engineering decisions.
    • Experience improving operational processes, reducing manual toil, mentoring engineers, managing delivery, and building healthy, accountable teams.
    • Experience with Java-based services, build systems, or code review workflows is a plus.
    • Comfort using or encouraging AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly within company guidelines.
    • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. A Master’s degree is a plus.

You'll also be supported by a Senior Language Specialist, as well as our Interpreter and Technology Help Desks.

Join our team now!

Job Description

Work at Home Bilingual Italian-English Video-Phone Interpreter

Job Title: Italian Interpreter

Location: Work at Home position in United States

Position: Video-Phone Interpreter

Pay: $15 - $17 per hour.

  • Compensation will not be less than any applicable state or local minimum wage.
    • For Colorado applicants, the expected pay range is $15.16 - $19.29 per hour.

We Offer:

  • Paid professional interpreter training and continuous development.

  • Incentives for meeting attendance targets.

  • Benefits include: Paid Sick Leave in accordance with applicable law, Medical, Dental, Vision, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Accident, Critical Illness & Life, AD&D, Insurance Package, Inpatient Hospital, Short Term Disability, and 401K Retirement.

  • Employee Referral Program.

  • Advancement opportunities within the organization.

  • Interpreter support.

  • An inclusive and diverse work environment.

Position Overview:

The ItalianVideo-Telephone- Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Italian and English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.

The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The video and audio interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.

This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The interpreters translate verbally.

**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment**

Essential Job Functions:

  • Respond to video and audio interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.

  • Participate in online, video and audio training sessions.

  • Deliver interpretation services via video and expediently type data on a dedicated device, such as a laptop, desktop computer, mobile phone, or tablet, in order to perform the essential functions of the job.

  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.

  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.

  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the video and audio interpreting sessions at all times.

  • Remain calm during video and audio interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.

  • Maintain punctuality and availability during scheduled work hours.

  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.

  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.

  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.

  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Qualifications

  • Fluency inItalian and English and skilled in the associated cultural dynamics.

  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.

  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.

  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.

  • Education or work experience in language-related fields such as teaching, language assessment, translation or interpretation preferred.

  • Must be able to adapt to any LLS technology enhancements that improve service delivery and meet client demands.

  • Must be at least 18 years of age.

  • Legally authorized to work in the United States.

  • Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States and with LanguageLine Solutions (i.e., H1-B visa, F-1 visa (OPT), TN visa or any other non-immigrant status).

  • High school diploma or equivalent.

  • Candidates who are currently employed by a client of LanguageLine Solutions or an affiliated LanguageLine Solutions business may not be eligible for consideration.

  • Ability to read and write the requested languages – highly preferred.

**Based on your location, a post-offer, a pre-employment background check and/or drug screen may be required**

Technical Requirements:

  • Dedicated personal device for business purposes.

    • Desktop / Laptop Computers with any of the following Operating Systems: Windows, MacOS, or ChromeOS.

    • Tablets (iPadOS or Android) are acceptable.

    • Smartphones (iOS or Android) are also acceptable.

  • Restricted brands:

    • Kaspersky products.

    • Huawei hardware.

  • High speed Internet connection for work related electronic communication. This internet connection should provide download speeds of no less than 5 Mbps, upload speeds of 3 Mbps, Ping value of no more than 300 ms, Jitter value of no more than 30 ms.

  • Must have access to a quiet space free from background noise or distraction.

About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Location: Chicago, IL; Austin, TX; Phoenix, AZ; Los Angeles, CA; San Francisco, CA; Denver, CO; St. Louis, MO; Kansas City; Dallas, TX

About the Department

The Specialist Solutions Engineering team at Cloudflare is a group of trusted technical advisors who partner with customers to solve complex security, connectivity, and performance challenges. We work hand in hand with the sales organization throughout the customer journey, from discovery and solution design through proof of value and technical validation. We are passionate about technology and dedicated to helping customers use the full power of Cloudflare's global network to achieve business-critical outcomes.

About the Role

As a Senior Solutions Engineer specializing in Cloudflare One, you will partner with account teams and customers to design, demonstrate, and validate integrated solutions across Zero Trust, enterprise WAN, and emerging AI technologies. You will lead the technical path for complex opportunities, translating customer risks, operational requirements, and business priorities into architectures that give stakeholders confidence to adopt Cloudflare.

Zero Trust is the primary focus of this role, with enterprise WAN and AI as the next priorities. Successful candidates will bring meaningful customer-facing Zero Trust experience and practical enterprise WAN experience. Email Security experience is welcome but not required. You do not need to be an expert in every part of the portfolio, but you must be able to connect these technologies into a coherent customer strategy and continue developing your expertise as the market evolves.

This is a Senior-level individual-contributor role for a curious, commercially aware technical leader who can guide customer evaluations, collaborate across teams, and improve the effectiveness of the broader field organization.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor, leading discovery and designing Cloudflare One architectures that address customer security, connectivity, and business requirements.
  • Guide qualified opportunities through solution design, demonstrations, technical evaluations, proofs of value, success-criteria management, and technical close.
  • Advise customers on Zero Trust strategies spanning identity-aware access, secure web gateway, data protection, SaaS security, browser isolation, device posture, and secure connectivity.
  • Design WAN transformation solutions that connect users, offices, data centers, and cloud environments using Cloudflare WAN and complementary Cloudflare One services.
  • Build expertise in AI-era opportunities and risks, including employee AI adoption, Shadow AI, sensitive-data exposure, AI application access, Model Context Protocol (MCP) server controls, and agentic AI governance.
  • Use AI tools thoughtfully to improve research, customer preparation, technical analysis, content creation, demonstrations, automation, and the repeatability of field activities.
  • Support broader Cloudflare One opportunities involving Email Security when relevant to the customer's strategy and requirements.
  • Clearly articulate Cloudflare's technical and business differentiation against competing Zero Trust, email-security, networking, and adjacent AI-security solutions.
  • Partner with sales teams on account strategy, pipeline development, and revenue goals while maintaining clear ownership of technical next steps and customer outcomes.
  • Create reusable architectures, demonstration and proof-of-value patterns, technical guidance, and lightweight automation, and coach peers and partners to execute more effectively.
  • Capture customer feedback, market trends, and product gaps, translating them into actionable input for Product and Engineering.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Support, Product, and Engineering to resolve technical issues and maintain customer trust during complex evaluations.
  • Own presales evaluation outcomes through technical close, then coordinate a clean handoff to the appropriate Customer Success, Professional Services, Support, or implementation teams.

Qualifications

Successful candidates are customer-focused technical leaders who combine broad security and networking experience with strong communication, commercial judgment, and learning agility. We welcome relevant backgrounds in Solutions or Systems Engineering, technical sales, consulting, or enterprise security and network architecture.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Solutions Engineering, Systems Engineering, technical sales, consulting, or enterprise architecture.
  • Meaningful customer-facing experience designing, demonstrating, evaluating, or implementing Zero Trust solutions.
  • Practical understanding of Zero Trust and SASE architectures, including identity, endpoint, network, application, data, and SaaS security considerations.
  • Practical experience with enterprise networking and WAN concepts such as routing, subnetting, VPNs, SD-WAN, hybrid connectivity, cloud networking, or network transformation.

jobs.excerpt: SummaryThe Provider Credentialing Specialist ensures that all licensed massage therapists and behavioral therapists meet the standards required to deliver care through the Zeel platform.
jobs.description:
Summary

The Provider Credentialing Specialist ensures that all licensed massage therapists and behavioral therapists meet the standards required to deliver care through the Zeel platform. This role is critical to maintaining regulatory compliance, supporting government payer partnerships, and enabling high-quality care at scale. You will verify licensure, documentation, and training requirements while managing a streamlined credentialing workflow across multiple U.S. states. This is a remote position, however, you must be located within the United States.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct primary source verification of medical credentials, certifications, and background checks for new provider applicants
  • Ensure all credentialing documents are collected, validated, and stored in accordance with internal policies and HIPAA standards
  • Maintain and update provider records in credentialing systems and databases
  • Help with recredentialing outreach and assisting with application help
  • Assist with audits, reporting, and compliance filings related to provider credentials and service eligibility
  • Communicate directly with providers to request missing documentation and provide updates on credentialing status
  • Help manage end-to-end provider account creation
  • Collaborate with Onboarding, Compliance, and Provider Experience teams to support timely provider activation
  • Track state-specific requirements, expirations, and recredentialing renewal timelines to maintain an active, compliant network
  • Stay up to date on changes in licensure regulations, background check requirements, and clinical credentialing standards
  • Help manage relationships with credentialing and occupational health vendors
  • Occupational Health work (scheduling providers in mobile health, facilitating clinical authorization forms, overview of medical documents with clinical members)

Required Qualifications

  • 2–4 years of experience in credentialing, compliance, provider enrollment, or healthcare administration
  • Familiarity with provider credentialing processes and standards (e.g., NCQA, URAC, state board licensure, NPDB)
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage documentation across high volumes and multiple deadlines
  • Excellent communication skills and comfort working directly with healthcare professionals
  • Proficiency with credentialing systems, Google Workspace, and project tracking tools
  • Eligibility to work in the US (we do not sponsor work visas at this time)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in credentialing licensed massage therapists or other allied health professionals
  • Knowledge of credentialing compliance for VA, Medicaid, or Medicare Advantage programs
  • Background in multi-state provider networks or mobile care delivery models
  • NAMSS certification (CPCS or CPMSM) is a plus
  • Bilingual in English and Spanish is a bonus
  • Experience using Salesforce, Verifiable, Evident, and Kustomer a plus

About Zeel

Zeel is redefining access to care through in-home and on-site services focused on acute and chronic pain, stress, and mental well-being. Its HIPAA-compliant platform connects patients with a nationwide network of licensed massage therapists who provide care directly in the home.

As a member of the VA Community Care Network, Zeel provides Medical Massage Therapy to veterans experiencing acute or chronic pain, PTSD, and other life-limiting conditions. Zeel also offers corporate wellness programs and staffs more than 200 five-star hotels and independent spas nationwide. Zeel combines award-winning technology with clinical excellence to deliver personalized, convenient, and impactful care.

Zeel provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Zeel complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment.

Privacy is the virtual card platform giving consumers and small businesses complete control over their online payments.

Our virtual cards protect 250,000+ users across the U.S., processing over $3 billion in transactions with bank-level security and encryption. From merchant-locked cards that can't be used anywhere else if stolen, to spending limits that block unauthorized charges, to one-click pausing that stops subscriptions instantly, Privacy puts financial control back in users' hands.

We're building a future where every online payment is secure by default, free from data breaches, unauthorized charges, and hidden fees. We're proud to have been named one of Forbes' "Top 100 Most Customer-Centric Companies" and featured in The Wall Street Journal, TechCrunch, and Wirecutter.

Privacy is the product that started it all. What began as Privacy.com grew into Lithic, now a Series C company backed by world-class investors including Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Stripes, and Mastercard, along with many others. Our dedicated team of 35 sits at the heart of Lithic's 170+ person organization, spanning 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City.

Reporting to Sam Pinsak, Privacy’s Product Lead, who oversees both product and marketing, you'll partner closely with your engineering manager, eng lead, and the engineers on your pod, a product designer, and, depending on the work, leads across risk, payment, and dispute ops, compliance, biz ops, and support. The product team is small, senior, and moves fast. This is a hands-on role: you'll own a broad surface and live in the details — writing the specs, pulling the data you need to make a call, staying close to customers, and sitting in planning and grooming with your engineering squad. You're self-sufficient with data day to day and partner with an analyst on the deeper dives, and you lean on AI tooling to do the work of a much bigger team. Every bet ties back to the P&L, scope gets cut hard, and you'll have a short path to the CEO and to real customers.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the roadmap and strategy for a core product surface
  • Own the surface and its year-long roadmap; keep the whole thing moving while going deep where it counts most right now
  • Pick the right problems across that surface and frame them into testable bets with clear outcomes; set the product vision and strategy
  • Act as the default decision-maker for your surface and make cross-area trade-offs; defend your calls under ambiguity at leadership review
  • Drive decisions with data and deep customer + business understanding
  • Own the metrics that roll directly into financial and business outcomes for your surface; know which levers move them and which to pull first to hit a target
  • Reason in contribution-margin and unit-economics terms, not just feature impact; hold a segment-level model of our customers and spearhead the research that resolves high-impact, ambiguous questions
  • Build the dashboards and success metrics other teams adopt, and use data to drive cross-functional buy-in
  • Lead the team and work cross-functionally
  • Lead an engineering squad as its product manager, and influence cross-functional teams to re-prioritize toward your roadmap
  • Turn recurring decisions into playbooks the team reuses; push for configurable systems and AI/tooling patterns that lift the whole team, not just you
  • Communicate clearly from the detail level up to the strategic picture, adapting to your audience; mentor other PMs and raise the team's craft bar

What You’ll Bring

  • Ownership of a product area (or multiple connected areas) end-to-end and set its strategy — not just execution of a roadmap handed to you
  • Demonstrate strong judgment under ambiguity: you pick the right problems, make defensible calls, and know when to walk away from one
  • Fluent in unit economics and how product decisions move the P&L
  • Ability to find the levers that matter in performance data and turn them into a clear story for non-technical audiences
  • Fluent with AI-assisted tools and actively building with them to multiply your own and the team's output
  • Ability to ramp quickly across unfamiliar domains and get to real depth quickly
  • Consumer or D2C product experience; consumer fintech or payments a strong plus, not a requirement
  • Ability to operate autonomously, with strong communication skills, ruthless about scope without sacrificing quality, and humble

The annual US salary range for this role is $168,000 - $225,000 plus equity. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Lithic and will be narrowed during the interview process based on the candidate’s experience and qualifications.

This is a remote position. However, candidates must be located in the United States, Canada (Ontario or British Columbia), Netherlands, Poland, or Czech Republic. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance.

Mindrift is looking for a highly skilled Presentation Designer to join the Tendem project (** and create high-quality presentations for real-world use cases.

In this role, you'll apply your expertise in visual communication, information design, and storytelling to create clear, engaging, and professionally designed presentations. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for creative professionals with hands-on experience in visual communications, information design, and storytelling.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Presentation Designer, you will focus on storytelling and visual hierarchy. We need a specialist who knows how to communicate complex information beautifully, turning raw data and narratives into compelling, highly persuasive slides and one-pagers. You will use tools such as PowerPoint, Keynote, Adobe Creative Suite, and Figma to create polished, presentation-ready deliverables.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design high-stakes pitch decks and professional one-pagers tailored for specific audiences.
  • Translate complex data into clear visual storytelling with a strong focus on minimalism and precise information hierarchy.
  • Elevate presentations using custom fonts, elegant animations, and perfect visual consistency.
  • Enforce a polished, persuasive, and premium corporate-meets-creative style across all deliverables.
  • Execute formatting quality standards through meticulous validation of visual alignment, pacing, and brand adherence before final delivery.

How to get started

Apply, pass qualification(s), and start contributing to projects aligned with your expertise — on your own schedule.

Educational qualifications

  • At least 2 years of relevant experience in graphic design, presentation design, visual storytelling, or data visualization is desirable.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Graphic Design, Fine Arts, Visual Communications, or related creative fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates must have a strong portfolio featuring high-end presentations, pitch decks, and data visualization (not just basic templates). We are looking for specialists who have a deep understanding of pacing, storytelling, and information design. A methodical, detail-oriented approach and the ability to work independently to transform complex narratives into premium visuals are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Presentation software: Expertise in PowerPoint, Keynote, etc., for building complex, dynamic, and perfectly animated decks.
  • Design tools: Deep proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop) or Figma to create custom graphics and layouts.
  • Data & information design: Ability to translate complex data and multi-level hierarchical structures into clear, minimalist visual storytelling.
  • Typography & animation: Advanced skills in working with custom fonts and smooth, elegant animations for premium deliverables.

Additional requirements

  • Hands-on experience creating high-end, premium corporate-meets-creative style layouts.
  • Strong attention to detail and absolute commitment to visual perfectness.
  • Self-directed work ethic with the ability to troubleshoot design challenges independently.
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)
  • Your CV must include a link to your portfolio featuring high-end presentations, pitch decks, and data visualization. Applications without a portfolio link, or without relevant presentation cases, will not be considered.

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $30 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer - AI Cost Visibility
jobs.excerpt: Location The senior Full-Stack Engineer will be an integral part of our Engineering teams in EMEA.
jobs.description:
Location

The senior Full-Stack Engineer will be an integral part of our Engineering teams in EMEA.This role is based remotely as a full-time employee in the UK, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands, Sweden and Israel. We are also open to contractors in Eastern Europe and Portugal.

Who We Are
DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production.
Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency.
With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The OpportunityAI is the fastest-growing line on our customers' cloud bills - and the hardest one to see. Model APIs, managed inference, GPUs, and a growing fleet of agentic coding tools each report spend differently, and most teams still can't answer the basic questions: what are we spending, on which workloads, for which teams, and is it worth it. Our AI cost visibility product, part of DoiT Cloud Intelligence, exists to answer them.
We're hiring a Senior Full-Stack Engineer into our R&D team to own this product end-to-end - from the Go services that ingest and model AI spend, through the APIs that expose it, to the React interfaces where FinOps practitioners and platform engineers make decisions. This is a young product in a category being defined right now. You'll shape how it works, not just implement someone else's spec, and there is a short line from your work to what customers see.
You'll work AI-augmented from day one. We expect you to use AI across your whole workflow - not as an occasional autocomplete - and to have real opinions about where it earns its place and where it doesn't.

Responsibilities

  • Owning features end-to-end. This is the core of the role. Take a problem from understanding the customer's pain, through design and implementation, to release, monitoring and iteration. You define what done looks like and you own the outcome - reliability, user experience and measurable impact included. Propose the work you think should happen; you're not here to wait for a spec.
  • Knowing the product and the domain. Understand how AI spend actually works - token and model pricing, inference and GPU economics, how usage rolls up to teams and initiatives - and how FinOps practitioners reason about it. You should be able to explain why a feature matters to a customer as clearly as how it's built, and bring that judgement into every design decision.
  • Working AI-augmented. Use AI daily across the full span of your work - exploring the codebase and unfamiliar vendor APIs, prototyping approaches, generating and reviewing code, debugging, writing tests and producing documentation. Push on what agentic tooling can do for this codebase, and bring judgement about where AI raises velocity and where a human still has to hold the quality bar.
  • Full-stack delivery. Design, build and scale backend services in Go and product experiences in TypeScript and React. Turn large volumes of cost and usage data into interfaces that make the answer obvious - clear, fast and trustworthy enough to base financial decisions on.
  • API-first. Build capabilities so they're fully available through APIs, not just the UI. Both humans and agents should be able to drive the platform.

Raising the bar. As a senior engineer, set the standard for the team: thoughtful design reviews, guard-rails that let customers succeed, and engineering practices that let us move fast without breaking trust. Mentor peers and share what you learn.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, including multi-tenant SaaS products, with a track record of owning features or products end-to-end in production
  • Strong Go for backend services - APIs, data processing, and the operational realities of running them
  • Strong TypeScript and modern React, with a good eye for how data should be presented
  • Comfortable across the stack. You may lean backend or lean frontend, but you can own a feature from the data model through to the interface
  • Experience building on public cloud (GCP preferred; AWS or Azure), and working proficiency in SQL against an analytical store such as BigQuery
  • Product-oriented thinking - you care as much about why you're building something and whether it works for users as you do about how it's built
  • AI-augmented working style - you already use AI tools across your engineering workflow and can talk concretely about what you've got out of them, and where they fell short
  • Strong knowledge of software engineering practices, design patterns and architectural principles, and the ability to set direction for others
  • Comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-moving market - you can figure out the right problem to solve, not just the right solution
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal

Self-organized, goal-oriented and self-motivated; confident, thorough and tenacious

Bonus Points

  • Knowledge of FinOps and FinOps products would be a strong plus.
  • BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Demonstrating a portfolio of what you've built in your career so far

Are you a Do'er?
Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.
We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.
What does being a Do'er mean? We're all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values.
Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page.
We thought so too, but we're here and happy we hit that 'apply' button.

Full-time employee benefits include:

  • Unlimited Vacation
  • Flexible Working Options
  • Health Insurance
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Stock Option Plan
  • Home Office Allowance
  • Professional Development Stipend
  • Peer Recognition Program

Many Do'ers, One Team DoiT unites as Many Do'ers, One Team, where diversity is more than a goal-it's our strength. We actively cultivate an inclusive, equitable workplace, recognizing that each unique perspective enhances our innovation. By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success.
