jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Operations Analyst (Temporary)
jobs.excerpt: Simpson Strong-Tie is a leader in engineered structural connectors, software, and solutions for the building industry.
jobs.description:
Simpson Strong-Tie is a leader in engineered structural connectors, software, and solutions for the building industry. We maintain a reputation as a trusted manufacturer, partner, and corporate citizen committed to our customers and employees.

Our founder, Barc Simpson established 9 Principles of Business we live out as company values and have made Simpson Strong-Tie an inspiring place to work since 1956. Our team of talented people are dedicated to our shared mission: to provide solutions that help people design and build safer, stronger structures.

Learn about our company culture directly from our team.

YOU

This temporary 4–6-month position offers an opportunity to play a critical role in advancing Talent Acquisition operations. As the Talent Acquisition Operations Analyst, you will serve as a strategic operations, analytics, and enablement partner for the Talent Acquisition team. You will translate recruiting data into clear insights, lead or support TA technology implementations, standardize processes and resources, and create scalable tools that improve hiring consistency, speed, quality, and candidate experience. This role partners closely with HR partners, hiring managers, HR operations, communications, and external vendors to turn strategy into practical execution.

This position requires a proactive, detail-oriented problem solver who can manage complex projects, communicate clearly across audiences, troubleshoot systems and process gaps, and use data to influence continuous improvement across the recruiting lifecycle.


WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Talent Acquisition Analytics, Reporting and Insights (30%)

Generate, analyze and communicate TA metrics that help leadership, recruiters, HR partners and business stakeholders understand recruiting performance, hiring trends and opportunities for improvement.

  • Maintain and improve recurring and ad hoc reporting on requisition volume, time-to-fill/time-to-offer, offer approvals, source performance, recruiter workload, platform usage, referral and internal applicant activity, quality-of-hire inputs and early turnover trends.
  • Prepare quarterly TA performance reviews, executive summaries, dashboards, and slide-ready insights that highlight progress, risks, root causes and recommended actions.
  • Maintain and enhance recruiter scorecards, operational tracking tools and KPI frameworks to support accountability, prioritization and data-driven decision-making.
  • Analyze applicant funnel health, sourcing channel performance and location-specific challenges to inform proactive sourcing, advertising and candidate flow strategies.

TA Technology, Systems and Process Optimization (30%)

Lead and support implementation, adoption and continuous improvement of TA systems and workflows, with a focus on scalable, compliant and user-friendly recruiting operations.

  • Serve as a key TA project partner for recruiting technology initiatives, including Paradox/Ty interview scheduling and referrals, SHL assessment integration, HiredScore implementation, Workday recruiting enhancements and related platform changes.
  • Coordinate user acceptance testing, system troubleshooting, hypercare support, issue logs, enhancement requests, access questions and cross-functional follow-up with HR systems, IT and vendors.
  • Partner with TA and business stakeholders to standardize intake forms, job description/job posting content, required vs. preferred skills mapping, stage definitions, candidate communications and disposition templates.
  • Evaluate system adoption and process gaps, recommend improvements, and develop scalable solutions that reduce manual work, improve consistency and strengthen candidate and hiring manager experience.

Program, Project and Change Management (25%)

Plan, coordinate and execute TA programs and strategic initiatives from concept through rollout, ensuring stakeholders are aligned, resources are ready, and adoption is supported.

  • Update and maintain the Talent Acquisition Playbook, Hiring Manager Portal resources, job aids, FAQs, templates, process documentation and operating standards for recruiters, HR partners and hiring managers.
  • Develop and deliver training and change-management materials for new TA processes and tools, including live sessions, My Workbench content, recordings, guides, communication drafts and follow-up resources.
  • Support structured interviewing, hiring events, dedicated interview pool pilots, first-year turnover improvement work, candidate experience initiatives and quality-of-hire measurement efforts.
  • Manage project plans, agendas, meeting cadences, action items and stakeholder updates to keep cross-functional work moving and aligned to TA priorities.

Stakeholder, Vendor and Recruiting Operations Partnership (15%)

Act as a central coordination point across TA, HR, business leaders and external partners to strengthen recruiting operations, vendor effectiveness and stakeholder experience.

  • Partner with recruiters, HRBPs and hiring managers on recruiting process improvements, branch/location hiring challenges, priority requisitions and manager communication needs.
  • Manage or support vendor relationships and utilization for platforms and partners such as Paradox, Workday, SHL, HiredScore, LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed and related recruiting tools.
  • Support recruiter and hiring manager enablement through clear communication, meeting facilitation, resource sharing, troubleshooting and escalation of system or process issues.
  • Contribute to employer brand, employee referral, social media spotlight, community outreach and candidate communication initiatives that improve attraction and engagement.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Data Analytics, Communications, Organizational Development or a related field required.3+years of experience in Human Resources: Talent Acquisition, HR operations, HR analytics, recruiting technology, program coordination, or a related strategic support role.
  • Strong analytical skills and process improvement mindset with the ability to gather, interpret and present data, trends and recommendations in a clear, business-focused way for leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Two or more years of experience supporting recruiting technologies, ATS/HRIS processes or HR systems implementations.
  • Advanced proficiency with Excel, PowerPoint and reporting or dashboard tools.
  • Two or more Workday Recruiting experience required.
  • Strong project management skills, including the ability to organize workstreams, manage action items, coordinate stakeholders, and drive execution in a fast-paced environment.
  • to create and deliver training materials, executive summaries, process documentation, and stakeholder communications.
  • Demonstrated ability to improve processes, document standards, identify root causes, and translate ambiguity into practical, scalable solutions.
  • Strong collaboration and influence skills with the ability to partner effectively with TA, HR, IT, HR systems, vendors, recruiters, hiring managers and business leaders.
  • High attention to detail, strong judgment, comfort with confidential information and commitment to compliant, equitable and candidate-centered hiring practices.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with Smartsheet, SharePoint, Power BI, Teams, My Workbench, LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, Paradox, SHL, HiredScore or similar recruiting enablement tools.

TRAVEL

This position may require domestic travel up to 15% of the time.


WORK STATUS & LOCATION

This full-time, non-exempt position is located remotely within the West Coast or Central United States, with ongoing collaboration across Simpson Strong-Tie locations and stakeholders.


RELOCATION

Relocation is not available for this position.


PAY

$30-$35 / hour

Description

TripleTen is an online teaching platform that empowers individuals, regardless of their prior experience, to embark on the exciting and challenging journey of mastering tech professions.

Our bootcamps focus on training students in software engineering, data science, business intelligence analytics, and QA engineering in a feasible and accessible way, ultimately leading them to thrive in a new career.

Our mission is to ensure that every student has the opportunity to successfully master a new profession, find their purpose, and become a valuable member of the tech industry.

Career Coaches help ensure that our graduates are job ready by their graduation date. They support the success of the Career Services team by coaching 150-200 students / graduates in group settings, and hosting workshops. This role is hands-on coaching, ensuring high-quality service delivery, streamlined processes, and effective problem-solving.

How to apply?

Apply here! We review applications on an ongoing basis and invite selected candidates to record an introductory video as a first step.

If there is an available opening, we will invite you to an interview with our Hiring Managers; otherwise, we will keep your profile and completed assignment on file for future opportunities.

Please submit your CV in English.

What you will do

1. Career Coaching & Student Support

  • Manage a portfolio of 150–200 students in a group format, with 1:1 office hours as needed.
  • Provide ongoing career coaching, including support for escalated or reassigned students.
  • Review resumes, LinkedIn profiles, portfolios, and cover letters, delivering feedback within 24 hours.
  • Conduct mock HR/cultural fit interviews and assess performance using internal guidelines.
  • Track student progress in internal systems and proactively flag risks (e.g., disengagement, delays).
  • Engage the student community by facilitating channels, sharing job market insights, and offering practical guidance.
  • Host webinars and career events as needed.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to improve career services and student experience.
  • Provide timely, ad hoc career support within a 24-hour response window.

2. Collaboration & Communication. Provide clear, empathetic, and solution-oriented feedback to students and teammates.

3. Organization & Reliability. Maintain structured records, manage time effectively, and respond to priorities within 24 hours.

4. Data & Performance Tracking. Monitor key metrics and use data to improve coaching outcomes.

5. Workshops. Support development and facilitation of career workshops.

6. Cross-Track Coaching. Coach across multiple tracks (Software Engineering, QA, Data, Cybersecurity, UX/UI).

Requirements

  • You have 2–5 years of experience in a relevant role, such as a career coach, recruiter, HR professional, or hiring manager (experience in executive search or coaching is a strong plus).
  • You have a strong understanding of the US job market, including hiring practices, candidate expectations, and cultural nuances.
  • You have excellent English proficiency (C1–C2), both spoken and written.
  • You are a people-oriented professional who can actively listen, provide structured and constructive feedback, and build trust with candidates.
  • You are able to inspire and motivate individuals or groups of job seekers throughout their job search journey.
  • You are highly organized, detail-oriented, and demonstrate strong ownership and follow-through.
  • You have outstanding communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Nice to have: prior experience in the tech industry or working with tech candidates.

What we can offer you

  • Fully remote part-time collaboration (20-25 hours per week, $15 USD per hour).
  • A comfortable digital office. We use modern digital tools — Slack, Miro, Notion, Google Meet, etc.— to make the process of working together seamless.
  • Growth. Our product is expanding quickly, so it's a great time to get on board and challenge yourself.
  • Diverse and tight-knit team which is spread out across US, LatAm, Europe and more.

Creative Fabrica is a subscription platform serving millions of creators, designers, and crafters worldwide. We're built on the principle that everyone can be creative. We remove what stands in the way: expensive software, technical expertise, and time-consuming production.

Our Studio AI suite offers more than 26 specialized AI tools that automate technical work: generate custom images, remove backgrounds, create fonts, and produce publication-ready designs in minutes instead of hours.

Creative Fabrica is building a new generation of AI products, and we want the quality and speed of our creative output to match the ambition of the products themselves.

We’re rebuilding and redesigning Studio into an experience that feels as fast and ambitious as the AI behind it. That takes frontend engineers who care about craft, performance, and product, not just tickets.

We are looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer who can own complex UI, push ideas, and make Studio feel snappy, polished, and delightful to use.

About the role:

As a Senior Frontend Engineer, you will build and evolve the frontend of Creative Fabrica Studio, the surfaces creators use every day.

You will work closely with product designers, product, and other engineers as a hands-on partner, but you are expected to work independently and resourcefully day to day: dig in, figure things out, and ship.

This is not a pure “implement the mock” role. We want someone with a creative mindset who is comfortable coming up with ideas, interaction details, performance wins, cleaner architecture and turning them into production-quality React/TypeScript.

You will have real ownership. Sometimes you will get a clear design and scope; other times you will be expected to shape the solution yourself and raise the bar for how Studio feels and performs.

What you will do:

  • Build and ship high-quality product UI for Studio in React and TypeScript.
  • Own complex frontend features end-to-end: architecture, implementation, polish, and follow-through in production.
  • Obsess over performance: load time, runtime responsiveness, rendering, and perceived speed in a heavy creative/AI product.
  • Partner tightly with Product Design: turn Figma into buildable reality, improve the experience together.
  • Bring ideas to the table, including better interactions, smarter component patterns, UX improvements, and technical approaches that make creators faster.
  • Raise the quality bar for frontend code: clarity, maintainability, testing where it matters, and reusable systems.
  • Work with APIs, state, and real-time or media-heavy flows typical of an AI creative suite.
  • Collaborate with backend and platform engineers to deliver reliable, scalable product experiences.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate your own work without lowering engineering standards.
  • Help shape frontend standards, reviews, and technical direction as a senior voice on the team.
  • Stay current with React, TypeScript, modern frontend performance practices, and AI product UX patterns.

What you will need:

  • 5+ years of professional frontend engineering experience shipping production web applications.
  • Strong proficiency with React and TypeScript in real product codebases (not only prototypes).
  • Deep understanding of frontend performance: rendering, bundling, caching, profiling, and fixing real bottlenecks.
  • Experience building complex, interactive product UI (dashboards, editors, creative tools, or similarly rich apps).
  • Comfortable using AI tools to accelerate your own engineering process
  • Good written and spoken English.
  • Creative and proactive: comfortable proposing ideas, not only implementing briefs.
  • Thrives in ambiguity: clarifies incomplete requirements, makes sound calls, and keeps shipping without waiting for perfect specs.
  • Independent and resourceful: unblocks yourself, finds answers fast, and owns delivery without heavy hand-holding, while still partnering well with design and engineering.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with AI products, generative-media tools, creative editors, or other media-heavy web apps.
  • Experience in a startup, agency, or other high-pace product environment.
  • Experience with design systems, component libraries, or improving frontend architecture at scale.

Please note: You must already be living in Australia or New Zealand to be considered for this role.

We are seeking an AI Infrastructure Engineer to design, build, and operate the platform layer that powers large-scale AI training and inference workloads. The role focuses on GPU clusters, distributed training frameworks, scheduling, storage performance, and developer experience for ML engineers and researchers, with strong emphasis on reliability, efficiency, and cost control. The ideal candidate has built or operated production AI infrastructure at scale, understands the interaction between hardware, kernel, scheduler, and ML framework, and brings strong software engineering discipline to platform work.

  • Design and operate GPU and accelerator infrastructure for training and inference, spanning on-prem clusters, cloud-managed services, and hybrid configurations.

  • Integrate frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, DeepSpeed, FSDP, Megatron-LM, and Ray Train into a unified platform offering.
  • Operate high-performance storage systems and data pipelines that keep accelerators fed with training data at near-line-rate.
  • Design networking architectures supporting RDMA, InfiniBand, NCCL, and high-bandwidth collective communication.
  • Build observability for AI workloads including utilization, throughput, training stability, and failure-mode analytics.
  • Implement checkpointing, restart, and fault-tolerance patterns for long-running training jobs at scale.
  • Drive cost optimization across compute, storage, and networking through scheduling, spot capacity, and right-sizing.
  • Develop developer tooling and paved-road workflows that let researchers launch experiments safely and efficiently.
  • Partner with research and applied ML teams to plan capacity for upcoming training runs.
  • Implement security controls, isolation, and access management for multi-tenant AI infrastructure.
  • Drive automation across cluster provisioning, lifecycle management, and configuration enforcement.
  • Maintain runbooks, capacity dashboards, and operational documentation for the AI platform.
  • Stay current with AI infrastructure research, accelerator hardware, and emerging open-source AI tooling.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Ten or more years of experience in infrastructure, platform, or HPC engineering.
  • Hands-on experience operating GPU clusters or large-scale ML training infrastructure.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and at least one systems language such as Go or C++.
  • Deep understanding of distributed training, accelerator architectures, and collective communication.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, or similar scheduling systems for ML workloads.
  • Strong understanding of Linux internals, networking, and high-performance storage.
  • Experience with at least one major cloud provider’s ML infrastructure offerings.
  • Strong software engineering practices including testing, CI/CD, and code review.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience operating InfiniBand or RDMA networking at scale.
  • Contributions to open-source ML infrastructure projects.
  • Familiarity with custom orchestrators or research-grade training stacks.
  • Exposure to frontier model training operations.

Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

The Product & Services Cybersecurity Team is accountable for advising and guiding our development organizations in securing our customer-facing products and services. We are a team of security architects, software security engineers, and security solutions engineers. We are passionate about what we do as it is a job like no other. This is an opportunity for you to use user cybersecurity skills to protect the people that protect us. Our customers are first responders. Fire, police, and paramedics, 911 call takers and 911 dispatchers. And when we or our loved ones place that 911 call, we become the customer of our customers. We want that call to be answered, and we want the communications between the dispatcher and the first responder to be available. But what if that 911 call center, or the communications link to the responders in the field, were under attack? What if you or your loved ones' call to 911 went unanswered, or they were unable to dispatch paramedics to your location, because they had been taken down by ransomware? This is not just theoretical, it is happening. First responders and 911 call centers are under attack around the globe, and this is a chance to fight back.

About the Team

The Motorola Solutions Federal Cloud (MSFC) Team is accountable for guiding Motorola Solutions platform and application teams through the complex web of sovereign cloud requirements and authorization processes which apply to our products across the globe. Our team directly enables access to new markets for MSI by successfully guiding and governing these processes, via the achievement of various authorizations, successful assessments, and certifications for Motorola Solutions products. This team is both internally and externally facing, and leads interactions with internal Motorola Solutions leadership, as well as external consultants, 3rd party assessors, various customers, and government agencies (both US and international).

jobs.description:
Job Description

Title: RFP & Contract Support Specialist

About Effective School Solutions:Effective School Solutions is a leading provider of school-based mental health services for K-12 students. Serving over 6,000 students daily across 120+ districts in 12 states, Effective School Solutions offers in-school clinical programs for students with the most intensive needs, as well as professional learning services, so all students can be supported in safe, supportive environment where they can thrive socially, emotionally, and academically.

About the Role: Effective School Solutions is seeking an organized and highly detail-oriented RFP & Contract Support Specialist to join our District and School Partnership team. This role will provide proposal-development support to the RFP Manager, contract-processing support to the Sales and Operations teams, and additional quote and proposal assistance as needed.

The largest portion of this role will involve supporting the development of requests for proposals, or RFPs, from kickoff through submission. The contract-support portion of the position will focus on quality assurance, coordination, approval routing, and status tracking.

This position reports to the Vice President of Marketing and maintains a dotted-line partnership with the Revenue Operations, Senior Analyst for contract-system standards and quality benchmarks.

Responsibilities and Duties:

RFP and Proposal Support

  • Support the RFP Manager throughout the proposal-development process, from initial kickoff through final submission.
  • Gather required information and coordinate with internal subject-matter experts to support complete and accurate responses.
  • Draft and update standard proposal sections using approved organizational language and resources.
  • Assist with proposal formatting, data gathering, document assembly, proofreading, and final quality review.
  • Maintain the RFP tracking log and proactively flag upcoming deadlines, missing materials, and potential submission risks.
  • Contribute approved content and completed responses to ESS’s internal RFP response database for use in future submissions.
  • Ensure proposals are polished, accurate, responsive to district requirements, and submitted on time.

Contract Support

  • Review and quality-check AI-generated contracts for accuracy and completeness before routing them for approval.
  • Manage contract intake, internal approval routing, and the handoff to signature.
  • Confirm that pricing, service details, terms, and other key information are accurately reflected in contract documents.
  • Flag pricing exceptions, unusual terms, or other potential issues to the Revenue Operations, Senior Analyst.
  • Maintain accurate contract-status tracking and follow up on outstanding items to prevent agreements from stalling in the pipeline.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Operations, Finance, Legal, and other stakeholders throughout the contracting process.
  • Follow established contract-system standards and quality benchmarks in partnership with the Revenue Operations, Senior Analyst.

Additional Growth and Operations Support

  • Assist the Operations and Growth teams with quote and proposal generation as capacity allows.
  • Provide formatting, document coordination, quality-assurance, and administrative support for other growth-related materials.
  • Help maintain organized and accessible proposal, contract, and quote documentation.
  • Adapt to shifting organizational priorities and provide support across functions during high-volume periods.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • One to three years of experience in RFP or grant writing, proposal development, contract support, quote support, or a related area.
  • This is not an entry-level role; candidates should have prior experience supporting complex, deadline-driven documents or processes.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to serve as a quality-control checkpoint for contracts and proposals.
  • Strong written communication, proofreading, editing, and document-formatting skills.
  • Ability to gather information and coordinate effectively with stakeholders across multiple departments.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities across RFP work, contract support, and ad hoc Operations requests.
  • Comfortable learning and using new software and AI-assisted tools.
  • Ability to track multiple deadlines and proactively follow up on outstanding information.
  • Demonstrated reliability, adaptability, accountability, and follow-through.
  • Experience working with CRM, proposal-management, contract-management, or document-collaboration platforms is preferred.

It’s not enough to have an incredible mission, join us because you share our values too:

  • Innovation: The world of mental health changes quickly. We respond to these changes by constantly exploring new ways to support our students, families, and school districts. We take an innovative approach, using data and research to identify the best therapeutic approaches. At Effective School Solutions, we foster creativity and learning, empowering our staff to drive positive change in our communities.
  • Accountability: To us, accountability means keeping our promises. We acknowledge mistakes and use them as opportunities to improve. This commitment strengthens trust and drives our mission.
  • Integrity: We view integrity as doing the right thing even when no one is looking. It is the bedrock of our work, guiding every decision and action. We prioritize open communication, sincerity, and authenticity in all our interactions, showing up consistently for one another and for the people we serve.
  • Impact: Impact is not just a goal—it is our reason for being, our “why.” We focus on delivering measurable results and creating lasting change. We are passionate about making a meaningful difference, one student, one family, and one school district at a time.
  • Compassion: We create opportunities for every individual to feel seen, heard, and valued. By cultivating empathy and understanding, we create an environment where everyone feels safe expressing themselves authentically.
  • Collaboration: We embrace and leverage diverse talents, perspectives, and resources. By working together, we amplify our collective impact and empower those we serve, ensuring every individual receives the support they need to thrive.

Why Join Effective School Solutions?

  • We are focused on addressing one of the most significant challenges facing our country: the mental health of our youth.
  • Effective School Solutions is a dynamic organization with a strong record of innovation and growth.
  • We provide employees with excellent career-growth opportunities.
  • We offer competitive compensation and benefits.
  • We value employees’ voices and perspectives and provides multiple opportunities to offer feedback and contribute to company decisions.

Effective School Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

jobs.excerpt: Our team members are at the heart of everything we do.
jobs.description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

Cencora is shaping the future of healthcare by providing solutions that enable better access to medical care. We are looking for an innovative Customer Experience (CX) Research Lead to join our growing Research and Insights Practice. We're seeking a highly collaborative, thoughtful, and creative researcher to lead complex research initiatives, shape research strategy, and translate customer insights into actionable business, experience, and product decisions. Reporting to the Director of Insights and Intelligence and partnering closely with members of the CX Strategy Team, this role will develop a deep understanding of our customers and ensure their needs, behaviors and experiences inform priorities across the enterprise.

The CX Research Lead will serve as a senior research practitioner and team lead, independently leading high-impact research, while guiding, developing, and overseeing the work of other researchers. This individual will help maintain research standards, elevate the quality and strategic impact of the team’s work, and foster partnerships with stakeholders across product, strategy, marketing, and other business functions. This role provides the unique opportunity to influence product, experience, and business strategy within a Fortune 10 organization and help advance the maturity and impact of customer research across Cencora.

About You

  • Experienced customer experience (CX) researcher or research professional with deep expertise in both qualitative and quantitative methodologies. You bring a strong foundation in research design, behavioral science, and data-driven analysis, applying rigorous research practices to solve complex business and customer challenges in fast-paced environments.

  • Skilled communicator who excels at building trusted relationships across stakeholders and translating research insights into clear, actionable recommendations. Comfortable navigating ambiguity, you can see the bigger picture and identify opportunities where research can drive meaningful customer impact and business value.

  • Passionate about advancing the discipline of research through collaboration, coaching, and mentorship, helping others grow while elevating the quality and influence of research across the organization. You continuously look for ways to improve research tools, processes, and methodologies to increase effectiveness, scalability, and impact.

  • Most importantly, you are confident communicating complex findings to senior leaders and executive audiences, influencing strategic decisions through compelling storytelling and evidence-based insights.

Responsibilities

  • Lead complex, high-impact research initiatives, end-to-end, from defining business questions and research strategy through execution, synthesis, storytelling, and activation of insights.

  • Develop strategic research plans and roadmaps in partnership with business and product leaders, identifying where research can have the greatest impact on customer experience and business outcomes.

  • Serve as a trusted research advisor to cross-functional partners, helping to translate ambiguous business challenges into clear research questions and evidence-based decisions.

  • Establish and champion research best practices, standards, and frameworks that maintain consistency, quality, and build scalability of research across the organization.

  • Conduct and oversee a broad range of quantitative, qualitative, and mixed-methods research, spanning generative, exploratory, and strategic research.

  • Synthesize insights across studies and data sources to identify broader customer needs, experience gaps, emerging trends, strategic opportunities.

  • Translate research findings into clear, compelling narratives and recommendations for senior leaders.

  • Provide day-to-day leadership to researchers, including research direction, prioritization, coaching, feedback, and development.

  • As the function grows, assume formal people leadership responsibilities, including management and development of direct reports.

  • Contribute to the continued development of Cencora’s research practice and culture of customer-centered, evidence-based decision-making.

Education and Work Experience

  • 7+ years in customer experience, market, or related research, with demonstrated experience independently leading complex research initiatives with impactful outcomes.

  • 3+ years of mentoring, coaching, or providing research direction to other researchers; prior formal people management experience preferred.

  • Demonstrated formal training in research methodology, behavioral science, study design, and analysis.

  • Bachelor’s degree in market research, Psychology, Cognitive Science, Human Centered Interaction (HCI), Human Factors, Sociology, Anthropology, or another research-intensive discipline with formal training in research methodology and design.

  • Advanced degree (Master’s or Doctorate) preferred.

  • Certification in market research, data analytics, or equivalent preferred.

  • A portfolio demonstrating past work experience and deliverables (e.g., surveys, user study designs, research reports, etc.).

Skills and Knowledge

  • Advanced proficiency in qualitative quantitative methodologies, including survey design, in-depth interviewing, and other appropriate research approaches.

  • Proficiency with survey and research platforms, such as Qualtrics, UserTesting, Medallia, and other similar tools.

  • Working knowledge of statistical analysis and data interpretation, including descriptive and inferential statistical techniques. Experience working with data analysis and visualization tools, such as Excel, Tableau, SPSS, SAS, Jamovi, R, Python, etc.

  • Experience synthesizing and analyzing qualitative and quantitative datasets to identify patterns and generate actionable insights.

  • Experience conducting or strong familiarity with Bayesian statistics.

  • Familiarity with collaboration tools such as Mural, Miro, or similar platforms.

What Cencora offers

We provide compensation, benefits, and resources that enable a highly inclusive culture and support our team members’ ability to live with purpose every day. In addition to traditional offerings like medical, dental, and vision care, we also provide a comprehensive suite of benefits that focus on the physical, emotional, financial, and social aspects of wellness. This encompasses support for working families, which may include backup dependent care, adoption assistance, infertility coverage, family building support, behavioral health solutions, paid parental leave, and paid caregiver leave. To encourage your personal growth, we also offer a variety of training programs, professional development resources, and opportunities to participate in mentorship programs, employee resource groups, volunteer activities, and much more. jobs.excerpt: Flex is building the AI-native private bank for business owners.
jobs.description:
Flex is building the AI-native private bank for business owners.
We’re re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations—rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners.
Since launching publicly in September 2023, Flex has scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue, with a clear path to profitability by late 2026. We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership.
Our customers are affluent business owners ($3–$200M in revenue)—the backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a ~$1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. Our ambition is to build a $100B+ company by delivering a product that is fundamentally better—not incrementally improved.
Flex has raised $100M+ in equity and $300M+ in debt.
- Mission-critical problems: We build software that directly controls how money moves at scale.
- High bar, low ego: Small teams, exceptional people, real ownership.
- Speed over comfort: We prioritize execution, quality, clarity, and results.
- Enduring impact: What we’re building will define how a generation of owners runs their businesses.

Team & Locations

We hire exceptional people who want to build hard things and see their work matter immediately. Roles are available in: San Francisco, Miami, New York, and fully remote.

Flex Fuels Ambition.

About Us

    This is a ground-floor seat on a small finance team, and it's a genuinely embedded one. Most of your week will be spent with our go-to-market org — reporting on what our growth spend is actually returning, and acting as the finance counterpart on deal structure and pricing. The rest goes to the budget cycle, where you'll sit with department leads to build and defend their plans.

    We're hiring for judgment and speed, not years served. If you're two years out of a banking analyst program, or a strong new grad who models well and writes clearly, you're the profile. You'll report to our Director of FP&A and get real exposure to the exec team.

What You'll Do

    Be the finance partner to go-to-market

    • Own reporting on the ROI of our growth investments — by channel, campaign, and segment — so the team knows what's working and what to cut

    • Run Deal Desk: serve as the finance liaison on pricing, deal structure, and non-standard terms, and be the person go-to-market pulls in before a deal gets committed

    • Build and maintain the customer and growth economics that inform how we invest in acquisition

    • Sit in go-to-market's meetings, not just their inbox — translate their questions into analysis and hand back a recommendation instead of a spreadsheet

      • Run the budget cycle with the teams

      • Partner with department leads through quarterly budget and headcount planning — collect inputs, pressure-test them, and translate them into the plan

      • Track spend against budget, surface drift before it compounds, and flag what needs a decision

      • Build the analysis behind headcount, vendor, and resourcing calls — payback, cost-to-serve, build-vs-buy

        • Support forecasting and reporting

        • Support the monthly forecast cycle: pull and reconcile actuals, build the variance analysis, and draft the commentary that explains what moved and why

        • Maintain the schedules and drivers that feed the company operating model, working alongside the Director of FP&A

        • Help assemble the monthly and quarterly reporting packages for leadership, the board, and lenders

          • Automate anything you do twice

          • Replace recurring manual work with something durable — AI workflows, queries, dashboards, templates — so next month it takes minutes

          • Bring rigor to automated output: reconcile it, stress it, and know where it breaks before someone else finds out

Requirements

    • 0–2 years in FP&A, strategic finance, investment banking, consulting, Big 4, or a comparably analytical role — exceptional new grads welcome

    • Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, accounting, engineering, mathematics, or another quantitative field

    • You build financial models from a blank sheet. Advanced Excel or Google Sheets is table stakes here, not a bullet point

    • Hands-on exposure to a real budgeting or forecasting cycle

    • AI is already the default in how you work, and you have the judgment to go with it: a reliable instinct for when a machine-generated answer is wrong, and the discipline to check before you forward it

    • You write clearly. You can compress a 40-tab model into three sentences a founder can act on

    • Extreme attention to detail, and comfort operating in ambiguity at speed — priorities here change faster than the plan does

    • Based in the US

      • Nice to Haves

      • SQL — you can pull your own data instead of filing a ticket

      • Python, or comparable scripting for analysis and automation

      • BI and analytics tooling (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Hex) and modern planning tools (Pigment, Cube, Aleph, NetSuite)

      • Fintech, banking, or lending background

Why Join Us

Build something generational — Capture the full lifecycle of money for ambitious business owners.
Work on real money, real risk — Payments, credit, and banking at serious scale.
Solve hard problems — AI, underwriting, compliance, and global finance from first principles.
True ownership — Small teams, high trust, real accountability.
Founder-level exposure — Direct access to leadership, customers, and investors.
High bar, high taste — Move fast without cutting corners.
Elite peers — People here are builders, not tourists.
Real upside — Meaningful equity if you help build something big.

jobs.description:
Job Summary:

Modaxo’s Aczel Group, which holds our Vontas, TripSpark, TransTrack, Momentm, Expretio, and Busology business units (“BUs”), is looking for a Group Legal Counsel to be its lead legal advisor and strategic business partner. The Group Legal Counsel will work closely with the Group Leader, Group Team, and BU General Managers, to shape commercial, contractual, legal, strategy and risks to support the group’s continued growth.

Job Description:

Our Group Legal Counsel is a trusted business partner who sits with group and BU leadership in strategy reviews, deal reviews, and key initiatives to bring sound legal and commercial judgment. Group Legal Counsel reports to the Group Leader, leads a team of lawyers and contract managers across the group’s six BU, and is accountable for the quality, consistency, and efficiency of legal support group-wide.

Beyond direct business partnership, the Group Legal Counsel drives shared tools, processes, and best practice adoption across BUs; develops the group’s legal talent; provides ongoing, hands-on legal support to the BUs units; and supports M&A activity as the group and Modaxo continues to grow through acquisition.

The Group Legal Counsel has a dotted line relationship with Modaxo’s General Counsel, and will work together to develop Modaxo’s legal strategy and M&A growth.

Business Partnership with Group and BU Leadership

  • Participate actively in group- and BU-level strategic conversations, including strategy reviews, deal reviews, and key initiatives.
  • Provide legal, contracts, and general risk assessment to the Group Leader, General Managers, and BU’s legal teams, to inform business and commercial decisions.
  • Act as a true business partner — a trusted advisor on legal matters and broader business questions alike, not solely a legal resource.
  • Establish and maintain a network of external specialized legal support in areas such as employment law, IP law and other required areas to support BUs in specific cases as needed.
  • Act as the Group’s legal leader; is the top contact and legal risk review and escalation point.

Establish Cross-BU Best Practices

  • Effectively manage communications between the portfolio, the group, and the business units.
  • Drive adoption of tools like HighQ across all business units and drive improvements to those tools to better support legal processes.
  • Ensure mandatory adoption of AI tools within the legal function across all business units.
  • Implement streamlined and automated legal processes across all business units, delivering measurable improvements in business results covering the full contract workflow from the intake through agreement signature and filing.
  • Enforce and update the Group’s policies and governance documents and procedures.

Talent Development and Management

Work with all legal resources across the group — lawyers and contract managers alike — on performance, growth, and long-term bench strength:

  • Support and collaborate with the General Managers to ensure consistent performance management across the group’s legal function, including regular goal setting, check-ins, and calibrated year-end reviews for both lawyers and contract managers.
  • Build clear career progression frameworks and competency paths for legal and contract management roles, so team members understand what growth looks like at each level.
  • Identify high-potential talent within the group’s legal function and build individualized development plans, including stretch assignments, secondments, and cross-BU exposure.
  • Support the maintenance of active succession plans for all key legal roles across the group, ensuring continuity of support through leadership transitions or unplanned vacancies.
  • Coach and mentor legal team members directly, and foster a culture of knowledge-sharing, feedback, and continuous learning across BUs.
  • Partner with the General Manager, Group HR and BU Legal Counsel on talent reviews, compensation benchmarking, and recruiting for legal and contract management roles across the group.
  • Drive engagement and retention of top legal talent through recognition, meaningful career mobility, and visibility into opportunities across the group’s business units.

Ongoing BU Legal Support

  • Work with Group Leader and General Managers to assign the right level and number of legal resources to support every BU in the group based on business needs and resource workload.
  • Manage the Group’s compliance and quarterly reporting obligations.
  • Provide ongoing, regular legal support for the Group’s business units, act as lead legal resource for key contracts, litigation, and high-risk or multi-BU matters.
  • Support General Manager and BU Legal Counsel with the coordination of the daily work of the contract managers assigned to BUs where needed .
  • Fill-in and overflow legal support for all BUs.

M&A Support

  • Support M&A activity across the group as needed, including diligence, purchase agreement negotiation, and integration of acquired assets and businesses.
  • Manage legal resourcing of larger M&A deals within the group.
  • Work with Modaxo General Counsel on Modaxo Global M&A and initiatives.

jobs.description:
Built on meritocracy, our unique company culture rewards self-starters and those who are committed to doing what is best for our customers.

Brown & Brown is seeking aBenefits Account Manager – Public Sector to join our growing team. 

The Account Manager is responsible for managing and retaining a dedicated book of business focused on public sector clients who offer employee benefit programs consisting of group medical, dental, vision, pharmacy management, life, disability, and workplace benefits. This role serves as a long-term strategic partner and primary point of accountability while delivering consistently high-quality client experience. Day-to-day responsibilities include leading benefits implementation, compliance alignment, renewals, and Open Enrollment strategy.

The Account Manager partners closely with public sector organizations to navigate regulatory complexity, multi‑layered governance and decision‑making environments, and long planning cycles—ensuring benefits programs are compliant, well‑executed, and aligned with agency or municipality goals. Success in this role requires a consultative mindset, strong public sector expertise, and the ability to proactively anticipate client needs, resolve issues, and strengthen trust over time.

How You Will Contribute:  

  • Manage an assigned book of business with a focus on client retention, deepening relationships through thoughtful service delivery, trusted partnership, and utilization of department best practices.

  • Define overall implementation strategy, timelines, and success criteria in partnership with the client.

  • Lead implementation kickoffs and facilitate key decision‑making conversations across client leadership and their teams.

  • Lead carrier and vendor relationship management, ensuring service delivery, performance standards, and contractual obligations are consistently met.

  • Serve as the strategic point of coordination to ensure benefits solutions align to client objectives.

  • Lead the development and execution of client wellness strategies, coordinating with wellness partners, and attending wellness‑related events to reinforce program goals and employee engagement.

  • Anticipate client risks, dependencies, and potential roadblocks; proactively adjust plans to maintain outcomes.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to the client, delivering clear guidance.

  • Resolve escalated issues that impact trust, timing, employee experience, or desired outcomes.

  • Maintain strong client relationships through proactive communication, accountability, and follow‑through.

Skills & Experience to be Successful:  

  • In‑depth knowledge of employee benefits programs, including group medical, dental, vision, pharmacy management, life, disability, and workplace benefits.

  • Working knowledge of public sector benefits environments, including governmental entities, municipalities, law enforcement agencies, special taxing districts, and school districts.

  • Understanding of benefits compliance and regulatory frameworks (e.g., ACA, ERISA, COBRA, HIPAA) and when to engage specialized third‑party expertise.

  • Knowledge of Open Enrollment planning and execution.

  • Familiarity with carrier and vendor operations, service models, and performance standards.

  • Understanding public sector governance, multi‑layered decision‑making, and procurement considerations.

  • Strong client relationship management skills with the ability to build trust, credibility, and long‑term partnerships.

  • Strategic planning and execution skills to lead implementations, renewals, and Open Enrollment initiatives.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to translate complex benefits and compliance topics into clear, actionable guidance.

  • Skilled at facilitating decision‑making conversations with client leadership and internal teams.

EDUCATION, TRAINING AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Finance, Risk Management, Public Administration, or related field, or equivalent relevant work experience.

  • Advanced coursework or continuing education in employee benefits, compliance, or public sector administration is a plus.

  • 5+ years of experience in employee benefits account management, benefits consulting, brokerage, or a related client‑facing role.

  • Prior experience managing a book of business, with demonstrated accountability for client retention and relationship growth.

  • Experience serving public sector clients (e.g., municipalities, school districts, counties, state agencies) preferred.

  • Active Life & Health Insurance license (or ability to obtain within the first90 days'timeframe).

  • Professional designations are a plus: CEBS (Certified Employee Benefit Specialist), PHR / SPHR, SHRM-CP/SHRM-SCP.

Teammate Benefits & Total Well-Being

We go beyond standard benefits, focusing on the total well-being of our teammates, including:

  • Health Benefits: Medical/Rx, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Disability Insurance
  • Financial Benefits: ESPP; 401k; Student Loan Assistance; Tuition Reimbursement
  • Mental Health & Wellness: Free Mental Health & Enhanced Advocacy Services
  • Beyond Benefits: Paid Time Off, Holidays, Preferred Partner Discounts and more.

Not reflective of all benefits. Enrollment waiting periods or eligibility criteria may apply to certain benefits. Benefit details and offerings may vary for subsidiary entities or in specific geographic locations.

Recruiting Vendors must have a valid written agreement and received prior written authorization from an authorized Brown & Brown representative before submitting candidates for any publicly posted role. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to Brown & Brown or its employees become the property of Brown & Brown, and no fees will be paid for such submissions. Additional information regarding this policy can be found on our careers page.

The Power To Be Yourself

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we are committed to fostering an inclusive environment comprised of people from all backgrounds, with a variety of experiences and perspectives, guided by our Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging (DIB) motto, “The Power to Be Yourself”.

jobs.title: Video Editor / Motion Designer
jobs.excerpt: DescriptionCapsLock specializes in providing digital marketing services to businesses facing sales growth challenges.
jobs.description:
Description

CapsLock specializes in providing digital marketing services to businesses facing sales growth challenges. Our services include sales consulting, data analytics, and recruitment support, ensuring efficient and accelerated growth. Founded by industry professionals in IT, design, and data analytics, we address the market need for exclusive, scalable customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, we value people, client orientation, quality, continuous improvement, integrity, and strong relationships. Our diverse, global team speaks over 10 languages whose ideas inspire the innovation that runs through everything we do, from unique technology to industry-leading services and customer experiences.

﻿Role overview

The Video Editor / Motion Designer at CapsLock creates and edits high-performing video content with the primary goal of improving conversion rates. This role sits at the intersection of creative storytelling, motion design, and modern AI tooling — producing advertising videos that convert cold traffic across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and landing pages.

You'll work closely with the Creative Director, marketers, and copywriters to develop, test, and iterate on video concepts, using AI tools alongside traditional post-production to accelerate output and raise the quality bar.

Responsibilities

﻿

Video Creation & Production

  • Develop video ads from concept to final delivery — funnel formats, YouTube, Facebook, and TikTok
  • Edit and enhance videos using dialogue, graphics, music, sound design, and visual effects, ensuring logical sequencing and strong storytelling
  • Create AI-generated advertising creative for paid social and landing pages, converting cold traffic into warm leads
  • Produce and refine photorealistic human characters in video, with attention to realism in motion, expression, and speech synchronisation
  • Enhance video quality through upscaling, smoothness improvements, and post-processing
  • Deliver polished final cuts optimised for advertising performance goals

Concept Development & Pre-Production

  • Craft clear storylines and narrative structures tailored to platform and audience
  • Prepare shoot guides and gather reference materials when collaborating with videographers
  • Research and propose multiple creative angles, selecting the best options based on data and research
  • Test different formats, calls-to-action, and visual approaches

AI Tools & Optimization

  • Research, test, and integrate new AI tools into the production workflow to improve efficiency and output quality
  • Experiment with AI-assisted editing techniques including avatar generation, voice synthesis, and automated post-production
  • Use AI tools to reduce production time without compromising quality

Analytics & Performance

  • Analyse video performance metrics and use insights to optimise creative
  • Run A/B tests on formats, hooks, CTAs, and creative elements — monitor and document results promptly
  • Build deep product knowledge and apply it to data-driven creative decisions

Collaboration & Trend Integration

  • Work closely with the Creative Director, copywriters, marketers, and designers to ensure creative alignment
  • Track and apply the latest video trends, viral formats, and platform-specific features
  • Document all tasks clearly in ClickUp per team standards

Requirements

Must-Have Skills

  • Full post-production capability: cutting, titling, colour correction, After Effects, sound mixing
  • Strong command of video rhythm, pacing, transitions, typography, and sound design
  • Skills in improving video quality — sharpness, smoothness, upscaling
  • Hands-on experience creating AI-generated video from scratch or from references
  • Ability to produce realistic human characters in video, including lip-sync and speech-to-movement synchronisation
  • Deep enough understanding of video editing to speak the language and spot problems early
  • Ability to work from a detailed brief and proactively propose creative solutions
  • Comfort collaborating with a Creative Director on iterations and new concepts

Technical Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in video editing, post-production, or motion design as a primary discipline
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects. Desktop-based editing is required — portfolios built on mobile-only tools such as CapCut will not be considered
  • Experience working within an agency or structured in-house team, with established workflows and reporting lines
  • Working experience with AI video tools: Veo, Higgsfield, Runway, Kling, HeyGen, or similar
  • Experience with AI image generation tools: Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, or similar
  • Solid understanding of video formats for YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook
  • Comfortable reviewing performance analytics and iterating based on data
  • Upper-intermediate English (B2) or higher

﻿Soft Skills

  • Curious to explore new tools, formats, and creative approaches
  • Adaptable to shifting priorities and fast-paced team dynamics
  • High execution speed without compromising quality
  • Consistent on-time delivery and strong attention to deadlines
  • Strong attention to detail, especially around compliance and brand guidelines
  • Critical thinking and a problem-solving mindset
  • Clear, professional communication and team collaboration skills
  • Initiative to find solutions even when processes are undefined

Why do we deserve your attention?

Not only do we offer fair and competitive pay, but we also provide perks and benefits that support your well-being and growth. Here are some of them:

Remote Work

We are a truly remote-first company. You choose where you feel the most productive and comfortable to make an impact.

Paid Time Off

Work-life balance matters to us, and we support it with paid time off for rest, personal time, or simply doing what makes you happy.

Ongoing Learning

We believe in curiosity and growth. That’s why we support continuous learning with workshops, online courses, conferences, and certifications.

Home Office

We help you set up your perfect workspace by covering equipment and furniture expenses, so you can do your best work from home.

Physical Well-Being

From gym memberships and yoga classes to home workout equipment or even a bicycle, we give you the flexibility to stay active your way.

Unlimited Sick Days

Your health matters. Take the time you need to rest and recover - we’ll be here when you’re ready to return.

Medical Coverage

We support you and your family with reimbursement for medical insurance and health-related expenses, including dental care and psychological support.

Co-Working Space

If you sometimes crave a change of scenery or more social interaction, we’ll cover the full cost of a co-working space.

Fun Stuff

From gaming nights and fitness challenges to annual retreats at world-class resorts, we make sure there’s never a shortage of fun and connection.

jobs.title: Data Analyst Internship
jobs.excerpt: DATA ANALYST INTERNSHIPWHO WE ARE:Passion for Life is a non-profit organization that operates with the power of dedicated interns like you.
jobs.description:
DATA ANALYST INTERNSHIP

WHO WE ARE:

Passion for Life is a non-profit organization that operates with the power of dedicated interns like you. We help under-resourced youth transform their passions into rewarding careers. Our mission is to provide forward-thinking career coaching and immersion opportunities driven by the students’ passions and talents in a fun, structured, and high-energy environment. Passion for Life was created to be a high-energy and engaging process that helps students identify their passions and gain clarity on how to utilize their core strengths and talents to select a career.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Data Analyst Intern plays a critical role in advancing the organization's mission by transforming raw program and operational data into clear, actionable insights. Working collaboratively across program, development, and leadership teams, this position supports data-driven decision-making by designing and maintaining evaluation frameworks, producing compelling reports and dashboards, and ensuring data integrity throughout the organization. The ideal candidate is both analytically rigorous and mission-passionate, with the ability to communicate complex findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Data Analysis & Program Evaluation: Conduct regular impact assessments, needs analyses, and program evaluations using both quantitative and qualitative methodologies to measure effectiveness and inform continuous improvement.
  • Data Management & Governance: Oversee data collection, cleaning, storage, and management in compliance with organizational standards, confidentiality policies, and applicable data governance requirements.
  • Reporting & Data Visualization: Create user-friendly, visually engaging reports and dashboards for both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including program teams, leadership, and funders.
  • Evaluation Framework & Strategy: Design and maintain robust evaluation frameworks that measure program outcomes, align with organizational goals, and inform strategic decision-making.
  • Collaboration & Capacity Building: Partner with program, development, and leadership teams to deliver data insights that support program enhancement and assist staff in building data literacy for day-to-day use.

Technical Skills:

  • Leadership and Delegation: Ability to lead research initiatives and delegate tasks effectively to team members or collaborators.
  • Research Platforms: Proficiency in research platforms and tools, including Python, Qualtrics, Microsoft Office Suite, and Java.
  • Analytics: Skilled in statistical and data analytics software (e.g., SPSS, SAS, R), with a strong foundation in analyzing complex datasets.
  • Data Collection and Cleaning: Experienced in data collection methods and techniques, ensuring clean, accurate, and reliable data for analysis.
  • Qualitative and Quantitative Data: Competent in both qualitative and quantitative research methodologies, applying each effectively to capture comprehensive insights.
  • Evaluation Design: Ability to design robust evaluation frameworks that measure outcomes and inform strategic decisions.
  • Creating Reports and Sharing Data: Skilled in creating clear, compelling reports and dashboards to communicate findings effectively to stakeholders, including program teams and funders.
  • Editing and Proofreading: Strong attention to detail in reviewing reports, ensuring clarity, coherence, and accuracy in documentation.
  • Research and Evaluation Planning: Skilled in planning and executing research projects aligned with organizational goals.
  • Instructional Design Principles and Learning Theory: Knowledgeable in instructional design (ID) principles, learning theory, and educational frameworks to support effective program evaluation.
  • Graphic Design and Multimedia: Familiar with tools such as Articulate, Captivate, and other eLearning and multimedia platforms, capable of creating engaging visuals and interactive reports.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Social Sciences, Public Policy, Human Services, or a related field required.
  • Master's degree or certifications in research methods, program evaluation, or data analytics (e.g., SAS, SPSS, Google Data Analytics, or equivalent) preferred.
  • Students with relevant majors and coursework aligned to the above are encouraged to apply for the intern role.

Experience

  • 1–5 years of experience in data analysis, program evaluation, or research, ideally within a nonprofit or mission-driven organization.
  • Proven experience conducting impact assessments, needs analyses, and program evaluations; community-based program familiarity strongly preferred.
  • Experience working across cross-functional teams and communicating findings to non-technical audiences.

Additional Information

Estimated time commitment: 9-10 hours/ week depending on needs, in addition to weekly meetings and occasional conference calls.

Term limit: 4-month unpaid intern position (Can be extendable on mutual agreement).

jobs.description:
Why Work at Mercer Advisors?

For more than 40 years, Mercer Advisors has been helping families amplify and simplify their financial lives by integrating financial planning, investment management, business management, tax, estate, insurance, and more, all managed by a single team. We deliver the kind of comprehensive care once reserved for only the wealthiest households.

Today, we serve over 42,800+ families across 110+ cities across the U.S. Ranked the #1 RIA Firm in the nation by Barron’s for two consecutive years, Mercer Advisors is an independent fiduciary legally bound to act in our clients’ best interests — always.*

Mercer Advisors offers a workplace that stands apart in the financial industry. More than half of our employees and client-facing professionals are women, reflecting the clients we serve. With a flexible, national footprint, we build our teams around exceptional talent — wherever they are.

Join us and help families amplify and simplify their financial lives with confidence.

* Mercer Advisors was ranked #1 for RIA firms with up to $70 billion in assets. The Barron’s top RIA ranking is based on a combination of metrics – including size, growth, service quality, technology, succession planning and others. No fee was paid for participation in the ranking, however, Mercer Advisors has paid a fee to Barron’s to use the ranking in marketing. Please see important information about the ranking criteria methodology here.

Job Summary:

As a key member of the Operations Team, the Billing Specialist partners with advisors, internal teams, and external stakeholders to ensure accurate and timely billing for Mercer Advisors’ investment management clients. This role is responsible for maintaining billing integrity, updating billing instructions, processing fees, resolving discrepancies, and supporting efficient revenue recognition processes.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Perform monthly billing audits, including fee calculations, account troubleshooting, and adjustment processing
  • Review and maintain client accounts and household structures to ensure accurate fee schedule assignments
  • Partner with advisors and internal stakeholders to update and maintain billing instructions, ensuring alignment with client agreements
  • Reconcile direct debit results and ensure timely and accurate fee collection
  • Respond to billing-related inquiries from advisors and Client Service teams in a timely and professional manner
  • Partner with Trading and Client Service teams to ensure sufficient account liquidity for billing debits
  • Proactively track, manage, and follow up on outstanding, failed, or rejected fee transactions
  • Investigate root causes of failed collections and coordinate resolution
  • Partner with advisors, Client Service, and Trading teams to facilitate collections, including funding accounts, re-processing fees, or updating client billing setups
  • Maintain detailed records of collection efforts and outstanding balances; provide regular reporting on aged receivables and collection status
  • Identify trends in collection issues and recommend process improvements to reduce failed or delayed billing

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail
  • Understanding of portfolio accounting and client performance reporting concepts
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel
  • Experience working with integrated financial systems and billing platforms
  • Experience with Orion strongly preferred
  • Experience with Salesforce strongly preferred
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively with advisors and cross-functional teams

Location: This is a remote position with a strong preference for candidates in the Mountain or Pacific Time Zones.

Working Hours: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM

Working Conditions: Professional office environment. Working inside. Standing and sitting. Will be assigned to a workstation. No heavy lifting over 10 lbs.

Application Deadline: The initial deadline for applications is 9/30/2026. Applications submitted after this date may still be considered on a rolling basis until the position/program is filled. We encourage all interested candidates to apply as early as possible. If a final decision has not been made by the initial deadline, subsequent applications will be reviewed as they are received.

Actual base pay within this range will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to the applicant’s geographic location, relevant experience, education, skills and licenses/certifications. This position is also eligible to earn incentive compensation through one of Mercer Advisors’ incentive compensation programs.

Base Pay Range
$26—$31 USD

Benefits:

Mercer Advisors offers a competitive and robust benefit package to our employees. Our benefit programs are focused on meeting all of our employees and their eligible dependents health and welfare needs. We offer the following:

  • Company Paid Basic Life & AD&D Insurance
  • Company Paid Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • Supplemental Life Short-Term Disability; Accident; Critical Illness; and Hospital Indemnity Insurance
  • Three Cigna medical plans offerings including two High Deductible Health Plans and a Traditional Co-Pay medical plan.
  • Kaiser Medical plans available in California
