jobs.title: Senior Pathologist
jobs.excerpt: PathAI's mission is to improve patient outcomes with AI-powered pathology.
jobs.description:
PathAI's mission is to improve patient outcomes with AI-powered pathology. Our platform promises substantial improvements to the accuracy of diagnosis and the efficacy of treatment of diseases like cancer, leveraging modern approaches in machine learning and artificial intelligence. We have a track record of success in deploying AI algorithms for histopathology in translational research, pathology labs and clinical trials. Rigorous science and careful analysis is critical to the success of everything we do. Our team, composed of diverse employees with a wide range of backgrounds and experiences, is passionate about solving challenging problems and making a huge impact on patient outcomes.

PathAI is seeking a US Board Certified Senior Pathologist with strong general surgical pathology skills to join our internal PathAI Pathology team. Reporting directly to the Head of Pathology, the Sr. Pathologist will serve as a subject matter expert throughout the company.

This is a critical role to support customer Biopharma programs, and to help build state-of-the-art artificial intelligence algorithms and digital pathology products. You are a pathologist who is keen to learn about new DP/AI technologies, is excited to work with Biopharma companies on their key programs, who has experience in biomarker assessment, and who will enjoy interacting with multidisciplinary teams. This is an opportunity to work in a company where all employees put patients first.

The Opportunity

  • You will collaborate with Pathology colleagues, Lab Ops and Clin Ops, Biopharma customer teams, project managers, machine learning scientists, and others to ensure the highest quality Pathology support.
  • You will collaborate with our Biopharma partners in all aspects of project development for exploratory biomarker and translational projects, as well as clinical services work related to clinical trials running through our GCP, GCLP, CAP and CLIA compliant Biopharma laboratory.
  • You will serve as a Pathology lead on Biopharma and other projects to recommend scoring approaches, help select network or KOL Pathologists, develop and provide training to clinical trial study readers, participate in manual and digital scoring of Pathology cases in various indications, and conduct internal assay validations.
  • You will represent PathAI on calls and face to face with Biopharma customers and KOLs, at Congresses and Meetings, and elsewhere as needed.
  • You will ensure the quality of annotations from the PathAI Contributor Network, the quality of Biopharma data, and compliance across all projects and programs.
  • You will provide Pathology subject matter expert guidance on new potential products, work with multidisciplinary teams to help develop new DP/AI models, assist in model deployments, review the outputs and statistics from the PathAI machine learning algorithms, and provide insights on the overall improvement of the output.
  • You will contribute to publications.

Who You Are:(Required)

  • You have an M.D. or D.O. with US Board Certification in Anatomic Pathology and an active state medical license.
  • You are residency-trained in anatomic pathology with expertise in surgical pathology and a proven ability to assess histopathology, IHC, ISH, and multiplex assays.
  • You have demonstrated experience in digital pathology.
  • You have demonstrated expertise and experience in immunohistochemistry and biomarker assessment (ex/ Her2, PDL1 etc).
  • You have a demonstrated background in translational research, immuno-oncology, and biomarker development.
  • The right candidate is structured and disciplined, has a natural curiosity about Biopharma programs and biomarker assessment and is also interested in the details of the machine learning field.
  • You have high emotional intelligence, communicate effectively, and are flexible and solution-oriented in your approach to problem solving and your work.
  • You enjoy working with multidisciplinary teams, and are an excellent collaborator, communicator, and team player.

Preferred:

  • You are fellowship trained with 2+ years of experience in clinical practice and/or biopharma/biotech industry settings.
  • You have outstanding interpersonal, verbal, and written communication and influencing skills: have built and cultivated important relationships both inside and outside of the organization and externally; have proven abilities to influence internal partners and stakeholders, thought leaders, national advocacy organizations, national standard-setting bodies, and other relevant external parties.
  • You have the proven ability to use sophisticated analytical thought, identify innovative approaches and act as a mentor.

This position is based in Boston, NYC, or remote.
Relocation benefits are not available for this position.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location Boston, MA is $208,000 - $320,000. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

PathAI is an equal opportunity employer. It is our policy and practice to employ, promote, and otherwise treat any and all employees and applicants on the basis of merit, qualifications, and competence. The company's policy prohibits unlawful discrimination, including but not limited to, discrimination on the basis of Protected Veteran status, individuals with disabilities status, and consistent with all federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Engineer I
jobs.excerpt: The SouthState story is one of steady growth, deep community roots, and an unwavering commitment to helping our customers move forward.
jobs.description:
The SouthState story is one of steady growth, deep community roots, and an unwavering commitment to helping our customers move forward. Since our beginnings in the 1930s to becoming a trusted financial partner across the South and beyond - we are known for combining personal relationships with forward-thinking solutions.

We are committed to helping our team members find their success while maintaining the integrity of our values: building trust, fostering lasting relationships and pursuing excellence. At SouthState, individual contributions are recognized, potential is cultivated and team members are inspired to achieve their greater purpose. Your future begins here!

SUMMARY/OBJECTIVES

The Cybersecurity Engineer (CSE) performs two core functions for the enterprise. The first is the day-to-day operations of the in-place security solutions while the second is the identification, investigation, and resolution of security related events detected by those systems. A Cybersecurity Engineer is expected to have a clear understanding of security best practice and understanding of the impacts of controls and the tuning thereof.

The CSE I performs day-to-day operational tasks to ensure the efficient operation of cybersecurity controls and platforms. This generally takes the form of response to tickets that are generated either from the system itself or as part of the Cybersecurity Operations ticket queue. The CSE I position requires initiative, accountability and ownership of tasks presented, leveraging knowledge and utilizing technical resources and other team members to drive success.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Ensures compliance with all bank policies and procedures as well as state, federal, and regulatory requirements.

  • Be fully aware of the enterprise’s security goals as established by its stated policies, procedures, and guidelines and to actively work towards upholding those goals.

System Monitoring & Threat Management

  • Review logs and reports of all in-place devices, whether they be under direct control (i.e. security tools) or not (i.e. workstations, servers, network devices, etc.) and interpret the implications of that activity to provide feedback to leadership.

  • Participate in investigations into anomalous activity.

  • Serve as a first responder and assist with initial investigations for potential security events or control impacts.

  • Assist in the ticket queue rotation to ensure efficient handling of requests.

  • Participate in the cybersecurity on-call rotation.

Operational Management

  • Maintain operational configurations of all in-place security solutions as per the established baselines and security best practice.

  • Participate in the design and execution of vulnerability assessments, penetration tests and security audits.

  • Provide on-call support for end users and all in-place security solutions.

  • Monitor all in-place security solutions for efficient and appropriate operations.

Acquisition & Deployment

  • Maintain up-to-date detailed knowledge of the IT security industry including awareness of new or revised security solutions, improved security processes and the development of new attacks and threat vectors.

  • Recommend and implement additional security solutions or enhancements to existing security solutions to improve overall enterprise security.

  • Research, evaluate, and stay current on emerging tools, techniques, and technologies.

  • Participate in projects or department initiatives.

  • Assist in the development and implementation of internal security projects.

  • Perform daily management of assigned security solutions.

Incident Response

  • Serve as a member of the incident response team as needed for response to cybersecurity incidents.

  • Participate in incident response planning and testing exercises.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

COMPETENCIES

  • Proven analytical and problem-solving abilities.

  • Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment.

  • Good written, oral, and interpersonal communication skills.

  • Ability to conduct research into security issues and products as required.

  • Ability to present ideas in business-friendly and user-friendly language.

  • Highly self-motivated and directed.

Keen attention to detail.

  • Team-oriented and skilled in working within a collaborative environment.

QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS

  • Education: Associate Degree (or equivalent work experience) from a regionally accredited institution in Information Security, computer science, mathematics, engineering, or a closely related field.

  • Experience:

    • Two (2) or more years of direct Cybersecurity experience preferably as a cybersecurity engineer or similar role maintaining cybersecurity safeguards at a financial institution.

    • Direct experience maintaining and operating current security platforms is preferred.

  • Certifications/Specific Knowledge:

    • One or more of the following (or similar) certifications preferred:

      • Global Information Assurance Certification (GIAC) Certifications (e.g., GIAC Security Essentials (GSEC), GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH), GIAC Continuous Monitoring Certification (GMON), GIAC Certified Intrusion Analyst (GCIA), GIAC Security Operations Certified (GSOC), GIAC Certified Enterprise Defender (GCED), GIAC Certified Detection Analyst (GCDA))

      • CompTIA Certifications (e.g., Security+, CySA+)

    • A strong security mindset, understanding of financial sector regulatory requirements and security best practice.

    • Other certificates and professional credentials with cybersecurity relevance will be considered.

TRAINING REQUIREMENTS/CLASSES

  • Annual Compliance Training

  • New Employee Orientation

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

Must be able to effectively access and interpret information on computer screens, documents, reports, and cash denominations, and identify customers. This position requires a large amount of time in front of a computer. This can be done sitting or standing with use of the right desk

WORK ENVIRONMENT

Telecommuting roles, no matter if hybrid or 100% full time telecommuting, must have a secure home office environment that is free from background noise and distractions. They must also have a reliable private internet connection that is not supplied by use of cellular data (hot spot). Cable or fiber connections are preferred. Requirements are subject to change, as new systems and technology are delivered.

TRAVEL

Travel may be required to come to meetings as needed.

Equal Opportunity Employer, including disabled/veterans.

jobs.description:
Bilingual Patient Follow-Up Specialist

Remote | Personal Injury | Part-Time, 30 hours/week initially | $6.5/hour

About the Role

We are seeking a highly organized, dependable, and personable Bilingual Patient Follow-Up Specialist to support a growing personal injury medical practice.

The immediate priority for this role is addressing a significant backlog of patient follow-up calls. You will conduct outbound outreach, document patient recovery progress, support attorney and legal documentation requests, and help ensure that tasks are completed accurately and on time.

The ideal candidate combines strong medical assistant experience with excellent communication, persistence, accuracy, and the ability to handle sensitive patient and legal information with a very high level of attention to detail.

Key Responsibilities

Patient Follow-Up & Outreach

  • Contact patients approximately 4 to 6 weeks after their visit to check on their recovery and current condition.

  • Conduct consistent outbound outreach through calls, texts, or other approved channels while remaining professional and respectful.

  • Follow up persistently when patients are difficult to reach without becoming overly aggressive or pushy.

Symptom Tracking & Documentation

  • Complete structured follow-up questionnaires regarding symptoms such as headaches, dizziness, and other reported concerns.

  • Record patient responses accurately in the practice's dedicated symptom tracking database.

  • Maintain complete and organized documentation so the physician can easily review patient recovery progress.

Legal Records & Billing Requests

  • Respond to requests from attorneys and law firms for patient evaluations, medical records, and billing documentation.

  • Compile the correct records and ensure all requested information is complete before sending or uploading it.

  • Handle legal and medical documentation with extremely high accuracy because errors can directly affect personal injury cases.

Portal & Task Management

  • Upload completed evaluations, records, bills, and other requested documentation into designated attorney or client portals.

  • Track outstanding requests and completed tasks so documentation does not fall through the cracks.

  • Maintain organized records across the clinic's internal systems and external portals.

Reporting & Operational Reliability

  • Provide End-of-Day reports summarizing completed calls, outreach attempts, pending follow-ups, and finished tasks.

  • Maintain consistent follow-through on assigned responsibilities and communicate quickly when an issue could affect completion.

  • Prioritize accuracy and reliability, particularly when handling patient records, legal requests, and time-sensitive documentation.

Cross-Training & Practice Support

  • Learn the Scheduling & Intake Specialist's core workflows, including scheduling, patient intake, and patient communication.

  • Provide backup coverage when the other VMA is unavailable or when patient volume increases.

  • Assist with incoming calls, emails, patient questions, or administrative work when additional practice support is required.

Required Qualifications

  • Fully fluent in English and Spanish.

  • Previous experience as a Medical Assistant, Medical Receptionist, Virtual Medical Assistant, or similar healthcare support professional.

  • Strong understanding of medical terminology and patient communication.

  • Exceptional attention to detail when entering records or managing documentation.

  • Strong telephone communication skills with a warm, conversational, and patient-centered approach.

  • Comfortable performing frequent outbound patient calls and follow-ups.

  • Highly organized and capable of independently tracking multiple open tasks.

  • Able to work consistently during Mountain Time business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience working with personal injury practices.

  • Experience communicating with attorneys or law firms.

  • Experience fulfilling medical records or billing documentation requests.

  • Familiarity with legal, clinic, or attorney portals.

Tools & Systems

  • Internal Clinic Symptom Database for documenting standardized patient follow-up responses and recovery symptoms.

  • External Law Firm/Clinic Portals for uploading completed evaluations, medical records, bills, and other requested documentation.

  • GoLean Productivity Tool and GoLean Private Network for productivity monitoring and secure access to practice systems and patient information.

What Success Looks Like

  • The existing patient follow-up backlog is steadily cleared, with patients contacted approximately 4 to 6 weeks after their visit and their recovery information documented accurately.

  • Attorney and law firm requests for evaluations, medical records, and billing documentation are completed accurately and on time, with the practice expecting effectively zero preventable errors.

  • Follow-ups, portal uploads, records requests, and outstanding tasks are consistently tracked through completion, with clear End-of-Day reporting and reliable backup coverage for scheduling and intake when needed.

jobs.excerpt: Who we areAbout StripeStripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses.
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Abuse Research Group (ARG) handles proactive threat hunting and adversary behavior analysis across Stripe products. Rather than reacting to alerts, the team maps end-to-end fraud and abuse paths, validates novel attack vectors, and identifies product conditions that enable fraud. Using agentic automated testing and simulation tools, ARG translates research into actionable threat advisories, strategic control recommendations, and regression scenarios to systematically eliminate vulnerabilities.

What you’ll do

As an Abuse Research Engineer in the Abuse Research Group, you will play a critical role in safeguarding Stripe’s financial ecosystem by proactively hunting for advanced threats, dissecting complex fraud vectors, and extracting actionable adversary intelligence. Rather than relying solely on reactive alerts, you will develop and execute hypothesis-driven threat hunting operations across internal telemetry and external sources to uncover fraudulent tools, tactics, and techniques (TTPs) before they impact Stripe’s platform. Central to this work is FT3 (Fraud Taxonomy 3.0), Stripe’s multi-layered taxonomy that decomposes monolithic fraud into structured kill chains. Collaborating cross-functionally with Fraud Ops, Strategy, Risk, Onboarding, and Security, you will integrate threat intelligence, build agentic simulation workflows, and systematically eliminate product vulnerabilities.

Responsibilities

  • Proactive Threat Hunting & Kill Chain Analysis: Formulate hypotheses and conduct iterative threat hunting operations across Stripe systems and external data.
  • FT3 Taxonomy: Apply and enrich the FT3 framework across empirical datasets and incidents, standardizing threat intelligence across kill chain phases and targeted API endpoints.
  • Threat Intelligence & Signal Expansion: Partner with teams like Fraud Intelligence to integrate, curate, and automate threat feeds into engineering workflows.
  • Cross-Functional Advisories & Strategic Controls: Translate raw research and retrospective findings into actionable threat advisories and control recommendations (policy, technical systems, support workflows, and detection mechanisms) for stakeholders across Fraud, Risk, Onboarding, and Security.
  • Agentic Testing & Adversary Simulation: Utilize agentic automated testing frameworks to simulate adversary TTPs, validate whether deployed controls interrupt empirical kill chains, and generate regression scenarios to exercise controls.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of experience conducting threat intelligence, threat hunting, or technical incident response within cyber security, product abuse, or trust domains.
  • 5+ years of experience analyzing large, complex datasets using data analytics tools to identify anomalies, map behavioral trends, and solve complex fraud problems.
  • B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Expert proficiency in Python and SQL, with demonstrated experience using code and scripting to automate workflows, build investigative tools, or query big data pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience in log analysis (e.g., application logs, API route telemetry, network security events), digital forensics, and cyber investigation methodologies.
  • Strong communication skills with a proven ability to translate complex technical research into clear, actionable recommendations and advisories for cross-functional partners.

Preferred qualifications

  • Deep technical understanding of threat actor motivations, infrastructure, and TTPs specific to financial fraud (e.g., ATO, Card Testing, Credential Stuffing).
  • Familiarity with standardized taxonomies such as FT3 or MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Proficiency with engineering, data processing, and analysis platforms such as Databricks, Trino, PySpark, Pandas, or Scikit-Learn.
  • Proven background utilizing Threat Intelligence Platforms (TIPs), tactical threat feeds, OSINT, and breach intelligence.
  • Demonstrated capability building or leveraging agentic LLM tools, automated testing systems, or control validation frameworks to model adversary behavior at scale.

The opportunity

Our Client is looking for a Social Media & Content Specialist to own its social media presence and content workflow, freeing up the small operations team to focus on field work. Our Client is a humanitarian nonprofit founded in 2015, delivering food, water, housing, medical support, and family relief across Palestine, Gaza, and Africa. It runs on transparency and word-of-mouth, with roughly 97% of donations going directly to programs. The operations team is currently focused on scaling outreach and fundraising visibility while maintaining consistency in how the mission is communicated online.

  • Build simple SOPs so content production stays consistent even when offline.

What you bring

  • Demonstrated ability in short-form video editing (reels, stories) and clean graphic design in Canva, shown through portfolio or work samples.

  • Comfortable working independently from a remote, async setup with reliable internet connection.

  • Based in the Middle East with some overlap with the Central Time Zone (Chicago).

  • Genuine alignment with humanitarian work in Palestine and Gaza.

  • Strong written communication in English.

Helpful, but not essential

  • Experience in nonprofit or faith-community communications.

  • Familiarity with TikTok or emerging short-form platforms.

  • Prior experience managing multiple fundraising campaigns simultaneously.

How the engagement works

Contracting party: You will contract directly with Apricot, which will manage contracting, invoicing/payroll, payments, and administrative support) Day to day, you will work with the clients’ Projects operations team and report to the Ops Manager.

For a consultant/contractor engagement, your work will be based on the agreed scope and deliverables. If you contract through Apricot, planned check-ins are [month 1 and month 3 / other approved cadence] to see how the engagement is working and help address issues.

About Apricot

Apricot is a nonprofit sourcing firm connecting displaced and underserved professionals from Palestine and the wider MENA region with global employment opportunities. We combine a clear social-impact mission with fast, high-quality recruitment delivery for international clients.

jobs.excerpt: Who Are We?  At CMLS Financial, we strike a unique balance: the financial strength of a 50-year industry leader with the energy of a dynamic, fast-paced firm.
jobs.description:
Who Are We?

At CMLS Financial, we strike a unique balance: the financial strength of a 50-year industry leader with the energy of a dynamic, fast-paced firm.

  • Growth & Exposure: With over $45 billion in assets under administration, our "booming" business means you gain high-level exposure and real opportunities for career advancement.
  • Supportive Culture: We are professional yet enjoyable. We provide a challenging environment supported by a team that wants you to succeed.
  • National Reach: Work with Canada's most prominent banks, investment managers, and pension funds from a platform with offices coast to coast.

Work Location

We are specifically looking for a bilingual candidate (French/English) based in Quebec, Canada, with a preference for the Greater Montreal area. This is a remote role with approximately one in-office team day per month.

Why We Are Hiring

We're growing our mortgage underwriting team to meet the significant increase in application volume in Quebec.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Adjudicate with Precision & Insight: Review and analyze residential mortgage applications and supporting documentation (credit, income, assets, and appraisals). You will apply sound credit judgment within established authority limits to identify and mitigate risk while ensuring full adherence to regulatory and internal policies.
  • Take Ownership of the Pipeline: Manage your end-to-end file pipeline in a high-volume, high-performance environment. You are responsible for ensuring applications are completed within specific timeframes and that deals close on schedule without sacrificing quality.
  • Deliver Solutions & Support: Act as a proactive partner to our broker partners. You don't just provide decisions; you provide solutions. You'll identify missing information early and engage proactively to resolve complex issues, ensuring a frictionless journey for the client.
  • Maintain the "Done Right" Standard: Cultivate a culture of rigorous due diligence. You will maintain organized, airtight loan files where every document is verified and aligned with company policies and lending guidelines.
  • Drive Continuous Improvement: Beyond daily underwriting, you will identify process efficiencies and mentor team members, maintaining a "can-do" attitude that thrives in a fast-paced, evolving lending landscape.

What You Bring

  • Minimum 3–5 years of experience in residential mortgage underwriting.
  • You don't take files at face value. You are the type of underwriter who digs into the details, asks clarifying questions, and looks for the "how" rather than just settling for a "no."
  • You thrive in a high-volume environment. You are organized, self-driven, and take pride in managing your pipeline efficiently without sacrificing quality.
  • You operate as part of a team. You are comfortable mentoring others and working across departments to move files forward.
  • You have a genuine interest in helping transform the mortgage customer journey.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience as an underwriter working in a credit union, monoline, or similar institutional environment.
  • Experience in prime/A-lending is central to this role; however, a diverse background in alternative/B-lending or commercial lending is an asset.
  • Bilingualism in English and French.

Interview Process

  • Recruiter Screen (30 min): An intro call to learn about your background and give you a real picture of the role.
  • Take-Home Assignment / Case Study: A chance to showcase your skills through a practical exercise relevant to the role.
  • Final Interview (60 min): You'll meet with the recruiter and the hiring manager for a final interview before a decision is made.
  • Offer Stage: Pending successful background, criminal, and reference checks, you'll receive a formal offer to join the team.

Supporting Your Life at CMLS

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Top-tier extended health, dental, and vision coverage, featuring 100% drug coverage.
  • Health & Wellness Spending Account: A $1,500 combined annual flex fund for things like gym memberships or extra medical needs.
  • Generous Paid Time Off: 4 weeks of vacation plus 8 personal floater days.
  • Retirement Savings: Access to a group RRSP/DPSP plan featuring competitive company-matching contributions.
  • Telemedicine Services: Access via Dialogue and coverage for licensed practitioner services.
  • Family Support: Robust Maternity and Parental Leave Top-Up programs.

Equal Opportunity Employer

CMLS Financial is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, including Indigenous peoples (First Nations, Inuit, and Métis), persons with disabilities, women, and members of visible minorities and LGBTQ2+ communities.

Disability-related accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Ready to Join Us?

We value your interest in CMLS Financial. We review applications immediately and will continue until the position is filled. While we thank all applicants for their time, please note that we will only contact those selected for an interview.

jobs.title: Business Operations Specialist (Operations & Supply Chain)
jobs.excerpt: Real opportunities.  Real impact.  Your career, redefined.
jobs.description:
Real opportunities. Real impact. Your career, redefined.

(NOTE: A human reviews every application at Oceans, so please apply for only one position and only once a year—if you're a better fit for another role, we’ll route your application accordingly and if we’re not quite ready for you, we’ll reach back out later.)

At Oceans, we help the best and brightest of Sri Lanka to take advantage of opportunities that otherwise wouldn’t be available to them, while supporting entrepreneurs around the world. Our community (we call them Divers) don’t do surface work—they go deep to solve complex challenges and make a real impact. And in doing so, they support bold ideas, expand their skills, broaden their expertise, and grow their careers, all without having to leave family and friends.

As a Business Operations Specialist, you will play a critical role in supporting an early-stage food and beverage startup as it prepares to scale its retail distribution. You'll work closely with the founders to coordinate the company's supply chain operations across procurement, manufacturing, logistics, inventory, and fulfillment, ensuring products move efficiently from suppliers through to customers.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong operational ownership with excellent organization, communication, and problem-solving skills. Rather than functioning as a traditional operations coordinator, you'll act as the hands-on operational owner for day-to-day supply chain execution—bringing structure to procurement, purchase orders, production schedules, inventory planning, and logistics while building scalable processes in an environment where the operational backbone is still being established.

Accountability

Your success as a Business Operations Specialist will be defined by your ability to keep supply chain operations running reliably, maintain inventory availability, and take ownership of the operational details that allow the founders to focus on growing the business.

Here's how you'll make an impact:

Supply Chain Operations

  • Coordinate ingredient procurement and manufacturing schedules to ensure production stays on track.
  • Manage purchase orders, supplier timelines, and procurement requirements.
  • Track production milestones from raw ingredients through finished goods.
  • Coordinate freight movements, shipment schedules, and delivery timelines.
  • Work closely with co-manufacturers and external vendors to ensure products are produced and delivered on time.

Inventory & Fulfillment

  • Monitor inventory levels across manufacturing, warehouse, and fulfillment locations.
  • Support demand planning and inventory replenishment to maintain product availability.
  • Coordinate with 3PL partners to ensure timely and accurate order fulfillment.
  • Maintain accurate inventory records and operational documentation.
  • Identify potential inventory shortages, delays, or fulfillment issues and escalate them proactively.

Operational Process Management

  • Build and document operational workflows as the company scales.
  • Identify process bottlenecks and recommend practical improvements.
  • Maintain and improve SOPs, supply chain documentation, and operational records.
  • Establish reliable processes for procurement, production, inventory, and logistics coordination.
  • Ensure critical operational deadlines are consistently met across suppliers and logistics partners.

Vendor & Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as the primary operational contact for manufacturers, suppliers, freight providers, warehouses, and logistics partners.
  • Coordinate across multiple external stakeholders to keep production and fulfillment moving efficiently.
  • Maintain clear and timely communication around orders, timelines, requirements, and changes.
  • Track outstanding actions and follow up to ensure commitments are met.
  • Identify and escalate operational risks early while keeping founders informed of issues and potential solutions.

AI & Operational Efficiency

  • Utilize AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude to streamline operational workflows.
  • Leverage AI for documentation, planning, communication, research, and operational analysis.
  • Identify repetitive operational tasks that can be automated or improved through AI.
  • Continuously experiment with tools and workflows that improve operational efficiency and execution quality.

Colleagues

You'll work closely with the founders, manufacturers, ingredient suppliers, freight providers, warehouses, and 3PL partners, acting as the operational owner responsible for keeping supply chain activities coordinated and ensuring products move efficiently from procurement through fulfillment.

At Oceans Talent, you'll also receive guidance and support from your Operations Manager, who will help you succeed in the role and ensure that you're continuously growing and developing in your career.

Skills and Qualifications

At Oceans Talent, we believe in T-shaped individuals—those who bring deep expertise in one area paired with broad curiosity across the business. As a Business Operations Specialist, your vertical focus will be on supply chain operations, procurement, inventory, and logistics execution, while your horizontal focus will include process improvement, analytics, stakeholder management, and AI-powered operational efficiency.

To excel in this role, you should have:

  • Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience in supply chain, procurement, operations, logistics, or related roles involving physical products, ideally within CPG, Food & Beverage, retail, or other inventory-based industries.
  • Supply Chain Operations: Strong practical understanding of procurement, purchase orders, manufacturing coordination, freight, logistics, and 3PL operations.
  • Inventory Management: Experience monitoring inventory, coordinating replenishment, maintaining accurate records, and supporting demand planning or forecasting.
  • Vendor Management: Proven ability to independently coordinate manufacturers, suppliers, freight providers, warehouses, and other external partners.
  • Process Improvement: Ability to build, document, and improve operational workflows and SOPs in environments where processes are still being developed.
  • Ownership & Autonomy: Strong sense of ownership with the ability to manage multiple operational priorities, follow through on commitments, and identify issues without waiting for direction.
  • AI Fluency: Strong familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar platforms, with the ability to integrate AI into daily operational workflows.
  • Communication: Excellent written English and strong communication skills, with the ability to coordinate clearly and professionally with founders and external stakeholders.
  • Industry Experience: Experience in Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), Food & Beverage, manufacturing, retail operations, or another physical-product environment is strongly preferred.

During the interview process, you'll have the opportunity to showcase your skills in the following areas:

  • Supply Chain & Procurement: How you manage purchasing, supplier coordination, production timelines, and physical product movement.
  • Inventory & Fulfillment: How you monitor inventory, support replenishment, and coordinate fulfillment across warehouses and 3PL partners.
  • Operational Problem Solving: How you identify bottlenecks, respond to operational issues, and implement practical solutions.
  • Vendor & Stakeholder Management: How you coordinate multiple external partners, communicate proactively, and maintain accountability.
  • Process Improvement & Organization: How you build structure, document workflows, and manage competing operational priorities.
  • AI-Enabled Operations & Ownership: How you use AI to improve operational efficiency and independently drive work forward in an ambiguous environment.

Diversity of experience is core to Oceans. You are expected to work inclusively with individuals from a variety of backgrounds, ensuring that both personal and collective dignity are supported.

Role Specifications

This is a remote role where you'll be expected to work with meaningful overlap with our client's working hours. You will also be expected to be present for in-person training programs during your first 3.5 weeks with us.

During the offer process, we'll share more information about our benefits and compensation philosophy, considering both market trends and individual factors.

About Oceans

At Oceans Talent, we connect the world’s top talent with visionary companies building what’s next. Here, you’re not just stepping into another role — you’re joining a team that values individuality, ambition, and growth without limits. Unique, like you.

We’re always excited to share more about our journey, where we’re headed, and how you can grow with us throughout the interview process.

The Medical Coding Auditor is responsible for keeping Sutherland coders in compliance by reviewing medical records and coding practices to ensure accurate assignment of ICD-10-CM, CPT, and HCPCS Level II codes in compliance with federal, state, payer, and organizational guidelines. This role evaluates coding accuracy, identifies documentation deficiencies, conducts audits, provides education to coding staff and providers, and supports revenue cycle integrity while minimizing compliance risk.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Perform retrospective, concurrent, and prospective coding audits for inpatient, outpatient, physician, and/or specialty services.
  • Review medical documentation to validate the accuracy and completeness of assigned diagnosis and procedure codes.
  • Ensure compliance with ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, CPT, HCPCS Level II, Medicare, Medicaid, commercial payer, and regulatory guidelines.
  • Identify coding errors, documentation gaps, and reimbursement opportunities.
  • Prepare detailed audit reports outlining findings, trends, recommendations, and corrective actions.
  • Provide one-on-one and group education to coders, providers, and clinical staff regarding coding updates, documentation improvement, and compliance requirements.
  • Monitor coding quality metrics and develop action plans to improve coding accuracy and consistency.
  • Stay current on coding regulations, Official Coding Guidelines, CMS regulations, payer policies, and industry best practices.
  • Assist with internal and external audits, payer reviews, and regulatory investigations.
  • Maintain confidentiality of protected health information (PHI) in accordance with HIPAA regulations.
  • Participate in policy development, process improvement initiatives, and coding education programs.
  • Track audit results and identify recurring trends to support continuous quality improvement.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 3-5 years of medical coding experience in a healthcare setting.
  • Minimum of 2 years of coding audit or quality review experience preferred.
  • Current coding certification such as:
  • Certified Professional Coder (CPC)
  • Certified Professional Medical Auditor (CPMA)
  • Certified Coding Specialist (CCS)
  • Certified Inpatient Coder (CIC)
  • Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT) or
  • Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA) preferred
  • Extensive knowledge of ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, CPT, and HCPCS coding systems.
  • Strong understanding of CMS regulations, National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI), Official Coding Guidelines, and payer-specific policies.
  • Experience with electronic health records (EHR) and encoder software.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Exceptional analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • Strong knowledge of healthcare reimbursement methodologies.
  • Ability to interpret complex clinical documentation.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational abilities.
  • Ability to maintain objectivity while providing constructive feedback.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and coding/audit software.

jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Senior Full Stack Engineer builds and evolves the NBA platform's Action Library and Command Center experience, the operational system used by business and program teams to create, configure, govern, and publish member actions across the enterprise. Built on React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and Kafka-based integration patterns, the platform serves as the primary control plane for authoring and managing actions throughout the member journey. This is a hands-on engineering role with a strong front-end focus: you design and build modern user experiences, develop the APIs and services that support them, and partner closely with product, design, and platform teams to deliver scalable, production-ready solutions.

Key Responsibilities

• Front-end engineering — Design and build responsive, accessible, and performant user interfaces using React and TypeScript.

• Full stack development — Deliver features across the stack, including React applications, Node.js/Fastify services, PostgreSQL data models, and platform integrations.

• Action Library development — Build capabilities that allow business users to create, configure, version, preview, govern, and publish member actions.

• API engineering — Develop and maintain REST APIs using contract-first principles, shared TypeScript models, and schema validation patterns.

• Data modeling — Design and implement PostgreSQL schemas, queries, and data access patterns that support reliable and performant user experiences.

• Workflow integration — Develop integrations with orchestration, decisioning, and Kafka-based publishing services to ensure actions flow reliably through the NBA ecosystem.

• User experience design — Translate complex business workflows into intuitive experiences that improve efficiency, usability, and adoption.

• Quality engineering — Build automated tests, participate in code reviews, and deliver secure, maintainable, production-quality software.

• Cross-team collaboration — Work closely with engineering, product, and platform teams to align requirements, integrations, and technical solutions.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

•5+ years of full stack software engineering experience with strong React and TypeScript expertise.

•Experience building production-grade web applications using modern React architecture and component-based design patterns.

•Strong Node.js/TypeScript backend development experience building REST APIs and service-oriented applications.

•Experience working with PostgreSQL or other relational databases, including schema design, query optimization, and data modeling.

•Understanding of modern front-end architecture including state management, routing, accessibility, performance optimization, and responsive design.

•Experience with API contracts, schema validation, and strongly typed development practices.

•Familiarity with containerized application deployment, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native application development.

•Strong testing discipline, including unit, integration, and end-to-end testing approaches.

•Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering and product teams.

Preferred Qualifications

•Experience with React 19, TanStack Router, Query, Form, and Table.

•Experience with Fastify, Prisma, Drizzle ORM, Redis, and PostgreSQL performance tuning.

•Familiarity with OpenAPI specifications, code generation, and contract-first API development.

•Experience with Kafka and event-driven architectures.

•Experience building workflow-driven applications, operational consoles, or enterprise business tooling.

•Familiarity with Kubernetes, Azure DevOps, ArgoCD, and modern deployment pipelines.

•Experience with OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, and observability platforms.

•Experience implementing OAuth 2.0, Azure AD, SSO, RBAC, or enterprise identity solutions.

•Background in healthcare, insurance, or another regulated industry with compliance and PHI handling requirements.

Success Indicators

  • State transitions are precise, deterministic, and resilient to retries

  • Side effects reliably occur exactly once, even during failures or replays

  • Systems recover gracefully from crashes and redeployments

  • AI-driven tooling decreases defect rates and expedites debugging

jobs.excerpt: Come Make an Impact on Millions of Brazilians! At RecargaPay, we’re on a mission to deliver the best payment experience for Brazilian consumers and small businesses, by building a powerful digital ecosystem where the banked and unbanked connect, and where consumers and merchants have a one-stop shop for all their financial needs.
jobs.description:
Come Make an Impact on Millions of Brazilians!

At RecargaPay, we’re on a mission to deliver the best payment experience for Brazilian consumers and small businesses, by building a powerful digital ecosystem where the banked and unbanked connect, and where consumers and merchants have a one-stop shop for all their financial needs.

We serve over 10 million users and process more than USD 4 billion annually. We’ve been profitable since 2022 and operate our own credit business. We are an AI-first, 100% remote team, scaling in the rapidly changing Brazilian financial market.

Our goal? Deliver the best payment experience in Brazil for people and small businesses alike.

We value autonomy, ownership, and a bias for action. We’re looking for people who are curious, hands-on, and driven by impact, who want to solve real problems, work with strong teams, and rethink what’s possible.

If you’re ready to do your best work, at scale, with purpose, this is your place.


Responsibilities

As SAP & Corporate Systems Tech Lead, you will be the founding hands-on technical leader for RecargaPay’s SAP and Corporate Systems capability. You will be responsible for the stability, evolution, integration, and technical governance of our SAP S/4HANA platform and the surrounding ecosystem of corporate applications across Finance, HR, Legal, Audit, Compliance, and Procurement.

This is a founding role. You will help build RecargaPay’s internal SAP and Corporate Systems technical capability from the ground up, reducing dependency on external partners, creating governance standards, and establishing the operating model required to support a regulated, fast-growing fintech.

You will work in close partnership with the squad's Product Owner, who owns product direction, business stakeholder management, vendor relationships, and RFI/RFP processes. Your role is to lead the technical execution of the roadmap, establish engineering and governance standards for SAP and Corporate Systems, and ensure that every change is observable, auditable, secure, and aligned with applicable regulatory frameworks such as BACEN, LGPD, Brazilian fiscal requirements, and SOX where applicable.

This is a deeply hands-on role. You are expected to stay close to the system and the team: reviewing and validating configurations, leading version upgrades and module updates, applying SAP Notes related to fiscal, legal, and regulatory changes, debugging production incidents, tuning HANA performance, governing transports, and pairing with Basis engineers, Functional Specialists, implementation partners, and internal engineering teams when needed.

Your leadership is exercised through proximity to the team: leading by example, reviewing configurations and changes, and acting as Tier 3 escalation for the most complex incidents. You are the primary technical reference of the squad and the main technical interface with Engineering, Security, Infrastructure, internal Specialists, and external implementation partners.

Champion a “clean-core / SAP-Minimalist” strategy, ensuring that S/4HANA remains as standard and maintainable as possible by prioritizing API-first integrations, avoiding unnecessary customizations, and moving non-core or highly variable business logic to external automation and orchestration layers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the hands-on technical execution of the squad's roadmap in partnership with the Product Owner, ensuring delivery quality, operational continuity, compliance and regulatory alignment, and sustainable technical decisions across SAP and the broader Corporate Systems landscape.
  • Own the technical governance and evolution of the SAP S/4HANA landscape end to end, taking action as required, including custom code strategy, development standards, release upgrades and their custom code adaptation, SAP Notes lifecycle, environment strategy, and coordination with the Basis Specialist and external partners for platform activities.
  • Lead, hands-on, the design, development, and review of ABAP solutions on S/4HANA, including enhancements (BAdIs, enhancement spots), CDS views, AMDP, RAP-based services, OData services for Fiori, forms, background jobs, and interfaces, setting the quality bar through ATC, ABAP Unit, code review, and performance analysis.
  • Own the technical architecture of the Corporate Systems ecosystem beyond SAP, including HRIS, Legal Tech, GRC, Procurement, Finance, Compliance, and workflow / automation platforms, ensuring a cohesive, secure, and auditable stack, while the Product Owner leads vendor selection, RFI/RFP, and contract governance.
  • Define and implement the SAP and Corporate Systems operating model, including demand intake, prioritization criteria, ownership boundaries, support model, escalation paths, governance forums, change and release management, development and documentation standards, and lifecycle management.
  • Define operational health indicators for SAP and Corporate Systems, including availability, job failures, interface errors, transport and code quality, incident recurrence, audit findings, SLA adherence, and business-impacting failures.
  • Define integration patterns between SAP and the broader corporate ecosystem, prioritizing API-first, event-driven where applicable, secure, auditable, and loosely coupled architectures, and owning the technical design of integrations across SAP, SaaS platforms, internal services, and automation layers.
  • Lead, hands-on, the adaptation of the SAP platform to fiscal, legal, and regulatory updates impacting Brazil and LATAM, including SAP Notes implementation with code adjustments, custom code impact analysis, localization extensions, master data impacts, and coordination with the Functional Specialist for the modules currently in scope.
  • Govern the technical side of change management across SAP and Corporate Systems, including STMS and ChaRM (Solution Manager 7.2 or SAP Cloud ALM) for SAP, and version control, code review, and deployment practices for non-SAP assets, ensuring safe and traceable changes across environments.
  • Oversee, together with the Basis Specialist and partners, the SAP platform operational practices that affect application reliability, including transport landscape health, background job strategy, interface monitoring, and upgrade readiness, ensuring that internal teams and partners follow reliable and auditable standards.
  • Define and enforce security baselines for SAP and Corporate Systems in partnership with Security and GRC, including secure coding practices, authorization design in custom objects, user lifecycle, SoD principles, SSO, audit logs, API security, and secrets management aligned with LGPD, BACEN, and SOX where applicable.
  • Establish master data governance practices for critical SAP and corporate objects such as Business Partner, chart of accounts, cost centers, legal entities, vendors, employees, tax data, approval hierarchies, and authorization-relevant attributes, including their consistency across SAP and non-SAP systems.
  • Champion the "SAP-Minimalist" and clean-core strategy, keeping the S/4HANA core clean by favoring released APIs and extensibility over modifications, prioritizing API exposure, and shifting non-core business logic to external automation or orchestration layers built with sound software engineering practices.
  • Run technical rituals for the squad: design sessions, code and architecture reviews, change advisory boards, post-mortems, patch planning, and tech debt grooming.
  • Act as the internal technical authority for SAP and Corporate Systems, reviewing solution designs, estimates, code, configurations, transports, integrations, security impacts, documentation, and production readiness for work delivered by internal teams or external implementation partners.
  • Lead troubleshooting and root-cause analysis of complex production incidents across SAP and corporate platforms, serving as Tier 3 escalation, debugging SAP standard and custom code where needed, and ensuring durable corrective actions.

Senior Data Architect

We are seeking a Senior Data Architect to support the Justice Information Management System (JIMS) 3.0, a comprehensive data integration and modernization initiative. This role will focus on designing and implementing an Enterprise Data Warehouse to consolidate multiple disjointed reporting data marts containing court data. The ideal candidate will be responsible for reviewing existing data architectures, performing detailed data profiling, creating design and mapping specifications, and developing Extract Transform Load (ETL) processes. The successful candidate will contribute to evolving the availability, governance, and reporting of court data by implementing a more efficient, user-friendly, and cost-effective reporting architecture that supports strategic, operational, and ad hoc reporting needs.

The Senior Data Architect will facilitate the effective definition and management of data architecture principles, strategies, and standards while identifying and documenting enterprise data requirements. Key responsibilities include developing and leading transition plans to guide current data to its ideal future state, establishing and participating in design reviews and architectural reviews, and providing information, advice, and consultancy to initiatives and projects aligning to the data architecture. The role will also involve developing Power BI reports for testing, performing quality assurance testing of Dimensions and Facts, updating data models for new attributes, staging required data, and providing feedback and lessons learned at project closeout. The candidate will work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to promote data models and practices that reduce redundancy and improve data quality across the organization.

Qualifications
- 5 years - Demonstrated experience defining data architecture and using Kimball architecture to develop data marts
- 2 years - Experience working in or with public-sector environments with awareness of public-sector constraints and privacy legislation such as FOIP
- Completed training with structured Query Languages specific to Microsoft T-SQL and/or Oracle and/or PL/SQL, and database development
- Obtained training within the past 5-10 years relating to Cloud Computing and Microsoft Azure and Azure Architecture
- Post-secondary degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or related field (equivalent experience may be considered; formal education strongly preferred)

- 5 years - Experience developing using software such as SAP/Sybase's PowerDesigner, or ERWin, or Oracle Designer, or SQL Developer Data Modeler, or Microsoft Visio

Our customers rely on Cargobase as a system embedded in their day-to-day operations.

Cargobase is entering its next phase of growth, scaling its product ecosystem, modernizing platform architecture, and expanding its global customer base. As customer complexity and commercial ambition increase, execution quality and customer outcomes become business-critical.

Role Overview

The Senior Customer Excellence Manager owns the full post-sales customer lifecycle, with accountability for onboarding, implementation, platform support, ongoing success, and commercial expansion within existing accounts. This role leads a global team of generalist Customer Excellence Consultants and is responsible not only for delivery quality and customer outcomes, but also for retention, expansion readiness, and revenue protection post-sale.

The role operates at the intersection of delivery, customer value realization, and commercial outcomes, ensuring customers adopt broadly, expand intentionally, and remain long-term strategic accounts.

  • Define clear expectations for consultants across delivery excellence, customer ownership, and commercial awareness.
  • Build career paths, conduct performance reviews, and promote a culture of accountability and collaboration.

  • Define and maintain implementation frameworks, playbooks, timelines, and quality standards.
  • Coordinate cross-functional collaboration with Product, Engineering, and Sales to address blockers, ensure customer readiness, and meet go-live commitments.

  • Establish team workflows to deliver timely support responses, effective issue resolution, and proactive account engagement.

Commercial Expansion & Revenue Impact

  • Partner with Sales to support account expansion, renewals, and commercial growth within existing customers.

jobs.title: Senior Editor/Designer – Performance Creative & AI
jobs.excerpt: ★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★Senior Editor/Designer – Performance Creative & AIWork Arrangement: This is a fully remote (telecommute) position.
jobs.description:
★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★

Senior Editor/Designer – Performance Creative & AI

Work Arrangement: This is a fully remote (telecommute) position.
Employment Type: Full-Time
Department: Creative Post-Production
Reports To: Art Director
Industry: Digital Marketing / Performance Creative
Experience: 5–7+ Years
Portfolio: Required

About the Role

We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Editor/Designer who combines video editing, motion design, static design, and hands-on AI-generated content (AIGC) expertise.

You'll create high-performing paid social and digital creative across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Shorts, and Google, working with traditional footage, UGC, client assets, and AI-generated content.

AI is a core part of this role. We're specifically looking for someone who has already produced and shipped AI-generated creative for real clients or brands, not someone who is simply interested in experimenting with AI.

You'll generate AI visuals and video, build AI-assisted UGC, work with synthetic voice and talent, extend traditional footage with generative tools, and help establish repeatable AI creative workflows and quality standards.

This is a senior hands-on production role for someone who understands both creative craft and performance.

What You'll Do

AI Visuals & AIGC Production

  • Generate and art-direct AI visuals for paid creative, including product scenes, environments, characters, backgrounds, B-roll, hero images, and generative video.

  • Prompt, iterate, and direct across image and video generation models to achieve specific creative briefs.

  • Work with tools such as Gemini/Nano Banana, Sora, Veo 3, Midjourney, Flux, Runway, Kling, Arcads, ElevenLabs, and similar emerging platforms.

  • Build AI-assisted UGC and spokesperson creative, evaluating when synthetic talent is appropriate versus real creator footage.

  • Combine generative and traditional workflows using techniques such as generative fill, extension, upscaling, restoration, relighting, lip-sync, dubbing, AI voiceover, and automated captioning.

  • Maintain character, product, style, and brand consistency across AI-generated campaigns.

  • Identify artifacts, anatomy or text errors, unnatural motion, and off-brand outputs before assets reach clients.

  • Build prompt libraries, templates, and repeatable AI workflows while evaluating new creative tools as they emerge.

Video Editing & Motion Design

  • Edit performance creative for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Shorts, and Google.

  • Work with client-provided footage, UGC, produced assets, libraries, and AI-generated content.

  • Execute complete post-production workflows including cutting, pacing, sound design, music selection, basic color, captions, resizing, formatting, and export.

  • Build performance-focused edits with strong attention to hooks, pacing, safe areas, messaging, and platform requirements.

  • Create motion graphics, animated typography, transitions, product callouts, end cards, GIFs, and other graphic systems.

  • Transform static concepts into dynamic animated executions.

Static Design & Visual Craft

  • Design high-quality paid ads, social graphics, and digital placements.

  • Apply strong layout, typography, composition, hierarchy, and visual storytelling.

  • Adapt creative across different formats, placements, and aspect ratios.

  • Execute both polished brand creative and faster performance-driven content depending on campaign needs.

Creative Execution & Optimization

  • Translate briefs, scripts, concepts, references, and Art Director guidance into compelling creative output.

  • Contribute ideas while executing against established creative strategy.

  • Produce multiple creative variations for A/B testing, optimization, and creative refreshes.

  • Apply campaign performance insights to hooks, pacing, layouts, structures, and visual treatments.

  • Incorporate feedback from creative leads, strategists, media teams, and clients.

  • Maintain accurate versioning across multiple campaigns and accounts.

Brand Quality & Creative Systems

  • Ensure creative follows client guidelines across color, typography, imagery, motion, voice, and AI-generated elements.

  • Maintain organized project files, footage, templates, AI generations, and exports.

  • Establish and maintain a high quality bar for AI-generated and hybrid creative.

  • Identify production bottlenecks and recommend better workflows, tools, or templates.

  • Support scalable creative systems and best practices across the team.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • 5–7+ years of experience in video editing, motion design, post-production, graphic design, or performance creative within an agency, brand, or performance marketing environment.

  • Meaningful professional experience across both video and static creative.

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience producing AI-generated visuals and AIGC for real client or brand work, supported by portfolio examples.

  • Working fluency with current image, video, and voice generation tools such as Gemini/Nano Banana, Sora, Veo 3, Midjourney, Flux, Runway, Kling, Arcads, ElevenLabs, or similar tools.

  • Strong AI prompting and iteration skills, including techniques for maintaining character, product, and visual consistency.

  • Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects.

  • Proficiency in Figma, Photoshop, and Illustrator.

  • Strong experience with paid social, digital advertising, UGC-style creative, and short-form video.

  • Strong understanding of layout, typography, visual hierarchy, and composition.

  • Understanding of platform-specific creative best practices across Meta, TikTok, and YouTube.

  • Ability to manage multiple clients, deadlines, and feedback rounds simultaneously.

  • Strong file organization and asset management skills.

  • Familiarity with A/B testing workflows and structured creative variations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in performance marketing or direct-response creative.

  • Experience with creator-led and lo-fi content alongside polished brand creative.

  • Familiarity with synthetic media disclosure requirements and platform policies for AI-generated content.

  • Exposure to additional channels such as email, landing pages, or CTV.

Ideal Candidate

You're a genuinely hybrid creative: equally comfortable editing in Premiere and After Effects as you are designing in Photoshop and Figma.

You've already created real paid advertising with generative AI and can explain which tools you used, why you selected them, how you iterated, and how the final creative was produced.

You treat AI as a creative craft tool rather than a shortcut. You understand its limitations, recognize poor-quality output, and know how to combine AI with traditional production when necessary.

You also understand performance creative: hooks, pacing, platform-native execution, testing, iteration, and results matter as much as visual quality.

How Success Is Measured

Success in this role will be reflected in:

  • Consistently strong creative quality across video, motion, static, and AI-generated assets.

  • Effective production of AI-generated content that meets brand and campaign standards.

  • Creative that is optimized for the requirements of each advertising platform.

  • Efficient execution, iteration, and versioning across multiple campaigns.

  • Strong application of performance insights to future creative.

  • Organized, scalable AI and post-production workflows.

  • Reliable execution across multiple clients and deadlines.

Why Join Us?

  • Work at the intersection of performance creative, design, video, and generative AI.

  • Produce real AI-powered advertising rather than experimental or conceptual work.

  • Work across leading social and digital advertising platforms.

  • Help define AI creative workflows, quality standards, and best practices.

  • Experiment with emerging image, video, and voice generation technologies.

  • Have meaningful creative ownership while collaborating closely with Art Direction and performance teams.

Important Notes

  • A strong portfolio is required.

  • Your portfolio should demonstrate professional experience across video and static creative.

  • Candidates must be able to demonstrate real AIGC/AI-generated creative produced for client or brand work.

  • Candidates should be prepared to discuss their AI workflow, including prompting, iteration, tool selection, quality control, and final production.

  • This is a hands-on creative production role, not solely a creative strategy or management position.

This is a fully remote (telecommute) position.

Job Description

Position Overview

Invenergy is hiring a Project Engineer, Renewable Electrical Engineering (SCADA). This role is on the Invenergy Construction team and is a key driver of how our wind, solar, and battery storage projects come to life. You will lead the end-to-end delivery of supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) systems and associated communications infrastructure, partnering with diverse stakeholders to shape conceptual designs, translate them into detailed designs, and drive procurement, commissioning, acceptance testing, and turnover. Your work will integrate and secure the SCADA/OT/IT ecosystem, including RTUs, controllers, energy management systems, network switches, firewalls, annunciators, and HMIs, ensuring every project starts up safely, reliably, and ready to perform from day one.

Responsibilities

  • Lead safe, compliant commissioning and startup of SCADA and communications systems for wind, solar, and battery projects. Bring systems online, validate performance through acceptance testing, and deliver a clean turnover to Operations.

  • Build and secure the communications network that runs the plant: IP plans, protocols, physical network interfaces, and firewall rules across SCADA/OT/IT equipment.

  • Partner with major stakeholders (plant controller OEMs, transmission operators, generator owners/operators) to configure controls and data paths to meet operational and grid requirements.

  • Own the energization and commissioning execution plan, define scope, sequence, readiness gates, and risk mitigations while maintaining NERC and project requirements.

  • Monitor construction progress remotely and via on site visits, support resolution of field issues, attend in person meetings with stakeholders, and provide on-site programming and field support during commissioning when required.

  • Coordinate with cross functional teams to ensure SCADA deliverables align with overall project requirements and critical path schedules.

  • Track design schedules, communicate status and risks, and ensure critical dates are met on time.

  • Maintain system specifications and configurations for SCADA, power plant controllers, RTUs, and IT/OT equipment to improve reliable operation and maintenance.

  • Oversee delivery of clean, complete as-built turnover packages (schematics, bills of materials, configuration/programming settings) to Operations for long-term maintenance and reliability.

  • Support technical due diligence with independent engineers and project partners by providing accurate, technical input and evidence.

  • Stay current on technology and best practices through training, conferences, and continuous learning.

  • Take on additional responsibilities as assigned by leadership to support team priorities and business needs.

Minimum Qualifications

  • BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or related degree.

  • 4+ years of transmission, distribution, and/or generation SCADA systems experience.

  • Knowledge of both the physical and software aspects of networking equipment that connect generation assets.

  • Experience and familiarity with various industrial communication protocols and architectures such as OPC, DNP3, Modbus and EGD.

  • Experience working around HV/MV electrical infrastructure (substations/switchyards, distribution systems, transmission lines, transformers, relays, meters, CTs, and PTs).

  • Ability to coordinate and manage multiple concurrent projects.

  • Considerable knowledge in computer and server operation.

  • Strong project management skills.

  • Strong oral and written communication skills and strong interpersonal skills.

  • Eligible to work in the United States without the need for employer visa sponsorship now or in the future.

  • Up to 25% travel is required.

  • Must have a valid driver’s license and be legally authorized to operate a motor vehicle.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior installation, commissioning and site construction experience in renewable power generation.

  • Experience working on GE WindSCADA, GE WindCONTROL, Vestas Online Business, SEL RTAC, and/ or Ignition by Inductive Automation.

  • Advanced knowledge and programming of SCADA, HMI, PLC, and RTU platforms.

  • Working knowledge of NERC compliance for low impact cyber systems.

  • Proven ability to coordinate and align work across diverse stakeholders, including EPC contractors, engineering firms, OEMs, and customers, to support successful project execution.

jobs.description:
NOTE: THIS POSITION IS AVAILABLE FOR REMOTE WORK FOR INDIVIDUALS LIVING BEYOND A 30 MILE RADIUS OF A PHYSICAL NUSCALE OFFICE BUT WITHIN THE CONTIGUOUS UNITED STATES.

POSITION SUMMARY: The Thermal‑Hydraulics Engineer 3 is an experienced technical contributor within the Nuclear Methods group of the Nuclear Fuels organization. Reporting to the Manager, Nuclear Methods, the engineer works in close coordination with the Thermal Hydraulics, Nuclear Design, and Code Development groups, as well as partners across other Engineering disciplines, Licensing, and Operations. This position is an engineer with experience in nuclear thermal-hydraulic analyses, codes, and methods, as well as familiar with interfaces with core design, neutronics, and design basis event analysis. This role will apply industry best-practices and knowledge of state-of-the-art methods to support development, validation, and licensing of new methods in areas including thermal-hydraulics, coupled codes, and reload safety analysis. The role requires familiarity with PWR thermal‑hydraulic principles, design‑basis safety analysis, and interfaces with core design, fuel design, neutronics, and transient analysis.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Contribute to development and validation of next‑generation multi‑physics methods integrating subchannel TH, system TH, and neutronics.
  • Support method qualification efforts including benchmark selection, acceptance criteria definition, and comparison against experimental data or legacy reference analyses, with particular emphasis in areas of thermal-hydraulic expertise. Develop and review software QA documentation.
  • Prepare and verify subchannel analyses, including steady-state and transient margin evaluations and CHF predictions, in support of new method development.
  • Prepare and verify coupled TH evaluations, including LOCA, non‑LOCA transients, and design‑basis evaluations, in support of new method development using industry-standard and advanced simulation tools.
  • Work collaboratively within the Nuclear Fuels organization to ensure design and analysis interfaces are adequately managed, including with core design, fuel design, subchannel thermal-hydraulics, and transient analysis. Help develop workflows that improve consistency, automation, or integration across multi‑physics safety analyses.
  • Contribute to technical development of licensing technical or topical reports, license applications, and other licensing documentation, and participate in licensing interactions including interface with the government regulator in areas of technical responsibility.
  • Prepare and verify engineering reports, calculations, studies, system descriptions, requirement specifications, and other design documents with particular emphasis on subchannel and system thermal-hydraulics. Work on tasks in multiple and diverse areas.
  • Provide technical leadership within Thermal Hydraulics; mentor junior engineers and lead analysis tasks in areas of expertise.
  • Develop resolutions to complex problems that require the frequent use of creativity and innovation.
  • Perform other duties as assigned. Flexibly support changing organizational priorities, including urgent analysis needs, cross‑functional reviews, technical troubleshooting, or special studies.

  • Problem solving: Identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner, gathers and reviews information appropriately. Uses own judgment and acts independently; seeks input from other team members as appropriate for complex or sensitive situations.
  • Oral/written communication: Listens carefully and speaks clearly and professionally in all situations. Edits work for accuracy and clarity. Is able to create, read, and interpret complex written information. Ability to develop strong interpersonal networks within the organization.
  • Planning/organizing: Prioritizes and plans work activities, organizes personal and project timelines and deadlines, tracks project timelines and deadlines, and uses time efficiently.
  • Adaptability: Adapts to changes in the work environment, manages competing demands and is able to deal with frequent interruptions, changes, delays, or unexpected events.

  • Team Building: Capable of developing strong interpersonal networks and trust within the organization.
  • Safety Culture: Adheres to the NuScale Safety culture and is expected to model safe behavior and influence peers to meet high standards.
  • Quality Assurance: Commits to the understanding and implementation of quality assurance regulations, standards and guidelines of 10 CFR 50 Appendix B, 10 CFR 21, and NQA-1.

MINIMUM SKILLS, QUALIFICATIONS AND ABILITIES:

  • Education: A minimum of B.S. degree in Nuclear, Mechanical, or Chemical Engineering (or related discipline) from a four-year accredited college or university is required. An advanced degree in Nuclear, Mechanical, or Chemical Engineering is desirable.
  • Experience: A minimum of 5 years of full-time, directly relevant engineering experience is required. Experience in implementing engineering design processes for subchannel thermal-hydraulics, transient analysis, and related safety analysis is required. Experience in neutronics or fuel performance preferred.
  • Industry Requirements: Eligible to work under Department of Energy 10 CFR Part 810.
