jobs.title: Designer - Digitalist
jobs.excerpt: The main purpose of the Designer is to work on design-related tasks for Digitalist's assigned clients and projects, with the responsibility to create quality, effective, well-designed, and impactful visual work across websites, e-commerce stores, and paid and owned marketing channels that converts and drives sales for our clients.
jobs.description:
The main purpose of the Designer is to work on design-related tasks for Digitalist's assigned clients and projects, with the responsibility to create quality, effective, well-designed, and impactful visual work across websites, e-commerce stores, and paid and owned marketing channels that converts and drives sales for our clients.

As a Designer, you will work closely with Account Managers, developers, and specialists to conceptualize and design a variety of client deliverables. On the web side this means design concepts for WordPress and WooCommerce websites and online stores, landing pages, and conversion-focused UX and UI work that is clean to hand over to development. On the marketing side this means Facebook and Google ad creatives, email marketing designs, content marketing graphics, and social assets, all of which have to express the voice, style, look and feel, and overall design of the brand. This will involve having a deep understanding of clients' visual brand identities, communicating new ideas to the team (verbally and visually), implementing client feedback in your designs, and supporting the team throughout the design and editing process. You will need to be creative while working within the direction of your design briefs.

The Designer will report directly to the Design Lead and the Agency Director, and will also work closely with the development, marketing, and analytics sides of the team to ensure that all designs are created well and on time.

About the Role:

Mission statement:

The primary mission of our Designer is to maintain the high design standards of our company by playing an active role in the design and visual creation process across our range of clients and for our own marketing material.

As our Designer, this will include translating analysis and conversion goals into design concepts for client websites and online stores, designing performance creative and email campaigns that reflect each client's message, brand, and style, coming up with innovative design ideas, and ensuring that your work is of the highest standard and delivered on time. Our web process always starts with the goal of higher conversion and sales, so you will be designing to a commercial outcome rather than to a mood board.

General Responsibilities:

  • Creating design concepts for client websites and e-commerce stores (primarily WordPress and WooCommerce), including page templates, product and category pages, checkout flows, and landing pages, using professional design tools (including Figma)
  • Preparing clean, well-structured, developer-ready files and handovers, including responsive states, components, spacing, and typography rules, and staying available to the developers through implementation
  • Creating high-quality, on-brand creatives for Facebook Ads and Google Ads, including static, motion-lite, and iteration variants for testing
  • Designing email marketing campaigns and flows, along with content marketing and social assets, in line with each client's brand identity
  • Creating and developing visually pleasing yet marketing-oriented and effective concepts in design
  • Working from data and analysis (heatmaps, analytics, tracking findings, test results) and turning that input into design decisions that lift conversion
  • Understanding the visual brand identity of various clients and being able to advise your Account Managers on potential design ideas, improvements, and optimizations
  • Understanding and communicating design ideas (in writing, verbally, and with the use of visuals) to other team members and, when needed, to clients
  • Receiving and implementing feedback and design changes to projects you have worked on
  • Assisting Account Managers with all tasks in Figma, including implementing edits and helping to design professional reports when needed
  • Being part of a team of both expert and less experienced designers, being able to work as a group when needed, and being able to stick to deadlines and deliver high-quality finished designs on time
  • Being well-versed in current design platforms and software, and open to learning how to effectively and productively use new tools
  • Designing marketing materials for our own company's marketing efforts when needed (including blog posts, social media content, and email assets)
  • Constantly educating yourself and developing your technical skills to enhance your expertise
  • Working on various tasks, initiatives, and projects as delegated by the Design Lead
  • Continuously working to improve the design-driven results for your assigned clients
  • Keeping contact with your assigned clients, including assisting in and attending regular meetings with them alongside the Account Managers
  • Maintaining high design standards across the agency and making sure the set targets for your assigned clients are met in terms of their design requirements
  • Participating in training and skill-building sessions for the Design Team to improve skills, performance, and overall expertise
  • Participating in the Design Team's group calls
  • Continuously working to discover industry-wide best practices and standards and presenting your findings to the Design Lead and the Agency Director
  • Being available to assist with all internal design-related needs from other parts of the team
  • Directly reporting to the Design Lead and the Agency Director (in that structural order)

Position Specs:

  • Fully remote position
  • Full-time commitment, Central Europe standard office hours (Monday to Friday)
  • Fixed-rate monthly salary
  • Receive contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement
  • Exclusivity agreement (nullifying the possibility to work in a position of a similar nature while working for Digitalist)
  • Committing to a 30-day notice period after the first month
  • Regular performance reviews every 9-12 months, with the first one being after 3-6 months

Requirements

About you:

Profile:

The ideal candidate must be an experienced designer with an established portfolio showcasing elevated, effective, and on-brand work for a variety of clients, stores, and niches. That portfolio should show both sides of this role: website and e-commerce design that shipped and performed, and marketing creative such as ad sets and email campaigns. Having been part of a design team before is a must for this role.

The Designer should have solid experience with Figma and the Adobe Creative Suite, and should be comfortable designing for WordPress and WooCommerce builds, including an understanding of what a theme or page builder can realistically implement. Experience with Elementor or a comparable builder, basic HTML and CSS literacy, familiarity with an email platform such as Klaviyo or Mailchimp, motion or short-form video editing, and previous agency experience are all considered a plus.

The Designer must be able to act swiftly upon receiving urgent requests and be able to work consistently with high levels of accountability. The right person will be professional and also have extensive graphic design experience, as well as strong communication, presentation, organizational, time management, and interpersonal skills to effectively deliver work of high quality promptly. You will need to possess a refined aesthetic sense, strong typography skills, effective time management skills, a high level of responsiveness, and the ability to take action and work fast to implement changes and solve design-related problems.

Familiarity with tools such as Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, WordPress, Slack, a time-tracking tool, a project management tool, and the Google Workspace Suite is a must for this role. You should feel comfortable working in a remote environment. Availability, accountability, professionalism, responsiveness, and consistency are highly important factors for us, so the Designer should display these qualities when it comes to workload commitments and general availability during office hours.

Key traits for this position:

Showing great attention to detail, being organized and structured, being both big-picture and process-oriented, possessing good communication and interpersonal skills, and having a grasp of current design-related digital marketing trends and best practices in our industry. The right person will also possess strong design and typography skills with a high level of visual intelligence. You need to be able to understand your assigned clients' brand identity, style, and voice and create designs that reflect that, and you need to be comfortable being held to a conversion or sales outcome rather than only to how the work looks. The ability to use design styles consistently across various client accounts is a must. Being accountable, approachable, and well-organized is key for this role.

Key Requirements:

  • At least 5 years of experience working as a Designer in a professional role or similar experience in a design role at another agency (preference will be given to candidates who have worked with remote teams and team members from different countries, or who have agency experience)
  • An in-depth understanding and proficiency in a variety of design tools, including Figma and the Adobe Creative Suite, and a willingness to learn how to use other design tools in the future
  • Demonstrable experience designing websites and online stores that were actually built and launched, ideally on WordPress or WooCommerce
  • Demonstrable experience designing paid social and search creative, and email marketing designs
  • Experience with Elementor or a comparable page builder, basic HTML and CSS literacy, an email platform such as Klaviyo or Mailchimp, motion or short-form video editing, or previous agency experience are considered a plus
  • Having an established design portfolio showcasing elevated, effective, and on-brand designs for a variety of clients, stores, and niches
  • Must possess the ability to create designs for a variety of clients, regardless of their brand and niche
  • A refined aesthetic sense and strong typography skills to be able to create and deliver quality work
  • Have the ability to take action and work fast to implement changes and solve design-related problems
  • Must possess strong communication, presentation, organizational, time management, and interpersonal skills to effectively deliver work of high quality promptly
  • Should be able to perform both repetitive and miscellaneous tasks while maintaining a high level of accuracy in your work
  • Must be highly accountable, responsive, and have an excellent ability to meet deadlines
  • Great aptitude for working with people, problem-solving, and thinking critically and analytically
  • Must be able to work on video editing tasks, mostly for UGC content
  • Possesses a growth and results-driven mindset, and can handle and implement constructive criticism
  • Any remote work experience is a major advantage
  • Excellent interpersonal skills to clearly and effectively communicate with clients as well as with the marketing, development, and analytics people on our team
  • Familiarity with working autonomously and managing your time (remote work experience is a plus)
  • Must be available and responsive during Central Europe standard office hours, Monday to Friday
  • Must have a stable internet connection and a laptop or PC, as well as be able to attend virtual video conferences
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English (you must be fluent in English, although English does not have to be your native language)
  • Slovenian, Croatian, or Serbian is a plus given our client base, but it is not a requirement
  • Being open to receiving feedback and constructive criticism and improving on it, as well as giving feedback of a similar nature productively to your team

Interested in joining a growing company where you will work with talented colleagues, enhance a supportive and energetic culture, and be part of the climate solution? At Energy Solutions, we focus on the big impacts. And we believe that market-based programs can be a powerful force to deliver large-scale energy, carbon, and water-use savings. Since 1995, we’ve harnessed that power to offer proven, performance-based solutions for our utility, government, and institutional customers.

Energy Solutions is seeking a Senior Compliance Specialist who will analyze, assess, and coordinate compliance with complex regulatory, contractual, privacy, audit, operational, data security, ethics, and risk management requirements under the direction of the General Counsel and Assistant General Counsel. This non-attorney role identifies compliance obligations, evaluates business risks, and recommends practical compliance solutions for legal review and business implementation.

In this role, the Senior Compliance Specialist will be operating with a high degree of independence, conduct risk assessments, interpret contractual and regulatory requirements, support audit and governance activities, and serve as a key compliance resource across the organization. Additionally, this person will collaborate with business units, project teams, Information Security, People and Culture, Finance, and external stakeholders to support compliance with contractual obligations, privacy requirements, regulatory requirements, audit expectations, and organizational policies.

This is a perfect opportunity for someone with strong analytical judgment, critical thinking, communication, and problem-solving skills, along with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Facilitate Energy Solutions' compliance and ethics program in alignment with regulatory requirements, contractual obligations, and organizational standards.
  • Conduct compliance assessments and monitoring activities to identify potential risks, control gaps, and compliance concerns.
  • Analyze regulatory requirements, contractual obligations and changes, audit provisions, client flow-down requirements, and operational commitments to determine compliance obligations.
  • Support privacy compliance activities, including ensuring compliance with California privacy requirements and other applicable privacy regulations, and responding to consumer privacy requests.
  • Conduct preliminary assessments of security events and privacy incidents, support the Company’s response, and escalate legal interpretation questions to counsel, as needed.
  • Prepare regulatory filings, compliance reports, and audit-related documentation.
  • Assess contractual insurance requirements and coordinate company insurance coverage, renewals, certificates, and supporting documentation.
  • Develop and maintain compliance-related policies, procedures, guidance documents, and operational controls.
  • Support due diligence reviews, client questionnaires, proposal activities, and contractual compliance assessments.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, Legal Studies, Business Management, Public Policy, Risk Management, Project Management, Information Security, Compliance, or related field.
  • 8 years of experience in contractual compliance, privacy laws, risk management, audit, legal operations, regulatory operations, governance, or related professional function.
  • Experience interpreting and implementing regulatory, contractual, privacy, audit, or compliance requirements in a business environment.
  • Experience conducting compliance assessments, risk analyses, monitoring activities, audits, remediation efforts, or operational reviews.
  • Experience supporting privacy, data protection, contractual compliance, governance, or risk management programs.
  • Experience facilitating compliance activities across multiple business functions and stakeholders.
  • Experience working with clients, auditors, regulators, subcontractors, or external stakeholders regarding compliance-related matters.
  • Experience developing policies, procedures, training materials, compliance documentation, and governance controls.
  • Advanced knowledge of privacy regulations, including CCPA/CPRA and other state-related regulations and laws, privacy rights requests, data protection obligations, and privacy incident response processes.
  • Willingness to conduct limited business travel (approximately 5%).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master's degree in business administration, Legal Studies, Public Policy, Risk Management, Regulatory Compliance, Information Security, Privacy, Project Management, or related fields.
  • Certified Information Privacy Professional (CIPP/US) is strongly preferred.
  • Certified Compliance and Ethics Professional (CCEP) preferred.
  • Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), Certified Risk and Compliance Management Professional (CRCMP), or similar compliance, audit, or risk management certification preferred.
  • Experience administering privacy compliance programs, including privacy rights requests, privacy incidents, privacy impact assessments, and state privacy regulations.
  • Experience working with government contracts, grant-funded programs, regulatory requirements, or highly regulated contractual environments.
  • Experience supporting SOC 2, NIST, ISO, or similar governance and compliance frameworks.
  • Experience managing contract compliance programs, audit obligations, insurance requirements, reporting obligations, and client flow-down requirements.
  • Experience serving as a compliance resource and supporting compliance monitoring, governance activities, policy development, training initiatives, and organizational compliance programs.
  • Experience preparing compliance reports, audit responses, risk assessments, dashboards, executive summaries, and governance-related reporting.

Job Title: Global Marketing Director- Repatha - United States Remote

Job Location: Washington D.C., District of Columbia, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

HOW MIGHT YOU DEFY IMAGINATION?

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

What you will do

Let's do this. Let's change the world. In this vital role, the Director, Global Marketing - Repatha will play a central role in shaping and executing the global commercial strategy for one of Amgen's leading cardiovascular brands. The Director will help maximize Repatha's long-term value by translating deep customer, market, clinical, access, competitive, and business insights into clear strategic choices; advancing the Global Brand Plan; and ensuring strong commercialization and execution across global markets.

Reporting to the Executive Director, Global Marketing Lead - Repatha, this role will lead major global brand priorities including VESALIUS-CV commercialization and launch readiness, lifecycle growth strategy, competitive preparedness, brand positioning and messaging, and global-to-local execution. The Director will partner closely with Global Medical, Development, Access, Regulatory, Commercial Data & Analytics, Forecasting, Finance, regional teams, affiliates, and external partners to strengthen Repatha's leadership in an increasingly dynamic LDL-C treatment landscape.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Shape and execute Repatha's global commercial strategy and Global Brand Plan, integrating customer, market, clinical, access, competitive, and financial insights into clear priorities, strategic choices, and lifecycle growth opportunities.
  • Lead commercialization and launch readiness for VESALIUS-CV and future evidence or indication expansions, ensuring new clinical evidence is translated into differentiated strategy, customer value, messaging, affiliate preparation, and measurable market impact.
  • Own and evolve Repatha's global customer and brand strategy, including priority customer segments, patient and HCP journeys, behavioral objectives, positioning, value proposition, strategic narrative, and core messaging as the market and competitive landscape evolve.
  • Lead competitive strategy and preparedness across current and emerging LDL-C therapies, identifying market inflection points and translating competitive intelligence into proactive strategic responses, affiliate guidance, and business recommendations.
  • Drive global-to-local execution by partnering with regional and affiliate teams to integrate market insight, establish clear strategic guardrails, enable appropriate local adaptation, and scale best practices across priority markets.
  • Lead highly matrixed cross-functional teams and major strategic workstreams, aligning Commercial, Medical, Development, Access, Regulatory, Commercial Data & Analytics, Forecasting, Finance, regions, affiliates, agencies, and other partners around shared priorities, decisions, timelines, and accountability.
  • Use customer, market, performance, and financial evidence to optimize strategy and investment, establish meaningful KPIs, identify execution gaps, and recommend resource and investment tradeoffs to maximize long-term brand value.
  • Champion innovative and AI-enabled ways of working across insight generation, competitive intelligence, content development, performance measurement, and global-to-local workflows while ensuring appropriate judgment, accuracy, compliance, and business relevance.

Expected travel (domestic and international) is 20%

Win

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The marketing leader we seek is a strategic, customer-focused, and collaborative leader with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications:

Doctorate degree and 4 years of marketing experience

OR

Master’s degree and 7 years of marketing experience

jobs.description:
Nosso Modo de Fazer no Time:

Transforme sua carreira com o iFood! Somos uma empresa brasileira de tecnologia referência na América Latina. Por meio de soluções inovadoras, conectamos milhares de restaurantes a milhões de consumidores diariamente com uma média de 100 milhões de pedidos mensais. Junte-se a nós e faça parte de uma equipe que está sempre à frente com tecnologia de ponta e inovação constante.

Seu Cardápio Diário:

  • Coordenar e priorizar testes de segurança em aplicações baseadas em LLMs, incluindo cenários de prompt injection, jailbreak, vazamento de dados, abuso de ferramentas e manipulação de contexto.
  • Supervisionar a execução de casos de teste em agentes internos e user-facing, garantindo alinhamento com os playbooks definidos pelo time.
  • Liderar a evolução de suítes de testes e ferramentas, como Promptfoo ou equivalentes, promovendo inovação e eficiência.
  • Monitorar e analisar alertas e sinais gerados por controles como LLM Firewall, guardrails, Anonymizer e AI Gateway, garantindo respostas rápidas e eficazes.
  • Validar e revisar testes funcionais e de regressão em serviços e controles de AI Security, assegurando a qualidade e a segurança das entregas.
  • Orientar análises de logs, métricas e eventos relacionados ao tráfego de LLMs, agentes e plataformas internas, identificando padrões e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Gerenciar a identificação de falsos positivos, falsos negativos e propor melhorias em regras, heurísticas e políticas de detecção.
  • Revisar e aprovar análises de segurança em MCPs, skills e ferramentas utilizadas por desenvolvedores ou agentes.
  • Garantir a segurança de artefatos de ML, supply chain e quality gates em pipelines, promovendo boas práticas e conformidade.
  • Documentar e revisar achados técnicos, evidências, FAQs, guias, playbooks e boas práticas, assegurando clareza e aplicabilidade.
  • Promover iniciativas de educação, awareness, CTFs, meetups, pesquisa aplicada e consolidação de referências técnicas, fortalecendo a cultura de segurança no time e na organização.

Ingredientes Que Buscamos:

  • Experiência sólida em segurança da informação, desenvolvimento de software, infraestrutura ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento avançado em APIs, HTTP, autenticação, autorização, logs e análise de eventos.
  • Proficiência em pelo menos uma linguagem de programação, preferencialmente Python, Go ou JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Experiência com Git, GitLab/GitHub, pipelines CI/CD e leitura de código.
  • Interesse e conhecimento em Inteligência Artificial, LLMs, agentes, Machine Learning ou segurança aplicada à IA.
  • Capacidade de transformar aprendizados técnicos em estratégias, testes, checklists ou recomendações acionáveis.
  • Excelência na comunicação escrita e verbal para documentar e apresentar testes, achados, evidências e recomendações.
  • Atenção a detalhes em análises de logs, permissões, prompts, configurações e fluxos de dados.
  • Liderança técnica, curiosidade e capacidade de evoluir continuamente com base em feedback e aprendizado.
  • Responsabilidade ao lidar com dados sensíveis, credenciais, ambientes internos e resultados de testes de segurança.

Para Realçar o Sabor:

  • Experiência acadêmica, projetos pessoais ou atuação em segurança, IA, dados ou engenharia de software.
  • Conhecimento sobre OWASP Top 10, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications ou conceitos de threat modeling.
  • Familiaridade com cenários de ataque como prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage, tool abuse ou ataques contra aplicações LLM.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de teste, automação, scripting ou organização de evidências.
  • Conhecimento em MCP, skills, agentes, AI gateways, token exchange ou propagação de identidade.
  • Interesse em ML Security, supply chain de modelos, segurança de datasets, dependências ou artefatos de Machine Learning.
  • Participação em CTFs, comunidades técnicas, grupos de pesquisa, meetups ou iniciativas de escrita técnica.

Buscamos uma pessoa apaixonada por segurança e inovação tecnológica, que esteja sempre em busca de novos aprendizados e que goste de desafios. Se você se identifica com este perfil, adoraríamos conhecer você!

Airspace partners with leading U.S. Medical Device companies to ensure life-saving equipment is transported safely and securely to hospitals in the local region. If a loved one suffers a serious injury, our Dedicated Drivers are the critical link between warehouses and hospitals, delivering essential surgical tools in real time. About the job:

The Senior Operations Coordinator is the administrative and documentation backbone for the DD Operational Support Team, primarily supporting the Manager of Operational Support, with additional support for Talent Acquisition Specialists and Regional Managers as capacity allows. This role keeps recruiting, onboarding, and training running on schedule by owning scheduling logistics, candidate and training records, and documentation upkeep. Job Description Summary

Position Overview:
The Lead Data Engineer is a senior delivery role responsible for building and delivering the data engineering work that turns ARKANCE's data and AI direction into working reality for clients. Where the advisory team shapes what a client should do, this role builds it: the pipelines, models, integrations, and data foundations that make data and AI usable in practice.
The Lead Data Engineer works on both sides of the business. On the client side, they lead the hands-on delivery of data engineering across engagements, taking direction from the advisory team and producing solutions that hold up in production. Internally, they help build the frameworks, templates, and reusable assets that let ARKANCE deliver this work consistently and at scale, shaping both the internal data capability of the practice and the client-facing delivery approaches it relies on.
As a lead, the role sets the technical standard for data engineering delivery, mentors others as the capability grows, and partners closely with the Data & AI Consultant to ensure a clean bridge from advisory intent to delivered outcome. It is a build-and-deliver role at heart, with the seniority to define how the work is done well.

Job Description

Essential Functions

Client Delivery

  • Lead the hands-on delivery of data engineering across client engagements, including data pipelines, integrations, transformations, and the data foundations that support analytics and AI.
  • Take direction from the advisory team and the Data & AI Consultant, converting assessed needs and designed target states into working, production-grade solutions.
  • Own the technical quality of data engineering deliverables, ensuring they are reliable, maintainable, and fit for the client's real operating environment.
  • Work directly with client technical teams to deploy, integrate, and hand over solutions in a way the client can sustain.
  • Advise on the practical realities of data infrastructure, surfacing constraints and risks early so delivery plans stay grounded.

Internal & Client-Facing Frameworks

  • Build and maintain the reusable data engineering frameworks, patterns, and accelerators that let ARKANCE deliver consistently across clients.
  • Shape the internal data capability of the practice, including the tooling, pipelines, and data foundations behind ARKANCE's own accelerators, benchmarks, and delivery assets.
  • Develop client-facing delivery approaches - reference architectures, integration patterns, and standards - that raise the quality and repeatability of engagements.
  • Contribute to the practice's technical standards and definition of done for data engineering work.

Technical Leadership

  • Set and uphold the technical standard for data engineering delivery across the practice.
  • Mentor and develop other engineers as the delivery capability grows, sharing patterns and raising the bar on quality.
  • Partner with the Data & AI Consultant to ensure advisory intent translates cleanly into delivered outcomes, and feed delivery insight back into how the practice scopes and estimates.
  • Stay current with the data engineering landscape - platforms, tooling, and integration approaches - and bring proven practice into ARKANCE's delivery.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Perform all other duties as assigned.
  • Duties and responsibilities are subject to change based on business needs.

Decision-Making & Autonomy

Operates with significant autonomy in data engineering delivery, technical design, and the frameworks and standards that support it. Serves as the senior technical authority for data engineering across client delivery and internal capability, partnering with advisory and delivery leadership to ensure the work is delivered well and scales. Sets the technical standard others work to, and escalates commercial and engagement-shaping decisions to advisory and delivery leadership.

Qualifications

  • Substantial hands-on data engineering experience, including data pipelines, integrations, transformations, and production data infrastructure.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver data engineering work in a client or customer-facing setting, translating requirements into reliable, maintainable solutions.
  • Experience building reusable frameworks, patterns, or standards that improve delivery quality and repeatability, not just one-off builds.
  • Strong grounding in data architecture, data quality, and governance, with the judgment to make sound trade-offs under real-world constraints.
  • Working understanding of how data foundations enable analytics and AI, and the ability to partner with advisory colleagues on data and AI initiatives.
  • Technical leadership experience, including setting standards and mentoring other engineers, with the seniority to define how the work is done well.
  • Familiarity with the AECO industry and the Autodesk ecosystem preferred, or the ability to build that context quickly.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

jobs.description:
Rôle et profil recherché

Relevant du Chef d’équipe, Recherche et Développement, l’Analyste d’affaires – Secteur immobilier jouera un rôle central dans la transformation de nos produits par l’intelligence artificielle. À l’intersection des clients, du produit et des équipes techniques, cette personne traduira les réalités immobilières en besoins, règles d’affaires, données et scénarios afin de créer des fonctionnalités et des agents IA fiables et créateurs de valeur.

Nous recherchons une personne qui comprend en profondeur le domaine immobilier et les défis de ses gestionnaires. Elle saura écouter les clients, modéliser leurs processus et guider les développeurs afin que les agents IA répondent aux besoins d’affaires, couvrent les cas limites et produisent des résultats explicables. Alors que l’IA accélère la production logicielle, ce rôle sera garant de la pertinence, de la cohérence et de la valeur des solutions livrées.

Responsabilités et fonctions :

  • Comprendre et traduire les besoins du marché immobilier : cerner avec les clients et les équipes internes les processus, irritants et priorités, puis les traduire en règles métier, exigences fonctionnelles, cas d’usage, scénarios, critères d’acceptation et cas limites clairs pour les développeurs.

  • Participer à la conception des agents IA : définir avec les équipes produit et techniques l’intention, le contexte, les données, les actions permises, les règles de décision, les contrôles humains et les résultats attendus.

  • Prioriser les occasions à forte valeur : repérer les processus immobiliers pouvant être améliorés, automatisés ou soutenus par l’IA, puis évaluer leur valeur client, leur faisabilité et leurs risques.

  • Contribuer à la validation avec les clients : tester les hypothèses, présenter au besoin des prototypes ou preuves de concept, recueillir la rétroaction et ajuster les solutions avant leur mise en production.

  • Assurer la fiabilité fonctionnelle : vérifier que les résultats de l’IA sont cohérents, explicables et conformes aux règles du domaine, puis collaborer avec l’assurance qualité aux tests et scénarios d’exception.

  • Soutenir la transformation IA et la feuille de route : utiliser l’IA pour accélérer l’analyse, la documentation et la validation avec jugement, traçabilité et responsabilité; contribuer à la modernisation de Hopem Immobilier et au développement d’agents IA spécialisés.

Exigences :

  • Expérience métier : expérience pertinente en analyse d’affaires, analyse fonctionnelle, gestion de produit ou amélioration de processus dans un environnement logiciel.

  • Connaissance du domaine immobilier : expérience concrète et bonne compréhension des réalités, processus et besoins de la gestion immobilière; un atout déterminant.

  • Innovation : curiosité et capacité à repérer des améliorations, à remettre en question les façons de faire et à contribuer à des solutions innovantes, notamment par l’IA.

  • Capacité d’analyse : aptitude à comprendre des processus complexes, à clarifier les règles d’affaires et à traduire les besoins clients en exigences précises.

  • Communication et vulgarisation : excellentes habiletés pour écouter, synthétiser et expliquer simplement des besoins d’affaires et des concepts complexes à des interlocuteurs clients, produit et techniques.

  • Autonomie et jugement : rigueur, sens pratique et capacité à faire progresser des besoins complexes ou peu définis.

  • Collaboration technique : capacité à établir un langage commun entre les réalités d’affaires et techniques et à collaborer efficacement avec les développeurs.

Les avantages offerts :

  • Un régime d’avantages sociaux complet comprenant les assurances médicale, dentaire et visuelle, un programme vie active de 325 $ par année, un programme d’aide aux employés, un REER collectif ainsi qu’un programme d’actionnariat des employés.

  • Trois semaines de vacances, cinq journées personnelles pour vous ressourcer ainsi qu’une journée de bénévolat dédiée à l’engagement communautaire.

  • Des modalités de travail flexibles favorisant la conciliation travail-vie personnelle, incluant le télétravail et un complément de prestations de maternité pour les six premières semaines.

  • De nombreuses possibilités de développement et d’avancement professionnel.

  • Une équipe collaborative composée de collègues passionnés, où l’entraide, le respect et l’esprit d’équipe sont au cœur du quotidien.

  • Et surtout, une ambiance de travail conviviale où les rires et le plaisir au travail font partie de la culture!

Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:

  • Coordinate in-field activity to maximize market, segment, and team dynamics to drive results.
  • Serve as the first-line manager for assigned Field Access Managers, providing clear direction, prioritization, coaching, and accountability for regional field execution.
  • Conduct routine field visits, ride-a-longs, coaching conversations, and performance reviews to reinforce compliant field behaviors, strengthen account planning, and develop individual FAM capabilities.

jobs.description:
At Goodweek, we're building a next-generation AI tool designed to revolutionize business productivity. We are focusing on delivering a secure, scalable, and reliable system that supports real business use cases across different departments. The goal is to make AI practical, controlled, and truly embedded in how modern organizations operate.

Goodweek is a partner-led AI Management Platform, built exclusively for our Partners: Distributors and MSPs (Managed Service Providers), who deploy it to their own clients. We give MSPs and Distributors a secure, governed, multi-model AI workspace with 40+ bidirectional integrations, SOC 2 certification, GDPR compliance, and 100% tenant isolation: the platform infrastructure they need to turn AI from a SKU they resell into a packaged, recurring service line they admin, bill, and support.

Our team spans across France, Spain, and the United States, and our vision is backed by 6 international investment funds.

The role

We are looking for an Account Executive to develop and grow Goodweek’s business across the UK market.

You will be the dedicated growth partner of your Distributors or MSPs´ portfolio. You take full ownership all along the entire Sell → Activate → Prove → Expand journey for each of your Distributors/MSPs: from prospection through expansion.

You are not here just to sign partners: you are here to make them succeed and drive intense, durable adoption of Goodweek across their end customers.

Tasks

Your role has two tracks: Direct MSPs (you own the full cycle) and Distributor-sourced MSPs (you own activation and growth, the VP Channel owns the sell).

1. Direct MSP Portfolio:

MSP Hunting & Acquisition

  • Identify, qualify and recruit new MSPs in the UK market.
  • Build and maintain a reliable MSP pipeline in Salesforce with expected volumes and timing, lead commercial negotiations, and bring MSPs to signature.

Activation & Onboarding

  • Follow the Goodweek activation framework (defined by Product Marketing) and make it come alive, adapted to each MSP's business context, verticals, and customer needs. This includes running onboarding sessions, delivering trainings and personalized demos, and building MSP-specific use cases with the right enablement content.

Adoption & Expansion

  • Measure and document real end-user engagement, and build the business case for broader adoption jointly with the MSP.
  • Help each MSP develop an active forward customer pipeline and drive progress toward the target of incremental licenses per activated MSP per month.
  • Spot churn signals or disengagement early and intervene with personalized remediation plans.
  • Co-build each MSP's growth roadmap: new customers, new use cases, new verticals.

Performance Tracking & Pipeline Discipline

  • Maintain an accurate, up-to-date forecast in Salesforce and regularly review key indicators: activation rate, time-to-first-customer, user engagement, and license growth.
  • Identify root causes of performance gaps, implement corrective actions, and surface field insights, recurring blockers and improvement opportunities to the VP Sales.

First-Level MSP Support

  • You're the first point of contact for MSPs on day-to-day issues and questions. You investigate hands-on, resolve issues whenever possible, and when escalation is needed, transfer full issue context to the engineering team.

Continuous Feedback Loop

You are Goodweek's most direct connection to partner reality - that intelligence must flow back into the company. You provide structured, actionable feedback across three areas:

  • Goodweek Product: friction points, missing features, hard-to-sell use case
  • Product Marketing: what content resonates, what needs updating or creating from scratch

Buscamos alguém com curiosidade, iniciativa e vontade de aprender, que goste de trabalhar em equipe e tenha interesse em conhecer e aplicar conceitos, técnicas, ferramentas e tecnologias voltadas para qualidade de software.
Como estagiário(a), sabemos que você está aqui para aprender e desenvolver sua experiência profissional. Por isso, você contará com o nosso programa de treinamento, que irá apoiar sua jornada de aprendizado e dar a você a oportunidade de conhecer melhor a área de Qualidade e colocar seus conhecimentos em prática.
Tudo isso em um ambiente que valoriza a Excelência. Para nós, isso significa estar sempre “descobrindo maneiras melhores de desenvolver software”. Você fará parte de um time que busca constantemente evoluir nossos processos, aprimorar nossas práticas e contribuir para sistemas cada vez mais confiáveis, estáveis e de qualidade.
Se você gosta de aprender, compartilhar ideias, trabalhar em equipe e quer começar sua carreira em Qualidade de Software, queremos conhecer você!No dia a dia, em conjunto com um Analista de Qualidade mais experiente, você irá:
    • Ser um ponto de referência em qualidade dentro do time, ajudando a disseminar e aplicar boas práticas em todas as etapas do desenvolvimento de software. Você também contribuirá para esclarecer dúvidas e alinhar requisitos e regras de negócio.
    • Analisar os requisitos levantados com nossos clientes, buscando entender suas necessidades e garantindo que a solução desenvolvida esteja alinhada ao que realmente precisam.
    • Criar casos de teste claros e precisos, de forma que todo o time consiga compreender o comportamento esperado da solução. Como utilizamos BDD, nossos casos de teste são normalmente escritos em Gherkin, mas também utilizamos outras abordagens quando elas fazem mais sentido para cada situação.
    • Executar testes manuais, tanto com base nos casos de teste definidos quanto de forma exploratória, investigando diferentes cenários e comportamentos para ajudar a garantir a qualidade do produto que estamos entregando.
    • Desenvolver automações de testes nos níveis de sistema e aceitação, atuando em projetos Web (frontend e backend) e Mobile.

Formação

    • Você está cursando, a partir do 5º semestre, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Computação, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas relacionadas?
    • Se você tem experiência e conhecimentos alinhados à vaga, mas está cursando uma graduação em outra área, não tem problema! Queremos conhecer sua trajetória. Conte no currículo sobre suas experiências, projetos e conhecimentos que possam contribuir para a posição.

Conhecimentos e habilidades que podem fazer a diferença

Para essa oportunidade, é importante que você tenha interesse ou alguma familiaridade com:
    • UI/UX, lógica de programação e metodologias ágeis;
    • Testes de software e seus principais fundamentos;
    • Programação e banco de dados;
    • Sistemas Web e/ou Mobile;
    • Testes manuais e/ou automatizados;
    • BDD e, preferencialmente, noções de Gherkin;
    • Análise e compreensão de requisitos e regras de negócio;
    • Boa comunicação e escrita;
    • Atenção aos detalhes e olhar crítico;
    • Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe e compartilhar ideias.
Não esperamos que você saiba tudo! Estamos buscando principalmente alguém com curiosidade, vontade de aprender e interesse em evoluir na área de Qualidade de Software.

Será um diferencial se você...

    • Já tiver alguma experiência com automação de testes em projetos Web (frontend e backend) e/ou Mobile.
    • Tiver outros conhecimentos, experiências ou projetos que você acredita que possam contribuir para o nosso dia a dia.

Job Title: HCM Test Automation & Quality EngineerJob Category: EngineeringTime Type: Full timeMinimum Clearance Required to Start: Public TrustEmployee Type: RegularPercentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%Type of Travel: Continental US* * *

The Opportunity:
CACI is seeking a HCM Test Automation & Quality Engineer to ensure the quality, reliability, and compliance of the Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM platform being deployed across the federal government as part of the HCM modernization program. With federal civilian employees depending on this system for their pay, benefits, and career management across multiple federal agencies, there is no room for defects in production. You will design and execute comprehensive test strategies covering functional, integration, regression, performance, security, accessibility, and user acceptance testing. Working within a SAFe Agile continuous testing framework, you will build automated test suites, execute parallel payroll validation, ensure Section 508 accessibility compliance, and coordinate UAT with agency stakeholders. Every Oracle quarterly update, every agency migration wave, and every integration endpoint must be validated before it touches the production environment. If you are passionate about quality at scale and thrive in high-stakes testing environments, this role is for you.

This role is remote, but with a preference to individuals in the DMV area.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and execute comprehensive test strategies and plans covering functional, SIT, regression, performance, security, data migration, and UAT for Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM.

  • Build and maintain automated test suites using OATS, Selenium, or equivalent tools to support continuous regression testing within the SAFe Agile delivery framework.

  • Execute parallel payroll validation testing by comparing Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM payroll results with legacy system outputs for each agency migration wave; document and resolve variances before production cutover.

  • Perform Section 508 accessibility testing to ensure the user interface meets WCAG 2.1 AA standards and is accessible to federal employees using assistive technologies.

  • Coordinate UAT with agency stakeholders, including test scenario development, tester training, defect triage, and sign-off tracking for each agency transition wave.

  • Design and execute performance and load testing to verify the platform meets required response time and throughput thresholds under peak federal workforce transaction volumes.

  • Implement defect management processes using JIRA or equivalent tools, tracking defects from discovery through resolution with severity classification, root cause analysis, and trend reporting.

  • Test integration interfaces with EHRI, eOPF, USA Staffing, payroll providers, Employee Express, MyPay, and other federal systems to validate end-to-end data flow accuracy and error handling.

  • Validate Oracle quarterly update deployments by executing targeted regression suites to ensure existing configurations and integrations remain functional.

  • Participate in SAFe Agile ceremonies, contributing to sprint planning, definition of done criteria, and continuous testing process improvements.

  • Develop and maintain test documentation including test plans, test cases, traceability matrices, and test execution summary reports.

  • Apply established methods and standards to independently resolve moderate functional and technical issues, contribute to team knowledge bases, and consult with senior staff on complex or unfamiliar problems.

  • Communicate effectively with project team members and stakeholders to report progress, explain technical approaches, and support collaborative problem‑solving within workstreams and Agile Release Train ceremonies.

Qualifications:
Required:

  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance (US citizenship required).

  • Bachelor’s degree and 5 years of relevant experience; additional experience may substitute for the degree.

  • 5+ years of professional experience in software QA, test engineering, or test automation for enterprise applications.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with automation tools such as Selenium, OATS, Tricentis Tosca, or equivalent.

  • Experience with functional, integration, regression, and performance testing for cloud‑based enterprise applications, preferably Oracle Fusion Cloud or Oracle ERP Cloud.

  • Proficiency with defect and test management tools such as JIRA, HP ALM, or Azure DevOps Test Plans.

  • Strong understanding of SAFe Agile continuous testing practices, including TDD and shift‑left strategies.

  • Experience coordinating UAT activities with business stakeholders, including planning, execution, and defect triage.

  • Excellent analytical and communication skills, with the ability to document results and communicate quality status clearly.

Desired:

  • 6+ years of testing experience with at least one large‑scale Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM or Oracle ERP Cloud implementation.

  • ISTQB Foundation or Advanced Level certification.

  • Experience using performance testing tools such as JMeter, Gatling, or Oracle Load Testing.

  • Experience performing Section 508 accessibility testing using tools such as ANDI, axe, or JAWS.

  • Knowledge of federal HR business processes including payroll, benefits administration, and personnel action workflows.

  • Experience with parallel payroll validation methodologies and automated payroll comparison testing.

  • Scripting skills in Python, JavaScript, or Groovy for automation and data generation.

  • Experience with Oracle Cloud technologies including OIC or OCI in enterprise HCM or ERP environments.

This position is contingent on funding and may not be filled immediately. However, this position is representative of positions within CACI that are consistently available. Individuals who apply may also be considered for other positions at CACI.

What You Can Expect:

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range:

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.

The proposed salary range for this position is:

$75,200-$158,100

CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

jobs.excerpt: About the CompanyAt Torc, we have always believed that autonomous vehicle technology will transform how we travel, move freight, and do business.
jobs.description:
About the Company

At Torc, we have always believed that autonomous vehicle technology will transform how we travel, move freight, and do business. A leader in autonomous driving since 2007, Torc has spent over a decade commercializing our solutions with experienced partners. Now a part of the Daimler family, we are focused solely on developing software for automated trucks to transform how the world moves freight. Join us and catapult your career with the company that helped pioneer autonomous technology, and the first AV software company with the vision to partner directly with a truck manufacturer.

Meet the Team

At Torc, our simulation teams are building the foundation for AV 3.0 driver-out development and certification. This team serves as the critical technical interface between simulation/modeling and autonomy consumers. By ensuring model fidelity, coverage, and usability, the team plays a vital role in evaluating and advancing autonomous driving software. We support massive-scale, parallel execution for scaled verification and validation (V&V) and high-throughput reinforcement learning (RL) training. Ultimately, we provide the framework and tooling that serves Autonomy, Safety, and Release with shared artifacts, common metrics, and deterministic reproducibility.

What You'll Do

  • Own and evolve the technical architecture for scalable vehicle modeling and simulation — extensible across vehicle types, sensor platforms, and fleet variability as Torc's autonomy program grows.
  • Develop and own high-fidelity truck and vehicle dynamics models (longitudinal, lateral, and transient behavior) spanning nominal, off-nominal, and failure-mode simulation domains.
  • Define and drive the statistical validation metrics that directly support Safety Case claims, ensuring model fidelity and coverage meet the bar required for driver-out certification.
  • Design and scale robustness testing frameworks — including controller/planner interaction testing — to stress-test autonomy software at the fidelity and throughput required for large-scale V&V and RL training.
  • Design, develop, and maintain high-fidelity simulation platforms used to validate autonomous driving software in closed-loop evaluation pipelines at scale.
  • Partner with autonomy engineering teams to capture and implement vehicle model requirements supporting planning, controls, and system-level V&V activities.
  • Own model capability communication, known limitations, and release notes to enable effective autonomy validation across consuming teams.
  • Ensure vehicle model updates don't regress autonomy V&V system performance, using automated regression frameworks you help define.
  • Execute full software development lifecycle activities primarily in C++ within a Linux environment and ROS/ROS2 tooling, applying Lean-Agile methodologies.
  • Perform root cause analysis on complex issues surfaced in simulation runs and hardware-in-the-loop testing.
  • Drive test plan design for data acquisition and telemetry supporting field data collection and vehicle model refinement.
  • Set direction for system-level test plans and verification strategies across the simulation org.
  • Communicate technical direction, design decisions, and blockers clearly at stand-ups, design reviews, and cross-org architecture discussions.
  • Build and maintain collaborative relationships with OEM partners and simulation tool vendors to evaluate, integrate, and co-develop simulation capabilities.
  • Mentor engineers across the simulation and autonomy domains and help raise the bar on code quality, process, and testing rigor.

What You'll Need to Succeed

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field plus 10+ years of relevant experience; or Master's Degree in the above fields plus 7+ years; or PhD plus 3+ years.
  • Deep proficiency in C++ (primary), Python for tooling, ROS/ROS2, CMake, and Linux.
  • Strong background in physics-based modeling of ground vehicles, including longitudinal/lateral dynamics, tire models, and powertrain.
  • Working knowledge of AV autonomy stack architecture — planning, controls, and system integration — to collaborate effectively with autonomy engineering teams and ensure vehicle models meet V&V requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate vehicle model capabilities and limitations to autonomy engineering teams, and to capture their requirements to inform model fidelity improvement initiatives.
  • Experience defining statistical validation metrics and robustness testing frameworks used to support formal safety case claims.
  • Experience with unit, integration, and regression testing, automated validation pipelines, and simulation-based performance benchmarking at scale.
  • Track record of driving technical consensus across simulation, autonomy, controls, product, and safety teams — this role is expected to help set direction, not just execute against it.
  • Ability to own and maintain key technical systems across multiple repositories and contribute to cross-org architectural decisions.
  • Operates as an advanced-level professional with wide latitude for independent judgment and minimal supervision.
  • Track record of mentoring engineers and contributing to technical direction within the simulation and autonomy domains.

Bonus Points!

  • Experience as technical lead for a vehicle simulation sub-team, driving architecture across vehicle types, sensor platforms, and fleet variability.
  • Experience with high-fidelity truck & trailer or heavy-vehicle models.
  • Experience building or extending closed-loop autonomous vehicle simulation environments at scale.
  • Familiarity with scenario-based validation and sim-to-real correlation activities.
  • Familiarity with how learned models (neural networks) consume simulation and vehicle model outputs in autonomy V&V workflows.

Perks of Being a Full-time Torc’r

Torc cares about our team members and we strive to provide benefits and resources to support their health, work/life balance, and future. Our culture is collaborative, energetic, and team focused. Torc offers:

  • A competitive compensation package that includes a bonus component and stock options
  • 100% paid medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees
  • 401K plan with a 6% employer matchFlexibility in schedule and generous paid vacation (available immediately after start date)Company-wide holiday office closures
  • AD+D and Life Insurance

At Torc, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We celebrate the uniqueness of our Torc’rs and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, or disabilities.

Even if you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications listed for this opportunity, we encourage you to apply.

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several geographic markets. Pay is based on a number of factors and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Torc's total compensation package will also include our corporate bonus and stock option plan. Dependent on the position offered, sign-on payments, relocation, and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits.

Venn is revolutionizing how businesses enable BYOD workforces, removing the burden of buying and securing laptops or dealing with virtual desktops. Our patented technology provides companies with a new approach to securing remote employees and contractors working on unmanaged computers. With Venn’s Blue Border™ software, work lives in a company-controlled Secure Enclave installed on the user’s computer, enabling IT teams to secure company data while ensuring end-user privacy. Over 700 organizations, including Fidelity, Guardian, and Voya, trust Venn to meet FINRA, SEC, NAIC, and SOC 2 standards.

The Opportunity
Venn is hiring its first dedicated in-house SEO/AEO hire. You'll own organic search end-to-end and build the strategy from the ground up, becoming Venn's central point of ownership for everything SEO: technical execution, content direction, AI search optimization, and the link between organic performance and revenue. Nobody else at Venn owns this today, which means the roadmap, the priorities, and the results are yours to define. You'll report into marketing but work closely with sales and the BDR team, using customer calls and feedback to sharpen how Venn's ideal customer profile shows up in keyword targeting and content strategy. This is a senior, largely self-directed role.

What You'll Do

  • Own technical SEO fixes directly in WordPress — indexing, crawlability, site architecture, Core Web Vitals, structured data, and schema
  • Run technical audits and lead migrations, redesigns, or international SEO work as Venn's footprint grows

  • Track how Venn shows up in AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and other AI-driven search surfaces, and adjust content, crawlability, and structured data to earn citations there
  • Partner with the BDR team and sales to turn customer calls and feedback into keyword targets, content angles, and page-level messaging
  • Own and manage Venn's SEO tool stack — Ahrefs or Semrush, GSC, GA4, Screaming Frog
  • Report on organic performance in terms leadership and sales actually care about — pipeline influence, not just rankings and traffic

What You Bring

  • 4-5+ years of hands-on SEO experience, in-house, agency, or both — you've been accountable for results, not just recommendations
  • Real, hands-on WordPress experience — you can go in and fix a technical issue yourself rather than describing it to someone else
  • Strong technical SEO grounding — crawling, indexing, Core Web Vitals, structured data, and site architecture
  • Genuine curiosity about AI search and AEO, with a point of view on where it's going, not just familiarity with the term

  • Confidence working cross-functionally with sales and BDRs, and comfort digging through customer calls for insight

How to Apply

Apply on our careers website and send over an email to with an example of a technical SEO fix you shipped yourself, and if you have one, a case study where you built an SEO strategy or function from zero.

Why You'll Love Working Here

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our team's health, well-being, and work-life balance, including:

  • Competitive compensation and commission opportunities
  • Equity at Venn
  • Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
  • Healthcare FSA, HSA, and commuter benefits
  • Unlimited paid time off, paid sick time, NYSE company holidays, and a paid birthday off
  • The opportunity to be part of a fast-growing startup with a collaborative, high-impact team where every voice is valued and there are clear paths for growth and promotion

We operate with Trust, Humility, Relationships, Innovation, Vigor, and Empowerment and we look for teammates who do the same!

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Senior Accountant to lead full-cycle accounting, financial reporting, reconciliations, and month-end close activities across a growing organization.

This is more than a traditional accounting role. You’ll take ownership of maintaining accurate financial records, preparing reliable financial statements, supporting audits, improving accounting processes, and ensuring compliance with GAAP or IFRS standards.

Working closely with Finance, FP&A, Payroll, and Operations, you’ll help deliver timely financial insights that support strategic business decisions while maintaining strong internal controls and audit-ready records.

Responsibilities

General Ledger & Accounting Operations

  • Prepare and post journal entries for accruals, prepaids, payroll allocations, fixed assets, depreciation, and intercompany transactions.
  • Maintain and reconcile key balance sheet accounts, including cash, accounts receivable, accounts payable, inventory, deferred revenue, credit cards, and other general ledger accounts.
  • Review financial transactions for accuracy, completeness, and proper classification.
  • Ensure the general ledger remains accurate and compliant with accounting standards.
  • Identify and resolve accounting discrepancies before they impact financial reporting.

Month-End Close & Financial Reporting

  • Lead monthly and quarterly close processes, ensuring timely completion within established deadlines.
  • Maintain close checklists and ensure all reconciliations and journal entries are completed accurately.
  • Prepare trial balances, financial statements, and supporting schedules.
  • Generate Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow reports for leadership.
  • Prepare variance analyses comparing actual results against budgets and forecasts.
  • Provide clear financial commentary and recommendations to support executive decision-making.

Audit, Compliance & Internal Controls

  • Support external audits by preparing PBC (Prepared By Client) schedules and supporting documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with GAAP, IFRS, and internal accounting policies.
  • Assist with sales tax, property tax, and corporate tax preparation.
  • Maintain organized, audit-ready accounting records and documentation.
  • Strengthen internal controls and ensure adherence to financial governance standards.

Process Improvement & Systems

  • Identify opportunities to improve accounting workflows and operational efficiency.
  • Reduce manual processes through automation and system enhancements.
  • Assist with ERP implementations, migrations, and accounting system improvements.
  • Develop and maintain accounting SOPs and process documentation.
  • Improve reporting accuracy, consistency, and month-end close efficiency.

Team Collaboration & Support

  • Review and support work completed by junior accountants and accounting staff.
  • Mentor team members on reconciliations, reporting, and accounting best practices.
  • Collaborate with FP&A, Operations, Payroll, and leadership teams.
  • Coordinate with Sales and Operations to ensure accurate revenue recognition and financial reporting.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • 4–5+ years of progressive accounting experience.
  • Strong experience with full-cycle accounting and month-end close.
  • Proficiency with QuickBooks, NetSuite, Xero, SAP, or similar ERP/accounting systems.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, and conditional formatting.
  • Strong understanding of journal entries, reconciliations, accrual accounting, and financial reporting.
  • Solid knowledge of GAAP or IFRS.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.

Nice to Have

  • CPA, ACCA, CMA, or equivalent accounting certification.
  • Experience with multi-entity accounting and financial consolidations.
  • Experience with foreign currency accounting.
  • Background in SaaS, professional services, real estate, or multi-location organizations.
  • Experience supporting ERP implementations or accounting automation projects.
  • Experience coordinating external audits and compliance reviews.

What Success Looks Like

  • Month-end close completed within five business days.
  • Less than 1% reconciliation error rate.
  • Accurate, timely, and audit-ready financial reporting.
  • Audit requests completed within established deadlines.
  • High-quality variance analyses and financial insights.
  • Improved accounting efficiency through process improvements and automation.
  • Leadership confidence in the accuracy and reliability of financial reporting.

Interview Process

jobs.excerpt: Since our founding in 2009, REGENXBIO has pioneered what’s possible in gene therapy.
jobs.description:
Since our founding in 2009, REGENXBIO has pioneered what’s possible in gene therapy. Today, we are advancing a pipeline of gene therapies designed to improve the lives of patients facing serious rare and retinal diseases and preparing to bring innovative new medicines to patients.

Our work is fueled by purpose and urgency because every day matters to patients and their families. If you're looking for meaningful work, opportunities to grow, and the chance to help bring potentially transformative gene therapies to patients, we'd love to hear from you.

What we do matters.

The Opportunity


    As the Director, Commercial Data, Advanced Analytics & Forecasting, you will build and lead the data, advanced analytics, and forecasting capabilities needed to ensure launch readiness and guide commercial decision-making. This individual will play a critical role in translating brand strategy into decision and analytics framework, develop advanced analyses and patient-based forecasts, and turn complex data into decision-ready insights and KPIs.

How You’ll Contribute

    • Design measurement frameworks that connect market development, customer engagement, field execution, account readiness, patient progression, access, treatment, and business outcomes.
    • Build advanced analyses and decision-support models to identify leading indicators and early-warning signals that enable action before risks or opportunities are evident in lagging performance measures.
    • Lead analytics across market sizing, patient identification, customer segmentation and targeting, referral networks, payer access, field-force optimization, territory potential, and launch performance.
    • Translate complex analytical findings into clear recommendations, implications, risks, and actions for senior executives and operating teams.
    • Own patient-based, demand, launch, and long-range commercial forecasting, incorporating drivers such as epidemiology, diagnosis, patient identification and eligibility, referral, treatment-center capacity, access, time to treatment, uptake, competitive dynamics, and supply considerations.
    • Build key scenarios, including base, upside/downside, label, and access scenarios
    • Monitor actual performance versus assumptions
    • Identify, evaluate, and manage relevant data sources, including HCP, payer, claims, prescription, account, CRM, patient services, hub, specialty pharmacy, specialty distributor, shipment, digital, financial, epidemiology, market research, and competitive intelligence data.
    • Oversee data ingestion, integration, customer and account master data, and aggregation processes to deliver accurate, high-quality, analytics-ready datasets.
    • Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, scorecards, and KPI-tracking tools, and support recurring business reviews using Power BI, Tableau, Excel, and other business intelligence platforms.
    • Develop a practical, governed roadmap for commercial AI, machine learning, generative AI, and analytical automation.

What You’ll Bring:

    • Bachelor’s degree in statistics, mathematics, computer science, or a related quantitative discipline; relevant advanced degree strongly preferred.
    • 10+ years of progressive experience in commercial analytics, data science, forecasting, business intelligence, commercial operations, or a related function within pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, or healthcare.
    • Direct experience supporting at least one U.S. product launch from pre-launch planning through launch or early commercialization.
    • Advanced, hands-on SQL proficiency required, including the ability to independently extract, join, transform, validate, and analyze complex datasets.
    • Strong hands-on capability in at least one of Python, R, SAS, Alteryx, or a comparable analytical platform.
    • Strong proficiency with Excel and business-intelligence or visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
    • Demonstrated experience building advanced analytical models, customer or account segmentations, targeting analyses, field-effectiveness analyses, and decision-support tools.
    • Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining patient-based, demand, launch, or long-range forecasts.
    • Experience working with healthcare-provider, payer, claims, CRM, patient-services, specialty-pharmacy, specialty-distributor, shipment, financial, market-research, or other complex commercial datasets.
    • Experience defining requirements for data acquisition, data integration, data warehouses or lakehouses, data aggregation, analytics-ready datasets, data quality, metadata, lineage, and governance.
    • Working knowledge of statistical modeling, predictive analytics, machine learning, AI, and analytical automation.
    • Ability to translate Brand strategy into analytical questions, data requirements, models, KPIs, insights, and commercial actions.
    • Willingness and ability to travel up to 25%.

What You Can Expect

    At REGENXBIO, we're committed to fostering an environment where people can do meaningful work, grow professionally, and make an impact. Our core values – trust, accountability, perseverance, and innovation – drive everything we do.

The estimated compensation range for this role is $196,000 to $265,000 annually. The actual salary offered to the final candidate depends on a number of factors such as relevant work experience, skills, education, and years of experience.

This senior-level role, reporting to the Creative Director, balances design execution with creative leadership, elevating craft standards, enhancing ways of working, and owning day-to-day creative delivery. You can manage the design and execution of entire campaigns (not just the production of specific pieces) and demonstrate an ability to keep other team members working alongside you within established deadlines. You demonstrate a high level of proficiency in design software and applications as well as great knowledge of printing procedures, photography, illustration, 3D and structural.
