jobs.excerpt: About JobGetAs the #1 app focused on everyday workers, JobGet is redefining the future of hiring.
jobs.description:
About JobGet

As the #1 app focused on everyday workers, JobGet is redefining the future of hiring. Founded in 2019, JobGet began as the only mobile-first hiring platform for everyday workers. Since then, we’ve grown by joining forces with Snagajob, the largest hourly job board in the U.S., followed by Seasoned, the leading platform for restaurant hiring. Each acquisition has brought JobGet closer to the frontline, making the platform faster, smarter, and more effective.

While most platforms chase volume, JobGet is laying the foundation for a new kind of hiring infrastructure focused on precision, speed, and real outcomes. Our AI-powered engine learns, adapts, and improves continuously. Employers don’t just get candidates, they get hires. Workers don’t just search, they get matched. The result is a more efficient hiring process with less friction and better results.

We serve a diverse range of industries, from food service and customer support to healthcare, logistics, and manufacturing. With access to over 200 million job seekers, our platform leverages cutting-edge AI to match qualified, role-ready candidates, automating key parts of the hiring process for faster decisions and better outcomes. By combining scale with precision, we’re transforming how businesses hire and how people find meaningful work.

Our mission is simple: to help everyday workers thrive by providing accessible, frictionless hiring solutions that deliver real results. Join us as we continue to build the future of work for the millions of people who power our world every day.

Learn more about our culturehere.

Who We Are

We’ve designed our values to be more than just buzzwords; they’re things we can do. We hope that our culture reflects our values by our commitment to living them every day.

Make a difference every day

  • Teamwork - We make time to help colleagues across JobGet succeed.
  • Excellence - We set ambitious targets, put in extraordinary effort, and persevere until we have accomplished — or exceeded — our goals.
  • Innovation - We’re a team of creative, outside-the-box thinkers who thrive in a continuously evolving environment. To us, innovation is about questioning the status quo and always striving to do things better.

Have Unwavering grit

  • Resilience - By remaining resilient and adaptable, we grow stronger as individuals and as an organization.
  • Accountability - We operate with an ownership mentality where everyone feels a sense of responsibility to make us better and always act in the best interest of JobGet.
  • Speed - We make decisions fast and execute them even faster. Bias for speed is one of our core strengths and a key advantage over our competitors.

Grow through curiosity & kindness

  • Respect - We treat each other with mutual respect, kindness, and celebrate our differences.
  • Learning - We ask questions and seek to understand by being genuinely curious & communicative.
  • Culture - We believe that each of us is responsible for our culture. It requires self-discipline and the drive to contribute to something greater than ourselves.

What You’ll Do

As our Principal Data Engineer, you will help lead the technical direction for how data flows, scales, and powers every decision at JobGet. You’ll own the data architecture behind our platform that connects hundreds of millions of job seekers with employers across dozens of industries; and you’ll do it at the intersection of high-throughput pipelines, real-time matching signals, and AI-driven product experiences.

Data Platform Architecture & Strategy

  • Drive Architectural Decisions: Lead design reviews for critical platform components, evaluating trade-offs across scalability, cost, reliability, and time-to-insight.
  • Champion Modern Data Stack Adoption: Evaluate and introduce best-in-class tooling (Databricks, Snowflake, dbt, Kafka, etc.) aligned with engineering principles and business needs.
  • Ensure Platform Reliability: Own the observability, alerting, and operational readiness standards for tier-1 pipelines, including runbooks, failover strategies, and reprocessing protocols.
  • Autonomy & Decision Making: Demonstrate high resourcefulness; you are empowered to make significant technical decisions and drive projects end-to-end with limited oversight.

Data Modeling & Pipeline Engineering

  • Build Production-Grade Pipelines: Design and implement robust batch data pipelines using Snowflake and dbt as the core of JobGet’s transformation layer, ingesting and serving data across product telemetry, marketplace signals, employer activity, and candidate behavior.
  • Lead Data Modeling Decisions: Establish data modeling standards (schema design, dimensional modeling, and data contracts) that serve analytics, ML feature engineering, and product instrumentation.
  • Solve the Hardest Problems: Personally take on the most complex data integration, performance, and reliability challenges that require principal-level judgment and hands-on implementation.
  • Support Real-Time & Near-Real-Time Needs: Architect and evolve streaming data infrastructure using technologies such as KSQL and Apache Flink to power real-time matching, recommendation, and product decisioning systems.

AI & Analytics Enablement

  • Enable Machine Learning at Scale: Partner closely with Platform Engineers and Data Analysts to design feature stores, training data pipelines, and inference-ready datasets that power JobGet’s AI matching engine.
  • Accelerate Analytics Delivery: Work with Data Analytics stakeholders to ensure data products are well-modeled, documented, and performant for self-serve consumption. Evaluate and integrate emerging AI-powered tools to enhance operational efficiency and developer productivity.

Data Governance, Quality & Security

  • Establish Data Governance Standards: Define and enforce policies for data quality, lineage, access control, and cataloging that scale across a growing and multi-product organization.
  • Protect Data Integrity: Implement data validation frameworks, SLA monitoring, and anomaly detection to maintain trustworthy data across all consumers.
  • Ensure Compliance & Privacy: Design data systems with privacy-by-default principles, ensuring alignment with applicable regulations (CCPA, GDPR, etc.) across candidate and employer data.

Hands-On Execution & Technical Excellence

  • Raise the Technical Bar: Mentor and level up engineers across the data team through code reviews and design guidance.
  • Partner Across Engineering & Product: Collaborate with Software Engineering, Product, and Analytics to ensure data requirements are deeply understood at inception.
  • Influence Without Authority: Drive adoption of data platform standards and architectural patterns across teams through clear communication, documentation, and trust-building.
  • Proactive Problem Solving: Personally identify and execute fixes for deep-seated bottlenecks, architectural bugs, and performance issues that impact system stability.

Who You Are

  • 10+ years of data engineering experience, with at least 3–5 years operating at a principal or staff IC level in a start-up environment.
  • Production-grade experience with Snowflake and dbt (required); you’ve designed, owned, and scaled these in a real product environment, not just used them.
  • Experience with real-time streaming technologies such as KSQL or Apache Flink is strongly preferred; you’ve built or operated streaming pipelines in production.
  • Hands-on AWS experience at scale, including cloud data architecture, cost governance, and infrastructure-as-code; Terraform experience is a nice-to-have.
  • DataOps experience: familiarity with CI/CD for data pipelines, automated testing frameworks, and deployment practices that treat data infrastructure like production software.
  • Significant, demonstrated AI usage in your day-to-day engineering work is required. You actively use AI tools (e.g. Claude, Copilot, Cursor, or similar) to move faster, reason through architecture, generate and review code, and solve novel problems. This isn’t a nice-to-have; it’s how we expect principal-level engineers to operate.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Python and SQL, with strong command of distributed systems, data pipeline design, and performance optimization.
  • Strong data modeling background: dimensional modeling, schema design, data contracts, and the ability to build structures that outlast the team member who built them.
  • Experience building data infrastructure that directly supports ML/AI systems, including feature pipelines, training data management, and inference-layer data serving.
  • Demonstrated track record of setting technical standards across teams, not just within your own scope: through RFCs, architecture reviews, or platform migrations.
  • Strong grasp of data governance fundamentals (data lineage, cataloging, access control, and quality monitoring) with practical experience implementing them in production.
  • Familiarity with real-time and near-real-time data architectures (streaming, event-driven design, CDC), especially in marketplace or two-sided platform contexts.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills; you can translate complex data infrastructure trade-offs into plain language for product and business audiences.
  • You have a builder’s mentality and an operator’s discipline. You move fast, ship with confidence, and hold yourself to a high bar even when no one is watching.

At JobGet, we’re looking for people who see themselves in our Values. If you have made a measurable impact in your career and are known for your grit and curiosity, we encourage you to apply. We look forward to hearing from you.

Benefits & Rewards

  • Purpose-driven organization
  • Flexible time off
  • Remote-first
  • Flexible work hours - our employees are in multiple time zones
  • Medical & dental plans
  • Parental leave
  • Employee stock options

jobs.description:
Position: Senior Research Project Manager

Department: Pediatrics Research

Schedule: 40 hours per week, Remote

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Center for Health Equity, Education, and Research (CHEER) at Boston Medical Center is a world-class center for maternal child health advocacy, training and research. Its mission is to bring about health equity by collaborating with community-based partners and providing technical assistance, training, evaluation, and inspiration. CHEER focuses on underserved populations, with a particular emphasis on maternal child health and nutrition.

Under the supervision of CHEER’s Director and Associate Director, the Senior Research Project Manager (SRPM) will support the CHAMPS National program. CHAMPS is a hospital-based initiative that promotes evidence-based maternity practices, with the ultimate goal of increasing breastfeeding rates and decreasing racial disparities in breastfeeding. The new CHAMPS National program is a CDC funded program, which expands hospital enrollment to 100 sites around the US and its territories. The SRPM will develop protocols, assessment instruments, monitor program implementation, provide training, and assist with manuscripts, presentations and reporting to the CDC. The SRPM will provide support to CHAMPS National hospitals, enabling access to trainings, resources, and QI training. The SRPM will function as liaisons between CHAMPS National team members, QI specialists, and trainers, and hospital contacts.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

(These generally will be required but may not always apply based on department-specific needs):

Project Management

  • Coordinates and facilitates the research project management life cycle, including initiation, development, and implementation of various complex experimentation projects.

  • Collaborates with other BU departments and universities on joint projects.

  • Offers training and assistance to other facilities working with the CHEER program, provides expert guidance and direct assistance.

  • Oversees outreach to facilities in different locations.

  • Responsible for scoping, coordinating early research activities, training program staff, and managing implementation of QI training, and research.

  • Coordinates research and hospital teams, and manages project timelines, to ensure milestones are completed within the specified and in line with annual objectives.

  • Meets regularly with stakeholders, including research staff, contractors, project and study teams, to collect and communicate business and research requirements, and set expectations for research-related work.

  • Responsible for the completion of both research and project management deliverables, including project plans and research schedules, progress reports and investigational applications.

Research Management

  • Works with Principal Investigators to select the most appropriate methodology and techniques for facilitating the research.

  • Responsible for producing qualitative and quantitative research plans, designing questionnaires and moderator guides.

  • Works with research and program implementation teams (BMC based andoff-site), and the project and research directors, to coordinate fieldwork initiatives, and conduct pre-research and post-research analyses and evaluations.

  • Works with research team to facilitate & ensure protocol adherence, quality assurance and HIPAA compliance.

  • Oversees data collection onsite and offsite, summarizes and interprets data.

  • Collaborates with Principal Investigator to author journal articles and to present findings at research seminars, study groups and conferences.

Staff Management

  • Supervise support staff (e.g., Research Coordinators, Research Assistants, etc), including training, delegating tasks, overseeing daily activities, mentoring, guiding through demonstration of best practices and offering opportunities for professional development.

  • Schedules and facilitates staff meetings. Plans agenda and ensures that minutes are taken, edited and distributed.

Administrative Duties

  • Assists the Principal Investigator with monitoring expenses, facilitating contracts, ordering materials and documenting all approved variances. Works with offsite team to oversee program expenses and offer guidance.

  • Liaises as necessary with Institutional Review Board (IRB) for submissions, correspondence, and regulatory binders, including administrative amendments.

  • Assists with development and writing of proposals to obtain funding for ongoing and future research activities.

  • Perform administrative duties associated with the study’s Data Monitoring and Safety Board, tracking and reporting adverse events and collecting data specified by the DMSB. Responsible for all other administrative duties related to research activities.

  • Performs other duties as required.

DEPARTMENT-SPECIFIC DUTIES

DEPARTMENT: Division of General Pediatrics

RESEARCH STUDY OR CLINICAL TRIAL: CHEER (Center for Health Equity, Education and Research) based projects

  • Manage project-specific work such as data collection, hospital meetings, hospital maternity staff trainings, and similar work

  • Some travel will be required as much of the work occurs offsite. This may take the form of work in hospitals across the United States and its territories, or community-based work in project locations supporting those hospitals.

(The above statements in this job description are intended to depict the general nature and level of work assigned to the employee(s) in this job. The above is not intended to represent an exhaustive list of accountable duties and responsibilities required).

JOB REQUIREMENTS

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor's degree in business management or field related to the project.

  • Advanced degree preferred.

EXPERIENCE:

  • Minimum of 5 (preferably 7+) years of progressively more responsible experience in research public health, health care administration and/or related field, including experience managing projects and operations.

KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS:

  • Must be highly organized and detail-oriented, have exceptional oral communications and writing skills.

  • Demonstrated proficiency in project management, including budgeting, planning, execution, delivery, quality assurance, and reporting.

  • Experience in data analysis and manuscript preparation is helpful.

  • Knowledge of MS Word, Power Point, and Excel is essential.

  • Must be a proactive problem solver with superb planning, program coordination, and leadership skills.

JOB BENEFITS:

  • Competitive pay
  • Tuition reimbursement and tuition remission programs
  • Highly subsidized medical, dental, and vision insurance options
  • Career Advancement/Professional Development: Access a wealth of ongoing training and development opportunities that will not only enhance your skills but also expand your knowledge base especially for individuals pursuing careers in medicine or biomedical research.
  • Pioneering Research: Engage in groundbreaking research projects that are driving the forefront of biomedical science.

ABOUT THE DEPARTMENT:

As the primary teaching hospital for Boston University Chobanian & Avedisian School of Medicine and BU schools of public health and dentistry, intellectual rigor shapes our inquiries. Our research is led by a belief that skin color, zip code, and financial circumstances shouldn’t dictate health.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer II, Revenue Experimentation
jobs.excerpt: About Life360Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love.
jobs.description:
About Life360

Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), as of June 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit .

Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above.

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

The Product Design team is the creative engine shaping the vision, strategy, and delivery of extraordinary member experiences at Life360. We are a diverse, collaborative group with an unwavering commitment to craftsmanship and delight in everything we create. With Life360’s rapid growth and strong business momentum, we have a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact at global scale. At the heart of our mission is a dedication to helping families feel safe, connected, and cared for through the transformative power of design.

The Growth Revenue Experimentation team (within the Product Design team) is the engine behind Life360's subscription revenue growth: we turn ideas about pricing, packaging, and the paywall funnel into fast, validated experiments. We run a high volume of tests across the entire subscription funnel - driving free users to start a trial, trial to paid conversion & churn prevention. Additionally, optimizing the top-performing features to drive further conversion, SKU and pricing routing, external billing, and churn and win-back, partnering closely with the Revenue ML team to personalize offers and target the right SKU to the right user. We set and hold the bar for experiment quality and methodology across the program, using tools like Statsig to run and govern testing at scale, and we ground every decision in research and data, validating or killing assumptions before they become a build. We are also an AI-native team: AI tooling is already speeding up how we generate hypotheses, build, and measure results, and we expect that velocity to keep climbing as our own workflows get faster too.

About the Job

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer II to join our Revenue Experimentation team and help drive Life360's growth through fast, high-quality design experimentation. This role sits at the intersection of product design, growth strategy, and data-informed decision-making, you'll design, test, and iterate on experiences across our subscription and monetization surfaces to uncover new ways to grow revenue and deliver value to families. You'll partner closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Data Scientists, and Content to turn loosely defined ideas into well-scoped tests, and well-scoped tests into learnings that shape our roadmap. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on ambiguity, moves fast without sacrificing craft, and wants their design decisions to directly and measurably impact the business.

For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $152k to $223k USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is $176k to $207k CAD. We take into consideration an individual's background and experience in determining final salary - therefore, base pay offered may vary considerably depending on geographic location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The compensation package includes a wide range of medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits, as well as equity.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and run a high volume of experiments across Life360's revenue and monetization surfaces, from trial conversion, trial-to-paid conversion to pricing, SKU routing, and churn/win-back.
  • Turn loosely defined experiment briefs into well-scoped, testable hypotheses, using research and data to validate or challenge the underlying assumptions.
  • Lead design for experiments that originate from your own ideas, and act as a critical, PM-partnering voice on ideas that originate elsewhere.
  • Partner with Data Science and Analytics to define success metrics, interpret experiment results, and translate learnings into follow-on hypotheses.
  • Present experiment concepts, in-flight learnings, and results to cross-functional stakeholders and leadership.

What We’re Looking For

  • 6+ years of product design experience, ideally with exposure to growth, experimentation, or subscription/monetization design.
  • A track record of shipping and iterating on A/B or multivariate experiments in a fast-paced, high-velocity environment.
  • Comfort operating with ambiguity, able to take a loosely defined brief and turn it into a well-scoped, testable hypothesis using research or data.
  • A proactive, ideas-first mindset: someone who brings concepts to the table rather than waiting to be handed a fully-formed brief.
  • Strong collaboration skills, able to both lead from your own ideas and constructively pressure-test others', as a true creative and strategic partner to PMs.
  • Experience partnering closely with engineers, content, and data science across the full experiment lifecycle, from concept to bug bash to results.
  • Excellent organizational habits: clean, well-documented Figma files and clear, traceable rationale for design decisions.
  • Fluency in Figma; familiarity with experimentation and analytics tooling (e.g., Optimizely, Amplitude, Statsig, or similar) is a plus.
  • Comfort using AI tools to accelerate design and production work.
  • Strong visual design craft, with hands-on animation skills.
  • A portfolio that showcases experimentation work, problem framing, hypotheses, iteration, and measurable impact, not just polished final screens.

Ways of Working

  • Operates in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, balancing multiple experiments at once.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity. Experiment briefs often start loosely defined, and it's the designer's job to validate the underlying problem (through research or data) and refine it into something well-scoped enough to actually test, confirming or challenging the original assumptions along the way.
  • Contributes ideas proactively, including in regular ideation sessions focused on a specific theme, bringing forward experiment concepts, not just executing others'.
  • Partners with PMs as a true collaborator: leads projects that originate from their own ideas, and acts as a critical partner on PM-originated ideas, pressure-testing them for UX soundness and product fit rather than simply executing.
  • Collaborates across design and other departments when an experiment touches product areas outside their own, to keep the experience consistent and aligned.
  • Keeps work organized and traceable: clean file structure, documented hypotheses and rationale, and clean, well-organized Figma files so anyone can see what's being tested, what's been done, and why.
  • Involves engineers early in the design process to surface technical questions and constraints before they become blockers.
  • Participates in bug bashes, testing experiments before launch to confirm the experience matches intent.
  • Uses AI as a creative and productivity partner, leveraging skills, automation, and AI-generated illustrations or animations where it makes sense, to move faster and free up more time for craft.

AI-Native Expectations

  • Daily use: You embed AI in all your workflows and use it for real, substantive tasks, including research, analysis, drafting, prototyping, analytics and experimentation.
  • Review and accountability for AI output: AI-generated outputs get the same level of care of as any of your deliverables. You are accountable for everything you ship.
  • Velocity: We expect senior practitioners who use AI well to operate with meaningful leverage: doing more with the same time, taking on problems that would otherwise require a larger team.
  • Team leadership: You share what works. You automate prompting strategies that others can build on and help teammates earlier in their AI workflow adoption get up to speed.
  • Continuous learning: The tooling is changing fast. You stay current and bring recommendations to the team when something would meaningfully improve how we work.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for US employees). We offer life and disability as well as supplemental plans for medical and dental for Canadian employees.
  • 401(k) plan with company matching program in the US and RRSP with DPSP plan for Canadian employees.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being.
  • Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns.
  • Learning & Development programs.
  • Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment.
  • Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers.

Life360 Values

Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference

  • Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.
  • Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard.
  • Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families.
  • High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done.

Our Commitment to Diversity

We believe that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger and more creative work environment that delivers better results. Together, we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we serve. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic best selves to work.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Life360. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any legally protected status.

We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences create a foundation for the best ideas. Come join us in building something meaningful.Even if you don’t meet 100% of the below qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying!

At its heart, the Smile platform enables people and organizations to better manage healthcare data. We help generate and liberate structured healthcare data to ensure effective delivery across care teams and health systems bringing #BetterGlobalHealth to patients everyday!

Apply today and find plenty of reasons to SMILE!

The Senior Cloud Security Engineer is responsible for designing, automating and deploying production grade services on behalf of the customers to a variety of clouds such as AWS, Azure, OCI and GCP.
This role combines strategic security architecture with hands-on operational execution owning cloud security posture management (CSPM), threat detection and response, application security testing (SAST/DAST), and RBAC governance. The successful candidate works closely with DevOps, Platform Engineering, and Development teams to embed security throughout the software delivery lifecycle and ensure all environments meet healthcare-grade compliance requirements

Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and continuously improve cloud security architecture and controls across Azure-based environments.
  • Lead threat modelling, vulnerability assessments, and security architecture reviews for cloud-native and hybrid infrastructure.
  • Own and operate cloud security posture management (CSPM) using Prisma Cloud — configure policies, monitor posture, triage findings, and drive remediation with engineering teams.
  • Deploy, tune, and manage Microsoft Defender for Cloud (and related Defender suite products) across Azure subscriptions; investigate alerts and drive incident response.
  • Integrate SAST and DAST tooling into CI/CD pipelines; triage findings, define severity thresholds, and partner with developers to close vulnerabilities prior to production release.
  • Own the RBAC governance process: design role models, conduct periodic access reviews, enforce least-privilege principles, and document role assignments across Azure and application layers.
  • Collaborate with DevOps and Platform Engineering teams to embed security controls (secrets management, image scanning, policy-as-code) into DevOps pipelines and IaC workflows (Terraform, Ansible).
  • Act as SME for security compliance frameworks relevant to healthcare data (SOC 2, HIPAA, ISO 27001, PHIPA/PHIPPA); map controls and support audits.
  • Provide Level 3 escalation for security incidents; participate in on-call rotation for incident response and forensic triage.
  • Lead and educate internal teams and clients on cloud security best practices, secure-by-design patterns, and zero-trust principles.
  • Document security runbooks, post-incident reviews, threat models, and lessons learned; maintain a living security knowledge base.
  • Ensure all working hours are accurately reported in the Time tracking system; the majority of hours are expected to be billed to client engagements.
  • Comply with all privacy, security, and confidentiality policies; hold all PHI and confidential information in strict confidence throughout and after employment.

Requirements :

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in cloud security, with the majority of that experience focused on Microsoft Azure (Azure Security Center, Azure Policy, Azure AD / Entra ID, Key Vault, NSGs, Private Endpoints, Defender for Cloud).
  • Proven, production-level experience with Prisma Cloud (CSPM/CWPP) — policy management, alert triage, and remediation workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender for Cloud and the broader Microsoft Defender suite (Defender for Servers, Containers, Identity, Endpoint).
  • Practical experience implementing and operating SAST and DAST tools (e.g., MEND, SonarQube,GitHub Advanced Security, OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite) within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Deep familiarity with DevOps pipeline security securing GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps pipelines, secrets management (Azure Key Vault, HashiCorp Vault), container image scanning, and supply-chain security.
  • Strong RBAC design and governance experience, building and enforcing role models, access review processes, and least-privilege controls across Azure and multi-tier application stacks.
  • Solid IaC experience with Terraform and/or Ansible; ability to write and review security-hardened infrastructure code.
  • Experience with Kubernetes / OpenShift and container security (runtime protection, admission controllers, image policies).
  • Solid understanding of networking fundamentals as they apply to cloud security: VNets, NSGs, Azure Firewall, Private Link, Zero Trust network segmentation.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of compliance frameworks applicable to healthcare (SOC 2, HIPAA, ISO 27001, PHIPA); experience supporting audits and mapping technical controls.
  • Professional cloud or security certifications preferred (e.g., AZ-500, MS-500, SC-200, CCSP, CISSP, or equivalent).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to convey complex security concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Accenture combines strategy, digital twins and simulation, robotics intelligence, orchestration, industrial integration and managed operations to help clients scale autonomous and adaptive physical operations. The Work:
The Physical AI Delivery and Solutioning Manager leads client workstreams and small-to-medium Physical AI engagements from discovery and solution definition through mobilization, implementation, validation and transition. jobs.description:
★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★

Art Director – Performance Creative & AI

Work Arrangement: This is a fully remote (telecommute) position.
Employment Type: Full-Time
Department: Creative Post-Production
Reports To: Creative Director
Direct Report: Senior Editor/Designer
Industry: Digital Marketing / Performance Creative
Experience: 5–8+ Years
Portfolio: Required

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Art Director to lead concept development and own the visual standard across paid and organic campaigns.

This role sits at the intersection of creative strategy, performance marketing, and execution. You will define creative direction and ensure that the work produced delivers against that vision, from initial concept through final client-ready assets.

You will directly manage a Senior Editor/Designer, assign and prioritize work, review deliverables, provide actionable art direction, and maintain a consistently high creative standard.

Because the team works extensively with both traditional production and AI-generated creative (AIGC), you must have enough hands-on AI fluency to confidently direct generative work, evaluate output quality, identify artifacts or brand inconsistencies, and determine when AI or traditional production is the better approach.

You will collaborate closely with Client Partners and Media Strategists to translate performance insights into high-quality, scalable creative across Meta, TikTok, and YouTube.

What You'll Do

Creative Direction & Team Leadership

  • Directly manage and develop a Senior Editor/Designer, setting priorities and managing capacity across accounts.

  • Review video, motion, static, and AI-generated creative before it advances to the Creative Director or client.

  • Provide clear, actionable art direction across composition, typography, layout, pacing, color, motion, and brand consistency.

  • Identify whether creative challenges originate from craft, concept, or the brief and address them at the appropriate level.

  • Maintain a high creative standard without becoming a production bottleneck.

Concept Development & AI Creative

  • Lead the development of creative concepts, campaign ideas, and visual narratives across multiple client accounts.

  • Translate briefs, brand guidelines, and performance insights into clear creative direction.

  • Develop concept decks, storyboards, briefs, visual references, and prototypes, primarily using Figma.

  • Use AI tools to develop visual references, storyboards, creative examples, scripts, and ad copy aligned with each client's brand.

  • Direct AI-generated work by evaluating generation quality, identifying artifacts and off-brand outputs, and improving prompt and reference strategies.

  • Stay hands-on when necessary by sketching, mocking, or prototyping creative directions.

Creative Production & Workflow

  • Own the creative process from brief through final build and delivery.

  • Guide production and revision rounds while balancing creative quality with efficient iteration.

  • Review both internally produced and creator-generated content.

  • Oversee final assets across static, video, and motion formats, ensuring they are complete, properly versioned, and platform-ready.

  • Improve briefing, feedback, documentation, and AI production workflows to reduce unnecessary revision cycles.

Performance Creative & Strategy

  • Partner with Client Partners and Media teams to turn campaign performance insights into creative direction.

  • Apply learnings from high-performing hooks, formats, visual systems, and concepts to future campaigns.

  • Make recommendations on whether creative directions should be scaled, iterated, or discontinued based on performance.

  • Build creative post-mortems to understand why concepts succeeded or underperformed.

  • Understand how creative should evolve across different stages of the marketing funnel.

Creative Systems & Scalability

  • Develop repeatable creative frameworks, templates, and design systems.

  • Create reusable art-direction standards that allow quality to scale across the team.

  • Maintain visual consistency across formats, campaigns, and channels.

  • Contribute to AI production workflows, prompt/reference libraries, and scalable creative processes.

  • Stay current on platform trends, emerging formats, visual styles, and generative creative tools.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • 5–8+ years of experience in Art Direction, Visual Design, or Performance Creative within an agency or brand environment.

  • Experience managing, mentoring, or formally directing at least one creative professional, such as a designer, editor, or motion artist.

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating concept development and visual direction across paid and digital channels.

  • Proven ability to translate strategy and performance insights into compelling, executable creative concepts.

  • Experience with social-first and performance-driven creative across Meta, TikTok, and YouTube.

  • Working fluency with AI creative tools such as Gemini/Nano Banana, Sora, Veo 3, Higgsfield, Seedance 2.0, or similar platforms.

  • Ability to evaluate and provide structured creative direction across video, motion, static, and AI-generated content.

  • Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.

  • Ability to manage multiple clients, campaigns, and priorities simultaneously.

  • Strong collaboration skills across creative, strategy, account, and media teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in performance marketing or direct-response creative.

  • Familiarity with UGC, creator-led, and platform-native advertising.

  • Working knowledge of After Effects and/or Premiere sufficient to effectively review post-production work.

  • Experience creating scalable creative systems, templates, or briefing frameworks.

  • Experience working with offshore teams or external creative partners.

  • Understanding of creative testing frameworks and iterative production workflows.

  • Experience establishing quality standards for AI-generated creative.

Ideal Candidate

You are a strong conceptual thinker who can transform strategy into creative ideas that are both visually compelling and realistically executable.

You know how to give specific, prioritized feedback that improves the work, and you genuinely enjoy developing other creatives.

You understand how to balance brand quality, performance, speed, and scalability, and you're comfortable leading the creative process while remaining hands-on when needed.

Most importantly, you have the judgment to distinguish between average and exceptional creative, including when that work is AI-generated.

How Success Is Measured

Success in this role will be reflected in:

  • Consistently high-quality creative across client accounts.

  • Strong alignment between creative direction and campaign performance.

  • Effective leadership and development of the creative team.

  • Efficient production and revision cycles.

  • Successful translation of performance insights into new creative concepts.

  • Scalable creative systems that maintain quality as production grows.

  • Effective integration of AI into creative workflows without compromising brand standards.

Why Join Us?

  • Own creative direction across a diverse portfolio of performance-driven campaigns.

  • Work at the intersection of creative strategy, performance marketing, and generative AI.

  • Direct both traditional and AI-powered creative production.

  • Influence creative systems, workflows, and quality standards.

  • Collaborate closely with experienced creative, strategy, account, and media professionals.

  • Help shape how AI is integrated into modern performance creative production.

Important Notes

  • A strong creative portfolio is required.

  • This is a senior, hands-on Art Direction role with direct responsibility for creative quality.

  • Candidates must have previous experience directing or managing another creative professional.

  • Candidates should be comfortable reviewing static, video, motion, and AI-generated creative.

  • Practical familiarity with modern generative AI tools is required; theoretical knowledge alone is not sufficient.

This is a fully remote (telecommute) position.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Review client benefit design documentation for completeness and accuracy, flagging open items and partnering with implementation and client success to resolve gaps prior to configuration.

  • Research and resolve inquiries related to claims adjudication and benefit configuration, partnering with client success to communicate findings and remediation steps.

  • Track work across implementation and plan change trackers, keeping status, ownership, and deadlines current so cross-functional partners have real-time visibility.

jobs.description:
TECHNICAL PRODUCT MANAGER

Product | Full-Time, Salaried | Reports to Head of Product

Company Seeking.com (Reflex Media)

Location Remote, anywhere in the USA

Compensation $145,000 to $190,000 base

Travel Required for team weeks, engineering deep dives, and quarterly planning in Las Vegas

About the Role

Seeking.com is the world's largest premium dating platform, founded and led by an MIT alumnus and headquartered in Las Vegas. We are a technical company. Our product is built on a set of microservices, internal tools, and third-party integrations that our engineering, moderation, support, and finance teams operate every day. Making that machine easy to understand and easy to run is the difference between a product team that ships and one that fights fires.

We are hiring the Technical Product Manager who owns the platform layer underneath the Seeking core experience. Our internal tools, our payments system, our content moderation stack, and the microservices behind them. This is the person who reads the code, walks the flow, sits with the engineers, and turns a tangled system into a clean one.

This role may also be a fit for candidates whose current title is Technical Product Manager, Platform PM, Infrastructure PM, API PM, Payments PM, Product Engineer with a systems bent, or Software Engineer who has moved into product ownership. If your day-to-day is turning technical complexity into simple, well-documented, well-instrumented systems, you should apply regardless of your current title.

This is the role for the Technical PM who is an expert at simplification, at organization, and at making complex systems easier to understand and easier to manage. If your instinct in a review is to add scope, this is not your role. If your instinct is to cut, clarify, and document, keep reading.

What You'll Own

Platform and Internal Systems Ownership

  • Own the roadmap for the internal tools and microservices that support Seeking, including support and moderation tools, automated content moderation systems, the internal payments system, and the technical services that connect them.
  • Treat every internal system as its own product, with a defined user, a metric, and a documented interface.
  • Set quarterly OKRs for your surface and define both leading and lagging KPIs for every Key Result you own.

Simplification, Documentation, and Order

  • Take systems that are messy and make them clean. Rename, restructure, deprecate, and consolidate until a new engineer can be productive on day two.
  • Own the technical documentation for the surfaces you cover in Confluence. Diagrams, data flows, API contracts, runbooks. If it is not documented, it is not shipped.
  • Write specs, user stories, and acceptance criteria clean enough that an engineer using Claude Code can build directly from them.

Doing the Work, Not Just Briefing It

  • Prototype endpoints, admin screens, and internal tools yourself before they hit the engineering backlog. Postman, a Figma flow, a working prototype in code, or a Claude Code or Cursor session that produces a testable artifact.
  • Write SQL against the production data warehouse, read the code, and walk the calls yourself. Do not ask an engineer to answer a question you can answer.
  • Use agent-assisted environments to produce real, testable artifacts inside a single sitting.

Collaboration Across Teams

  • Serve as the primary translator between the engineering team and the non-technical teams (support, moderation, marketing, finance) who depend on these systems.
  • Ensure technical feasibility on every proposal and drive prioritization of what actually gets built.
  • Communicate updates, tradeoffs, and risks to stakeholders in plain, direct language.

Payments and Moderation

  • Own the internal payments system as its own product. Understand the flow end-to-end: authorization, capture, settlement, reconciliation, refunds, chargebacks, tokenization, and PCI scope.
  • Own the moderation and support tooling that keeps the platform safe and the members supported, including our LLM-based message moderation pipeline.
  • Track the metrics that matter: transaction success rate, decline rate by gateway, latency, ticket time-to-resolution, moderation SLA.

Data-Driven Decision-Making

  • Instrument every feature with the data layer in mind from day one, using Amplitude, Mixpanel, Firebase, or comparable.
  • Analyze data to measure the success of every technical change you ship, and follow up with the fix or the deprecation.
  • Propose data-driven improvements to the systems you own, and back them with the numbers.

Required Qualifications

  • Engineering degree. Bachelor's in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field. A business degree on its own does not qualify. If you did not train as an engineer, this is not the role for you.
  • Three to six years in a technical product role, ideally with an engineering background as an individual contributor before moving into product.
  • Working knowledge of system architecture, REST APIs, microservices, and database design. You can read the code, sketch the data flow on a whiteboard, and explain the tradeoffs in an integration.
  • SQL fluency. You can write, read, and debug non-trivial queries against a production warehouse without help.
  • Referenceable shipping history in technical product work. At least one platform, API, or internal system you personally owned end-to-end, with the metric you moved and by how much.
  • Daily, fluent use of agentic AI tools (Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, MCP-based workflows, or comparable). You will be asked to demonstrate this in the interview.
  • Simplification instinct. Show us a system you took over that was messy and left cleaner. Fewer moving parts, better documentation, a metric that improved because of the cleanup.
  • Outstanding written communication. Specs, PRDs, runbooks, decision docs. Your writing should be a competitive advantage, and it should be shorter than the reader expects.
  • Presentation skill. You can walk a room through a complex system in ten minutes without losing anyone. Direct answers, no meandering. If a simple question gets a ten-minute answer, this is not the role for you.
  • Fluency in the operating stack. Confluence for documentation, Jira for shipping, Monday for cross-team scheduling. You can operate the stack without needing a project manager to do it for you.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on background as a software engineer before moving into product, ideally in backend, platform, or infrastructure.
  • Working experience with payments on a technical level: systems, flow, entities, PCI scope, and reconciliation.
  • Working experience with support ticketing and content moderation systems, including LLM-based moderation pipelines.
  • Cloud fluency (AWS preferred), including a working understanding of DevOps practices and deployment pipelines.
  • Prior experience in dating, social, marketplace, subscription, or other consumer-focused product categories.
  • Public work we can look at: a technical portfolio, an open-source contribution, a spec you wrote, a system you diagrammed, or an agent toolkit you have shared.
  • Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary: $145,000 to $190,000, commensurate with experience.

Full-time, salaried, fully remote within the US.

99% coverage of our medical base plan, dental, and vision insurance. 65% coverage for qualified dependents. 100% coverage of short-term disability, long-term disability, and life insurance for qualified employees. 50% 401(k) match up to 6% per month. Flexible Spending Account. Flexible paid time off.

Direct exposure to the CEO from day one, and a clear growth path as platform scope expands.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Reflex Media is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We strictly prohibit discrimination of any kind. Candidates are encouraged to apply for qualified positions regardless of race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, or any other protected characteristics as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. Reflex Media's hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and the needs of the company. All offers of employment are contingent upon the completion of a full background and reference check.

This role leads a team of project management professionals who partner with business leaders, Retail Operations, Managed Care, Marketing, Contact Center, Finance, IT, and other stakeholders to ensure initiatives are clearly prioritized, effectively resourced, and delivered on time with measurable business outcomes. The Senior Manager, PMO serves as a strategic business partner and execution leader, ensuring technology-enabled and system-related projects remain business-led, operationally practical, and aligned to field and customer needs rather than driven solely by technical priorities.

  • Lead the PMO function supporting hearing aid retail growth, operational execution, and enterprise transformation initiatives.

  • Monitor project performance, risks, dependencies, budgets, timelines, decisions, and issue resolution to ensure predictable delivery and timely escalation when needed.
  • Develop executive dashboards, status reporting, KPIs, and portfolio analytics that enable data-driven decision-making and organizational transparency.
  • Lead resource planning and capacity discussions to support realistic prioritization, effective sequencing, and sustainable execution across business and technical teams.
  • Support change management planning, stakeholder communication, training coordination, and adoption tracking to ensure initiatives are implemented successfully in the field.

Work Experience:

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in project management, program management, business transformation, retail operations, or related disciplines.
  • 3+ years of experience leading project managers, project teams, or cross-functional workstreams.
  • Experience managing complex, cross-functional initiatives in matrixed organizations with both business and technical stakeholders.

About the Role
Intermedia is looking for a Data Scientist to join our AI Data Science team.
In this role, you will develop and apply advanced machine learning, generative AI, and statistical techniques to improve the intelligence, effectiveness, and reliability of Intermedia's digital agents. You will work on challenging problems involving large language models, retrieval, agent behavior, experimentation, evaluation, and optimization to help create digital agents that can understand customer needs, access relevant knowledge, and successfully complete complex tasks.
You will work closely with AI/ML engineers, software engineers, product managers, and other data scientists to take ideas from experimentation through production. You will have significant ownership of data science solutions while helping establish strong practices for measuring and continuously improving the quality of our AI-powered experiences.

What You Will Be Doing

Machine Learning & Agent Intelligence
  • Develop, evaluate, and improve machine learning and generative AI solutions that power Intermedia's Digital Agent Platform.
  • Apply large language models (LLMs), natural language processing, retrieval, and other advanced AI techniques to improve agent understanding and performance.
  • Develop approaches that improve agent reasoning, tool selection, knowledge retrieval, context management, personalization, and task completion.
  • Experiment with model, prompt, retrieval, and agent configuration strategies to identify approaches that deliver the best customer and business outcomes.
  • Evaluate commercial and open-source models and recommend appropriate approaches based on quality, latency, scalability, and cost.
Generative AI & RAG
  • Design, develop, and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions that ground digital agents in relevant enterprise and customer information.
  • Develop and evaluate embeddings, retrieval strategies, ranking approaches, semantic search, and other knowledge-retrieval techniques.
  • Build and refine end-to-end pipelines that combine LLMs with retrieval systems, enterprise knowledge sources, and agent workflows.
  • Develop approaches to improve the relevance, accuracy, and consistency of AI-generated responses.
  • Identify and mitigate issues such as hallucinations, poor retrieval, inappropriate responses, and other failure modes in generative AI applications.
Evaluation & Experimentation
  • Develop rigorous evaluation frameworks for measuring digital agent quality, including accuracy, relevance, task completion, reliability, safety, and customer experience.
  • Design offline and online experiments to compare models, prompts, retrieval strategies, agent configurations, and other AI approaches.
  • Apply statistical analysis, hypothesis testing, segmentation, and other quantitative methods to evaluate AI performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Define appropriate metrics and benchmarks that connect model and agent performance to customer and business outcomes.
  • Analyze production behavior and feedback to identify patterns, failure modes, and opportunities to continuously improve digital agents.
  • Ensure data and model quality through comprehensive testing, validation, and performance evaluation.
Data & Solution Development
  • Gather, preprocess, analyze, and model large volumes of structured and unstructured data from multiple sources.
  • Use Python, SQL, Spark, and other relevant technologies to build scalable analytical and machine learning solutions.
  • Develop features, datasets, and analytical approaches that support model development, experimentation, and evaluation.
  • Partner with data and engineering teams to build and maintain reliable pipelines for model training, evaluation, and production use.
  • Contribute to scalable ML/AI pipelines that support experimentation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure solutions are reproducible, maintainable, and designed to operate effectively at production scale.
Collaboration
  • Partner with Product, AI/ML Engineering, Software Engineering, and other Data Science team members to translate customer and business problems into effective AI solutions.
  • Communicate analytical findings, model performance, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Participate in technical and design reviews and help establish strong practices for AI experimentation, evaluation, and model development.
  • Mentor and support less experienced data scientists and contribute to knowledge sharing across the team.

What You Will Bring to the Role

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Machine Learning, Analytics, or a related quantitative field; Master's degree preferred.
  • 4+ years of professional experience in data science, machine learning, applied AI, or a related analytical field.
  • Strong experience developing and applying supervised and unsupervised machine learning models to real-world problems.
  • Hands-on experience with generative AI, large language models, NLP, or other modern AI technologies.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and experience with SQL and large-scale data processing technologies.
  • Experience with modern machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, or equivalent technologies.
  • Strong understanding of statistical analysis, experimentation, hypothesis testing, model evaluation, and performance measurement.
  • Experience working with large volumes of structured and unstructured data.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently frame ambiguous problems, develop analytical approaches, evaluate alternatives, and deliver actionable solutions.
  • Experience taking machine learning or AI solutions beyond experimentation and contributing to their deployment and operation in production environments.
  • Understanding of model quality, data quality, bias, reliability, and other considerations associated with production AI systems.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with the ability to connect technical results to customer and business outcomes.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain complex analytical and AI concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across Data Science, AI/ML Engineering, Software Engineering, Product, and business teams.

  • Hands-on experience with Workday REST/SOAP APIs.

The Chief Legal Officer (CLO) is the senior legal executive responsible for overseeing the organization's legal strategy, governance, regulatory compliance, corporate affairs, and risk management. 1. Legal Strategy & Executive Advisory

  • Serve as the principal legal advisor to the CEO, Board, and executive leadership team.
  • Develop and execute the organization's legal strategy in alignment with business objectives.
  • Provide legal guidance on strategic initiatives, mergers and acquisitions, partnerships, and corporate restructuring.
  • Anticipate and mitigate legal risks associated with business operations and growth.

2. Corporate Governance

  • Ensure compliance with corporate governance standards and best practices.
  • Advise the Board and executive leadership on fiduciary responsibilities and governance matters.
  • Manage board resolutions, corporate records, and governance policies.
  • Support corporate secretarial functions where applicable.

3. Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management

  • Oversee enterprise-wide legal and regulatory compliance programs.

  • Manage litigation strategy and external legal counsel relationships.
  • Oversee dispute resolution, arbitration, mediation, and regulatory investigations.
  • Assess litigation exposure and recommend appropriate legal actions.
  • Ensure effective management of legal claims and liabilities.

6. Mergers, Acquisitions & Corporate Transactions

  • Lead legal due diligence for mergers, acquisitions, joint ventures, and investments.
  • Structure transactions to minimize legal and regulatory risk.
  • Manage external advisors and legal workstreams throughout transaction lifecycles.

  • Promote a culture of ethics, integrity, and compliance.

The senior Full-Stack Engineer will be an integral part of our Engineering teams in EMEA.This role is based remotely as a full-time employee in the UK, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands, Sweden and Israel. We are also open to contractors in Eastern Europe and Portugal.

Who We Are
DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production.
Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency.
With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The OpportunityAI is the fastest-growing line on our customers' cloud bills - and the hardest one to see. Model APIs, managed inference, GPUs, and a growing fleet of agentic coding tools each report spend differently, and most teams still can't answer the basic questions: what are we spending, on which workloads, for which teams, and is it worth it. Our AI cost visibility product, part of DoiT Cloud Intelligence, exists to answer them.
We're hiring a Senior Full-Stack Engineer into our R&D team to own this product end-to-end - from the Go services that ingest and model AI spend, through the APIs that expose it, to the React interfaces where FinOps practitioners and platform engineers make decisions. This is a young product in a category being defined right now. You'll shape how it works, not just implement someone else's spec, and there is a short line from your work to what customers see.
You'll work AI-augmented from day one. We expect you to use AI across your whole workflow - not as an occasional autocomplete - and to have real opinions about where it earns its place and where it doesn't.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-moving market - you can figure out the right problem to solve, not just the right solution

OpenFn is the Digital Public Good for public service automation & AI orchestration. Our platform automates data exchange and digital workflows so that governments and NGOs can deliver public services more efficiently, achieve interoperability across fragmented systems, and scale critical public services across government, health and humanitarian programs.

Our team, Open Function Group, the primary steward of this open-source platform, is a lean, fully-remote social enterprise, with a team of integration specialists, solution architects, and implementation consultants working across 15+ countries.

We are not making marginal improvements to already comfortable lives. We are building the infrastructure that allows governments to function, clinics to operate, and vulnerable populations to access services they depend on.

The role

We're hiring a Marketing Director to own and grow OpenFn's brand, both online and in-person amongst our target audience of Governments, Implementation Partners and Funders across the Digital Public Infrastructure and Digital Public Goods ecosystem.

OpenFn has a strong existing reputation across the ecosystem and this hire will be crucial in our next phase of growth. You will make changes to our brand positioning through website updates and marketing campaigns that will demonstrate clear return on investment for the role and its activities. You will help generate new leads for the rest of our growing Business Development unit and you will increase awareness about the incredible social impact and social services work that our team and product is already supporting.

You'll be based in Sub-Saharan Africa, but this is a global role. We have a strong footprint in Africa (French and English), as well as across LAC (Spanish). You will own the strategy and execution of marketing across those regions.

What you'll be doing

Own Brand and Positioning

  • Own and maintain our OpenFn Website as our primary marketing asset: messaging, structure, content, and conversion paths. We'll give you all the LLM and agentic coding capability you need to get the job done, provided you can show return on investment. The website will be yours.
  • Sharpen OpenFn's positioning for our three core audiences: governments, implementation partners, and funders across the DPI and DPG ecosystem
  • Own and maintain our brand and style, including our /openfn-brand-guidelines Claude Skill, so that content generated across the team stays consistent and on-brand
  • Ensure our language is credible with ministries and digital transformation units, and reflects that governments own their initiatives and OpenFn supports them

Generate demand and qualified leads

  • Design and run marketing campaigns that generate qualified inbound leads for the Growth UInit, across Africa (French and English) and LAC (Spanish)
  • Own the top of the funnel: SEO, AEO, content, email, events, and paid experiments if needed
  • Work with the Head of Growth and Partner Program Director to make sure inbound is routed, tracked, and followed up
  • Report on marketing performance against pipeline contribution, and be able to show clear return on the role's activities

Tell the impact story

  • Turn our own work and partners' work into case studies, blog posts, talks, and campaign materials
  • Build a repeatable content engine: a regular publishing cadence across the OpenFn blog, Community, LinkedIn and social channels
  • Grow OpenFn's presence and following amongst the DPG and DPI community, including our open source community

Show up in the ecosystem

  • Propose, plan, and run events (in-person or webinars), and represent OpenFn at ecosystem convenings, government digital transformation events, and DPG community moments (10-15% travel)
  • Secure speaking slots, panels, and co-marketing opportunities with partners, funders, and DPG peers
  • Build relationships with ecosystem media, newsletters, and movement shapers in the DPI space

Build the marketing function

  • Define and own a clear Marketing Strategy for building and positioning the OpenFn Brand, so that our capabilities and offering are clearly communicated and understood
  • Help design and own the marketing budget and make deliberate, evidence-based calls about where it goes, with clear evidence of return on investment
  • Put in place the analytics, CRM hygiene, and reporting we need to know what's working
  • Shape what this function looks like as it grows and make the clear case for additional resource based on clear return on investment

What you'll not do

  • You won't run a large team. This is a hands-on, build-it-yourself role to begin with. There will be budget you can pitch for, but no direct reports on day one.
  • You won't do internal comms or employer branding as a primary focus. You may occasionally help, but your mandate is external.
  • You won't close deals. You'll generate and nurture demand; other parts of our Growth Team owns qualification, proposals, closing and ongoing management.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in marketing, with a track record of owning brand, positioning, and demand generation for a technology product or platform
  • Demonstrable experience generating qualified leads and pipeline, and reporting on marketing's contribution to revenue
  • Familiarity with digital public goods, digital public infrastructure, or open source software, and the communities around them
  • Strong writing skills: you can produce clear, credible copy for senior government and funder audiences without a copywriter (including keeping LLMs in check so that our brand voice is always nice to read)
  • Hands-on experience owning a website end to end, including CMS, SEO, AEO, analytics, and conversion
  • Experience executing campaigns across multiple regions and languages
  • Technical understanding of software tools, particularly those used in Software Automation, AI Agentic Management, system integration and workflow automation, sufficient to write credibly for technical and non-technical audiences alike
  • Comfort operating with a small budget and making sharp prioritisation calls about where it goes
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a small, fully-remote team across multiple time zones
  • Fluent, professional-level communication skills in English and one other language (Spanish or French), with the ability to work effectively across a distributed, multicultural team
  • Reliable access to a quiet, dedicated remote workspace with strong, stable internet connectivity sufficient for daily video calls and cloud-based collaboration

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working within the social impact sector or with organizations across industries such as government digital transformation, health, humanitarian response, environmental protection
  • Experience in a start-up or growing company, where you have helped successfully build out a Marketing function before
  • Experience marketing to public sector buyers, and an understanding of how procurement and donor funding cycles shape demand
  • Experience marketing complex digital transformation, business process transformation, or data integration work
  • Working proficiency in both French and Spanish
  • Experience building a marketing function from a standing start, rather than joining an established one
  • You're a generalist!

Benefits
