jobs.title: Director, FP&A - Revenue & GTM
jobs.excerpt: KLDiscovery is a leading global provider of eDiscovery, information governance, and data recovery solutions, serving AmLaw 100 firms, Fortune 500 corporations, and government agencies.
jobs.description:
KLDiscovery is a leading global provider of eDiscovery, information governance, and data recovery solutions, serving AmLaw 100 firms, Fortune 500 corporations, and government agencies. Our Nebula and RelOne platforms deliver SaaS-based legal technology underpinned by managed services and professional services — a complex, multi-revenue-stream business requiring sharp financial leadership to scale effectively.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Director of FP&A — Revenue & GTM will serve as the strategic financial partner to the Chief Revenue Officer, sales leadership, and go-to-market teams. This individual owns the end-to-end revenue planning process across KLDiscovery's three primary revenue streams: SaaS/subscription (Nebula / RelOne), Managed Services, and Professional Services. The role sits at the intersection of finance and revenue operations — requiring both the analytical depth of a seasoned FP&A professional and the operational command of a sales ops leader capable of driving process hygiene, pipeline integrity, SFDC governance, and commissions accuracy.

This is a high-visibility role that will directly shape how the company forecasts, prices, and measures revenue performance as it transitions from usage-based to subscription billing and prepares for a potential refinancing event. Salary range for the position is 175-195,000 USD person annum.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Revenue Planning & Forecasting

  • Own the end-to-end revenue forecast model covering SaaS ARR/MRR, Managed Services recurring revenue, and Professional Services project revenue, with full waterfall from bookings through recognized revenue

  • Develop and maintain a rolling 12-month revenue forecast updated monthly in collaboration with CRO, regional VPs, and Sales Ops

  • Lead weekly and monthly forecast review calls with sales leadership, holding teams accountable to pipeline hygiene, stage progression, and close-date accuracy

  • Build and maintain ASC 606 compliant revenue recognition models, including SSP allocation across performance obligations and deferred revenue schedules for the SaaS-to-subscription transition

  • Produce scenario analyses (upside/downside/base) for leadership and board consumption, clearly articulating key revenue risks and opportunities

Sales Operations & CRM Governance

  • Partner with CRO and Sales Ops to own the Salesforce (SFDC) data governance framework — enforcing field hygiene, pipeline stage definitions, opportunity validation rules, and close-date discipline

  • Design and enforce the Quota Coverage Review (QCR) process, identifying coverage gaps, concentration risks, and capacity shortfalls in the annual sales plan

  • Lead territory design and quota-setting processes for the annual plan, in collaboration with HR, Sales Leadership, and Compensation teams

  • Build and maintain the revenue operations reporting stack: pipeline velocity, win/loss analysis, ACV by segment, sales cycle analytics, logo retention, and net revenue retention (NRR)

  • Act as the finance liaison for any CRM optimization or ERP/CRM integration work, ensuring system changes support accurate revenue reporting

  • Lead or partner on Order-to-Cash (O2C) integration initiatives — mapping and improving the end-to-end flow from opportunity creation in SFDC through CPQ, order management, billing, AR, and cash application in the ERP (Oracle); identify and close data gaps that cause revenue leakage, billing errors, or AR aging issues

  • Partner with IT, Sales Ops, and Accounting to design O2C workflows that support the subscription billing transition on Nebula/RelOne, including automated invoicing triggers, dunning logic, and deferred revenue hand-offs between systems

Commissions & Incentive Compensation

  • Own the monthly commissions calculation and reconciliation process, partnering with Sales Ops and HR to validate attainment and payout accuracy

  • Maintain commission capitalization schedules under ASC 340-40, ensuring proper amortization of incremental contract acquisition costs in accordance with company policy

  • Evaluate and recommend improvements to incentive compensation plan (ICP) design to align rep behavior with ARR growth, multi-year deal structuring, and professional services attach rates

  • Implement or enhance commissions management tooling (e.g., CaptivateIQ, Xactly, or SFDC-native solutions) to improve accuracy, auditability, and timeliness of payouts

GTM Financial Partnership & Strategic Analysis

  • Serve as the dedicated financial business partner to the CRO and GTM leadership team, participating in QBRs, sales all-hands, and strategic planning sessions

  • Analyze customer economics: CAC, LTV, payback period, NRR, gross and net churn by product line and customer segment

  • Build financial models to evaluate pricing changes, new product launches, bundle constructs, and professional services pricing for managed services engagements

  • Support M&A due diligence and refinancing workstreams by providing normalized ARR schedules, revenue quality analysis, and cohort data

  • Evaluate and support the build-out of FP&A systems infrastructure (Adaptive Insights, Anaplan, or equivalent) to improve forecast automation and reduce manual model maintenance

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • 10–12+ years of progressive finance experience, with at least 5+ years in FP&A roles supporting revenue or GTM functions at a SaaS, legal tech, or B2B technology company

  • Direct experience owning revenue forecast processes across multiple revenue streams, including SaaS subscription, managed services, and professional/consulting services

  • Demonstrated experience working within or alongside Sales Operations, including CRM governance (Salesforce), pipeline reporting, and territory/quota design

  • Hands-on commissions management experience, including calculation, dispute resolution, and capitalization accounting under ASC 340-40

  • Working knowledge of ASC 606 revenue recognition, including multi-element arrangements, SSP allocation, and deferred revenue waterfall modeling

  • Expert-level financial modeling skills in Excel; experience with EPM/FP&A platforms — Oracle PBCS strongly preferred for planning and forecasting infrastructure; familiarity with FCCS a plus

  • Demonstrated experience leading or supporting Order-to-Cash (O2C) process integration — including system connectivity between CRM (SFDC), CPQ, ERP (Oracle/NetSuite), and billing platforms — with an eye toward revenue data integrity, AR automation, and cash application accuracy

  • Strong executive presence with the ability to lead cross-functional forecast calls and challenge CRO-level stakeholders with data

Preferred

  • Experience in legal technology, eDiscovery, information governance, or adjacent B2B SaaS verticals

  • Prior exposure to PE-backed company environments, QofE processes, or leveraged capital structure reporting

  • CPA, CFA, or MBA from a top program

  • Familiarity with commissions automation platforms (CaptivateIQ, Xactly, Spiff)

  • Experience supporting or leading a transition from usage-based to subscription billing models

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN YEAR ONE

  • Revenue forecast accuracy within ±3% of actuals for 3 consecutive quarters

  • SFDC pipeline data governance framework deployed with measurable improvement in data quality scores

  • Commissions process fully documented and automated with zero material errors in quarterly payouts

  • ASC 606 compliant revenue recognition model built and validated for Nebula/RelOne subscription transition

  • QCR analysis embedded as a standing agenda item in monthly CRO leadership reviews

  • NRR and logo churn metrics published monthly with full cohort-level breakdowns

WHO THRIVES HERE

You're someone who doesn't wait to be asked — you see a broken process and you fix it. You can walk into a sales QBR, challenge a VP's pipeline assumptions with data, and leave the room having earned their trust. You're comfortable owning both the model and the meeting. You understand that in a PE-backed legal tech environment, every slide you build might end up in front of a lender or an investor — and you build accordingly.

jobs.excerpt: Who We Are:SmithRx is a rapidly growing, venture-backed Health-Tech company.
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

SmithRx is a rapidly growing, venture-backed Health-Tech company. Our mission is to disrupt the expensive and inefficient Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) sector by building a next-generation drug acquisition platform driven by cutting edge technology, innovative cost saving tools, and best-in-class customer service. With hundreds of thousands of members onboarded since 2016, SmithRx has a solution that is resonating with clients all across the country.

We pride ourselves for our mission-driven and collaborative culture that inspires our employees to do their best work. We believe that the U.S healthcare system is in need of transformation, and we come to work each day dedicated to making that change a reality. At our core, we are guided by our company values:

  • Integrity: Our purpose guides our actions and gives us confidence in the path ahead. With unwavering honesty and dependability, we embrace the pressure of challenging the old and exemplify ethical leadership to create the new.
  • Courage: We face continuous challenges with grit and resilience. We embrace the discomfort of the unknown by balancing autonomy with empathy, and ownership with vulnerability. We boldly challenge the status quo to keep moving forward—always.
  • Together: The success of SmithRx reflects the strength of our partnerships and the commitment of our team. Our shared values bind us together and make us one. When one falls, we all fall; when one rises, we all rise.

Job Summary:

We are looking for an entrepreneurial, highly experimental VP of Growth Marketing to build and scale our revenue engine in the Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) space. PBM is a huge market that never got modern growth marketing. The job is to bring the gold standards other industries take for granted to one that isn't using them, and find the levers specific to how this market buys. Lots of ground to take.

In this role, you will build a team and a function dedicated to discovering, testing, and scaling the unique growth and engagement tactics that win in our industry. Managing a small but growing team, you will architect a culture of rapid experimentation, holding a healthy tolerance for failure as long as it drives fast, actionable learning.

What you will do:

  • Architect an Experimentation Engine: Build a culture of high-velocity testing across messaging, channels, and outreach strategies. Manage a rigorous pipeline of growth experiments, pivoting quickly from failures and scaling what works.
  • Discover PBM-Specific Growth Levers: Work with Sales and Product to find the channels and partnership loops that land with complex healthcare buyers and the brokers who advise them. Build for both motions: selling direct to employers, and winning through the broker channel that drives much of PBM selection. It's regulated, so build compliance in as you go.
  • Manage & Scale a Hybrid Team: Run Growth as GTM Engineering: Lead the current Growth Ops and BDR team toward sharper targeting and automation. Build a human-and-agent operating model: agents doing research and personalization at scale, people directing strategy and creative.
  • Build a Technical Growth Pod: Empower this technical pod to build bespoke internal growth tools, engineer new acquisition loops, and test technical hypotheses that standard marketers can't execute.

What you will bring to SmithRx:

  • Creative and rigorous: You have the ability to generate bold, high-variance ideas. You also hold them to hard measurement. Both halves matter: the creative swings, and the discipline to know which ones actually worked.
  • First-Principles Thinker: You don't just copy/paste the B2B SaaS playbook. You have a proven ability to evaluate complex, nuanced markets (like healthcare, fintech, etc) and design bespoke growth strategies from scratch.
  • Scientific Mindset: You treat growth as a science. You have a strong track record of designing rigorous tests, a high tolerance for failed experiments, and a relentless focus on capturing and applying learnings.
  • Full-Funnel & Outbound Expertise: You understand how to experiment with outbound sales cadences, BDR metrics, and pipeline generation just as well as digital acquisition.
  • Technical Acumen: You know how to deploy technical talent (Growth PMs and Developers) to build programmatic growth engines, run complex tests, and bypass traditional marketing limitations.
  • AI-Powered Experimentation: You go past using ChatGPT to write emails. You use AI/LLM agents for account research and personalized outbound at scale (Clay, Cargo, agent tooling), and you build the team around that model.
  • Growth Architecture: You are comfortable designing workflows across modern growth stacks. You have hands-on experience with advanced data enrichment, behavioral product analytics (e.g., PostHog, Amplitude), intent-signaling platforms, and conversion optimization tools (e.g., Mutiny, VWO).
  • No-Code / Low-Code Operations: You and your Growth Ops lead can move fast without waiting on IT. You know how to use modern LLM platforms to build the tools and infrastructure you need.
  • Proven Leader with Hands-On Experience: 8+ years of experience in growth marketing, demand generation, or revenue operations at a high-growth, venture-backed startup.

jobs.description:
Commercial Project Manager


BRIEF DESCRIPTION OF SUNSTRONG MANAGEMENT
SunStrong Management is a leading independent asset management and servicing platform specializing in residential and commercial solar energy portfolios. SunStrong provides end-to-end services including operations and maintenance, customer billing and support, asset performance management, and investor reporting. The company partners with leading capital providers to optimize clean energy assets at scale, supporting the growth of distributed renewable energy while delivering reliable performance and exceptional customer experience.


THE COMMERCIAL PROJECT MANAGER POSITION

SunStrong Management is searching for a Commercial Project Manager (PM) responsible for the end-to-end planning, execution, and delivery of commercial & industrial (C&I) and utility-scale solar projects, including re-powering initiatives, major remediation work, and battery energy storage system (BESS) installations. This is a remote role overseeing multiple concurrent projects, ensuring they are completed safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with quality standards, contractual obligations, and customer expectations. The PM works cross-functionally with various engineering, procurement, construction, O&M, safety, asset management, subcontractors, and landowners to ensure smooth execution and high-quality project delivery.

COMMERCIAL PROJECT MANAGER RESPONSIBILITIES

Project Planning & Pre-Construction

  • Lead development of project schedules, budgets, scopes of work, and risk assessments for C&I and utility-scale solar and BESS projects with Field Service Partners.
  • Conduct site assessments, walkdowns, and constructability reviews for re-powering scopes and remediation activities.
  • Develop project execution plans, staffing plans, QA/QC plans, and safety plans.
  • Coordinate design reviews and ensure engineering deliverables support the scope of work.
  • Support procurement activities, supplier evaluations, and material forecasting.

Project Execution & Delivery

  • Oversee all field work, subcontractor performance, and construction progress.
  • Manage construction activities including module swaps, inverter refreshes, RSD retrofits, tracker repairs, BOS replacements, and BESS installations.
  • Ensure adherence to NEC, IEEE, UL, AHJ requirements, and utility rules.
  • Monitor project progress, production rates, and sequencing.
  • Facilitate project meetings and resolve field issues, RFIs, and conflicts.

Safety & Compliance

  • Enforce site safety requirements and compliance with OSHA, NFPA 70E, and internal safety programs.
  • Oversee JHAs, PEC/LOTO requirements, tailboard meetings, and incident reporting.
  • Ensure subcontractor alignment with safety standards.

Contract & Financial Management

  • Manage project budgets, cost reporting, forecasting, and revenue recognition.
  • Oversee contracts, change orders, purchase orders, and vendor invoicing.
  • Track scope deviations and negotiate change orders.
  • Ensure projects meet margin targets and financial KPIs.

Commissioning & Closeout

  • Coordinate commissioning for solar and BESS systems.
  • Manage QA/QC punch lists, inverter startups, EMS/SCADA integration, and utility witness testing.
  • Ensure delivery of as-builts, manuals, reports, warranties, and training.
  • Lead lessons-learned reviews.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction management, renewable energy, or related field preferred.
  • 3+ years of C&I or utility-scale solar project management experience.
  • Experience with BESS deployments strongly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of electrical systems, trackers, BOS, civil/structural work.
  • Proficiency with MS Project, P6, Procore, or Smartsheet.
  • Strong financial, communication, and leadership skills.
  • Ability to travel as needed.


Benefits
SunStrong Management offers a rich and affordable Health & Wellness Benefits package that includes:
  • PPO and HDHP Medical Plans, buy-up plans for both Dental and Vision, ancillaries such as Accident, Critical illness, Hospital indemnity, Employer sponsored Short Term and Long-Term Disability, Voluntary Life, and Legal services along with multiple add-ons.
  • Our 401(k) Package includes a Safe Harbor Match of 100% up to the first 4% and 50% on the next 2% with immediate vesting.

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT QUINCEQuince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo.
jobs.description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Head of Inventory Control and Strategy

Quince is seeking a seasoned inventory control expert to run our global inventory control program from the ground up. You will own the standards, playbook, and governance that underpin inventory integrity across our entire growing global fulfillment network.

Responsibilities

Inventory Accuracy & Shrink Control

  • Own book vs. physical accuracy targets across all global nodes
  • Shrink control frameworks — identifying, quantifying, and remediating inventory loss at every point of the supply chain

Cycle Count Governance

  • Execute the global cycle count cadence strategy
  • Oversee counts and audit protocols across all facilities and 3PL partners

Reconciliation & Adjustment Root Cause

  • Own the inventory adjustment governance model
  • Drive cross-functional root cause analysis on systemic variances across all functions
  • Maintain SOX-compliant inventory controls, including documented approval thresholds, audit trails for adjustments, and segregation of duties across the reconciliation process
  • Reduce unresolved adjustment volume quarter over quarter with measurable targets

WMS Integrity

  • Ensure inventory records in WMS accurately reflect physical reality at all times
  • Partner with technology and operations teams to identify and close data integrity gaps, latency issues, and process breakdowns within the WMS

Global SOP Design & Process Infrastructure

  • Author and maintain the global inventory control SOP library — policies, procedures, escalation paths, and training frameworks
  • Drive consistency of execution across domestic and international nodes

Qualifications

Required:

  • 7+ years in inventory control, fulfillment operations, or supply chain at a high-volume retailer, e-commerce operator, or logistics company
  • Experience maintaining SOX compliance for inventory processes, including control documentation and coordination with internal/external audit
  • Deep WMS expertise, having configured, audited, and conducted troubleshooting of WMS inventory records, not just used the system
  • Proven ability to build global or multi-site SOPs from scratch and drive adoption across distributed teams
  • Strong analytics literacy: you can write SQL, build a reconciliation model in a spreadsheet, and tell a story with inventory data without needing a data analyst as an intermediary
  • Experience managing 3PL relationships and holding external partners accountable

Preferred:

  • Experience operating across international fulfillment nodes (APAC, EMEA, or global 3PL networks)
  • Familiarity with a variety of WMS platforms
  • Background in audit, finance-adjacent inventory controls, or shrink investigation

Pay Range: $170,000-$220,000

All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles.

Pay Range
$170,000—$220,000 USD

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

The Position

Title: Department Chair, Health Science Programs

Position Type: Full-time

Requisition No: 27005

Category: Faculty

Job Purpose: The Department Chair, in collaboration with the Dean of Learning and

Instruction, ensures the workforce relevancy, quality, and continuous

improvement of Calbright Health Science Programs.

Location: Remote, various locations throughout California
Salary Range: Faculty salary schedule placement (depending on qualification and

education) + 15% $95,830.65 - $132,067.15

** The first review of the application shall occur approximately on 10/12/2026 **

Position Overview

The Department Chair position supports Calbright College’s mission to offer competency-based, workforce-relevant programs for adult learners through high-impact andragogical practices in online, skills-based curriculum and assessment. In collaboration with the Dean of Learning and Instruction, the Department Chair ensures program quality, workforce relevancy, and continuous improvement of the Health Science Programs.

The Department Chair provides leadership for Health Science program planning, implementation, workforce alignment, and continuous improvement. The Chair works collaboratively with faculty, industry partners, accrediting agencies, and healthcare organizations to ensure programs meet workforce demands, regulatory requirements, and industry standards. The position supports program development, approval processes, the identification of experiential learning opportunities, healthcare partnerships, and advisory council engagement to ensure graduates are prepared for employment in high-demand healthcare fields.

Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities

The duties below are representative of the role and are not intended to cover all of the
duties performed within the scope of work.

  • Collaborate with Learning and Instruction leadership to support program approval
    processes, including state, accreditation, certification, and regulatory requirements applicable to Health Science programs.
  • Monitor healthcare industry trends, workforce demands, certification requirements, and regulatory changes to ensure the program's ongoing relevance and compliance.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to support the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of Health Science programs utilizing competency-based and skills-based learning models.
  • Leads regular program-level meetings to review program quality, continuous improvement, and student success metrics and data.
  • Works with cross-functional teams (including program faculty and staff) to ensure program outcomes, assessment measures, and course content are rigorous, responsive, and relevant to workforce skills and needs. Support Adjunct Faculty in setting annual SMART goals to support student success.
  • Oversee adjunct faculty in the assigned department area, including performing quarterly and annual reviews, approving timesheets, training, mentorship, referring student cases, and assisting with escalations. Reviews and monitors student and course feedback to ensure the student voice is represented, and provides recommendations for content and program improvements.
  • Lead the program review process by overseeing review cycles, collecting and analyzing data, engaging stakeholders for input, and preparing comprehensive reports to support continuous improvement and informed decision-making.
  • Leads with a data-informed mindset to validate quality, analyze student outcomes data, and contribute to trend analysis and metric tracking across programs.
  • Support the identification, evaluation, development, and maintenance of clinical, practicum, internship, apprenticeship, and other experiential learning opportunities aligned with program outcomes and accreditation requirements.
  • Collaborate with external partners to ensure experiential learning environments provide appropriate opportunities for student skill development and workforce readiness.
  • Lead Health Science Advisory Councils and engage healthcare employers, licensing bodies, workforce agencies, and industry experts to ensure program alignment with workforce needs, credentialing requirements, emerging healthcare trends, and industry-recognized certifications.
  • Develop and maintain partnerships with healthcare organizations, employers, professional associations, and workforce agencies to support student success and workforce alignment.
  • Maintain relevance in the discipline, including but not limited to certifications, professional development, and networking.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned that support the objective of the position.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • In-depth knowledge in one or more department program areas.
  • Knowledge of and commitment to competency-based education and assessment forward design.
  • Knowledge of healthcare workforce trends, healthcare delivery systems, regulatory requirements, and industry-recognized credentials.
  • Knowledge of healthcare program accreditation, certification, and approval processes.
  • Ability to develop and maintain productive partnerships with healthcare organizations, employers, workforce boards, and professional associations.
  • Knowledge of experiential learning, clinical education, internship, practicum, and work-based learning models.
  • Ability to interpret labor market information and workforce data to support program development and continuous improvement.
  • Knowledge of program review processes, outcomes assessment, and key performance metrics.
  • Working knowledge of program development/design and performance metrics
  • Collaboration and the ability to work across teams toward a unified goal.
  • Effective communicator and resolution-oriented towards students if/as appropriate within the program(s).
  • Effectively communicates and collaborates with fellow faculty members within
    and across disciplines and programs.
  • An innovative and student-centric thought leader in discipline and industry practice.
  • Capable of leading and promoting change management.
  • Demonstrate understanding of, sensitivity to, and respect for the diverse academic, socio-economic, ethnic, religious, and cultural backgrounds, disability, and sexual orientation of community college students, staff, and faculty.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Baccalaureate degree in Nursing, Allied Health, Health Sciences, Public Health, Healthcare Administration, or a related health discipline.
  • Minimum three years of professional experience in healthcare, health sciences education, workforce development, healthcare administration, or a closely related field.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting program quality, curriculum development, workforce alignment, regulatory compliance, or student success initiatives.

Desired Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Nursing, Health Sciences, Public Health, Healthcare Administration, Healthcare Education, or a related discipline.
  • Current professional licensure or certification in an applicable healthcare field.
  • Experience with healthcare accreditation, certification, or board approval
    processes.
  • Experience developing partnerships with healthcare employers, clinical organizations, workforce agencies, or industry stakeholders.
  • Experience with competency-based education, skills-based learning, or
    workforce-focused educational models.
  • Online teaching, online program administration, or adult learning experience.
  • Experience leading advisory councils, workforce advisory boards, or employer
    engagement initiatives.

Working Conditions and Travel

  • Calbright College is a statewide online college where all instruction and support are done via various online technologies both in person and remotely. Calbright College has administrative offices in Sacramento available for use. When working remotely, employees should be able and willing to use the digital communication tools used by the college and to work on a computer for extended periods. Although this is a primarily remote position, there may be instances in which you will be required to attend meetings or travel to in-person sites (clinical affiliates).
  • Regular attendance is considered an essential job function; the inability to meet attendance requirements may preclude the employee from retaining employment.
  • The person holding this position is considered a mandated reporter under the California Child Abuse and Neglect Reporting Act and is required to comply with
    the requirements set forth in Calbright College policies, procedures, and Title IX.
  • Calbright College celebrates all forms of diversity and is deeply committed to fostering an inclusive environment within which students, staff, administrators, and faculty thrive. Individuals interested in advancing Calbright College’s strategic diversity goals are strongly encouraged to apply. Reasonable accommodations will be provided for qualified applicants with disabilities who self-disclose.
  • Requires the ability to function in a remote online instructional environment, performing work of primarily a sedentary nature. Requires the ability to use hearing and speech to make presentations to groups and carry on conversations over the phone and in-person. Requires speaking skills to communicate with staff and students in one-on-one and small group settings, on the phone, and to distinguish sound prompts from various types of equipment. Requires near visual acuity to read printed materials and computer screens. Requires sufficient hand/arm/finger dexterity to retrieve work materials, operate a personal computer keyboard, and operate standard office equipment. Requires the ability to lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.
  • Work is performed indoors where minimal safety considerations exist.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Calbright College provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, age, veteran status, disability or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Calbright College complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment.

Who We Are

Calbright College is one of California’s newest community colleges – the first statewide, online campus designed to bridge the gap between employers with unfilled positions and students who don’t have either the time or money to attend a traditional school. Our mission is to increase economic mobility and close equity gaps for working adults who lack easy access to traditional forms of higher education by offering online, flexible, affordable skills-based programs that provide tangible economic value for both working adults and hiring managers.

Role-specific job summary

The Consultant, Process Management supports complex Standard Variable and Base Compensation plans that require advanced analytical capability, judgment, data validation, stakeholder consultation, and strong operational controls. The role will provide additional capacity and resilience across Base Commissions, Profit Share, OCP/EGP, and related compensation plans, including the transition of NWAG Profit Share from Finance.

The role is designed to absorb growing and newly transitioned work, strengthen co-plan ownership and backup coverage, reduce concentration of complex work among existing plan owners, and support accurate and timely compensation outcomes during recurring and peak processing periods.

Role-specific responsibilities

  • Serve as the Plan Owner for NWAG Profit Share as the plan transitions from Finance, including learning the existing process, documenting requirements and controls, stabilizing administration, and establishing sustainable co-owner and backup coverage.

  • Support ownership and co-ownership of complex Standard Variable and Base Compensation plans, including Base Commissions, Commercial Line Profit Share, Surety Profit Share, CL MM OCP, and related OCP/EGP work, based on the approved plan-owner alignment.

  • Provide additional validation and processing capacity for plans with high payment impact, complex calculations, multiple lines of business, or significant stakeholder visibility.

  • Learn and apply the business rules, system workflows, data dependencies, timing requirements, and historical context associated with assigned plans.

  • Perform complex calculations, data preparation, reconciliation, validation, and quality review using advanced Excel and other applicable tools.

  • Analyze plan results, identify discrepancies or unusual trends, determine root cause, and recommend corrective action before payments or results are finalized.

  • Participate in UAT, requirements clarification, defect research, and issue resolution for assigned plans and related technology changes.

  • Coordinate with plan owners, co-plan owners, backups, Compensation Design, Technology/IT, Finance, Business Insights, and business partners to resolve issues and maintain processing continuity.

  • Support the transition of appropriate recurring reporting to Business Insights while retaining the ability to produce ad hoc analysis and reporting needed for plan administration, validation, issue resolution, and commission-impact analysis.

  • Contribute to documentation, process standardization, knowledge transfer, and cross-training to reduce key-person dependency and improve plan resilience.

  • Establish and maintain clear ownership, co-ownership, backup, and escalation expectations for assigned plans.

  • Support peak-period capacity planning and flex across Standard Variable and Base Compensation work as demand, timing, and priorities change.

  • Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, or improve recurring calculations, validation, reporting, and documentation activities.

  • Contribute to continuous-improvement initiatives and recommend practical improvements that reduce manual effort, rework, operational risk, or processing time.

  • Participate in stakeholder communications and provide clear status, risks, decisions needed, and next steps for assigned work.

  • Perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Initial scope and expected placement

The role is expected to report to the Manager, Process Management and operate primarily within the Standard Variable and Base Compensation POD.

Initial work is expected to include:

  • NWAG Profit Share ownership following the Q4 transition from Finance

  • Base Commissions co-ownership and expanded backup depth

  • Commercial Line Profit Share co-ownership or ownership transition, as determined through onboarding and capacity planning

  • CL MM OCP ownership as the plan matures

  • Surety Profit Share co-ownership and related coverage

  • Additional support for OCP/EGP and other complex Standard Variable Compensation work during peak processing periods

The final plan-owner, co-plan-owner, and backup assignments will be maintained in the approved plan-owner documentation and may evolve as training, capacity, and business demand change.

Required capabilities and experience

  • Advanced Excel capability, including the ability to use formulas, data validation, reconciliation techniques, and analytical tools to evaluate complex compensation results. An Excel proficiency assessment is required as part of the hiring process.

  • Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to understand and administer complex compensation rules across multiple lines of business and processing cycles.

  • Ability to investigate discrepancies, interpret data, identify root causes, and make sound recommendations.

  • Comfort learning SAP-based workflows, manual processes, data dependencies, and technology-supported compensation administration.

  • Ability to participate effectively in UAT, requirements discussions, defect investigation, and technology change activities.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex compensation results and risks to nontechnical partners.

  • Ability to manage judgment-heavy, high-accuracy work under recurring and peak-season deadlines.

  • Ability to work across teams and build effective relationships with Compensation Design, Technology/IT, Finance, Business Insights, and business partners.

  • Willingness and ability to document processes, develop backup capability, and transfer knowledge to others.

  • Data Analytics certification is required for new team members, consistent with the team's evolving technical capability expectations.

Preferred experience

  • Experience in compensation, incentive administration, commissions, financial operations, payroll, or another high-accuracy operational environment.

  • Experience administering or analyzing variable compensation, profit share, commissions, or other complex financial calculations.

  • Experience with SAP, SQL, macros, Power BI, Power Automate, or similar data and automation tools.

  • Experience supporting technology implementations, UAT, requirements, defects, or process improvement.

  • Experience transitioning work between organizations or stabilizing a newly assumed process.

Job Description Summary

As a Consultant, you'll provide expertise on business and/or systems processes. You'll work on complex process analysis, design, implementation, execution or operational management. Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves

We're building competitive-programming problems and their automatic graders (test cases + checkers) used to train advanced AI coding models. You'll create problems, write both correct and deliberately-wrong solutions, and design the tough test cases that catch subtly-broken code. Your work is what makes the training signal trustworthy.

To apply, share: your competitive-programming handle(s) + current/peak rating, any problem-setting experience, and IOI/ICPC/olympiad history.

What you'll do

  • Write original algorithmic problems — clear statement, sound constraints, an intended solution;
  • Write correct solutions in C++ and Python;
  • Write realistic wrong solutions (common mistakes) to test against;
  • Build and harden test cases: generators, edge cases, stress and "hacking" tests;
  • Write checkers/interactors (testlib) for problems with more than one valid answer;

jobs.description:
Avec plus de 1 000 municipalités et MRC membres, la Fédération québécoise des municipalités (FQM) a pour mission de défendre les intérêts politiques et économiques des régions. Vous collaborerez à faire du Québec de demain le Québec de toutes les régions en permettant aux municipalités du territoire d’offrir des milieux de vie dynamiques et prospères à leurs citoyens, en leur donnant accès à des services de qualité, dans le respect des réalités régionales.

La Direction de l’évaluation foncière offre des services spécialisés aux municipalités et aux MRC partout au Québec, en assurant la gestion et la mise à jour des rôles d’évaluation. Elle réalise notamment l’équilibration des rôles, le maintien de l’inventaire physique et intervient à titre d’experte devant les tribunaux. Elle veille à l’exactitude, à l’équité et à la conformité des valeurs foncières. Par son expertise, elle contribue à la confiance envers le système de taxation municipale et soutient les organisations dans la compréhension et la gestion de leurs enjeux d’évaluation.

Nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e) télé-inspecteur(-trice) pour faire partie d’une équipe engagée qui répond aux besoins des municipalités et des régions, contribue à l’atteinte des objectifs de l’organisation et participe à faire en sorte que le Québec de demain soit le Québec de toutes les régions.

Mode de travail: télétravail

Horaire: 37.5 heures par semaine

TON QUOTIDIEN À LA FQM

Le (la) télé‑inspecteur(-trice) en évaluation foncière est responsable de réaliser, à distance et en mode virtuel, l’ensemble des activités de mise à jour du dossier de propriété nécessaires au processus de confection et de tenue à jour des rôles d’évaluation foncière. À l’aide d’outils numériques, de rencontres virtuelles avec les propriétaires, de formulaires d’auto-déclaration, de photos transmises et de documents techniques, la personne effectue le relevé et l’appréciation des caractéristiques physiques des immeubles résidentiels ou multi‑résidentiels assignés à sa division. Elle compile les données pertinentes, documente les dossiers, valide l’exactitude des informations et contribue à maintenir un inventaire complet et conforme aux normes en vigueur.

LE RÔLE QUI T’ATTEND

  • Réaliser les inspections virtuelles (permis, ventes, maintien d’inventaire) des propriétés résidentielles à l’aide de plateformes numériques et de rencontres vidéo avec les propriétaires;

  • Communiquer avec les propriétaires afin d’expliquer le processus, clarifier les éléments techniques et assurer un déroulement fluide et professionnel des inspections virtuelles;

  • Guider les propriétaires dans la prise de photos, de mesures ou de validations nécessaires à l’inspection;

  • Effectuer l’analyse et l’appréciation des caractéristiques physiques des bâtiments (dimensions, matériaux, composantes, état) à partir de l’information transmise;

  • Utiliser les formulaires d’auto‑évaluation et en assurer la compréhension, la collecte, la vérification et la mise à jour;

  • Réaliser des croquis informatiques et transmettre les instructions nécessaires aux propriétaires pour obtenir les informations complémentaires;

  • Documenter de manière exhaustive les dossiers d’inspection dans les systèmes informatisés;

  • Compléter les enquêtes de vente et mettre à jour les formulaires selon l’état physique déclaré ou démontré au moment de la transaction;

  • Effectuer la validation des données avant la fermeture de l’inspection selon les normes et directives établies;

  • Faire preuve de jugement pour identifier les dossiers nécessitant une inspection terrain par l’équipe spécialisée;

  • Exécuter, au besoin, toute autre tâche connexe pour soutenir les activités du service.

POURQUOI TE JOINDRE À NOUS?

Ce qui nous distingue:

  • Rémunération concurrentielle

  • Régime d’assurances collectives, incluant les protections dentaire et oculaire

  • Régime de retraite avec participation de l’employeur (5 % employeur; 5 % employé), flexible et adapté à ton avenir grâce aux options REER, CELIAPP ou une combinaison des deux

  • Un minimum de 3 semaines de vacances annuelles dès l’entrée en fonction

  • Banque de 6 congés personnels

  • Congés payés entre Noël et le jour de l’An

  • 13 journées fériées par année

Et plus encore :

  • Activités sociales et sportives

  • Programme de reconnaissance pour souligner les évènements professionnels et personnels importants

  • Accès à de la formation continue, notamment grâce à notre portail de formation pour les employés

  • Un environnement collaboratif riche en expertises diversifiées

LE PROFIL QU’ON RECHERCHE

  • Détenir une AEC ou un DEC en technologie de l’évaluation en bâtiment ou toute autre formation pertinente;

  • Bonne connaissance des matériaux de construction;

  • Aisance marquée avec les outils technologiques (appels vidéo, partage d’écran, prise de photos avec appareils mobiles);

  • Connaissance de la suite Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, Excel);

  • Connaître les applications informatiques liées à l’évaluation foncière (un atout);

  • Excellentes compétences en communication et sens du service client;

  • Capacité à travailler de manière autonome, organisée et efficace dans un environnement 100 % virtuel;

  • Avoir participé à des inspections ou relevés (un atout).

OpenFn works with a growing network of implementation partners, systems integrators, and digital transformation consultancies who deliver services to governments and NGOs and, in doing so, embed OpenFn into their own solutions. You won’t work directly with the ministries, digital transformation units, and NGOs who use OpenFn directly. Rather, you'll focus on the organizations who advise and implement for them, helping those partners succeed with OpenFn so that they, in turn, bring OpenFn to more of the customers they serve.

You'll be based in Sub-Saharan Africa and initially focused on partners across the region, but this is a global role: as OpenFn's partner network grows, we expect you to develop relationships with partner organizations beyond the continent as opportunities arise.

You'll own the full lifecycle of these relationships: identifying and onboarding new partners, training and enabling them to sell and implement OpenFn effectively, and growing the recurring revenue that flows through the partner channel. You’ll also be on the hook for designing and delivering a certification program that we can build a capability around, with the objective of achieving a scalable Partner Program.

Identify & onboard partners

Grow partner-driven revenue

  • Track partner pipeline and revenue performance, and report on it to OpenFn leadership
  • Identify opportunities to expand existing partner relationships into new countries, sectors, or accounts

Enable & support the partner network

  • Facilitate ongoing training and support to help partners understand and effectively sell and implement the OpenFn platform
  • Act as the primary relationship owner for OpenFn's most important partners, building trust with senior stakeholders on the partner side
  • Coordinate with OpenFn's product, services, and support teams so partners have what they need to succeed with their clients

Build & curate the partner community

  • Drive a regular cadence of partner calls, regional meetups, and content, including collaborative feature-prioritization sessions and opportunities to publish on the OpenFn Community
  • Gather feedback from partners on the program's effectiveness, and relay region-specific insights and opportunities to OpenFn leadership

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • A track record of identifying, onboarding, and managing a portfolio of partners and driving measurable revenue outcomes through them
  • Strong understanding of partnership ecosystems and incentive structures

  • You're a generalist!

Benefits

We are looking for an experienced Customer Service Manager to lead our Customer Service function and ensure a consistently high level of service throughout the customer journey.

This is a hands-on management role. In addition to supervising and developing the Customer Service team, you will personally manage complex customer situations, escalations, complaints, and service issues that require management-level attention.

Our business operates in a fast-paced container, logistics, and service environment where customer concerns may involve deliveries, container condition, modifications, repairs, billing, documentation, scheduling, or communication between departments.

The right person is proactive, organized, solution-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of difficult situations from the initial complaint through final resolution.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Service Leadership

  • Manage, coach, and support Customer Service team members.
  • Establish clear expectations for communication quality, response times, follow-ups, and case ownership.
  • Monitor team workload and ensure customer requests are assigned and handled appropriately.
  • Provide ongoing feedback, training, and performance support.
  • Develop and maintain Customer Service procedures, templates, escalation processes, and service standards.
  • Help create a culture where customer issues are owned rather than passed from one department to another.

Customer Complaints & Escalations

  • Serve as the primary escalation point for complex or dissatisfied customers.
  • Personally handle sensitive customer complaints and high-priority cases.
  • Investigate concerns by gathering information from relevant departments.
  • Communicate professionally with customers during difficult or high-pressure situations.
  • Establish clear expectations regarding timelines, solutions, and next steps.
  • Follow cases through until an appropriate resolution is reached.
  • Identify situations that require escalation to senior management.

Cross-Functional Coordination

Work closely with Sales, Dispatch, Operations, Production, Supply Chain, Accounting, Collections, and other departments to resolve customer concerns.

Issues may include:

  • Delivery delays or scheduling concerns
  • Container condition or quality complaints
  • Repairs or service requests
  • Container modifications
  • Missing or incorrect documentation
  • Billing or payment questions
  • Order discrepancies
  • Communication breakdowns
  • Service quality concerns
  • Post-sale customer support

The Customer Service Manager is expected to coordinate the resolution rather than simply redirecting the customer to another department.

Performance & KPIs

Establish, monitor, and report Customer Service performance metrics, including:

  • First response time
  • Average resolution time
  • Number of open customer cases
  • Aging of unresolved cases
  • Complaint volume
  • Escalation rate
  • Repeat complaints
  • Customer satisfaction
  • Case closure rate
  • Team productivity and responsiveness

Analyze recurring customer concerns and identify their root causes.

Provide management with recommendations for operational or process improvements when recurring problems are identified.

Process Improvement

  • Review current Customer Service processes and identify gaps.
  • Create clear workflows for inquiries, complaints, escalations, and follow-ups.
  • Implement appropriate tracking and reporting systems.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of customer interactions and resolutions.
  • Work with other departments to prevent recurring customer problems.
  • Identify opportunities to improve communication throughout the customer journey.
  • Provide management with regular reporting on customer trends, major complaints, risks, and improvement opportunities.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of Customer Service, Customer Success, Account Management, Operations, or related experience.
  • 2+ years of supervisory or management experience preferred.
  • Proven experience handling difficult customers, complaints, and escalations.
  • Experience managing or developing Customer Service processes and KPIs.
  • Experience in shipping containers, logistics, transportation, manufacturing, construction, equipment, or another operational industry is strongly preferred.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Strong leadership and people-management skills.
  • Excellent conflict-resolution and problem-solving abilities.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple urgent customer situations.
  • Comfortable working across departments and holding stakeholders accountable for follow-up.
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
  • Experience with CRM, ticketing, phone, email, and customer tracking systems.

Working Hours

This is a fully remote position, but availability during U.S. Pacific Time business hours is required:

Monday–Friday | 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time

Candidates located outside the United States must be able to consistently work this schedule.

What Success Looks Like

Within this role, success means building a Customer Service function where:

  • Customers receive timely and professional responses.
  • Complaints have clear ownership.
  • Open cases are actively followed until resolution.
  • Escalations are handled quickly and professionally.
  • Customer Service and Operations communicate effectively.
  • Recurring problems are identified and addressed at their root cause.
  • Management has visibility into customer issues and service performance.
  • The Customer Service team has clear standards, accountability, and measurable KPIs.

We are looking for someone who can combine strong customer advocacy, operational thinking, and leadership while understanding that excellent customer service is not only about answering customers—it is about taking ownership and getting problems resolved.

jobs.description:
Senior Technical Success Manager
Location: Remote, Travel as Needed
Reporting to: Technical Operations Manager

At STN, we don't just adapt to the digital future, we engineer it. Our mission is to help organizations thrive in a rapidly evolving technology landscape through strategic insight, cutting-edge solutions, and a security-first mindset. We provide end-to-end services spanning cloud consulting, AI infrastructure, and enterprise security, enabling secure, scalable, and future-ready transformation.

As trusted advisors, we align IT investments with business outcomes that drive performance and growth, starting with deep strategic engagement and delivering tailored solutions built for long-term impact.

Our approach is innovation-led and rooted in cybersecurity, with a focus on leveraging the right technologies to solve real-world challenges. We invest in our people and foster a culture of growth, inclusion, and purpose because we believe empowered teams build transformative technology.

Overview

The Technical Success Manager is responsible for the operational, technical, and lifecycle success of assigned managed-services customers. The position serves as a primary relationship and coordination point between the customer and STN’s Service Desk and Managed Services Operations, Engineering, Project Management Office, Sales, Procurement, Finance, and leadership teams.

The Technical Success Manager develops and maintains an informed understanding of each customer’s business, stakeholders, technology environment, managed-services agreement, support history, active initiatives, asset lifecycle, and upcoming contractual obligations. The role facilitates recurring customer meetings, monitors service performance and escalations, tracks commitments, coordinates ongoing initiatives, supports asset and technology lifecycle planning, and ensures that contract, licensing, warranty, and service renewals are identified and addressed in advance.

This is a non-commissioned role. The Technical Success Manager identifies customer needs and qualified improvement opportunities but transfers solution design, pricing, negotiation, forecasting, and closing responsibilities to the appropriate Sales, Solutions, or contract-management resources.

Key Responsibilities

Customer relationship and account knowledge

  • Serve as a primary operational point of contact for assigned managed-services customers.
  • Build relationships with customer executives, business leaders, technical contacts, department managers, and escalation stakeholders.
  • Understand each customer’s business operations, critical technology dependencies, supported locations, key vendors, communication preferences, and service expectations.
  • Maintain an accurate stakeholder map identifying decision-makers, technical contacts, executive sponsors, renewal owners, and escalation contacts.
  • Maintain awareness of customer sentiment, organizational change, operational risks, business priorities, and upcoming initiatives.
  • Represent the customer’s interests internally while maintaining contractual, technical, and operational boundaries.

Customer meeting management

  • Coordinate and attend weekly, monthly, quarterly, and other scheduled customer meetings based on account requirements.
  • Prepare agendas using ticket activity, service performance, project status, lifecycle items, renewals, open decisions, risks, and upcoming initiatives.
  • Facilitate meetings or support the designated meeting owner.
  • Document decisions, owners, due dates, risks, dependencies, and follow-up actions.
  • Distribute meeting notes and action summaries within the established service standard.
  • Track customer commitments through completion and escalate overdue or blocked actions.
  • Assist with monthly service reviews, quarterly business reviews, executive reviews, and technology-planning discussions.

Support ticket and service oversight

  • Review open tickets, aging tickets, escalations, recurring incidents, reopened tickets, and customer-impacting trends for assigned accounts.
  • Monitor high-priority and customer-sensitive issues to confirm ownership, communication cadence, and appropriate escalation.
  • Follow up on tickets and initiate with Managed Services Operations, who remain responsible for completing the work; keep informed and help move stalled tickets forward.
  • Help ensure customer-facing updates are timely, accurate, understandable, and aligned with confirmed technical information.
  • Identify patterns that may require root-cause analysis, problem management, technical remediation, training, lifecycle replacement, or project work.
  • Review relevant SLA performance, ticket volume, response trends, resolution trends, and backlog information.
  • Avoid bypassing established service ownership or directly assigning technical work outside approved processes.

Customer environment understanding

  • Develop a working account-management understanding of the customer’s environment, including:
  • STN Provided services and how they interact within their environment which may include:
    • Servers, cloud services, virtualization, storage, and business-critical applications.
    • Network, internet, wireless, firewall, remote-access, and connectivity services.
  • Cybersecurity, monitoring, logging, vulnerability, and compliance-related services.
  • Backup, disaster recovery, business continuity, and recovery objectives.
  • Locations, facilities, remote-work requirements, and key third-party dependencies.
  • Managed-services agreement, supported scope, service exclusions, and customer responsibilities.

Asset and technology lifecycle management

  • Maintain visibility into supported customer assets and technology platforms using the designated systems of record.
  • Track or validate purchase dates, deployment dates, warranties, leases, vendor support, end-of-sale, end-of-support, and end-of-life information.
  • Identify unsupported, aging, or capacity-constrained technology before it creates an operational emergency.
  • Coordinate with technical teams to validate lifecycle risks, replacement timing, dependencies, and recommended next steps.
  • Maintain a rolling 12, 18, or 24 month lifecycle forecast for assigned customers.
  • Bring upcoming lifecycle needs into customer service reviews, budgeting discussions, and QBRs.
  • Confirm that completed replacements, upgrades, and decommissions are reflected in asset and customer documentation.
  • Escalate material asset-data gaps and coordinate corrective action with the responsible team.

Contract, licensing, warranty, and renewal management
  • Maintain a consolidated renewal calendar for managed-services agreements, licensing, subscriptions, warranties, leases, connectivity, cloud, security, backup, and relevant third-party services.
  • Begin renewal preparation within the company’s required advance window.
  • Validate customer quantities, users, devices, locations, service tiers, usage, asset status, and current requirements.
  • Identify material differences between contracted quantities, deployed quantities, billed quantities, and customer expectations.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Procurement, Finance, Contract Administration, and technical teams to resolve discrepancies.
  • Prepare a renewal-readiness summary documenting expiration date, current services, quantities, expected changes, stakeholder contacts, known concerns, technical recommendations, required approvals, and target completion date.
  • Schedule or support customer renewal-planning discussions and track quotes, approvals, signatures, purchase orders, provisioning, and billing updates.
  • Escalate renewals that are delayed, incomplete, commercially at risk, or operationally critical.
  • Confirm completed renewals are reflected in Salesforce, NetSuite, the contract repository, billing, the STN One portal, and customer documentation.

Initiative and light project coordination

  • Maintain visibility into active customer projects, upgrades, remediations, onboarding activities, and operational initiatives.
  • Coordinate with PMO to understand schedules, milestones, dependencies, customer responsibilities, risks, and expected completion dates.
  • Communicate confirmed status information during customer meetings.
  • Track customer decisions, approvals, access requirements, scheduling needs, and other dependencies that may affect delivery.
  • Perform light coordination for small operational initiatives when a formal Project Manager is not assigned and when ownership is explicitly delegated.
  • Escalate scope, budget, resource, schedule, and delivery risks to the responsible Project Manager or operational leader.
  • Avoid making commitments regarding project scope, budget, resources, or completion dates without confirmation from the accountable owner.

Proactive improvement and Sales handoff

  • Identify potential improvements based on service trends, technical findings, lifecycle risks, contract changes, customer requests, business changes, and documented gaps.
  • Recognize potential needs involving security, lifecycle replacement, licensing, cloud, backup, disaster recovery, networking, compliance, training, or managed services.
  • Document the customer problem, business impact, urgency, known technical context, relevant stakeholders, timing, and required technical validation.
  • Create or initiate the opportunity record using the established Salesforce or portal process.
  • Conduct a structured handoff to Sales and participate in discovery when customer or account context is required.
  • Track whether the customer receives timely follow-up and maintain account-level visibility into opportunity status.
  • Do not present unapproved pricing, negotiate terms, promise discounts, or function as the closing salesperson.

Escalation management

  • Follow the company’s technical, service, executive, contractual, security, and sales escalation paths.
  • Confirm customer impact, urgency, current owner, communication expectations, and next-update time.
  • Ensure the appropriate leaders and technical resources are engaged.
  • Maintain a clear record of actions, decisions, owners, risks, and communications.
  • Support post-incident follow-up and lessons-learned activities when appropriate.
  • Identify escalations that indicate broader customer-health, service-scope, contract, or relationship risk. ​​​​​​​
Documentation, reporting, and internal coordination
  • Maintain an account-success plan for each assigned customer.
  • Keep stakeholder, environment, contract, lifecycle, renewal, initiative, risk, and escalation records current.
  • Conduct recurring internal account reviews with Service Delivery, Managed Services Operations, Engineering, PMO, Sales, Procurement, Finance, and leadership as appropriate.
  • Provide leadership with visibility into account health, upcoming renewals, lifecycle exposure, open commitments, escalations, and commercial handoffs.
  • Use the STN One portal, Atlassian products (Jira and Confluence), the ticketing system, Salesforce, NetSuite, monitoring tools, and other approved platforms according to defined processes.
  • Support customer onboarding, transitions, offboarding, and material environment changes, and validate that onboarding (G.9) and offboarding (G.11) duties are complete.
  • Identify possible service-scope misunderstandings or recurring out-of-scope requests and route them for review.

Experience & Qualifications

Required

  • Four or more years of experience in an MSP, IT service-delivery, technical account-management, customer success, or comparable customer-facing technical role.
  • At least two years managing customer relationships, escalations, recurring reviews, or an assigned account portfolio.
  • Operational working knowledge of networks, servers, cloud services, cybersecurity, monitoring, backup, and disaster recovery.
  • Experience reviewing support tickets, service metrics, customer escalations, and recurring issue trends.
  • Experience coordinating technical projects, upgrades, remediation activities, or customer initiatives.
  • Experience using a PSA, CRM, ticketing system, documentation platform, project system, asset platform, or monitoring portal.
  • Ability to interpret service descriptions, contract dates, licensing quantities, warranties, and renewal requirements.
  • Strong written communication, meeting facilitation, organization, documentation, and follow-through skills.
  • Ability to communicate credibly with customer executives, business contacts, and technical teams.
  • Sound judgment regarding when to involve Service Delivery, Engineering, Security, PMO, Sales, Finance, Procurement, Legal, or leadership.

Preferred

  • Direct Managed Service Provider employment experience.
  • Experience leading monthly service reviews, QBRs, executive reviews, or technology-planning meetings.
  • Experience with contract renewals, software licensing, hardware warranties, leases, or vendor services.
  • Experience developing asset or technology lifecycle plans.
  • Experience with Atlassian Jira and Confluence, a customer portal, PSA, CRM, RMM or monitoring tools, and IT documentation platforms.
  • ITIL 4 Foundation, Microsoft Fundamentals, CompTIA, CAPM, Project+, or similar relevant certification.
  • Experience working with regulated or compliance-sensitive customers.

Physical and work requirements

  • Regular use of video conferencing, collaboration tools, ticketing systems, dashboards, and customer portals.
  • Ability to participate in meetings across supported customer time zones.
  • Periodic customer, company, or vendor travel as required by account needs.
  • Occasional participation in urgent customer escalations outside the normal meeting schedule.
  • Reasonable accommodations will be considered in accordance with applicable law and company policy.

Compensation

  • Full-Time, Exempt
  • $100,000-$110,000/year, DOE

Benefits

  • Health Coverage – Medical, Dental & Vision
  • FSA Health and Dependent Care available • 401(k) Plan
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Observed Holidays Paid
  • Cell Phone Allowance
  • Collaborative, growth-driven culture

Candidates must be U.S. Citizens or Permanent Residents. We are unable to provide sponsorship at this time.

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check and reference verification. All applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

jobs.description:
Description

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior C++ Engineer to join Bright Data's browser research team, working at the intersection of browser engineering, systems programming, and data extraction — modifying and extending Chromium/WebKit to unlock new capabilities for research and large-scale data collection.

Responsibilities

  • Modify and extend Chromium/WebKit source code for research and data extraction use cases
  • Build, debug, and reverse-engineer browser engines, internals, and protocols (CDP, DevTools, networking stack) across platforms (Windows, Linux, macOS)
  • Customize, patch, and rebase a Chromium fork; track and merge upstream changes
  • Collaborate with engineers, researchers, and product teams to rapidly prototype and ship high-quality changes

Requirements

  • ﻿5+ years of hands-on C++ (C++17/20); ability to navigate large codebases and make precise, targeted changes fast
  • Strong understanding of software architecture in large-scale, cross-platform systems
  • Deep knowledge of web protocols and browser internals: HTTP/2/3, TLS, CDP, DOM, JavaScript engines
  • Experience with security research, reverse engineering, or browser automation (significant advantage)
  • Open-source contributions, especially browser- or devtools-related (significant advantage)
  • Chromium (significant advantage)
  1. Build tools: depot_tools, GN/Ninja/Siso; architecture: multi-process model, Blink/V8, sandbox, Crashpad
  2. Patch/rebase management for forks; resolving large conflicting merges
  • Debugging & Tooling: Visual Studio, WinDbg, ETW/xperf, ProcMon; crash dump triage across processes
  • Nice to have: Linux containers (Docker, containerd, LXC); CI/CD; security hygiene (sandbox, AppContainer, mitigation policies); basic Node.js/JavaScript

﻿*Fully remote position(for candidates who are not from Israel).

jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Digital Illustrator to create high-quality visual content for slot games across mobile and web platforms. This role focuses on illustration for symbols, characters, environments, UI elements, and promotional assets that feel bold, polished, and game-ready.

You’ll work closely with art direction, game design, animation, and production teams to bring game themes to life while staying aligned with technical and gameplay requirements.

What you’ll do

  • Create illustrated assets for slot games, including symbols, characters, backgrounds, frames, and feature visuals
  • Develop art that supports gameplay clarity, theme storytelling, and player engagement
  • Translate art direction and style guides into consistent, production-ready illustrations
  • Prepare layered files and clean assets for animation, implementation, and export
  • Collaborate with animators, UI designers, and producers to ensure assets function smoothly in-game
  • Use generative AI tools as part of the creative workflow for ideation, concept exploration, or asset development, while maintaining artistic quality and consistency
  • Iterate on artwork based on feedback, performance considerations, and game balance needs
  • Occasionally support marketing or promotional visuals tied to game launches.

What we’re looking for

  • Strong illustration skills with a clear understanding of composition, color, lighting, and readability
  • Experience creating art specifically for games, preferably slot games or casual mobile games
  • Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator
  • Familiarity with generative AI tools and an understanding of how to use them responsibly and effectively within a production art pipeline
  • Ability to work in a variety of styles, from stylized and playful to polished and premium
  • Solid understanding of asset organization, naming conventions, and production pipelines
  • Comfort working from briefs, references, and established brand styles
  • Strong attention to detail and consistency across asset sets

Nice to have

  • Experience with slot game mechanics and common features (reels, symbols, bonuses, jackpots)
  • Familiarity with Spine, After Effects, or animation-friendly asset prep
  • Understanding of mobile performance constraints and optimization
  • Experience working with licensed IP or regulated gaming products

What success looks like

  • Artwork that is visually appealing, readable at small sizes, and cohesive across entire games
  • Assets delivered on time, cleanly organized, and ready for animation or implementation
  • Strong collaboration with cross-functional teams and openness to iteration
  • Consistent contribution to the overall quality and identity of the game portfolio

jobs.description:
CareDx is a leading precision medicine diagnostics company advancing care in transplant, specialty oncology, and cell therapy.
