jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II
jobs.excerpt: Who we areSamsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

Join Samsara's In-Vehicle Experience team as a Senior Software Engineer. You'll be the technical leader of the team, setting the direction for what we build and how. We are building AI voice experiences that speak to, coach, and assist drivers as they work, spanning proactive assistance, on-demand interaction, and the range of situations in between. We are looking for the product-minded full-stack engineer who will figure out what those experiences should be, ship them, and build the systems that let them evolve into one coherent product rather than a set of disconnected tools.

You'll design what agents say and how they behave, build the services that support them, and iterate on both based on what drivers actually experience. These systems sit at the intersection of software, AI, and the physical world. Because drivers interact with our products while operating a vehicle, decisions about what reaches them, and when, carry real weight. The systems underneath are where the hard-to-reverse decisions live. How agents share context, how concurrent interactions get arbitrated, and how the system's decisions can be explained after the fact. You'll decide what's worth building, and own the systems that make it possible.

You'll ship against clear priorities from day one. We are looking for someone whose instinct is to shape the direction of the team's work, not just execute against it. Putting forward a point of view, making the case for it, and getting the team moving in a new direction is core to how this person operates. Engineers who habitually notice what should improve and then make it happen, rather than waiting to be told, will find this kind of role familiar.

AI-assisted engineering is central to this role. You will be expected to use tools such as Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor proficiently throughout the software development lifecycle, not only for code generation but also for investigation, design, testing, review, and operational work.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US.

In this role, you will:

  • Define what to build and how to build it, shaping product direction from the engineering side.
  • Build and ship voice agent experiences from zero to one in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment. Iterate quickly based on real interactions.
  • Own the technical direction for how these experiences coordinate: how they share context, how concurrent interactions get arbitrated, how the system holds up as more experiences are added, and how its real-time decisions can be investigated by the teams that need to.
  • Make and document architectural tradeoffs where requirements are still evolving, favoring foundations that generalize as new use cases emerge over one-off solutions that don't.
  • Serve as the team's technical anchor: review designs, unblock decisions, and mentor engineers as they expand into unfamiliar technical domains.
  • Introduce new patterns for full-stack and AI-assisted engineering, and get the team using them.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership of products from concept through production.
  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Recent, primary experience shipping LLM/agent based products end-to-end, including evaluation of AI behavior in production.
  • Experience with memory, context, or retrieval systems for AI applications (e.g., RAG pipelines, vector databases, long-lived session context).
  • Strong programming and design fundamentals (Go, TypeScript, Python).
  • Experience designing APIs and service boundaries that other systems rely on.
  • Experience setting technical direction on a team and mentoring other engineers.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to influence technical direction without formal authority.
  • Located in and authorized to work in the United States or Canada (this is a fully remote role).

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience building zero-to-one products in fast-moving, high-autonomy environments.
  • Experience building persistent memory or personalization systems where agents learn about users over time.
  • Experience with multi-agent orchestration: coordinating multiple agents, avoiding conflicts, and maintaining consistency.
  • Experience building scheduling or arbitration systems.
  • Experience designing systems that combine structured and open-ended signal collection to inform product decisions.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$154,700—$260,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.title: Principal DevOps Engineer
jobs.excerpt: DescriptionWe are looking for Principal DevOps Engineer to design and build the AWS infrastructure and delivery platform the new gaming platform will run on.
jobs.description:
Description

We are looking for Principal DevOps Engineer to design and build the AWS infrastructure and delivery platform the new gaming platform will run on. Greenfield: define the cloud foundation — account structure, networking, Kubernetes platform, CI/CD, observability — before the first production workload lands, then scale it to sportsbook peak traffic for millions of players. The platform must hold under live-betting spikes, strict uptime expectations for a money-moving system, and gaming-regulator audit and compliance requirements. Hands-on technical leader: writes infrastructure code daily, sets platform standards, and is the technical authority on how software is built, shipped and operated.

What you will do:

  • Design the AWS foundation from scratch: multi-account architecture (AWS Organizations), landing zone, VPC and networking, IAM strategy, cost governance
  • Build and operate the container platform — Amazon EKS, service mesh, autoscaling tuned for spiky sportsbook load, multi-AZ (and where justified multi-region) resilience
  • Define everything as code: Terraform for all infrastructure, GitOps delivery (Argo CD or similar), paved-road CI/CD pipelines so product teams ship safely and often
  • Establish the observability stack — metrics, logging, tracing, alerting (Prometheus/Grafana, OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch) — and drive an SLO-based reliability practice with error budgets
  • Own production readiness: incident response, on-call design, runbooks, chaos/load testing ahead of major sporting events, blameless postmortems
  • Build the infrastructure side of the migration off the current third-party platform: dual-running environments, data migration pipelines, cutover mechanics
  • Embed compliance into the platform: audit trails, environment segregation, backup/DR, controls that satisfy gaming regulators by construction
  • Partner with the AI coding platform team: provision and operate the infrastructure behind AI-assisted development, and bring AI tooling into DevOps workflows
  • Mentor engineers across teams on cloud-native and operational best practices; set organization-wide standards

Requirements

Must have:

  • 10+ years of DevOps / platform / infrastructure engineering, including 3+ years at staff/principal level with organization-wide influence
  • Deep hands-on AWS: EKS, EC2, RDS/Aurora, networking (VPC, Transit Gateway, Route 53), IAM at scale, multi-account architectures (AWS certifications such as SA Professional / DevOps Professional are a plus)
  • Expert-level infrastructure as code with Terraform
  • Strong Kubernetes operational depth: day-2 operations, upgrades, capacity, cost
  • Track record of building CI/CD and developer platforms engineering teams adopted willingly — golden paths, not gatekeeping
  • Observability and SLO/error-budget practice (Prometheus/Grafana, OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch)
  • Experience operating high-availability, high-throughput production systems with real traffic spikes, with documented playbooks from real incidents
  • Strong scripting/programming (Python, Go or Bash) and comfort reading application code
  • Experience designing backup, disaster recovery and business continuity for systems where data loss is not an option
  • Excellent written and spoken English; communicates platform decisions clearly to engineers and executives

Nice to have:

  • Hands-on use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex) for infrastructure, pipelines and ops automation — a significant plus
  • Security engineering: cloud security posture management, secrets management (e.g. Vault), vulnerability management, SAST/DAST/SCA in CI/CD, ISO 27001 / SOC 2 / PCI DSS
  • iGaming, sports betting, fintech or another regulated, high-transaction-volume domain
  • Migration off a third-party vendor platform
  • Event-streaming infrastructure (Kafka/MSK) and database operations at scale
  • Polish and/or Spanish

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, ASW Launch Ops
jobs.excerpt: About ZiplineZipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service.
jobs.description:
About Zipline

Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products.

Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds.

About You and The Role

Joining Zipline as a Senior Software Engineer on the ASW Launch Ops team, you will be part of the Application Software organization. You will build the operational platform that turns a new market from an idea into a live, revenue-generating network—covering site acquisition, infrastructure design, permitting, construction execution, deployment tracking, and launch readiness.

This is a greenfield, high-ownership individual contributor role. You will help establish the technical foundations for a platform intended to scale Zipline from tens of sites to hundreds or thousands. Working directly with Real Estate, Launch Operations, Construction, Hardware, Flight Operations, Commercial, and Manufacturing, you will replace fragmented manual workflows with a unified, auditable, and automated operational system. Your work will directly affect Zipline’s ability to expand into new countries and reliably deliver time-critical supplies at scale.

What You'll Do

  • Drive core product domains. Serve as a technical owner for critical capabilities across site acquisition, permitting, infrastructure design, construction execution, deployment tracking, and launch readiness—ensuring their long-term technical health and strategic direction.
  • Deliver measurable impact. Reduce manual coordination, shorten site-launch timelines, improve launch-date predictability, and give cross-functional leaders clear visibility into execution, dependencies, and risk.
  • Lead technical design. Define the APIs, data models, service boundaries, and architectural patterns that power the platform, with a focus on maintainability, auditability, observability, and pragmatic evolution.
  • Build durable operational workflows. Translate complex real-world processes into software that supports long-running workflows, government and vendor interactions, physical assets, documents and permits, approvals, dependencies, state transitions, and exception handling.
  • Create a unified operational source of truth. Build resilient integrations across ERP, GIS, document management, permitting, construction and project management, asset management, and internal operational systems.
  • Design for the people doing the work. Partner directly with users to turn fragmented processes and data into intuitive tools for planning and execution. Prototype workflows, validate them in real operating environments, and drive adoption.
  • Own production excellence. Build and operate business-critical services with meaningful health metrics, SLOs, observability, runbooks, and recovery mechanisms. Participate in on-call, lead incident response when needed, and improve systems through thoughtful postmortems.
  • Remain deeply hands-on. Ship production code, review critical changes, troubleshoot complex system behavior, and follow major capabilities from discovery through deployment and operation.
  • Lead through influence. Create clarity in ambiguous problem spaces, identify systemic risks and cross-team dependencies, and drive alignment across technical and operational stakeholders.
  • Elevate the team. Mentor peers, raise engineering standards, and strengthen practices in system design, automated testing, CI/CD, operational reliability, and pragmatic delivery.

What You'll Bring

  • Senior individual contribution. At least 5 years of professional experience developing and maintaining full-stack production systems at scale, or demonstrated equivalent technical mastery.
  • Product-minded engineering. You understand user needs, identify root causes, and design pragmatic solutions that balance business value, usability, technical simplicity, and long-term maintainability.
  • Systems perspective. You can break down ambiguous operational problems, collaborate with stakeholders to define the right solution, and deliver software that improves real-world processes.
  • Strong technical fundamentals. You design maintainable systems, model data thoughtfully, create robust APIs, and make sound tradeoffs across frontend applications, backend services, distributed systems, and infrastructure.
  • Complex workflow experience. You have modeled long-running workflows, external dependencies, physical assets, and complex state transitions with strong auditability, observability, and failure recovery.
  • Integration experience. You have built reliable integrations between internal services and external or enterprise systems. Experience with ERP, GIS, document management, construction, permitting, or asset management systems is valuable but not required.
  • Modern technology mindset. You are comfortable learning and working across technologies such as Python, Go, PostgreSQL, React, Kafka, gRPC, AWS, Grafana, and Honeycomb. We value engineers who learn new tools quickly over experience with every specific technology.
  • Effective use of AI. You use AI thoughtfully throughout the development lifecycle—including design, implementation, testing, debugging, and code review—while maintaining strong engineering judgment and quality.
  • Operational excellence. You define meaningful service-health metrics and reliability goals, create actionable runbooks, participate in on-call rotations, and drive improvements through incident reviews.
  • Quantifiable results. You have shipped high-impact capabilities that reduce manual intervention, shorten cycle times, increase predictability, improve throughput, or strengthen reliability—and can demonstrate the results with concrete metrics.
  • Cross-functional leadership. You communicate clearly under ambiguity, prioritize decisively, and influence stakeholders across engineering and operational organizations without relying on formal authority.
  • Owner’s mindset. You balance speed with correctness and understand the real operational consequences of software used to deploy physical infrastructure and support safety-critical operations.

Assuming this position, you will take meaningful ownership of a business-critical operational platform from day one. Your mandate is to deliver quantifiable improvements in launch velocity, predictability, execution visibility, and system reliability while building foundations capable of supporting Zipline’s continued global expansion.

What Else You Need To Know

This role can be based in South San Francisco or remotely within the United States. Regular travel is expected so that you can work closely with stakeholders, understand operational challenges firsthand, and build software grounded in real-world workflows.

Travel may include visits to Zipline headquarters, operating sites, and new-market launches. Remote team members should expect more frequent travel—typically a few days at a time, potentially once per month.

We value diversity at Zipline and welcome applications from those who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. If you like the sound of this position but are not sure if you are the perfect fit, please apply!

jobs.excerpt: Nift is disrupting performance marketing, delivering millions of new customers to brands every month.
jobs.description:
Nift is disrupting performance marketing, delivering millions of new customers to brands every month. We’re actively looking for a Sales Director, Mid-Market to lead our Mid-Market team. The Mid Market team is focused on acquiring new Mid-Market (MM) eCommerce and Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) brands / advertisers. As we continue to scale our revenue, this leader will play a critical role in expanding our footprint, building our team, and driving core growth.

In this role, you will manage, coach, and scale our team of Mid-Market Account Executives. You will drive a builder/player/coach model—hunting and managing your own accounts while equipping your team of AEs to prospect, pitch, close, and scale brands with the capacity to spend $50k–$200k (can be more) per month with Nift. You will train your team to effectively compete for performance marketing budgets against other paid social and digital performance marketing channels.

Our Mission

Nift’s mission is to reshape how people discover and try new brands by introducing them to new products and services through thoughtful "thank-you" gifts. Our customer-first approach ensures businesses acquire new customers efficiently while making customers feel valued and rewarded. We are a data-driven, cash-flow-positive company that has experienced 731% growth over the last three years. Now, we’re scaling to become one of the largest sources for new customer acquisition worldwide.

Backed by Spark Capital & Foundry who also invested in Slack, Snap, SeatGeek, Fitbit, Warby Parker, Wayfair and Twitter, we are poised for exponential growth and ready to demonstrate impact on a global scale. Read more about our growth here.

What you will do:

Job Title: HCM Cloud SAFe Agile Coach & Scrum MasterJob Category: Information TechnologyTime Type: Full timeMinimum Clearance Required to Start: Public TrustEmployee Type: RegularPercentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%Type of Travel: Continental US* * *

Opportunity:
CACI is seeking a HCM Cloud SAFe Agile Coach & Scrum Master to drive Agile execution excellence across a large-scale federal HCM modernization program deploying Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM for federal civilian employees across multiple agencies. The SAFe Agile framework serves as the delivery engine that makes this complexity manageable. As an Agile Coach and Scrum Master, you will facilitate Agile Release Train (ART) ceremonies, serve as Scrum Master for cross-functional teams across Core HR, Talent and Learning, Benefits, Compensation, HCM Application Security, and Technical/Functional Support, and coach teams on SAFe principles and practices. You may also serve as a Release Train Engineer (RTE), orchestrating Program Increment (PI) Planning, managing cross-team dependencies, tracking velocity and throughput metrics, and driving inspect-and-adapt cycles. With Oracle quarterly updates, parallel agency transitions, and comprehensive functional requirements, the program requires disciplined Agile execution at every level. This role is ideal for Agile professionals seeking to coach and lead at enterprise scale within a program shaping federal IT delivery for years to come.

The role is remote with preference for candidates in the DMV area.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as Scrum Master for one or more cross-functional Agile teams aligned to Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM modules such as Core HR, Talent Acquisition, Learning, Benefits, Compensation, HCM Application Security, or Technical/Functional Support.
  • Facilitate all SAFe Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, backlog refinement, and inspect‑and‑adapt sessions focused on continuous improvement.
  • Serve as or support the Release Train Engineer (RTE) in planning and executing PI Planning events, coordinating PI objectives, identifying cross-team dependencies, and establishing realistic commitments.
  • Track and report Agile metrics including velocity, throughput, cycle time, cumulative flow, defect rates, and PI predictability to provide visibility into team health and delivery performance.
  • Identify, track, and remove impediments that hinder team progress, escalating systemic issues and facilitating cross-team dependency resolution.
  • Coach team members, product owners, and stakeholders on SAFe Lean‑Agile principles, Scrum practices, and a continuous delivery mindset.
  • Coordinate cross-team planning for Oracle quarterly update sprints, ensuring update assessment, regression testing, and deployment activities align with PI cadence.
  • Facilitate ART sync meetings, Scrum of Scrums, and system demos to maintain alignment across functional, technical, integration, and testing teams.
  • Support agency transition task orders by tailoring Agile practices to each agency migration wave, scaling ceremonies appropriately for varying complexity tiers.
  • Maintain and optimize Agile tooling such as JIRA and Confluence to ensure accurate backlog management, sprint tracking, and program-level reporting.
  • Facilitate inspect‑and‑adapt workshops at the end of each PI and drive problem‑solving activities that result in actionable improvements.
  • Operate independently to analyze and resolve complex functional and technical issues, mentor junior team members, and serve as a program-wide Agile resource.
  • Lead small work efforts and technical initiatives, conduct deliverable reviews, and guide junior consultants on Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM best practices.

Qualifications:
Required:

  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance (US Citizenship required).

  • Bachelor’s degree and 7 years of relevant experience; additional experience may substitute for the degree.

  • 7+ years of professional experience in Agile coaching, Scrum Master roles, or Agile delivery for enterprise IT programs.

  • Active SAFe certification (SA, SSM, SASM, or SPC).

  • 5+ years of hands‑on experience serving as Scrum Master or Agile Coach for teams of 7–12 members in enterprise software development or implementation environments.

  • Demonstrated experience facilitating PI Planning, managing program‑level backlogs, and coordinating cross‑team dependencies within SAFe Agile Release Trains.

  • Strong facilitation and conflict resolution skills for guiding teams through retrospectives, problem-solving, and complex discussions.

  • Experience with Agile project management tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps, or Rally.

  • Excellent communication skills for interacting with technical teams, product owners, and program leadership.

Desired:

  • 8+ years of Agile coaching or Scrum Master experience, including enterprise-scale SAFe implementations with 5+ Agile teams.

  • Experience serving as a Release Train Engineer (RTE) responsible for ART‑level planning and execution.

  • Multiple SAFe certifications demonstrating breadth across the framework (e.g., SA + SSM + SPC, or RTE + SPC).

  • Experience coaching Agile teams in Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM, Oracle ERP Cloud, or similar enterprise SaaS environments.

  • Familiarity with federal IT program delivery, government contracting, and Agile implementation within regulated environments.

  • Experience with SAFe Lean Portfolio Management practices such as portfolio Kanban, strategic themes, and lean budgeting.

  • ICAgile ICP‑ACC or Certified Scrum Professional (CSP‑SM) certification.

  • Experience with Oracle Cloud technologies such as OIC or OCI in enterprise HCM or ERP context

This position is contingent on funding and may not be filled immediately. However, this position is representative of positions within CACI that are consistently available. Individuals who apply may also be considered for other positions at CACI.

What You Can Expect:

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range:

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.

The proposed salary range for this position is:

$90,300-$189,600

Company :

Highmark Health

Job Description :

JOB SUMMARY

The SVP Clinical Guidance serves as the senior clinical leader responsible for translating enterprise clinical strategy into the design, development, and execution of the Living Health Guidance System. This role will lead the clinical vision for a next-generation guidance model that proactively supports members, enables providers, and advances more effective, affordable, and evidence-based care.

Working in close partnership with clinical, product, technology, data, analytics, provider, and operational leaders, this executive will ensure clinical intelligence is embedded across digital and physical care experiences. The SVP will guide the development of clinical decision support capabilities, including evidence-based pathways, pharmacy recommendations, longitudinal data insights, and AI-enabled guidance tools that deliver personalized, actionable recommendations for members and providers.

This leader will play a critical role in advancing the organization from traditional health plan administration toward proactive clinical guidance. The SVP will ensure recommendations are grounded in data, clinical evidence, provider workflows, and member needs, while supporting improved outcomes, earlier intervention, greater affordability, and a more seamless healthcare experience.

The ideal candidate is a senior clinical executive with deep experience in clinical strategy, health informatics, digital health solutions, provider engagement, and large-scale transformation within a complex healthcare environment.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Establish and execute the long-term clinical vision and 5+ year strategy for the Living Health Guidance System, leading the organizational shift from reactive administration to proactive, trust-based clinical advocacy.

  • Serve as the senior clinical leader on the cross-functional leadership team, defining the strategic priorities and scope for the "Clinical Brain" to ensure alignment with the Enterprise 2030 vision.

  • Exercise disciplined fiscal oversight of the clinical guidance engine, defining budget standards, directing investment in "build vs. buy" opportunities, and ensuring all resource allocation is directly tied to delivering improved health outcomes and a clear return on investment.

  • Champion the clinical imperative for radical simplicity, ensuring the guidance system is designed to remove administrative friction and make the best health decisions the easiest actions for members to take.

  • Spearhead the end-to-end design of the "Clinical Brain," the core intelligence of the Guidance System, by overseeing the development of its clinical decision support logic, AI-driven agents, and advanced data models.

  • Ensure all guidance is built on a foundation of genuine, evidence-based clinical direction, creating actionable and authoritative recommendations backed by robust data and pathways.

  • Determine the optimal "build vs. buy vs. partner" strategy for all clinical intelligence components, evaluating external solutions to accelerate speed-to-market while retaining proprietary control over key differentiators.

  • Lead the seamless integration of clinical intelligence across the entire health journey, collaborating extensively with product, design, engineering, and data teams to embed guidance into all member and provider touchpoints.

  • Drive the clinical strategy for provider enablement and alignment, deploying tools, EMR integrations, and innovative incentive models that foster collaboration and reward adherence to optimal care pathways.

  • Authoritatively recommend the next best health actions for members and facilitate the seamless sharing of actionable information with their providers to create a connected and collaborative care experience.

  • Ensure the guidance system enables more effective and affordable care, leading to measurable improvements in health outcomes, increased upstream preventive care, and a reduction in the total cost of care.

  • Influence the generation of significant multi-million dollar savings through the successful clinical leadership and strategic implementation of the Guidance System across the enterprise.

EXPERIENCE

Required

  • A minimum of 15 years of progressive leadership experience within a large, complex healthcare organization, such as an integrated delivery and financing system, health plan, or a health technology company.

  • Demonstrated track record of success in designing, developing, and implementing large-scale clinical decision support systems and/or digital health solutions.

  • Proven experience leading clinical strategy and program development in a multi-stakeholder environment.

Preferred

  • None

SKILLS

  • Strategic & Visionary Leadership: Ability to translate high-level strategy into a concrete operational vision and execution plan.

  • Collaborative Influence: Expertise in leading through influence, working in a matrix environment, and fostering collaboration across cross-functional teams and executive leadership.

  • Health Informatics: Deep understanding of clinical data architecture, interoperability standards, EMR systems (like Epic), and data analytics.

  • Clinical Program Design: Proficiency in designing evidence-based scalable clinical programs that drive measurable improvements in health outcomes and affordability.

  • Operational Excellence: Strong ability to manage complex projects, drive for results, and navigate the challenges of a large-scale transformation initiative.

  • Provider Engagement: A strong understanding of provider workflows and the ability to build systems that support and enable clinicians.

EDUCATION

Required

  • An advanced clinical or medical degree (e.g., MD, DO)

Preferred

  • A PhD or Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Health Informatics, Public Health, Business Administration, Medical Management) combined with extensive clinical experience

LICENSES or CERTIFICATIONS

Required

  • Medical Doctor

Preferred

  • Active medical license

  • None

  • Less Than 25%

About Us

Chess.com is one of the largest gaming sites in the world and the #1 platform for playing, learning, and enjoying chess.

We are a team of 600+ fully remote people in 60+ countries working hard to serve the global chess community. We are here to support 250M+ chess players worldwide with the best possible product, content, and tools to serve the community!

We are a tech company. A gaming company. A content company. And we do it all with passion and commitment to the game. Above all we prize our mission-driven, flat, life-celebrating, no-corporate culture, and we look forward to meeting you and learning more about what you can bring to the team.

About the Role

As a Senior Product Designer in Connect, you’ll lead the design of high-impact experiences for some of our most important and visible features like Home, Profile, Notifications, Widgets, Friends, Messages, Sharing, and more.

Your work will span cross-functionally where different features meet and overlap and you will partner closely with Product, Engineering, and other Product Designers to craft an engaging and cohesive experience across web, iOS, and Android for millions of players across the world.

You'll identify opportunities beyond the brief, and influence product and design decisions while helping raise the craft quality bar across the team.

About You

You’re an experienced Product Designer with strong visual craft, product judgment, and the confidence to influence how a product takes shape. You think beyond the feature in front of you, considering how decisions connect across product experiences. You’re comfortable navigating ambiguity and competing perspectives, present your thinking with clarity and composure, and help other designers improve through thoughtful critique.

You’re interested in how people connect and find joy in designing fun and healthy ways for them to build relationships and feel like part of a global community.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the end-to-end design of high-impact product experiences across Chess.com’s web, iOS, and Android apps, and deliver polished, production-ready UI designs.
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Design, and other stakeholders to shape requirements, clarify ambiguity, and influence product and design direction.
  • Design how players connect, socialize, and feel like they’re part of a global community on key features like Home, Profile, Friends, Messaging, Notifications, Leaderboards, and more.
  • Think horizontally across features and the broader design system, identifying opportunities to improve consistency, usability, and quality across the product.
  • Raise the craft bar through strong UI design, thoughtful interactions, and sound product judgment grounded in context, heuristics, and user insight.
  • Proactively identify meaningful product opportunities beyond the immediate brief and help move them from idea to well-articulated design direction.
  • Present your design proposals and clearly articulate your decisions, navigate differing perspectives, and help cross-functional partners align to reach strong decisions.
  • Build and iterate on high-fidelity prototypes using our Design System, using tools like Cursor and Claude, to explore directions and accelerate decision making.
  • Contribute to design critiques, provide constructive feedback to other Product Designers, and help strengthen the quality of the team’s work without direct people-management responsibility.
  • Maintain design ownership through implementation and help ensure strong design-to-code alignment across platforms.

Skills / Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience working as a Product Designer on a consumer-facing product or game.
  • A portfolio of polished web and mobile UI design work that demonstrates excellent craft, strong product thinking, and accountability.
  • Mastery of UI design fundamentals, including typography, color, layout, visual hierarchy, alignment, contrast, interactivity, user experience heuristics.
  • Experience using agentic tools like Cursor and Claude to build shareable prototypes and quickly iterate on different ideasDemonstrated experience owning complex product work from early problem definition through implementation.
  • Strong Design system fluency, including the ability to use established patterns while thinking across features and identifying opportunities to improve consistency.
  • A track record of influencing product and design decisions, presenting proposals clearly, and navigating cross-functional disagreement or competing priorities.
  • Familiarity with frontend development and how design translates into code across web and mobile platforms.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, proactive remote collaboration, and the judgment to operate effectively with autonomy and ambiguity.

Preferred / Nice to Haves

  • A love for chess and knowledge of Chess.com and its product experience.
  • Experience designing social features for mobile games or consumer products.
  • Motion design experience, with strong product and UI design craft as the foundation.
  • Design engineering or frontend development experience on web, iOS, or Android.

● We are 100% remote (work from anywhere!).

● This position is open to applicants globally and requires at least 3 hours of overlap with U.S. working hours.

jobs.excerpt: Job Opening Details:Bionews, a digital news company dedicated to creating communities for patients with rare and chronic diseases and their caregivers, is looking for members of the myasthenia gravis (MG) community to join our freelance staff of caregiver columnists on Myasthenia Gravis News.
jobs.description:
Job Opening Details:

Bionews, a digital news company dedicated to creating communities for patients with rare and chronic diseases and their caregivers, is looking for members of the myasthenia gravis (MG) community to join our freelance staff of caregiver columnists on Myasthenia Gravis News.

A Bionews columnist is a patient or caregiver who shares about life with a rare or chronic disease. They write personal essays in a column format to inform, inspire, empathize, and advise. Their audience includes patients, caregivers, medical teams, and researchers. Columnists also write to a general audience interested in learning how to improve society's understanding and treatment of disease/disability communities.

All columns are reviewed with a critical eye by professional editors who will work with columnists to smooth rough spots and help the columnist grow as a writer. This is a contract position.

Please note you MUST be a member of the myasthenia gravis community -- caregiver preferred -- in order to apply for this position.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Fulfill 1x weekly deadlines as agreed upon on hire.
  • Communicate efficiently with your managers and editors.
  • Submit 400-800 word drafts that adhere to Bionews policies and procedures.
  • Aside from exceptions, drafts should not take more than 45 minutes to edit.
  • Fulfill revisions as requested by editors in a timely manner.
  • Complete training assigned by Bionews HR.

Experience Required

  • Prior experience with writing for an audience.
  • At least three months’ direct experience with caring for someone with MG.
  • Caregivers must be direct relatives, guardians, or spouses.

Experience Preferred

  • Experience in being professionally edited for publication.
  • Experienced in generating a blog or column.
  • Participation in support groups, internet forums, or community groups relevant to MG.

Knowledge Required

  • Fundamentals of how MG works.

Knowledge Preferred

  • The content needs or wants of the MG community.

Skills Required

  • A swift and independent learner of Internet technology.
  • A creative mind capable of regularly generating unique content that appeals to target audiences.
  • Time management.
  • Advanced creative writing.

Skills Preferred

  • Experience in using WordPress for content creation.
  • Experience with the Slack communication app.

Abilities Required

  • Internet access and use.
  • Native or fluent English writing and reading abilities.

Who is Bionews?
Bionews is a leading online health, science, publication, and research company with one purpose: to serve patients with a rare or chronic disease. We do this by connecting them with current, trusted, and relevant news and information. This content is delivered regularly and provided by actual patients as well as professional journalists, writers, editors, scientists, and experienced media executives. Our end customers are truly patients living with rare and chronic diseases. Visit www.bionews.com for more information.

Bionews Vision
To empower, inspire, and champion the patient voice as the preeminent resource that engages, informs, and connects the global rare and chronic disease community.

Bionews Purpose
We connect rare and chronic disease communities by providing a unified and distinctive space to engage, educate, and empower those affected by rare diseases to help improve patient health and quality of life.

Values: R.A.R.E.

  • RESPONSIBILITY
  • ADVOCACY
  • RELATIONSHIPS
  • EMPOWERMENT

jobs.title: Maskinmäklare – bygg upp ditt eget distrikt
jobs.excerpt: Som maskinmäklare på Maskinera får du ansvar för ett eget geografiskt distrikt med stor frihet, tydliga mål och möjlighet att påverka din egen inkomst.
jobs.description:
Som maskinmäklare på Maskinera får du ansvar för ett eget geografiskt distrikt med stor frihet, tydliga mål och möjlighet att påverka din egen inkomst. Vi söker dig som älskar försäljning, triggas av resultat och vill vara med och bygga något – inte bara förvalta det som redan finns.

Om Maskinera

Maskinera är en snabbväxande och innovativ aktör inom nätauktioner för begagnade kvalitetsmaskiner. Vi utmanar en traditionell bransch genom att kombinera modern teknik och digitalisering med stark lokal närvaro och personliga kundrelationer.

Sedan starten har vi vuxit snabbt över hela Sverige och hjälpt allt fler företag att sälja sina maskiner genom vår digitala auktionsplattform. Nu fortsätter vi vår expansion och söker fler drivna säljare som vill vara med och bygga Maskinera vidare.

Vi är fortfarande tidigt på vår resa, vilket innebär att du kommer in i ett bolag där du får möjlighet att påverka, utvecklas och göra verklig skillnad.

Om rollen

Som maskinmäklare ansvarar du för försäljningen och kundrelationerna inom ditt geografiska distrikt.

Rollen handlar i grunden om människor, förtroende och affärer. Du bygger successivt upp ett starkt nätverk och arbetar för att bli en självklar partner för företag i ditt distrikt.

Du arbetar aktivt med både nya och befintliga kunder, skapar nya kontakter, bokar dina egna möten och spenderar en stor del av tiden ute hos företag i ditt område. Målet är inte bara att göra en enskild affär – utan att bygga relationer som skapar återkommande affärer över tid.

Du ansvarar för hela försäljningsprocessen, från första kontakt och kundmöte till förhandling, avslut och fortsatt utveckling av kundrelationen.

När ett objekt ska säljas dokumenterar och fotograferar du maskinen inför auktionen. Därefter tar Maskineras digitala plattform och organisation vid och hjälper till att marknadsföra objektet mot potentiella köpare.

Du utgår hemifrån, planerar själv dina dagar och får stor frihet under ansvar.

Ditt distrikt är din marknad – och din framgång bygger på relationerna du skapar där.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

  • Bygga upp och utveckla en stark kundportfölj i ditt distrikt

  • Skapa nya kundrelationer genom telefon, digitala kanaler och personliga möten

  • Boka och genomföra dina egna kundmöten

  • Utveckla befintliga kunder och skapa långsiktiga affärsrelationer

  • Förhandla och driva affärer från första kontakt till avslut

  • Arbeta aktivt för att bli en självklar partner för dina kunder över tid

  • Dokumentera och fotografera maskiner inför försäljning

  • Planera och utveckla ditt distrikt med ett tydligt affärs- och resultatfokus

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker framför allt säljdriv – maskinkunskap kan vi lära dig.

Du har erfarenhet av försäljning och är van vid att själv skapa aktivitet och affärsmöjligheter. Du väntar inte på att telefonen ska ringa, utan tar initiativ, skapar nya kontakter och driver ditt eget arbete framåt.

Du trivs i en miljö med högt tempo, tydliga mål och höga ambitioner. Du är uthållig, tävlingsinriktad och motiveras av att din egen prestation påverkar resultatet.

Samtidigt förstår du att riktigt bra försäljning bygger på förtroende. Du är social och förtroendeingivande och tycker om att utveckla en första kontakt till en långsiktig kundrelation.

Vi tror att du kommer lyckas i rollen om du:

  • Har erfarenhet av försäljning och kundbearbetning

  • Är van vid att själv skapa nya kontakter och affärsmöjligheter

  • Har ett tydligt resultat- och tävlingsdriv

  • Motiveras av att din prestation påverkar din inkomst

  • Är självgående och trivs med stort eget ansvar

  • Är uthållig och beredd att lägga ner arbetet som krävs för att lyckas

  • Är social, förtroendeingivande och skicklig på att bygga relationer

  • Är strukturerad och kan planera och prioritera ditt eget arbete

  • Talar och skriver svenska obehindrat

  • Har B-körkort

Ett intresse för maskiner, fordon eller entreprenad är meriterande, men inget krav.

Din bakgrund

Du behöver inte komma från maskinbranschen.

Vi tror att du kan ha en bakgrund inom exempelvis försäkringsförmedling, företagsförsäkringar, fastighetsmäkleri, bilförsäljning, finansiering/leasing eller annan uppsökande och relationsdriven försäljning.

Det viktigaste för oss är inte exakt vad du har sålt tidigare. Vi är mer intresserade av hur du säljer, vad som driver dig och vad du vill åstadkomma framåt.

Vad erbjuder vi?

Ett distrikt att bygga
Du får ett tydligt geografiskt ansvar och möjligheten att bygga upp din egen kundportfölj och en stark position på din lokala marknad.

Stor frihet och eget ansvar
Du utgår hemifrån och planerar själv dina dagar. Vi tror på frihet under ansvar och fokuserar på resultat snarare än var du befinner dig mellan 08.00 och 17.00.

Möjlighet att påverka din egen inkomst
Hos oss ska det löna sig att prestera. Din ersättning består av fast lön tillsammans med en prestationsbaserad del som ger dig möjlighet att påverka vad du tjänar.

En plats på en tillväxtresa
Maskinera är fortfarande i ett skede där enskilda medarbetare kan göra stor skillnad. Du kommer inte in i en färdig organisation där allt redan är bestämt – du blir en del av att bygga den.

Ett ambitiöst säljteam
Du blir en del av ett team med höga ambitioner, tydliga mål och stort fokus på utveckling och prestation. Vi delar framgångar, utmanar varandra och vill hela tiden bli bättre.

Praktisk information

This position blends day-to-day software engineering with technical leadership. It involves architecture-minded decision making, modernizing legacy systems, reducing technical debt, and establishing consistent platform patterns. These efforts span across two independent health plan technology stacks. The role also promotes modern engineering practices (CI/CD, infrastructure and security as code, automated testing, and observability) and expects responsible use of Humana-approved AI and code generation tools to accelerate delivery and improve quality.

The Senior Full Stack Engineer – Platform & Architecture is responsible for hands-on architecture, design, development, and modernization of applications and platforms that support the Wisconsin Medicaid Market. This role operates with a high degree of autonomy and trust, owning solutions end-to-end across the full stack rather than being confined to a single application or technology area.

The Wisconsin Medicaid Market IT team functions as a highly empowered, end-to-end technology organization supporting two acquired health plans with independent core administration systems and technology stacks. As a result, this role works across the full spectrum of core platforms and supporting systems—collaborating with peers, enterprise architecture, and platform partners to define technical direction, align to enterprise standards where appropriate, and reduce system complexity and operational burden.

This position regularly wears multiple hats—building and modernizing software across front-end, back-end, database, integration, and hosting layers; contributing architectural vision; addressing technical debt; and improving reliability and scalability across environments. The engineer will lead by example through hands-on delivery, strong code review practices, and mentoring. Additionally, they will drive software-driven automation, focusing on CI/CD, infrastructure, and security as code. Full Stack Application & Platform Engineering

Deep experience building and modernizing applications across the full stack, including front-end, back-end, data, integrations, and hosting. Strong experience with the Microsoft technology stack (e.g., .NET, SQL Server, Windows-based services) and cloud-hosted solutions (especially Azure). DevOps, Automation, and Infrastructure/Security as Code

Cloud-Native Patterns (Containers & Orchestration)

Reliability, Observability & Operational Excellence

Ability to improve production supportability through monitoring, logging, alerting, and runbook-style documentation; experience reducing incident volume via root-cause analysis, automation, and resilient design.

Cross‑Domain Systems Thinking

Ability to understand and navigate interactions across multiple insurance core systems, platforms, and supporting services, identifying opportunities to simplify workflows and reduce system sprawl.

Architecture‑Minded Engineering

Strong aptitude for evaluating existing solutions, identifying technical debt, and recommending pragmatic architectural improvements that balance near‑term delivery with long‑term sustainability.

Modernization, Reliability & Code Quality

Experience modernizing legacy technologies and improving reliability, performance, and operational supportability through thoughtful design, refactoring, and automation.

AI‑Assisted Development & Code Generation

Comfort actively leveraging AI‑assisted development and code generation tools to improve productivity, code quality, analysis, and learning. Expected to use these tools day‑to‑day and model effective practices for the team. Experience with Humana's approved code generation tooling (e.g., Windsurf/Codeium) is highly preferred; strong aptitude and willingness to learn is equally valued.

Ways of Working & Mindset

Thrives in autonomous, high-trust environments. Comfortable wearing multiple hats, collaborating across teams, influencing through expertise, and remaining hands-on while leading technical direction, mentoring teammates, and partnering with leaders on architectural and process decisions.

Sr. Software Engineer

Summary of Position:

Reporting to the Director of Software Engineering, the Senior Software Engineer owns a system or subsystem within Verisma’s enterprise application and is accountable for its architecture, quality, and operational health. Given a business goal, this individual defines the problem, selects the approach, and leads the work to completion — frequently across several engineers. The Senior Software Engineer sets technical standards on the team and develops the engineers around them. The ideal candidate is a full-stack developer with deep expertise in React, C#, and SQL Server who has carried production systems in a regulated environment and has established sound AI-assisted development practice.

Scope:

A system or subsystem, with decisions that reach adjacent teams. Given a goal rather than a specification, the Senior Software Engineer defines the problem and the approach and is accountable for the long-term maintainability of what they own. Hands-on technical work: approximately 75% of time, including writing code, code review, design review, and technical documentation. The remainder is design, technical planning, and mentorship. Supervisory responsibility: None. Provides technical direction and mentorship without formal reporting authority.

Duties & Responsibilities:

Technical Ownership

  • Take technical ownership of core components of the enterprise application, with a long-term vision for scalability and maintainability
  • Translate business goals into technical designs, identifying constraints and trade-offs and documenting decisions for the team
  • Lead multi-person technical efforts from design through delivery, anticipating and removing risk before it reaches production
  • Design, develop and enhance features using React (TypeScript) on the front end and C#/.NET on the back end
  • Optimize and maintain SQL Server databases, including schema design, performance tuning and data integrity
  • Lead efforts to refactor legacy codebases into modern, modular architectures using cloud-native best practices
  • Implement and automate unit and integration testing strategies to ensure code quality and reliability
  • Establish and uphold technical standards within the team, including code review expectations, secure coding practices, and PHI-handling requirements
  • Participate in on-call rotation and lead resolution of production issues within the owned system
  • Design and evolve event-driven integrations between services, selecting the appropriate messaging pattern for the problem — publish/subscribe, queue-based work distribution, or event sourcing — and defining event contracts, versioning, and delivery guarantees
  • Ensure asynchronous workflows fail safely, accounting for duplicate and out-of-order delivery, poison messages, dead-lettering, and eventual consistency in ways that preserve data integrity and the auditability of PHI

AI-Native Engineering Practice

  • Establish AI usage patterns within the owned system area, including where AI-generated artifacts require additional verification before merge
  • Identify the architectural and security failure modes that AI-generated code reliably introduces, and design review practice that catches them as pull request volume rises

Collaboration & Development

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience required

o C#/.NET for backend development o React with TypeScript and Redux for frontend development o SQL Server (T-SQL, schema design, stored procedures) o Azure (App Services, containers, horizontal scaling, message queues)

  • Demonstrated ability to review AI-generated code critically, able to describe specific instances where generated output was rejected and the reasoning behind it

Janea Systems (USA) is a dynamic team of the best & brightest software engineering specialists and solutions innovators, from around the world. From kernel to cloud, we provide high-impact software development services to Fortune 500 companies.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Solution Architect to join our consulting engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing scalable, production-grade architectures for enterprise software systems. You will work closely with engineering teams and client stakeholders to architect distributed systems, cloud platforms, APIs, and data flows that support business-critical applications. As a senior technical authority, you will define architectural standards, guide complex implementations, and help ensure that the systems we deliver are scalable, secure, reliable, and maintainable in productionenvironments.

Location

Fully Remote / European Residence required OR LATAM Residence

Compensation

Salary

Work Schedule

Full time / Flexible working hours

Reports to

Head of Engineering

Member of

Engineering Team

Key Responsibilities:

Architecture & System Design

  • Design end-to-end architectures for enterprise applications, cloud platforms, and distributed backend systems.
  • Define system-level architectures spanning services, APIs, integrations, and data stores.
  • Ensure high availability, scalability, performance, and cost efficiency across the systems you design.
  • Make and document architectural decisions, including trade-off analysis and technology selection.

Platform & Cloud Engineering

  • Architect cloud-native and hybrid solutions across compute, networking, storage, and identity.
  • Design data flows and integration patterns, including event-driven and streaming architectures.
  • Define approaches to CI/CD, infrastructure as code, observability, and operational readiness.
  • Guide modernization and migration of legacy systems toward maintainable, scalable architectures.

Technical Leadership

  • Provide architectural leadership to engineering teams delivering client projects.
  • Establish best practices for system design, security, integration, observability, and reliability.
  • Conduct architecture and design reviews, and mentor engineers on building scalable software systems.

Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Work closely with backend engineers, data engineers, frontend engineers, and DevOps teams to design cohesive solutions.
  • Partner with client stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into scalable technical architectures.
  • Help guide technical decisions and scoping during project planning and delivery.

Innovation & Thought Leadership

  • Stay current with advancements in distributed systems, cloud platforms, and software architecture.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the scalability, resilience, and efficiency of systems across projects.
  • Contribute to internal knowledge sharing and architectural standards across Janea's engineering teams.

To be considered for this position, you must have the following qualifications:

  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, distributed systems, or backend architecture.
  • 5+ years in an architect or senior technical leadership capacity, owning system design end to end.
  • Strong experience architecting large-scale, production-grade software systems.
  • Deep understanding of microservices, distributed systems, API design, and integration patterns.
  • Strong programming experience in Python, Java, C#, C++, or similar languages.
  • Experience designing systems in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling, data pipelines, and relational and non-relational data stores.
  • Working knowledge of security, performance, observability, and cost as first-class architectural concerns.
  • Excellent system design, problem-solving, and technical leadership skills.
  • Strong written and spoken English communication skills.
  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

Ideal candidates will also have:

  • Experience working in client-facing consulting or professional services environments designing enterprise-scale systems.
  • Experience supporting pre-sales work: solution shaping, technical proposals, and delivery estimation.
  • Experience modernizing or replatforming legacy systems in large enterprises.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform, Pulumi) and platform engineering practices.
  • Experience designing systems under regulatory or compliance constraints (SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, PCI DSS).
  • Experience with high-throughput or low-latency systems, or systems-level and native engineering.
  • Relevant certifications (AWS Solutions Architect Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or equivalent).

Why join Janea? Because world-class talent deserves world-class opportunities. What we offer:

  • Competitive compensation with benefits, paid vacation, and sick leave.
  • The opportunity to work with a globally diverse team of top engineering talent on the industry's toughest engineering challenges.
  • Ultra-flexible working conditions – we provide a generous office equipment allowance so you can work from home, we can also provide you with a desk at an office/coworking facility near you, or use both. No business travel necessary.
  • An enjoyable, start-up work environment, with excellent opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • Flexible working hours – as a remote-first company, our focus has always been on getting the job done well, not when or where it gets done.

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about leading engineering teams to deliver high-quality software solutions that solve complex business challenges?

Do you enjoy mentoring engineers, driving technical excellence, and collaborating across teams to create scalable, innovative products?

About the Business

LexisNexis Risk Solutions is the essential partner in the assessment of risk. Within our Business Services vertical, we offer a multitude of solutions focused on helping businesses of all sizes drive higher revenue growth, maximize operational efficiencies, and improve customer experience. Our solutions help our customers solve difficult problems in the areas of Anti-Money Laundering/Counter Terrorist Financing, Identity Authentication & Verification, Fraud and Credit Risk mitigation and Customer Data Management. You can learn more about LexisNexis Risk at

About our Team

The engineering team develops and supports a portfolio of web and API-based fraud prevention products that process millions of transactions with low-latency, real-time risk scoring and rules-based decisioning. The team also develops and maintains customer and operational tools for transaction management, fraud feedback, and platform administration while generating behavioral intelligence and risk insights at scale. Supporting both real-time and batch processing workloads, the team continuously works on enhancing fraud detection capabilities through configurable, data-driven rules and scoring models that enable rapid innovation and business agility.

About the Role

As a Software Engineering Lead, you will serve as a subject matter expert while leading a team of software engineers in the design, development, and delivery of complex applications and systems. You will combine hands-on technical leadership with people management responsibilities, helping to drive engineering excellence, mentor developers, and deliver business-critical solutions in a collaborative environment.

Responsibilities

  • Interface with other technical personnel or team members to finalize requirements.
  • Write and review portions of detailed specifications for the development of system components of moderate complexity.
  • Complete complex bug fixes.
  • Work closely with other development team members to understand moderately complex product requirements and translate them into software designs.
  • Successfully implement development processes, coding best practices, and code reviews.
  • Operate in various development environments (Agile, Waterfall, CI/CD etc.) while collaborating with key stakeholders.
  • Resolve complex technical issues as necessary.
  • Mentor and/or train entry-level software engineers as directed by department management, ensuring they are knowledgeable in critical aspects of their roles.
  • Keep abreast of new technology developments.
  • Design and work with complex data models.
  • Carry out management responsibilities in accordance with the organization’s policies, procedures, and applicable laws.
  • Ensure all staff is provided with training and resources needed to perform their jobs to the most outstanding degree possible.
  • Manage and encourage new ideas from staff to foster improvements through innovations.
  • Empower the staff to be accountable and responsible for their own actions and decisions.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of Software Engineering experience and 2+ years of software engineering lead experience
  • BS Engineering/Computer Science or equivalent experience required
  • Advanced knowledge of software development methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall, DORA).
  • Strong experience with various resource models such as Managed Services and/or Staff Augmentation.
  • Strong knowledge in industry best practices in external resource development.
  • Ability to partner and lead internal and external technology resources in solving complex business needs.
  • Test-driven development and strong research skills.
  • Strong proficiency with data manipulation language including optimization techniques.
  • Strong understanding of normalized/dimensional data modeling principles.
  • Ability to design and work with complex data models.
  • Strong knowledge of multiple data storage subsystems.
  • Expertise in development languages including but not limited to: C#/.NET, JavaScript, HTML, XML, SQL, Linux.
  • Strong knowledge in industry best practices in development.
  • Knowledge in using and developing applicable tool sets.
  • Ability to write and review portions of detailed specifications for the development of complex system components.
  • Strong skills in setting, communicating, implementing, and achieving business objectives and goals through the direct management of others.
  • Strong organization/project planning, time management, and change management skills across multiple functional groups and departments, and strong delegation skills involving prioritizing and reprioritizing projects and managing projects of various size and complexity.
  • Strong problem-solving experience involving leading teams in identifying, researching, and coordinating the resources necessary to effectively troubleshoot/diagnose complex project issues; prior success extracting/translating findings into alternatives/solutions; and identifying risks/impacts and schedule adjustments to facilitate management decision-making.
  • Strong communication (verbal and written) and customer service skills. Strong interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills applicable to a wide audience including senior and executive management, customers, etc., including diction/terminology and presenting information in a concise and effective manner to clients, management, and various departments using assorted communication mediums.

jobs.title: Expert Software Engineer
jobs.excerpt: At Ensono, our Purpose is to be a relentless ally, disrupting the status quo and unleashing our clients to Do Great Things!
jobs.description:
At Ensono, our Purpose is to be a relentless ally, disrupting the status quo and unleashing our clients to Do Great Things! We enable our clients to achieve key business outcomes that reshape how our world runs. As an expert technology adviser and managed service provider with cross-platform certifications, Ensono empowers our clients to keep up with continuous change and embrace innovation.

We can Do Great Things because we have great Associates. The Ensono Core Values unify our diverse talents and are woven into how we do business. These five traits are the key to achieving our purpose.

Honesty – Reliability – Curiosity – Collaboration - Passion

About the role and what you'll be doing:

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced C++ Expert Engineer with 10+ years years of hands-on, production-level experience to join our engineering team. In this role, the candidate will design, develop, and maintain high-performance, production-grade C++ systems. The candidate will play a key technical leadership role — driving architectural decisions, mentoring peers, and championing best practices across the software development lifecycle.

  • Architect, develop, and maintain complex, high-performance applications in C++ (C++11/14/17/20 and beyond)
  • Take ownership of critical system components with a focus on reliability, scalability, and performance
  • Design and implement solutions involving advanced memory management and concurrent/multithreaded architecture
  • Lead code reviews and enforce coding standards and best practices across the team
  • Define and maintain CMake-based build systems and manage multi-platform build configurations
  • Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines and Docker-based containerisation workflows
  • Diagnose and resolve complex issues using tools such as GDB and Valgrind; lead performance profiling and tuning initiatives
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams in a Linux-based development environment
  • Contribute to and maintain automation scripts using Python and shell scripting
  • Interact with relational data sources using SQL where required
  • Manage source code, branching strategies, and release workflows using Git
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers; drive technical growth across the team
  • Participate in system design discussions, technical planning, and effort estimation

We want all new Associates to succeed in their roles at Ensono. That's why we've outlined the job requirements below. To be considered for this role, it's important that you meet all Required Qualifications. If you do not meet all of the Preferred Qualifications, we still encourage you to apply.

Required Qualifications

  • Expert understanding of dynamic memory allocation, RAII, smart pointers (unique_ptr, shared_ptr, weak_ptr)
  • Experience diagnosing and resolving memory leaks, dangling pointers, and buffer overflows
  • Familiarity with custom allocators and memory pool strategies
  • Strong command of the C++ threading model (std::thread, std::mutex, std::atomic, std::condition_variable)
  • Experience with lock-free and wait-free programming patterns
  • Ability to identify and resolve race conditions, deadlocks, and thread-safety issues
  • Expert-level experience with CMake for cross-platform build configuration
  • Proficiency with Docker for containerised development and deployment environments
  • Hands-on experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions)
  • Advanced use of GDB for low-level debugging and post-mortem analysis
  • Proficiency with Valgrind (Memcheck, Helgrind, Callgrind) for memory and thread analysis
  • Bachelor's or master’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline
  • Equivalent industry experience will be considered in lieu of formal education
  • Soft Skills: Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Why Ensono?

Ensono is a place to make better happen – for our clients and for your career. You can do great things through innovation or collaboration, by learning or volunteering, or to promote diversity and inclusion. You can do great things for your own health or for a healthier planet. Whatever it means to you to do great things we want Ensono to be the place you can do it.

We are a client-facing business, but we do encourage clients to allow us to work remotely most of the time so if you are not required to be on a client site, you can choose to work from home or in our Ensono offices.

Some of our benefits include:

  • Unlimited Paid Days Off
  • Three health plan options
  • 401k with company match
  • Eligibility for dental, vision, short and long-term disability, life and AD&D coverage, and flexible spending accounts
  • Family Forming Benefit including fertility coverage and adoption/surrogacy reimbursement
  • Paid childbearing and paternal leave
  • Education Reimbursement, Student Loan Assistance or 529 College Funding
  • Sabbatical leave
  • Wellness program
  • Flexible work schedule

As of the date of this posting, a good faith estimate of the current pay scale for this role is $130,000 to 150,000 annually based on a full-time schedule. Please note that placement in the range may vary based on numerous factors including but not limited to skills, experience, internal equity, and business needs. In addition to base salary, other compensation programs, depending on eligibility, includean annual bonus plan based on company and individual performanceand an equity grant under our Associate Equity Appreciation Program.

Ensono is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. We are committed to providing equal employment to our Associates and building a diverse and inclusive workforce. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable law.
